078136.item_story_marketing:
It’s hard not to feel like a kid again when biting into a crisp chocolate chip cookie. The butteriness of the cookie, the softness of the chocolate, even the sound of the crunch all have a tendency to take one back to a simpler time. Our tasting panel certainly found that to be true of Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Crispy & Crunchy Chocolate Chip Cookies, every bite of which offer all the time-transporting tastes and textures you could want in a classic chocolate cookie—and all without the inclusion of any gluten.

There used to be a time when folks felt the need to qualify gluten-free foods as being “good...for gluten free.” Nowadays, though, gluten free alternatives have made such strides that it practically goes without saying: these Chocolate Chip Cookies aren’t just good for gluten free—they’re good, period! And especially so when packed in school lunches, enjoyed as an afternoon snack, or used to make creamy ice cream sandwiches. We recommend pairing a Cookie or two with a glass of ice-cold milk, or your favorite non-dairy beverage, to truly maximize that like-a-kid-again feeling.

078137.item_story_marketing:
Of all the styles of sparkling wine the world has to offer, you’d be hard pressed to find a more versatile variety than Prosecco. Light, floral, and fruity, it serves equally well before, during, and after a meal, enjoyed just as it is, or mixed into a mimosa or other fizzy cocktail. And that’s precisely why we’re partnering with a prominent Prosecco provider to present, for the first time, our very own Trader Joe’s Prosecco.

Made within the DOC confines of northeastern Italy, this is a truly proper Prosecco. Each brisk, bubbly sip starts with a bouquet of wisteria flower and freshly sliced apples, which leads gracefully into well-balanced notes of stone fruit and toasted almond. It’s a superb sparkler to keep on hand for everything from birthday brunches to romantic Valentine’s dinner dates to spontaneous celebrations.

078138.item_story_marketing:
Question: How can you tell if a sandwich is successful? Answer: It’s on a roll. And not just any roll—Trader Joe’s Sandwich Rolls. To be clear, our bakery section has been on a roll lately (idomatically speaking), so there are many Trader Joe’s breads of different shapes and sizes that will make a stellar sandwich. Still, these Artisan Style Rolls bring something particularly special to the Sandwich table!

The Canadian bakery that makes these sub-shaped Rolls for us uses a slow and gentle fermentation to achieve an airy crumb. The soft insides are complemented by a hearty exterior that can support all kinds of cold cuts and condiments—not to mention a healthy helping of meatballs, sauce, and melty cheese.

You’ll find these Sandwich Rolls to be equally delicious, whether you’re enjoying a cold Italian grinder, or a hot Philly cheesesteak. And when lightly toasted, they develop a wonderfully thin, crisp crust. They can also be pressed quite successfully in a panini grill if you’re craving a traditional Cubano... We hate to stop when we’re on a roll, but... all that’s really left to say is: stop by our bakery shelves today and pick up a twelve-ounce bag of four Trader Joe’s Sandwich Rolls!

078145.item_story_marketing:
No matter how much we may procrastinate, and try as we might to avoid it, there’s simply no getting around it—sooner or later, the laundry must get done. That’s why we’re doing our part to ameliorate this inevitability with a selection of laundry solutions, including our Free & Clear Liquid Laundry Detergent, and now, our totally non-liquid Trader Joe’s Free & Clear Laundry Detergent Sheets. Made with a mix of stain-fighting protease enzymes, these water-soluble Detergent Sheets act just like laundry pods—just place one in your washer before adding a load of laundry—and also happen to be totally free of dyes, fragrances, optical brighteners, phthalates, or phosphates.

Suitable for use in both regular and high-efficiency (HE) washing machines, each box of Trader Joe’s Free & Clear Laundry Detergent Sheets contains 32 individual Sheets, making it a convenient and cost-effective way to get your clothes clean—especially considering that smaller and less-soiled loads can be done with half a Sheet. We also like the fact that a box takes up considerably less room than a container of liquid detergent or laundry pods. Because if the laundry indeed must get done, we’re in favor of any thing that might make it a little easier.

078168.item_story_marketing:
We certainly don’t mean to cast any aspersions, but we’ve tried our fair share of other cold-pressed juices and juice shots out there, and, in the spirit of “if you can’t say something nice, don’t say anything at all,” well... we’ll leave it at that. When we go for a juice shot, we like a lot of flavor, a lot of freshness, and not a large price tag. That’s why we’re excited to bring Trader Joe’s Organic Energy Juice Shots to our fridge. Made with a mix of organic orange juice, mango purée, and spinach juice, as well as organic green tea extract, each Shot contains just about the same amount of caffeine as a cup of cooffee, and all for around half the price you’d pay for that same cup of coffee at your corner café.

Bottled under high pressure processing (HPP) to maintain the safety of the juice and quality of the flavor, these Shots are perfectly portioned and ready to toss into a backpack, gym bag or lunch box for a sweet and tropical boost of Energy. We find that they’re especially useful for bringing along on your morning commute, on a hike, or during a long plane ride or road trip—any ocassion, really, where a green tea extract-powered pick-me-up might prove helpful.

078175.item_story_marketing:
Much like people, we find that it’s what’s on the inside of a sandwich that truly counts. That said, it’s also true that what’s inside the inside of a sandwich is just as important. That’s why, when we set out to create Trader Joe’s Delicatessen Sliced Roast Beef, we made sure that our supplier didn’t add any nitrates or nitrites—in fact, each slice only contains the nitrates and nitrites that naturally occur in sea salt. You could call that being ingredient-conscious—we like to think of it as an acute appreciation of inner beauty.

Lightly seasoned with vinegar powder & dried garlic, and sliced to an easy-to-stack, medium-to-thin thickness, our Sliced Roast Beef is an ideal inclusion for your next homemade sandwich. We find that its savory flavor and tender, toothsome texture are especially suited for pairing with soft, spongy breads (like our sweet and satisfying Brioche Buns) and tangy, allium-forward condiments (like our Aioli Garlic Mustard Sauce). And for an easy midnight snack or post-workout protein boost, simply roll a slice up with your favorite cheese, and enjoy.

078222.item_story_marketing:
When it comes to classic, heat-n-eat fingerfoods with a kick, Trader Joe’s Spicy Chicken Nuggets don’t just talk the talk—they strut their Spicy stuff! They’re made with all-natural Chicken breast and rib meat, from hens raised on all-vegetarian feed and never given antibiotics or hormones. The bite-sized, classically Nugget- shaped patties are breaded with wheat, rice and corn flours, then covered in a cayenne-based hot sauce and lightly fried to a golden brown. (Hints of garlic and vinegar make the sauce as savory and tangy as it is Spicy, so you can think of them as the fiery lovechild[ren] of classic Chicken Nuggets and game-day hot wings.)

Like we said, these Nugs bring the heat, and since they’re fully cooked and refrigerated (not frozen), they only need a few minutes in the air fryer, oven, or microwave before they’re ready to go. And by “ready to go,” we mean ready to dip. For heat-seekers craving even more savory, spicy flavor, try dipping them in Thick, Bold & Spicy Red Sauce, Hot Honey Mustard Dressing or Spicy Honey Sauce; for Nugget-noshers looking to take a walk on the milder side, go with Organic Kansas City Style BBQ sauce or Buttermilk Ranch Dressing... or whatever sauce suits the mood!

078268.item_story_marketing:
Looking for a high-quality gluten free pasta? Perhaps a pasta with a bit more protein? Or is fiber what you’re favoring these days? Trader Joe’s Chickpea Fusilli Pasta checks all these boxes—and more!

Constructed from a blend of chickpeas and tapioca flour, and formed into a classic corkscrew shape, this gluten free Pasta boasts an impressive 11 grams of protein and six grams of fiber per serving—yes! Just as impressive? The Pasta’s toothsome texture makes it an ideal partner to a tangy tomato sauce or creamy alfredo any night of the week, and it’s hearty enough to hold up in a pasta salad with TJ’s French Vinaigrette with Shallots, Marinated Grilled Artichoke Halves, and chunks of Prosciutto Wrapped Fresh Mozzarella Cheese.

We’re offering Chickpea Fusilli Pasta in 12-ounce boxes, every day—that’s 50% more pasta than similar boxes found elsewhere, for a mere fraction of the price. In other words, if you’re looking for value—check!

078275.item_story_marketing:
Rich and juicy with savory-sweet flavor, it’s no wonder that Trader Joe’s BBQ Teriyaki Chicken has been a customer favorite since 2004. It’s a complete meal alongside white rice and steamed veggies, but on days you can’t be bothered to take out the rice cooker and the steamer basket, Teriyaki Chicken Bowls make for an extra speedy and equally delicious alternative.

Much like the classic Japanese preparations of Teriyaki Chicken, we like to keep it simple. Establishing the foundation is chunks of dark Chicken thigh meat—think dense and juicy, with especially Chicken-y flavor. As for the sauce, ginger, garlic, and lime juice lend aromatic tang, while soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, and sugar contribute quintessentially sweet, umami-laden Teriyaki flavor.

To make it a complete meal, we lay the Chicken over a bed of Calrose rice, alongside broccoli, carrots, and bok choy. It’s an all-in-one lunch or dinner that heats from frozen in the microwave in about four minutes. If you’ve got a second to spare, garnish your Bowl with sesame seeds and sliced green onions, or a squirt of Sriracha Sauce for a spicy kick.

078276.item_story_marketing:
You’ve got places to go, people to see, and, more likely than not, stuff you’ve got to bring with you. That’s one reason why we’ve put so much effort into creating fun and functional reusable bags over the years (and inadvertently created a few Mini Tote crazes along the way...). Because wherever you’ve got to go, you’ll need some support along the way. Our newest addition to our reusable bag lineup, Trader Joe’s Stand- Up Collapsible Grocery Tote Bag, ups that support even more, with a sturdy structure that will both Stand Up on its own, preventing spillage in a moving car, bus, or bicycle basket, and is fully Collapsible for ease of storage when not in use. Amazing!

Crafted for us by an expert Tote maker in Vietnam, these Bags are a particularly practical way to get your Groceries to and fro. And because one of our other reasons we’ve put so much effort into fun and functional reusable bags is so that you can carry your stuff in style, each of these Totes is covered in a vibrant, colorful, eye-catching design. They’re great for everything from everyday Grocery use, packing up books when moving, or for giving to friends and family as a remarkably pragmatic gift.

078278.item_story_marketing:
The full panoply (or should we say, panapple-y) of Trader Joe’s Organic Fruit Sauce Crushers includes Apple Strawberry, Apple Mango, Apple Banana, Apple Carrot, and of course the original, Apple. Now, our latest Crush includes a fall-famous spice that’s about as apple-friendly as one could be!

Trader Joe’s Organic Apple Cinnamon Fruit Sauce Crushers are simple in construction, and profoundly classic on the palate. It only takes three ingredients to create this taste: organic apple purée, organic cinnamon powder, and ascorbic acid (to maintain color). Unscrew the top, raise it to your mouth, and give it a gentle squeeze. You’ll experience sweet, crushed Apple, and warm, woody Cinnamon—blended into a Fruit Sauce that is ideal for an anytime snack, and enticing for people of all ages.

Unopened, each 3.17-ounce pouch is shelf-stable, which means you can take them on an outing where refrigeration may be hard to come by. You can also store extra in your pantry, so you’re never out. Add a refreshing aspect to these Crushers by keeping them chilled in your fridge. You might even freeze some for a super-cool snack when you’re enjoying the summer sun!

078280.item_story_marketing:
During the autumn and winter months, one of our favorite ways to add a bit of savory flavor and a touch of crunchy texture to a dish is our Gourmet Fried Onion Pieces, which you might be most familiar with for their role in a classic green bean casserole. Of course, we certainly don’t stop enjoying adding savory flavor and crunchy texture to dishes during the rest of the year. That’s where Trader Joe’s Crispy Jalapeño Pieces come in. Available in our stores all year round, these captivatingly Crispy bits provide some satisfying savoriness and crunch to anything they’re added to, as well as a nice, even level of Jalapeño heat.

These crisps are made for us by a supplier in Thailand, who thinly slices and lightly batters Jalapeño peppers, then fries them to a crisp, golden brown. Just like their onion-based counterparts, we find that these Crispy Jalapeño Pieces are particularly great for adding texture to casseroles and bakes (just think of a Jalapeño- powered green bean casserole or baked mac & cheese!), but that’s hardly where we’d stop. We recommend using them as a topping for salad, sandwiches, hot dogs, rice bowls, roasted veggies, egg scrambles, shepherd’s pie—you name it! And if you’re not necessarily in a cooking mood, they also make an excellent snack, right out of the pouch.

078285.item_story_marketing:
Returning to our shelves after a brief (but certainly not unnoticed!) hiatus, Trader Joe’s Turkey Chili with Beans is back, brought to us by a new supplier with a new recipe that, dare we say, improves upon the already- estimable original. They start with a base of ground turkey, crushed tomatoes, and red beans, then season it all with diced green chile peppers and jalapeños, onions, and a suite of classic chili seasonings including garlic powder, cumin, and oregano. It all results in a superlatively hearty and satisfying home-style Chili that’s equally excellent as an entrée or topping.

Ready in mere minutes when heated in the microwave or on the stovetop, our Turkey Chili with Beans might be one of the easiest (and most cost-effective) options for a quick weekend lunch that you’ll ever find on our grocery shelves. It can be enjoyed totally on its own, or accessorized with all sorts of condiments and toppings: we’re particularly partial to a nice dollop of Sour Cream, some diced onions or sliced scallions, and, for those with a flair for the fiery, plenty of Chunky Garlic & Jalapeño Hot Sauce. Speaking of toppings, this Chili’s chunky consistency and mix of meaty and tender textures also makes it great for ladling over hot dogs and hamburgers—you can even pair it with a Spicy Jalapeño Chicken Sausage or Ground Turkey patty if you want to keep things poultry-specific.

078297.item_story_marketing:
Named for the Cantonese word for “seafood,” hoisin sauce gets its moniker not by virtue of containing seafood as an ingredient (it traditionally contains no animal-derived products, sea-based or not), nor by being specifically designed for serving with seafood (although it is, indeed, great with fish.) Rather, its title comes from the fact that its rich aromas and umami undertones evoke an ineffable, subtly seafood-y quality that’s celebrated in Szechuan cuisine. To that, we’d also add that a great hoisin sauce, like Trader Joe’s Hoisin Sauce, also expresses a certain sticky sweetness, savory character, and velvety texture that make it one of the more versatile condiments you’ll ever find.

Made for us by a supplier in Thailand, who starts with a base of fermented soy bean paste, black sesame paste, and brown sugar, each batch of our full-flavored Hoisin Sauce is seasoned with a blend of aromatic spices like star anise, garlic powder, coriander seed, and Szechuan peppercorns. You may have had hoisin with roast duck, spring rolls, and noodle soups before—all excellent pairings, but that’s hardly where we’d stop. We recommend drizzling our Hoisin over stir-fried vegetables, fried rice, bánh mì sandwiches, burgers, barbecued ribs, grilled shrimp or salmon, or even just using it as a sweet and savory dip for Fries.

078301.item_story_marketing:
Our supplier built this special bag of Trader Joe’s Vegetable Root Chips from the ground up, literally. They specially pick a unique, colorful collection of exotic root vegetables, an exciting mix with old favorites like sweet potato, and for some color variety, we used more sweet potato, colored with beet juice. We included more Root vegetables, of course – taro, a sweet, pale colored root native to Asia, and batata, basically a white sweet potato, and last but most definitely not least, parsnips, a root vegetable closely related to carrots, but faint in color. The Vegetables are picked and reconstructed into the form of tasty Chips. They are crunchy, crispy, and naturally pretty sweet too. We are seriously “rooting” for these chips!

From the first bite, you’ll transform any occasion into a gourmet snacking experience. The elegant colors and distinctive flavors are the perfect complement to any meal. Pair alongside any of our other veggie snacks and protein options for an all-inclusive BBQ or everyday lunch or dinner. But also feel free to start the veggie root party for one, by cracking open your own bag and digging in as they are for an anytime snack.

078302.item_story_marketing:
Garlic just keeps on giving, doesn’t it? It seems no matter its state—raw and minced, roughly chopped and sautéed, or whole and slowly roasted into confit—it has something wonderful to offer one’s tastebuds. And as Trader Joe’s Crispy Garlic ably demonstrates, when sliced thin and fried to a glorious golden brown, garlic’s gifts easily extend into the textural realm, too. We tried plenty of options before finding this iteration of Crispy Garlic, which is brought to us by an expert supplier in Thailand. Only their Crispy Garlic was able to capture that flavorful-but-not-bitter, nicely-fried-but-not-tough, crunchy-but-still-melt-in-your-mouth quality that our tasting panel adored. We think you’ll adore it, too.

Trader Joe’s Crispy Garlic is excellent as a topping on stir-fries, salads, and scrambled eggs; pizzas, pastas, and pad Thai; or even burgers, baked potatoes, and bánh mi. It can be mixed into homemade cheesy dips and casseroles, sprinkled over noodle dishes or roasted veggies, or even just enjoyed over a bowl of freshly made rice. Frankly, there’s not really a savory dish we wouldn’t add Crispy Garlic to, and once you get your hands on a pouch, we’re sure you’ll feel the same way. They’re available in our grocery aisle, every day.

078355.item_story_marketing:
In 1353, the Italian poet and writer Giovanni Boccaccio dreamed up a “mountain, all of grated Parmesan cheese” in his masterpiece The Decameron…and almost seven hundred years later, we’re still dreaming of mountains of Grated Parmesan Cheese. Thankfully, you don’t have to travel all the way to the Italian provinces of Parma and Reggio Emilia; our suppliers right here in the States have you covered.

Trader Joe’s Grated Parmesan is sure to enhance any dish you add it to with its rich and roundly nutty flavor. And we really do mean any dish—we can hardly think of a meal that wouldn’t do with a bit of extra bit of Parmesan-powered umami. It adds a soupçon of savoriness to a bowl of soup, a bit of pizzazz to a pizza, a little something extra to a salad, and, of course, a nice pop of flavor to practically any pasta. And since it’s so conveniently pre-Grated, it’s all the more handy to keep in your fridge for pre-planned and ad hoc applications alike.
078355.item_story_qil:
In 1353, the Italian poet and writer Giovanni Boccaccio dreamed up a "mountain, all of grated Parmesan 
cheese" in his masterpiece The Decameron¿almost seven hundred years later, we're still dreaming of mountains 
of Grated Parmesan Cheese. Thankfully, you don't have to travel all the way to the provinces of Parma and 
Reggio Emilia, Italy; the dairy wizards of Plymouth, Wisconsin have you covered.
 
Trader Joe's Grated Parmesan is sure to enhance any dish you add it to with its signature sharp, salty flavor. 
Sourced from fourth-generation Wisconsin cheesemakers operating since 1939, all of the milk used to make 
this Parmesan comes from dairy farms no further than 60 miles from the cheesemaking facilities.
 
With that combination of local milk and generational expertise, you'll find yourself sprinkling this beloved 
great-tasting, Grated Parmesan hither and yon with confidence! On your favorite pasta, your favorite salad,  
or your favorite soup¿anyone else craving Parmesan garlic bread all of a sudden?

Grated Parmesan Cheese

078384.item_story_marketing:
Cool, mellow, and just a touch sweet, Monterey Jack is one of those cheeses that pretty much everyone can agree on—why, even its name makes it sound like a fundamentally friendly fellow. One of our favorite aspects of a good Monterey Jack is how well it serves as a canvas to other flavors—Pepper Jack being one of its most popular permutations. Which lead us to think: what other savory sensations might Monterey Jack mingle well with? That, in turn, lead to some epicurean experimentation, which happily lead to Trader Joe’s Sliced Black Truffle Monterey Jack Cheese.

It’s crafted for us by an expert cheesemaker in Wisconsin, who infuses their Jack with bits of black summer truffle before cutting it into sandwich-ready slices. Every bite is savory and satisfying, with a toothsome texture and a distinct touch of truffle-y, umami oomph that makes it especially great for grilled cheeses, patty melts, and quesadillas. Try it on a burger, melted into an omelet, or, if you’d like a little complementary savory-sweet situation, alongisde some Fresh Cut Cantaloupe Chunks.

Our Dutch supplier starts with a traditional, young Gouda base. On its own, it’s pleasantly mellow and smooth. Incorporate Walnut pieces, however, and it becomes a satisfying symphony of contrasting flavors and textures. Each bite is mild yet earthy, creamy yet crunchy, and undeniably delicious.

Gouda is quite the versatile cheese, and Gouda with Walnuts is no exception. Serve it on a cheese board featuring fresh apple slices and Pumpkin Cranberry Crisps, with a glass of Pinot Noir. Or, sandwich slices of Gouda, Oven Roasted Turkey Breast, Organic Apricot Preserves, and arugula between slices of Ciabatta Demi-Baguette, then toast to panini perfection. You’ll find Gouda with Walnuts in the cheese section for a limited time—pick up a wedge while supplies last!

078428.item_story_marketing:
It feels like we’ve all had that experience where we’re at a restaurant, enjoying a burger, or a rice bowl, or some manner of crispy appetizer, when we suddenly realize that the dish itself is rather ho-hum, and it’s the sauce it’s served with that we really like. Well, Trader Joe’s Spicy Dynamite Sauce is that sauce. Not literally, of course, but it is our version of those savory, sweet, and spicy catch-all condiments you encounter out in the world that make you think “why don’t they just bottle and sell this?” We did, dear reader. We did.

Once harvested, they’re carefully dried in the summer sun by our trusted Turkish apricot supplier (and by Mother Nature, of course). What really makes these Dried Apricots Simply Amazing is the final step, which involves a gentle steaming. This unique method yields unbelievably Soft Apricots with a tender, chewy, almost velvety texture. Each bite of these reddish gems presents a floral, candy-like quality that is tempered by a pleasant tang.

Because they are harvest-dependent, we’re offering Trader Joe’s Simply Amazing Soft Dried Apricots only for a limited time. When in season, you’ll find them on our shelves alongside our simply amazing assortment of dried fruits and nuts.

078466.item_story_marketing:
Ever since we started carrying wines—lo, those many decades ago—we’ve made it our mission to ensure that every time you make the trek to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s wine shop, you’ll find something wonderful. Whether it’s an everyday gem or one of our limited-quantity Trader Joe’s Reserve wines, there’s always something reliably fantastic to try—and for an unimpeachably excellent value, too. Now, we’re continuing that mission with the introduction of Trading Post by Trader Joe’s. Made exclusively for us by a trusted winery partner in the heart of Napa Valley, you can think of the Trading Post label as the best of both worlds among our wine selection, combining the same outstanding quality and value of our limited-run Reserve wines with the consistent availability of our everyday favorites.

For the Trading Post’s inaugural outing, we’re offering a characteristically robust and elegant Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon. With rich and alluring aromatics of black cherry, vanilla, and tobacco, and a complex profile of ripe fruit, baking spice, and toasty oak, it’s precisely the kind of jammy Cab that made Napa famous. Bold, yet easy-drinking, with a long, languid, satisfying finish, it serves just as well paired with a seared steak or hearty stew as it does completely on its own, enjoyed with a book, movie, or good company.

078490.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s has picked a peck of Pickled Jalapeño Pepper Slices—pray tell, how many piquant, Pickled Peppers will you procure? While you consider that tongue-twister, let us elaborate on the twisty, tangy, tongue-scorching flavors that these Jalapeños deliver. Each jar is packed with Jalapeño Peppers, Sliced to an ideal thickness for using as a topping, then filled with a delightfully tart, vinegar-based brine. In that brine, the Jalapeños take on some of that tangy flavor, a tender texture, and also get a chance to mellow out, giving them a nice, easy-going (yet still fun and fiery) level of heat.

We’re prone to placing these Pickled Peppers on a slice of pizza, a homemade burger or sandwich, or anything else that could do with a pleasant little pop of heat. They make a natural fit for a platter of nachos, an awesome choice for an omelet, and a terrific topper to a bowlful (or baked potato-ful) of Turkey Chili with Beans. We could go on all day about how these Pickled Jalapeño Slices can elevate everything from avocado toast to zucchini bread, but we’re sure that all the heat-seekers out there will already have their favorites picked out—a whole peck of favorites, no doubt.

078495.item_story_marketing:
We love a good twist as much as anyone—especially if the twist happens to come in the form of an aromatic infusion of turmeric. And as luck would have it, that’s precisely what you’ll find in every sip of Trader Joe’s Organic Turmeric Twist. It’s made with a base of cold-pressed organic orange and carrot juices, along with a touch of organic apple and lemon juices for sweetness and stability. While that would be delicious enough on its own, here’s where things take a Twist: our supplier brightens each batch with cold-pressed organic ginger for some spice, then finishes it off with cold-pressed organic turmeric for some elegant earthiness and a glorious, golden orange hue.

Sweet, tangy, and remarkably refreshing, our Organic Turmeric Twist is best served nice and chilled, either right out of the bottle or in a glass with ice. Made entirely from cold-pressed juices (and no added sugars, we should mention), we find that its mix of citric, carrot-y, and herbaceous notes makes it ideal for sipping after a run, hike, or gym session. That said, we’re also big fans of pairing it with a to-go sandwich or salad (our Caesar Salad with Salmon comes to mind) for a working lunch.

078521.item_story_marketing:
Direct from the “why hadn’t we thought of that before?” department and right into our candy section come Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Covered Crunchy Corn Kernels! Made for us by an esteemed Colombian chocolatier, these sweet, savory, oh-so-satisfyingly Crunchy morsels of roasty, toasty Corn smothered in rich Dark Chocolate represent a snacking synthesis that we’re utterly excited to explore. Too often solely relegated to the realm of road-trip or sports-spectation snacking, the lightly salty edge and crisp texture of a Crunchy Corn Kernel makes a surprisingly intuitive foil to the subtly fruity and floral undertones of Colombian Dark Chocolate, forging ahead on a fun, flavorful, confectionary frontier.

Ideal for practically any situation that calls for sweet snacking, we can’t wait for you to enjoy these Dark Chocolate Covered Crunchy Corn Kernels while enjoying a board game with friends, reading a book on a lazy weekend, bingewatching the latest streaming sensation, or even simply munching by the handful whenever the mood suits you. And for those who’d like to experiment even further on the sweet-savory spectrum, we recommend sprinkling a few Kernels over a bowl of French Vanilla Ice Cream along with some flaky sea salt.

078522.item_story_marketing: Of all the various fresh pumpkins and decorative gourds we sell in the autumn, what do Snowball Pumpkins (literally) bring to the table? First, they’re white; like, ghostly white. Unlike other light-colored pumpkin varieties, these don’t yellow under the sun. Second, they’re round; like, really round. They’re not perfect spheres, mind you, but they’re much rounder than your average pumpkin. Third, their relatively small size is ideal for cooking; like, emphatically ideal for cooking! Due to their beautiful shape and color, nutty and sweet Snowball Pumpkins make great roasting vessels. Cut out a “lid,” scoop out the seeds, and fill with your favorite holiday stuffing components—then bake with the top on until knife-tender. Finally, remove the lid and serve (one per person), for a hearty and delicious autumnal meal. (And don’t forget to eat the bowl!)
078522.name: HOL A - PUMPKIN SNOWBALL

078523.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Farfalle Pasta with Italian Chicken Sausage starts with durum wheat Farfalle, a pasta shape not yet featured among our frozen pastas. These “bowties” are covered in a rich & spicy tomato sauce and paired with crumbles of savory Italian Chicken Sausage. To prepare, simply cook the Pasta from frozen according to the package instructions, plate it up, and enjoy!

This Pasta dish is Spicy, but if you’re craving even more heat, try adding a spoonful of Italian Bomba Hot Pepper Sauce. And if you want to add some fresh flair, we recommend some torn leaves of Organic Basil, and a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese. With or without these extras, you’re in for a tasty meal... and we guarantee you won’t have to worry about the leftovers.

078527.item_story_marketing:
The galette is a treasured tradition among French bakers, dating back over a thousand years to the time of the Norman Dynasty. While we in the States might most immediately think of fruit pies with partially folded edges when we hear the word “galette,” the French consider the galette a whole category of baked good, ranging in shapes, sizes, and forms that include sweet cakes, savory flatbreads, ridged waffles and even buttery cookies. Inspired by a beloved regional variation of galette known as Broyés du Poitou, Trader Joe’s French Galettes Butter Cookies are made especially for us by an esteemed French bakery near the historic city of Nantes. They use a traditional recipe that includes French cultured butter to produce a satisfyingly crisp exterior, and crumbly, wonderfully melt-in-your-mouth interior. 

A delicious dessert or sweet snack in practically any context, we particularly enjoy our French Galettes Butter Cookies when paired with a hot cup of coffee or tea. Simple, sweet (but not too sweet), and texturally toothsome, they make a great companion to a bowl of ice cream or platter of fresh cut fruit. And since each box contains twelve Cookies, they’re great for sharing when you’ve got folks over for dinner—if you haven’t already eaten them all yourself, of course.

078555.item_story_marketing:
Savory garlic, zesty ginger and preservative-free soy sauce form the flavor base for this unique, Asian-style sauce that’s become a mainstay in our grocery aisle. You might think it’s just another teriyaki sauce – you’d be wrong. It’s so much more than that. In addition to its sweet, savory, and spicy ingredients, where this sauce veers from the everyday is in the addition of sesame seeds to the mix. The seeds add flavor and texture, setting Trader Joe’s Soyaki quite apart from the crowd. Remember to give the bottle a good shake before using – this will ensure the seeds are dispersed throughout the sauce, ensuring maximum seed exposure and an excellent Soyaki experience.

Try Trader Joe’s Soyaki as a marinade for chicken, beef, pork or shrimp – the slightly sweet flavor of the sauce is equally delicious grilled, broiled, pan sautéed or baked. Use it as a stir-fry sauce for veggies and tofu. It makes a good dip for gyoza or shu mai. You may even find yourself drinking it straight from the bottle – we’re not recommending this, but who are we to judge?

078557.item_story_marketing:
Ah, Thai curry, the hearty, comfort food dish of Southeastern Asia. And while we know how capable you are of sourcing, baking, and blending all the ingredients needed for a great Thai curry, Trader Joe’s Thai Style Yellow Curry Sauce is looking to take the load off of your shoulders and get lip-smackingly piquant curry in a bowl and on your dining table in a few minutes flat.

Traditional curry colorings used to be as simple as indicating the level of spice ready to be unleashed within (ranging from red - hot, yellow - mild, green - subtle zest). But as chefs began whipping more unique flavors into their curries, each color became associated with more than just their heat content. In the case of Trader Joe’s Thai Yellow Curry Sauce, we’ve honored the modern recipe of a zesty, ginger-forward sauce packed full of onion and garlic purées. With this sauce you can make a traditional yellow curry dish in no time! Cook up some meat, poultry, tofu, or veggies until done, stir in our Thai Style Yellow Curry Sauce, simmer until heated through, and serve on a bed of rice.

078576.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s French Vanilla Ice Cream is a super premium vanilla ice cream that talks the talk - we don’t mean French; we mean the language of flavor! Our rich French Vanilla Ice Cream has an unmistakably creamy-custard texture that can be enjoyed plain or used as a companion for any combination of cookies, candies, and chocolates.

What makes a quart of French vanilla ice cream “French”, you ask? It has nothing to do with the vanilla bean itself (which is only grown near the equator, not near France at all); it merely means that the ice cream begins with a base that contains egg yolks, unlike regular vanilla ice cream. Trader Joe’s French Vanilla Ice Cream is made in this French tradition, which ultimately lends a pale-yellow color and a richer, smoother consistency than traditional vanilla ice cream. Notice that super premium designation? To get there, an ice cream must have less than 50% overrun, meaning that one gallon of mix would create no more than one and a half gallons of finished ice cream. Trader Joe’s French Vanilla Ice Cream has 26% overrun - aka dense, super SUPER premium ice cream!

078580.item_story_marketing:
This is why people scream for ice cream. Trader Joe’s Coffee Bean Blast Ice Cream is, in our most humble opinion, the very best coffee ice cream available anywhere on planet Earth. Or beyond, on other planets whose populations value ice cream. Lest you think we hyperbolize – which we would never, ever do – we’re about to tell you exactly what makes this ice cream so special.

First and foremost, our Coffee Bean Blast Ice Cream has very low overrun. Overrun, in ice cream speak, is the amount of air that’s whipped into the ice cream – the higher the overrun, the lower quality the ice cream. Because there is so little air in this ice cream, it is thicker, richer and creamier than lesser quality ice creams. And then there’s the flavor. Big WOW here. Some coffee ice creams have a little coffee flavor – some don’t even use actual coffee. Our Coffee Bean Blast Ice Cream features big, bold, intense coffee flavor that comes from brewed Colombian coffee and bits of very finely ground French Roast Colombian coffee beans in every bite.

078613.item_story_marketing:
By now you know the story of Greek yogurt - most of the liquid has been strained out, making its texture more 
like that of sour cream. But did you know that's only part of the story? There's a dark secret behind much of 
what's marketed today as "Greek" yogurt. You see, to save both time and money, many yogurt manufacturers 
skip that all-important straining process, instead choosing to add thickeners to regular yogurt to achieve a 
similar, creamy texture. We find that more than a little disingenuous for a couple of reasons. One, real Greek 
plain yogurt has no thickeners. And two, real Greek yogurt is significantly higher in protein than its yogurt 
relatives, specifically because of that straining process. You can be sure the Greek Yogurt in every tub of Trader 
Joe's Greek Yogurt with Honey is the real dea.

This Greek Yogurt with Honey is smooth and creamy, super rich, and delivers an ideal balance of yogurt-y 
tart and honey sweet.

078684.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s 70% Peruvian Cacao Dark Chocolate Bar isn’t just a chocolate bar; it’s an international love story of quality and flavor. It starts with only the finest cacao beans, singularly sourced from Peru, which, thanks to its lush climate and unique, high-altitude geography, is renowned for its high-quality cacao. There, the beans grow in harmony with the land, developing a flavor that’s unique to the Andes—earthy, aromatic, and subtly floral. Once harvested, they make their way across the Atlantic to Italy, where our skilled supplier (a renowned European chocolatier) transforms them into an exceptional Bar.

Each Bar is made with just two simple ingredients—unsweetened chocolate and sugar—so you get a chocolate-eating experience that’s pure, unadulterated, and deeply satisfying. The 70% Cacao content delivers a flavor that’s bold and intense, yet still delightfully smooth, with complex floral notes that reveal themselves as the Chocolate melts on your tongue. Whether you’re looking for a midday pick-me-up, an after-dinner indulgence, or a thoughtful gift for a fellow chocolate-lover, our 70% Peruvian Cacao Dark Chocolate Bar is a versatile and winning choice. It’s a sweet taste of Peru, crafted with Italian expertise, available only at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

078717.item_story_marketing:
Sometimes the easiest way to spice up your day is to riff on an already-established routine. For example, swap your go-to breakfast bread for Trader Joe’s European Grains & Seeds Bread. Our Danish bakery partner starts with a hearty sourdough rye Bread base, bolstering it with flaxseed, sunflower seeds, rye flakes, and wheat bran before baking it to a deep brown hue. The resulting loaves are classically European—moist, toothsome, and somewhat dense, with a slightly sweet, delightfully nutty quality in each thin slice.

When it comes to toppings and fillings, the thin-yet-sturdy slices of European Grains & Seeds Bread are ready for near-infinite riffing: try topping a slice with a pat of Cultured Salted Butter and a swoosh of berry preserves; sliced Cave Aged Le Gruyère and Rosemary Ham, or ripe avocado and a spoonful of Crunchy Chili Onion. Enjoy a slice as the base of an open-faced sandwich topped with Whipped Cream Cheese, Smoked Salmon Pieces, and plenty of fresh dill. If it’s soft & chewy you’re seeking, use untoasted slices of European Grains & Seeds Bread to scaffold scoops of tuna salad—and don’t forget the pickle on the side! This singular sliced Bread is now available on the Bakery shelves at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, every day.

078733.item_story_marketing:
The tradition of savory, flavorful charcuterie in Spain dates all the way back to antiquity, when invading Romans brought salting and curing techniques of meat preservation to the Iberian peninsula. In the centuries since, charcuterie (especially pork-based charcuterie) has become an utterly integral part of the Spanish culinary landscape, which now hosts countless specialized styles of jamón and sausage. Trader Joe’s Spanish Inspired Charcutería contains a selection of three such variations, each thinly-sliced and ready to serve: serrano ham (a salt-cured, prosciutto-like ham), uncured salchichon (a rich, savory-seasoned, salami-like summer sausage), and uncured chorizo (a peppery, garlicky, and smoky pork sausage). 

All three can be enjoyed as part of a tapas spread or hors d’oeuvres platter, and all three pair wonderfully well with a bold, fruit-forward red wine—we’re particularly partial to a glass of Satis Dei Syrah Garnacha, ourselves. Any or all members of the trio make a superb addition to a sandwich (try mixing and matching to your preference of smoky/salty/spicy). And we’d be remiss if we failed to mention that they also taste great simply snacked upon on their own, right out of the package.

078750.item_story_marketing:
Looking for a savory alternative to overnight oats when your tastebuds beckon for a quick and portable breakfast? Trader Joe’s Unexpected Cheddar and Turkey Sausage Egg White Bites are made for full-flavored gobbling on the go!

Courtesy of cage free egg whites, these Bites have the ideal structure for handheld morning meals. Light and fluffy on the inside with just enough bite on the outside, they travel equally well to the office as they do from your fridge to the microwave. Unexpected Cheddar brings its unique aged Cheddar-Parmesan tanginess, while red pepper, black pepper, sage, coriander, and rosemary seasoned turkey sausage packs 17g of protein per serving. A touch of cottage cheese rounds off each Bite with satisfying creaminess.

With two Bites per package, Unexpected Cheddar and Turkey Sausage Egg White Bites are an egg-xpediently filling and gluten free breakfast. Remove the outer plastic packaging, microwave for 60 seconds, let stand for one minute, and bite right in. They’re delicious and satiating right out of the microwave and with enhancements when you have an extra minute or two. Dab a dollop of sour cream for a tangy boost, get your veggies in with a spread of Fresh Bruschetta Sauce, or shake a few dashes of Habanero Hot Sauce for a fiery kick!

078778.item_story_marketing:
Sometimes, it’s the simple things about a cookie that really make it stand out: the crunch of its crisp, perfectly baked exterior. The buttery sweetness as it crumbles in the mouth. That balancing bit of saltiness that brings the whole experience together. All of these elements are particularly pronounced in Trader Joe’s Crispy Oatmeal Cookies with Sea Salt, a sweet treat that takes the simplicity of its recipe to some sublime places on the palate. 

Made with a base of flour, sugar, oats, and a whole lot of butter, these bite-sized Cookies offer a whole medley of textures and flavors, far beyond the sum of their parts—our tasting panel was especially taken with their refined butterscotch notes, courtesy of the toasty Oats. As such, they make an excellent sweet treat for all sorts of occasions. Enjoy a bowlful as a sweet snack on family movie night. Pack a few as a mini-dessert in a school lunch—or your own work lunch, for that matter. And if you’d really like to take things to the next level, let them lend their simply sweet and Crispy character to yet another dessert by crumbling them over an ice cream sundae or frosty milkshake. It’s as simple as that!

078780.item_story_marketing:
Pumpkin season happily coincides with the beginning of baking season. In fact, as temperatures dip and heating the kitchen is no longer a cause for concern, the only real challenge is deciding what to bake first! We recommend starting with new Trader Joe’s Pumpkin & Spice Snickerdoodle Cookie Mix.

Pumpkin powder provides an authentic base flavor for this Mix, complemented with the ideal blend of warm spices, including cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, ginger, and clove. Its conveniently pre-measured status allows for light work of dough assembly; a stick of butter, an egg, and a tablespoon of cold milk are all that’s required from your end to stir it together. From there, you simply shape the dough into two-tablespoon-sized balls, roll them in the provided Sugar & Spice Mix, then bake at 375°F for about 12 minutes.

The resulting Cookies are chewy in the center, golden-crisp at the edges, and loaded with sweet, Pumpkin & Spice flavor! Enjoy them warm from the oven, perhaps with a cozy mug of Harvest Blend Herbal Tea, or some gently warmed Apple Spiced Cider.

078791.item_story_marketing:
At Trader Joe’s, a product doesn’t pass muster just once—it must do so again and again, long after it launches, to ensure our customers are as excited about it as our tasting panel was when it was first presented. Recently, our buyer applied this standard for satisfaction and deliciousness to our preexisting pizza sauce, and knew we could do better. And after a few rounds of tasting and tweaking an array of sauce options, we did—allow us to (re)introduce Trader Joe’s Pizza Sauce!

With a bright tomato flavor and more subtly seasoned profile than its predecessor, this Pizza Sauce provides a savory base layer that complements pizza toppings without overpowering them, and makes for a mighty tasty Breaded Mozzarella Cheese Sticks dip, too. An added bonus: it’s packed into shelf-stable jars, so you can always have a jar of Pizza Sauce at the ready when the craving strikes.

In addition to our tasting panel standards for satisfaction and delicious, this kosher-certified Sauce passes muster when it comes to value, too. If “pizza party” is in your day planner, pop on over to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, where you’ll find jars of Pizza Sauce on our grocery shelves for an incredible price, every day.

078792.item_story_marketing:
Hail Caesar! This star of the salad world has conquered our hearts in countless variations, and the latest version to join our ready-to-eat ranks may just be the most exciting yet: Trader Joe's Caesar Salad with Salmon! This tasty twist starts by shaking up the classic formula with a base of chopped kale in addition to the customary Romaine, then mixes things up further via the use of crunchy Parmesan cheese crisps instead of croutons. It’s finished with a hearty portion of grilled salmon, which, when mixed all together with the included creamy Romano Caesar dressing, creates a marvelous mix of savory flavors and toothsome textures that all combine into one seriously satisfying salad.

Ideal for on-the-go lunches and quick & easy, weeknight dinners, our Caesar Salad with Salmon is ready to eat right out of the fridge, and pairs particularly well with a fruity iced tea. We recommend packing it with some fresh fruit and a Sparkling Peach Black Tea for a complete work lunch or picnic-ready meal.

078799.item_story_marketing:
Vanilla, plain? Never! A spice so integral to desserts across the world can’t possibly be boring, but it can be quite expensive—vanilla beans in particular. That’s why Trader Joe’s has brought premium Bourbon Vanilla Beans to your neighborhood store at a marvelous value!

Vanilla Beans are actually the pods of Vanilla orchids—including V. planifolia, better known as Bourbon Vanilla. They were first cultivated on their namesake island of Île Bourbon (now called Réunion) before operations moved to its larger neighbor to the west: Madagascar. If “Vanilla” and “Madagascar” seem synonymous, it’s because the island’s tropical climate and heavy rainfall produces Bourbon Vanilla Beans that are especially large, plump, and high in vanillin, the compound that gives the spice its wonderfully sweet and “warm” flavor.

There’s one downside to these aromatic and versatile beans: their price tag! Fortunately, we buy ours directly from their grower and processor, allowing us to offer offer premium, Madagascar-grown Bourbon Vanilla Beans at an amazing value. Bring yours home and incorporate them into baked goods and desserts, Vanilla sugar, and Vanilla-infused spirits, while supplies last!

078808.item_story_marketing:
The venerable pecan, of pie fame, likely grew wild for centuries before being domesticated and cultivated as a major agricultural crop. Today, the United States produces hundreds of thousands of tons of pecans annually – Trader Joe’s doesn’t sell all of them, but we do move a plethora of pecans through our doors each year. We sell raw pecans and roasted pecans, whole pecans, and pieces of pecans. And, these, the pecans de resistance, Sweet & Spicy Pecans.

Trader Joe’s Sweet & Spicy Pecans begin as high quality, fancy junior mammoth (that’s how they’re officially categorized in nut-land; even we couldn’t make that up) pecan halves from Texas. They’re roasted with canola oil, and seasoned with sugar, salt, and a kicky blend of spices – cayenne, ancho chile, and paprika – to create a uniquely flavored nut that’s at home as a snack, salad topper, or cheese plate partner. They’re not too sweet and not too spicy; their balance is what makes them so craveable. Our recommendation: Buy two at a time; you can thank us later.

078809.item_story_marketing:
One of our favorite things about shortbread is how well its rich, crumbly sweetness goes with other flavors. We could list examples all day, but, frankly, it might be easier to list all the things shortbread doesn’t go well with (Sardines? Sauerkraut? Toothpaste, maybe?). One winning flavor combo that’s not even remotely up for debate, however, is shortbread and apples. There’s just something about that mix of lush fruitiness and dense, buttery texture that’s undeniable—so much so, in fact, that we’ve enshrined it into a seasonal sweet treat in the form of Trader Joe’s Apple Shortbread Cookies.

Made for us in small batches by a supplier in the U.K., the recipe for these scrumptious Shortbread Cookies includes dried apples, apple juice concentrate, and plenty of butter—in fact, each Cookie’s composition is nearly one quarter butter, by weight! Before baking them to a perfect, crisp, golden brown, our supplier makes an adorable, apple-shaped impression into each Cookie, making them an appetizing and aesthetically appropriate addition to any autumnal dessert board.

078836.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s sells Gluten Free Pizza Dough if you’re in the mood to make a pie from scratch. But if you’re looking for a ready-to-bake, gluten free solution, look no further than Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Cheese Pizza with a Cauliflower Crust.

You’ve seen this kind of pie before, even in our freezers, so we can’t exactly claim it’s revolutionary. We can say that the delicious Gluten Free crust (first ingredient: Cauliflower) develops a nice crispness in just 10-12 minutes in the oven. It handily delivers our tangy tomato sauce, and melty mozzarella & provolone cheeses right to your mouth.

Perhaps what’s most impressive about this Gluten Free Cheese Pizza is the possibilities. While we’ve engineered this pie to be enjoyable just as it is, it’s also a blank canvas for your own pizza creativity. And with a Trader Joe’s store full of toppings, it’s safe to say, the possibilities are endless!

078841.item_story_marketing:
This is no ordinary salmon. In fact, we think it’s pretty special. Trader Joe’s Wild Nova Style Smoked Sockeye Salmon is made for us from a family recipe that dates back more than seventy years. A combination of the traditions of Native Alaskans and those of the Norwegian immigrants who made their way across the world to this same region, our recipe results in a naturally delightful delicacy. Wild Sockeye Salmon from icy cold Alaskan water is smoked slowly over native hardwoods and seasoned with salt.

Sounds simple enough but trust us, smoked salmon of this quality, with flavor this mild and sweet, is rare indeed. You can serve Trader Joe’s Wild Nova Style Smoked Sockeye Salmon with bagels and cream cheese, of course. But why stop there? Try it tossed into your favorite green salad, in omelets or your favorite pasta dish.
078841.item_title: Wild Nova Style Smoked Sockeye Salmon

078881.item_story_marketing:
For just a moment, consider the complementary nature of dark chocolate and pistachios with us, won’t you? In terms of flavor, there’s the earthy, delicately sweet notes of a finely roasted pistachio, which plays remarkably well off of the rich, ever-so-slightly bitter elements of dark chocolate. And texture-wise, the tooth-sinking smoothness of dark chocolate superbly rounds out a pistachio’s tender interior after its initial, delicately snappy bite. It’s like they were made for each other—a match made in snacking heaven, if you will. We certainly will, which is precisely why we’ve introduced Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Covered Pistachios to our shelves.

Inside each pouch, our supplier has smothered shelled, dry roasted, and salted California Pistachios in a perfectly proportioned layer of deep Dark Chocolate so that each balanced bite takes your taste buds on a trek across the sweet-salty spectrum. They make an unbeatable anytime snack, can be mixed in to your own custom trail mixes, and are especially adept for adding to charcuterie boards and cheese plates, to provide even more captivating contrast. We also find that they make the ideal palate cleanser for serving in between sips at an at- home wine tasting with friends.

078900.item_story_marketing:
Food trends come and go, but every so often, a culinary innovation will come along that truly thrills our taste buds. Trader Joe’s Strained Thick & Creamy Plain Greek Yogurt is one such innovation. Made with whole milk and cream, our supplier employs a special straining process to remove excess whey from the finished Greek Yogurt, resulting in a velvety, Thick & Creamy texture, but with a less tangy flavor than our other Greek yogurt offerings. What’s more, the Plain Yogurt is cultured after pasteurization (hello, live and active cultures!) and boasts 15 grams of protein per ¾-cup serving to boot!

We’re offering this kosher-certified Strained Greek Yogurt in an impressively sized 32-ounce tub, because you’ll truly want to enjoy it that often: topped with granola and fresh fruit, swirled into smoothies and sauces for extra creaminess, or mixed with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic for a savory chicken marinade that yields unbelievably moist and flavorful results. You’ll find this delightful dairy innovation in the refrigerators at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, every day.

078925.item_story_marketing:
Imagine sinking your teeth into the perfect chocolate chip cookie. First, there’s the initial resistance of the cookie’s crisp outer layer. Then, just as that resistance gives way to the cookie’s soft, chewy interior, you’re hit with a symphony of buttery, brown-sugary, and, of course, chocolatey flavor. “It’s pitch-perfect!” You exclaim. “We agree,” we respond, “and it’s gluten free.” Shocked, you reach for the box, and there it is, plain as day: Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Chocolate Chunk Cookies with Sea Salt. Well, I’ll be darned...

Now made using an updated recipe that results in an even softer, even fresher-feeling texture, these Gluten Free Chocolate Chunk Cookies are a true achievement in gluten free baking. Each box contains six Cookies made with a blend of oat flour, rice flour, tapioca starch, brown sugar, and plenty of butter. The real scene- stealers, however, are the rich, semi-sweet Chocolate Chunks throughout and the coarse Sea Salt sprinkled on top. Together, they offer up an effortless harmony of sweet and salty—it’s the kind of Cookie confluence that’ll bring you back for another bite. And another. And another—thank goodness we’re selling them six to a box. You’ll find them in our bakery section.

078928.item_story_marketing:
Imagine sinking your teeth into the perfect cookie: first, there’s the initial toothsome resistance of the crisp outer layer, and the sweet aromas of butter and vanilla. Then, that resistance gives way to the soft, chewy interior and full flavors of semisweet chocolate, brown sugar, and sea salt. Imagine the chocolate and soft cookie melting in your mouth, expressing all kinds of sweet and savory flavors as you wash it down with a chilled glass of milk (or non-dairy beverage). Now, what if we told you that this exact experience is readily available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s? Imagine no more: we present to you The Sea Salt Chocolate Chunk Cookie.

Now made using an updated recipe that results in an even softer, even fresher-feeling texture, each box contains six Sea Salt Chocolate Chunk Cookies that are big in both size and flavor. In fact, they’re just about the perfect size and shape for making delicious cookie ice cream sandwiches, and the bits of coarse, crunchy Sea Salt interact wonderfully with a scoop of French Vanilla Ice Cream. That said, if you’re more in the mood for a simpler, solo Cookie experience, try warming one up in the microwave for a few seconds just prior to enjoying.

078932.item_story_marketing:
We have so many yummy gummy candies under our belt, it would be easy to rest on our laurels and coast for a while on this gummy momentum. But that’s not the TJ’s way! Whether we are talking about gummies, curries, or berries, our developers won’t stop until we’ve created all the best products we think our customers want and deserve. 

For example, we’ve been wanting to add Strawberry flavored Sour Belts to our candy assortment for years now. Though we’ve searched the world (literally) for a worthy supplier, we’ve found that most candy makers use artificial flavors and artificial colors. That’s not what we want to offer our customers. So, we kept searching... and our persistence has finally paid off! Meet Trader Joe’s Sour Strawberry Candy Belts. 

These long, flat, rose-colored strips are made for us by an expert gummy candy supplier in Turkey who only uses natural flavors, and colors derived from fruit & vegetable juices. Open the tub and you’ll be hit by a fragrant Strawberry aroma, like a strawberry plant that’s been basking in the summer sun. This Strawberry scent sets you up for the real payoff, found in the pleasantly chewy, sugar-covered Belts that boast a balanced, sweet & sour Strawberry flavor. And... they’re vegan!

This Sour Strawberry Candy is another notch in our belt, but even more importantly, it’s another win for our customers: delicious, naturally flavored, vegan Candy, sourced with love and available every day at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s!

078933.item_story_marketing: The contents of each jar are solely organic maple syrup that’s been reduced down to its purest essence, then whipped to a captivatingly creamy consistency. It’s fantastic on French toast, marvelous mixed into yogurt, and enchanting as an accompaniment to a cheese board (we particularly like it spread thin on a slice of sharp Cheddar). Don’t let us dictate how you use Trader Joe's Organic Maple Butter—feel free to let your imagination, and desire to make anything and everything sweeter and more maple-y, soar.
078933.item_story_qil:
If you have time for a quick story: A few years ago, we introduced Trader Joe's Organic Maple Butter to our 
shelves, and it not only became an instant icon of our fall-seasonal selections, it acted as a sort of herald for 
more maple products to come. Then, a few years after that, tragedy struck. A supply issue prevented us from 
bringing it back, for a full two years. But right here and now, we're excited to give that story a happy ending. 
Back with a new supplier, a new look, and the same simple, single-ingredient recipe and superlatively sweet 
taste, Trader Joe's Organic Maple Butter has made its triumphant return!

Indeed, the contents of each jar remain solely Organic Maple syrup that's been reduced down to its purest 
essence, then whipped to a captivatingly creamy consistency. It's still fantastic on French toast, marvelous 
mixed into yogurt, and enchanting as an accompaniment to a cheese board (we particularly like it spread thin 
on a slice of sharp Cheddar). Don't let us dictate how you use it-feel free to let your imagination, and desire 
to make anything and everything sweeter and more maple-y, soar.

Organic Maple Butter
078933.name: HOL BUTTER MAPLE ORGANIC

078936.item_story_marketing:
Just in time for summer, Trader Joe's Cacay Oil Body Butter has arrived to help keep your skin soothed, moisturized, and hydrated from now until autumn! It's made with a base of smooth and silky coconut oil and shea butter, to which our supplier adds vegan-sourced collagen-supporting peptides and squalane, as well as moisturizing Cacay Oil. In addition to its skin-nourishing properties, it's also scented with a light and elegant pink dragonfruit and jasmine fragrance, to leave you feeling refreshed after every use.

Derived from the seeds of the South American Cacay tree's fruit, and celebrated the world over for its cosmetic and culinary qualities, Cacay Oil is naturally rich with linoleic acid, making it an ideal moisturizer. Normally, that would also make it a candidate for a sky-high retail-we've seen similar creams on the market go or as much as $48. But since this is Trader Joe's, you can find an eight-ounce tub of our Cacay Oil Body Butter for a fraction of a fraction of that price. While supplies last, you can pick one up as a gift for a loved one, an addition to your collection of spa-day essentials, or a bit of portable self-care to bring along on a summertime trip.

078937.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Spinach & Ricotta Raviolini are tiny ravioli that are made for us in Italy by pasta pillow pros. We call them “pros” because it’s very challenging to fill and keep closed such small ravioli. After a year of research (no joke!)—and equipped with a new, specially made die to cut the pasta—our Raviolini line was up and running.

Each Raviolini is 50% pasta and 50% filling, which is a rare ratio in the stuffed-pasta universe. The pasta is formed from a delicate, egg and durum-wheat flour dough. The filling includes spinach in a creamy, garlicky bechamel sauce, with a rich blend of ricotta & mozzarella cheeses.

Given their tiny size, these Spinach & Ricotta Raviolini eat very similar to a plate of tortellini, where you get to enjoy a bunch of them in every bite. They’re so delicious on their own, you may simply complement them with a drizzle of TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil and a sprinkle of Shaved Parmigiano Reggiano. And their slight stature means they’re quick cooking and ideal for dropping into a pot of soup just a few minutes before it’s finished simmering! You’ll find 10-ounce packages of Trader Joe’s Spinach & Ricotta Raviolini in our refrigerators, every day.

078963.item_story_marketing:
A quintessential sign of summer, Trader Joe’s Mangoes are sublimely sweet and jubilantly juicy this time of year. Need help figuring out if your Mango is ready to go? A ripe Mango is slightly soft when squeezed and gives off a sweet smell near the stem.

So, how to utilize thee, ripe Mango? Let us count the ways. Freeze cubed Mango and add to a pitcher of Organic Lemonade or your favorite tropical cocktail—they won’t water down your drinks and are a treat to eat at the bottom of your glass. Add chopped Mango to your summer salsas and scoop them up with Quinoa and Black Bean Tortilla Chips. Or roll slices in a Jicama Wrap with a big dollop of your favorite yogurt for an “it’s too hot to cook” breakfast.
078963.name: MANGO EACH

Trader Joe’s Honey Roasted Macadamia Nuts & Roasted & Salted Cashews is one of those snacks with a name that describes really well what’s in the container. We’ve glazed halved Macadamia nuts with a cane sugar & honey combination, then roasted them to caramelize the coating. The Cashews are simply roasted with sunflower oil and salted. The Roasted nuts are evenly mixed together so that with every bite, you can enjoy the crunchy, buttery flavor of both nuts—along with the delightful (to borrow a word) contrast of salty and sweet.

Snack by the handful when you’re working, or pair them with your favorite beer or cocktail when friends come over. Either way, Trader Joe’s Honey Roasted Macadamia Nuts & Roasted Salted Cashews is a nut combo that’s very hard to beat!

078977.item_story_marketing:
The saying is as true as it ever was: breakfast is the most important meal of the day. We might add, though, that we remain as steadfast to our corollary as we’ve ever been: just because it’s important, doesn’t mean it can’t also be fun. Trader Joe’s Very Berry Granola might just be the prime, practical application of this proposition: our supplier starts with hearty clusters of rolled oats—the kind of foundation that very important breakfasts are built upon—then sprinkles in bits of dried and sweetened blueberries and dried strawberries, so that every bite has an elegantly balanced blend of crunchy textures and sweet, fruity flavors. In other words: important, fun, and inarguably delicious.

Start your day off with a sublimely simple bowl of this gluten free Very Berry Granola and a splash of milk, or your favorite non-dairy alternative. (We find that our Non-Dairy Oat Beverage makes a particularly excellent partner to this Granola’s fruit-forward flavors.) Or, if you prefer, end your day with a pitch-perfect parfait by layering Very Berry Granola into some Greek Yogurt with your favorite TJ’s fruit preserves. In between, you can simply snack on Very Berry Granola by the handful—snacking is certainly important (and fun, and delicious) too, after all.

078993.item_story_marketing: New to our Italian wine offerings, this Nebbiolo from Piedmont offers great value. It’s elegant and slightly spicy with aromas of violet and raspberry. Dry and velvety, it has balanced tannins and structure. A more approachable alternative to Barolo, it’s a great option for fall, pairing well with hearty dishes.
078993.item_story_qil:
The Langhe hills of northwest Italy's Piedmont region are home to some of the most prestigious and 

long-lived wines produced from the noble Nebbiolo grape. This particular bottling hails from the Langhe 

DOC, a broad regional designation that includes the area south of Alba and encompasses the most prestigious 

appellations of Piedmont (Barolo, Barbaresco), where the grape is regaled for its ability to translate the area's 

unique terroir into profoundly aromatic and structured wines.  

Swirling allows the captivating perfume to unfurl - revealing beguiling aromas of ripe cherry, dried 

roses, fresh tar, licorice, truffles and autumnal woodland notes. On the palate, the texture is simultaneously 

broad and chiseled with sturdy but fine-grained tannins carrying impressions of rich red and dark fruits, spice 

and lingering minerality across a juicy, mouth-watering finish that goes on and on. While still somewhat 

youthful after a few years, this Nebbiolo Langhe DOC is enjoyable now and will also reward those with the 

patience to cellar it for a few years further.   

The wine's boldly structured and savory character calls for heartier fare to allow its complexity to 

fully shine. Perfectly matched with rich dishes featuring wild game, cured meats or aged cheeses, this 

Nebbiolo would be sublime paired with venison stew with juniper berries, wild boar ragu tossed with 

pappardelle, or a board of Toma Piemontese and Bra Duro with shaved truffles. For vegetarians, roasted 

portobello mushrooms with rosemary or baked pasta al forno with caramelized onions would stand up nicely. 

No matter the pairing, this bottling promises an intellectually stimulating and memorable experience with 

each sip.
078993.name: ROSA DELL OLMO LANGHE NEBBIOLO DOC

079003.item_story_marketing:
The idea of any Double Cream cheese is that it contains at least 60% butterfat, guaranteeing a rich and creamy result in every bite... and we’re doubling down on the declaration that Double Cream cheeses are, in fact, doubly delicious. Dubious? Doubtful? Don’t be. Instead, head to the cheese case at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s and pick up a mini-wheel of Trader Joe’s Double Cream Brie.

Made in the traditional French style by a respected Wisconsin cheesemaker, our Double Cream Brie’s bloomy rind envelops a smooth, rich, creamy cheese, delivering exactly what you want from a classic Brie. It’s delightful on its own, served with TJ’s Chile Crackers, or added to an elevated grilled cheese sandwich. Or, to really lean into its double-creaminess, top your wheel of Brie with honey, nuts, and herbs, then wrap it in TJ’s Organic Crescent Roll dough and bake it at 350°F for about 30 minutes. The resulting “Brie en croûte” will be awesomely ooey... irresistably gooey... and oh-so-delicious.

Double Cream Brie

079033.item_story_marketing:
While most folks would probably peg the hamburger as the most representative American food, we'd have to  throw our support behind the humble hot dog. Aside from its close association with baseball (the American national pastime) and summertime (arguably the most American season, though that's another topic altogether), only pizza comes close to the hot dog in its proliferation of regional variation throughout these United States. Practically every major American state and city has their own specific spin on hot dogs, from the vibrantly vegetal Chicago dog, to the chili-and-onion-smothered dogs of Coney Island, to the bacon-wrapped hot dogs of Los Angeles. And so, to help celebrate the holistically American hot dog, we proudly offer Trader Joe's Uncured Beef Hot Dogs, to be enjoyed in whatever preparation you prefer-from sea to shining sea.

Our all-Beef, Uncured Hot Dogs contain no added nitrates or nitrates (except those that occur naturally in sea salt and cultured celery powder), and cook up wonderfully well on the grill, in the frying pan, or immersed in boiling water (or beer, we should add!). Once heated through, they have a fantastically snappy texture to their bite, and take well to all kinds of condiments and fixings. No matter which regional variation you subscribe to, or even if you just enjoy it with a simple drizzle of ketchup and/or mustard, our Hot Dog Buns, and Brioche Hot Dog Buns will make an invaluable vehicle for them.

079060.item_story_marketing:
If you frequent the wine section at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, you’ve likely come across Maison Barboulot Cabernet Syrah. (And if you haven’t visited the wine section lately, come say hi! Our Crew are friendly, knowledgeable, and would love to tell you about their favorites). This one-time hidden gem is now a solid customer favorite, thanks to its amazing quality and equally excellent price. So, when our buyer came across a rosé from the same region in France, with the same quality-to-price characteristics, we jumped at the chance to bring it into stores. Just in time for summer, give it up for Maison Barboulot Cinsault Rosé!

If you were sitting at a sidewalk café in France, this is likely what you’d find in your glass come happy hour. It’s made from 100% Cinsault (pronounced “SAN-soh”) grapes, grown among the morning mists and Mediterranean sea breezes of the Pays d’Oc region. Those growing conditions contribute to the wine’s artful balance of floral and fruity notes and its dry and refreshing nature, as well as its light and lively palate that plays well with baked salmon, pesto chicken, or a citrus-y pasta salad. We’re delighted to say: Rosé is here to stay!

079061.item_story_marketing:
The Loire Valley, south of Paris and about in the middle of France, is known widely for its wine production— most notably, white wines. Sauvignon Blanc from the sub-region of Sancerre is perhaps this Valley’s most famous white. But while Sancerre may be the most well-known and prestigious white-wine provenance in the region, there’s another sub-region called Touraine that produces comparable whites. And Touraine is where Vignobles Lacheteau Sauvignon Blanc originates.

Vignobles Lacheteau Touraine Sauvignon Blanc is, indeed, composed of 100% Sauvignon Blanc grapes, and is fermented in stainless steel tanks to preserve its fresh flavor profile and vibrant character. It’s deeply aromatic, with bright notes of citrus and spring blossoms, tasters will note a pronounced, yet balanced, acidity that keeps the palate engaged with every scintillating sip. Drink it chilled, on its own, or enjoy a glass with a green salad with Goat Cheese and French Vinaigrette with Shallots. You may find it pairs surprisingly well with a grilled Sweet Italian Sausage, too.

079074.item_story_marketing:
You never know when a craving for chocolate may strike. If you’re anything like us, for example, a craving for Colombian milk chocolate might strike you quite frequently. And when it comes to lightly salted Colombian milk chocolate, embedded with crunchy bits of caramelized candy, you may just find yourself in a state of being perpetually craving-struck. That’s why we always like to have a bag of Trader Joe’s Crunchy Milk Chocolate & Sea Salt Thins on hand. Crafted for us by an expert Colombian supplier, these individually wrapped Thins are perfectly proportioned for providing a quick, satisfying mix of salty and sweet, as well as a marvelous melt-in- the-mouth texture, in every balanced bite.

Within the world of chocolate, Colombian cocoa is celebrated for its fruity notes and relatively subtle sweetness. Here, those elements are especially allowed to shine in contrast with the Sea Salt and the crispy, toffee-like texture of the caramelized candy bits throughout. In addition to making a delicious (and highly shareable, we might add) anytime sweet treat, we find that it makes a particularly great pairing for a creamy, full-flavored cheese (like our sweet White Stilton with Apricots). And for an elevated afternoon pick-me-up, these Milk Chocolate & Sea Salt Thins are ideal for cutting through the acidity of a cup of Colombia Supremo Coffee.

079108.item_story_marketing:
Combining the umami elegance of sliced white and shiitake mushrooms, the aromatic excellence of chopped garlic and shallot, and the enchanting cheesiness of Parmesan, cream cheese, and ricotta, then delivering them all together in flaky, bite-sized crusts, Trader Joe’s Mini Mushroom Tartelettes are hors d’oeuvres for all occasions. Whether they’re enjoyed as a starter at a sophisticated dinner party with friends, as a straight-from- the-air-fryer midnight snack, or even as an entrée when paired with a leafy green salad, their mix of savory, herby, and buttery flavors are certain to satisfy.

Beyond satisfying the palate, which these Tartelettes do with aplomb, the fact that they’re super easy to prep is properly satisfying, too: just a few minutes in the conventional oven or air fryer, and they go from frozen to golden brown and crispy. And, of course, the remarkably reasonable retail at which we’re offering them might be their most satisfying trait of all. While our Mini Mushroom Tartelettes are hors d’oeuvres for all occasions, they’re not available for all seasons. You’ll only find them in our freezers during the holidays, and only while supplies last.

079111.item_story_marketing:
Combining the congenial crunch of cruciferous veggies like cabbage, kale, Brussels sprouts, and radicchio, with zesty, mango-forward flavors inspired by Thai cuisine, Trader Joe’s Sweet Chili Mango Salad Kit gives you everything you need to serve a super tasty salad for your next meal—besides, we suppose, a salad bowl and some tongs. Inside each all-in-one Kit, you’ll find the aforementioned blend of crisp, shredded veggies, crunchy roasted sunflower seeds, toasted quinoa, dried bits of mango, and a Thai-style sweet and spicy vinaigrette. With just a quick toss of these ingredients, you’ll instantly have a Salad with tangy, tropical flavors and layers of complementary textures in every bite.

Equally excellent as a side as it is a main (particularly when topped with your favorite protein), we find that this vegan Salad Kit’s constituent Sweet Chili Mango flavors are especially suited for serving alongside fare like spring rolls, stir-fries, and aromatic curries. That said, we also find that its spicy and fruity aspects make it an apt choice for incorporating into seafood tacos, a base for a Tempeh bowl, or using as a topping on a Turkey Burger.

079114.item_story_marketing:
Hard, stale bread certainly has a place at the dinner table in the form of salad croutons and poultry stuffing. When it comes to rolls, however, it’s quite...sacrolligious. And yet, dry Dinner Rolls seem to prevail in grocery stores across the land. Not at Trader Joe’s, though—we say “no” to roll mediocrity with our soft and moist Dinner Rolls.

Bite into one of these pull-apart Rolls, and you’ll notice that they’re incredibly moist compared to other store- bought options. The secret? Potato flour! This spudsy superstar attracts and holds water better than other flours, so we add a bit of it to give Trader Joe’s Dinner Rolls their especially soft texture. A touch of sugar lends subtle sweetness, making for craveable rolls that’ll have you questioning if it’s worth saving room for dinner.

Dinner Rolls are most delicious when warmed in the oven for 3-5 minutes at 400°F. Place them in a basket atop holiday dinner tables and serve with Salted Butter Quarters, or tangy Cultured Salted Butter, if you’re feeling fancy. They also excel as slider buns, and as carb companions to soup and salad dinners. You’ll find Dinner Rolls in the bakery section through the holiday season, while supplies last.

079142.item_story_marketing:
In the early 1990s, an orchardist discovered a new kind of apple growing in his Minnesota Honeycrisp orchard. With a little detective work, he determined that local bees had taken the pollen from an unknown tree nearby and cross-pollenated it with Honeycrisp blossoms. The SugarBee® was born!

Fast-forward to present day, and you, dear customers, can enjoy the crisp, firm texture and crunchy bite of
SugarBees®. Their flavor hints at caramel and molasses, with distinct notes of honey—a fitting homage to their raison d’etre (reason for bee-ing, if you will). Snack on slices alongside a bowl of our Maple Spiced Nut Mix for an authentically autumnal treat. Or peel and slice these bee-uties to tuck into your seasonal pies, tarts, and turnovers. Yum! Pick your own from our produce shelves, while they’re in season.
