079153.item_story_marketing:
When our product developers think of ways to flavor cheeses, it’s usually a question of what ways we can complement the inherent quality a cheese already has. The sharpness of Cheddar, for example, lends itself extremely well to spicier notes. Creamy Goudas take on smoky and herby elements with aplomb. And for a tangy and tart goat’s milk cheese? Something sweet, umami-rich, and irresistibly alliaceous will make it sing— something like the combo found in Trader Joe’s Caramelized Onion Goat’s Milk Cheese, in fact.

Whether it’s enjoyed on a cracker, a bit of crostini, or a well-toasted bagel, this Caramelized Onion Goat Cheese creates a synergistic symphony on the palate. It elevates cheese plates and charcuterie boards with its balance of sweet and savory. It uplifts burgers and sandwiches when used as a spread. And when baked with a bit of puff pastry and fresh fig, makes a truly unforgettable hors d’oeuvre. Just be sure to stop by the cheese section of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s soon, because supplies are limited!

079157.item_story_marketing: England’s highly esteemed Stilton® cheese is protected by the European Union with a PDO, or protected designation of origin, to ensure any cheese bearing the name lives up to its spectacular reputation—cheeses like Trader Joe’s White Stilton¨ Cheese with Apple & Pear. Produced for us in Leicestershire, in the heart of the Vale of Belvoir, to be precise, this White Stilton¨ is made only from locally pasteurized cow’s milk, infused with a sweet Apple & Pear compote and dried red Apple pieces. It’s unpressed during its six-week aging period, which is the key to creating its characteristically airy texture. The result is a sensationally light, slightly tangy cheese that offers pops of fruitiness throughout, complementing the savory flavor and creamy-crumbly nature of the base. Consider crumbling this Stilton¨ atop a salad, or layering a thick slice on a grilled vegetable sandwich. Of course, it presents particularly well on a cheeseboard alongside Pumpkin Cranberry Crisps and freshly sliced pears (plan ahead—it’s best enjoyed after a 30-minute rest at room temperature).
079157.item_story_qil:
England's highly esteemed Stilton® cheese has been made in the exact same way and in the exact same places 
for hundreds of years. It's so revered, in fact, that it's protected by the European Union with a PDO, or protected 
designation of origin, to ensure any cheese bearing the name lives up to its spectacular reputation-cheeses 
like Trader Joe's White Stilton® Cheese with Apple and Pear.

Produced for us in Leicestershire, in the heart of the Vale of Belvoir, to be precise, this White Stilton® is made 
only from locally pasteurized cow's milk, infused with the pleasant sweetness of freeze-dried Apple pieces 
and a hint of Pear. It's formed into a cylindrical shape, but is not pressed during its six-week aging period to 
help create an airy texture. The result is a sensationally light, slightly tangy cheese that offers pops of sweetness 
throughout to complement the savory nature and creamy-crumbly texture of the base.

White Stilton® Cheese with Apple and Pear is best enjoyed after a 30-minute rest at room temperature, so 
plan ahead before crumbling a handful over salads, soups, and pizzas. It also presents particularly well on a 
cheeseboard alongside walnuts, figs, and apple and pear slices. Or, spread it on crackers, drizzle them with 
honey, and pair them with Porto Morgado 10 Years Old Tawny Port [sku 71736] for a sweet and sophisticated 
dessert. 

White Stilton® Cheese with Apple and Pear
079157.item_title: White Stilton Cheese with Apple & Pear
079157.name: HOL CUT WHITE STILTON WITH APPLE AND PEAR

079169.item_story_marketing:
Autumn means many things to us, here at Trader Joe’s. It’s pumpkin season. It’s soup season. It’s maple season. And of course, as temperatures start to swing toward the “sweater weather” side of the spectrum, it’s also the onset of baking season. Here now to herald this auspicious autumnal occasion, Trader Joe’s No Sugar Added Dark Chocolate Chips are an excellent option for bakers of all experience levels—especially those looking to limit their sugar intake.

Made with flavorful dark chocolate from Colombia, as well as sugar-free allulose and rich cocoa butter, these gluten free and dairy free Dark Chocolate Chips can be used in any recipe or situation that calls for chocolate chips. From dependable desserts like chocolate chip cookies, brownies, and blondie bars, to break-out breakfasts like pancakes, muffins, and banana breads, to even just spontaneously snacking on by the handful, these No Sugar Added Dark Chocolate Chips can be enjoyed in all kinds of contexts. For an extra special treat, we recommend melting them down in a saucepan on the stove and dipping with your favorite fruit.

079171.item_story_marketing:
Here at Trader Joe’s—particularly during the holidays—we’re big on Chalkidki olives. That’s because Chalkidiki olives are big on flavor, big on buttery texture, and, well, generally quite big. That makes them especially ideal for stuffing with other foods that complement their bold and briny flavor profiles, as can be seen (or more importantly, tasted) in our creamy, tangy, and super savory Blue Cheese Stuffed Chalkidiki Olives. New for this year, we have Trader Joe’s Lemon Stuffed Olives, which take a decidedly more citric approach to yield similarly sumptuous results.

To make each batch, our supplier in Greece starts with pitted, generously-sized Chalkidiki Olives, cured according to Greek tradition to ensure a firm, meaty texture and full, fruity flavor. They then stuff each Olive with tart and zesty Lemon peel, pack them in brine, and send them our way, where they await being added to cocktails, mezze plates, and charcuterie boards by you. We recommend serving them with cheeses, slicing them and using as a topping for homemade pizza and focaccia, and simply snacking on them, right out of the jar. We also recommend picking them up from your neighborhood Trader Joe’s sooner rather than later, as supplies are limited.

079181.item_story_marketing:
Feta fans know that tangy, fresh-tasting feta cheese brings a pop of pleasing flavor wherever it’s added (pizzas, salads, pasta, et al.). Feta fans also know that the cheese’s crumbly texture can be somewhat limiting in certain culinary contexts. Now, thanks to Trader Joe’s Whipped Feta Spread, feta fans will also soon know the delight of enjoying it with unbelievable ease—on a bagel, on a chip, at the end of carrot stick, and beyond!

To create this Spread, our supplier whips fresh Feta with cream cheese, Greek yogurt, and a bit of olive oil to create a creamy, ultra-spreadable, mega-dippable concoction that’s sure to become a hit for game-watch parties and afternoon snack roundups alike. The recipe includes 51% Feta, and it’s Whipped just enough to ensure you’ll still find salty chunks of it throughout, like little treasures scored whilst diving in with a pita, a chip, or an Organic Persian Cucumber. What’s more, our amazing price means you’ll keep more treasure in your wallet, too!

079207.item_story_marketing:
Are you longing for the cozy flavors of pumpkin spice coffee, but not in the mood for a hot cup of joe? Then Trader Joe’s Pumpkin Spice Flavored Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate is decidedly for you!

It starts with the same, beloved characteristics of our perennially popular Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate: it’s made with 100% Arabica beans that are cold brewed up to 24 hours to highlight the coffee’s lush, fruity notes. Imbued with a classic Pumpkin Spice blend of cinnamon, ginger, clove, and nutmeg, the base Brew is rounded out with a bit of orange peel, resulting in a Coffee that’s teeming with Pumpkin Spice flavors in every sip!

While we recommend mixing one part Concentrate with two parts water, milk, or non-dairy beverage, the beauty of this kosher-certified Pumpkin Spice powerhouse is you can create the beverage of your dreams. After preparing in your Coffee vessel of choice, reach for a cup of Nonfat Pumpkin Greek Yogurt or a slice of Cinnamon Coffee Cake for an extra festive breakfast. You’ll find Pumpkin Spice Flavored Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate with our shelf-stable coffee offerings, for a limited time.

079212.item_story_marketing:
On its own, caramel is a superlatively capable confection. It’s rich, buttery, and remarkably sweet—a massive presence on the palate. When combined with some complementary element, however, it becomes something else entirely: a foundation on which to build captivatingly complex structures of flavor. Nowhere is that more evident than in Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Covered Caramels. They’re made for us by an expert supplier, who starts with a super sweet and enchantingly chewy square of lightly salted, vanilla-tinged Caramel, then coats it in a layer of full-flavored, tooth-sinkable Dark Chocolate. Together, this toothsome twosome of ingredients play off one another beautifully: the bitter elements of the Chocolate bring out the vanilla in the Caramel, while the delicately salty and sweet notes of the Caramel heighten the Chocolate’s muted fruity flavors.

Aside from serving spectacularly well on a dessert board, cut into bits and sprinkled atop of a scoop of French Vanilla Ice Cream, or simply enjoyed as the mood strikes, Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Covered Caramels also make a great gift for anyone you know with a sweet tooth. Bring a pouch over the next time you’re invited to a friend’s for dinner—they’re especially delicious when enjoyed after a meal with a glass of wine and great conversation.
079212.item_story_qil:
On its own, caramel is a superlatively capable confection. It's rich, buttery, and remarkably sweet-a massive 
presence on the palate. When combined with some complementary element, however, it becomes something 
else entirely: a foundation on which to build captivatingly complex structures of flavor. Nowhere is that more 
evident than in Trader Joe's Dark Chocolate Covered Caramels. They're made for us by an expert supplier, who 
starts with a super sweet and enchantingly chewy square of lightly salted, vanilla-tinged Caramel, then coats it 
in a layer of full-flavored, tooth-sinkable Dark Chocolate. Together, this toothsome twosome of ingredients play 
off one another beautifully: the bitter elements of the Chocolate bring out the vanilla in the Caramel, while the 
delicately salty and sweet notes of the Caramel heighten the Chocolate's muted fruity flavors.

Aside from serving spectacularly well on a dessert board, cut into bits and sprinkled atop of a scoop of French 
Vanilla Ice Cream [sku 78576], or simply enjoyed as the mood strikes, Trader Joe's Dark Chocolate Covered 
Caramels also make a great gift for anyone you know with a sweet tooth. Bring a pouch over the next time 
you're invited to a friend's for dinner-they're especially delicious when enjoyed after a meal with a glass of 
wine and great conversation.

Dark Chocolate Covered Caramels
079212.name: CARAMELS DARK CHOCOLATE

079213.item_story_marketing:
There’s a whole host of reasons why we love gummy candies; a multitude of ways in which we admire their chewy texture; a flight of facts about their fun and fruity flavors; a deluge of data about the delightful shapes they can take. And so it’s with this great array of affections for gummies in mind that we bring Trader Joe’s A Gaggle of Gummy Candies to our shelves. Made for us by an expert confectioner in France, each Gaggle contains an eclectic coterie of sweet Gummy Candies in a range of shapes and flavors that includes cherries, octopi, fried eggs, and cola bottles, along with Gummy bears to give the collection a classic feel.

Great as a gift for any avid Gummy appreciator, or indeed anyone with a sweet tooth, our Gaggle of Gummy Candies comes in at a hefty 14 ounces, making it an impressive array in terms of quality and quantity. In addition to being delciously sweet and toothsome in texture, we find that their various designs also make them great for decorating. Try placing them on cupcakes, in sundaes, or in pudding topped with crumbled Joe-Joe’s for a fun variation on a “worms in dirt” dessert. (Octupi in a swamp, perhaps? Cola bottles in a bog, anyone?)

079260.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Leave In Conditioner is a salon-quality Conditioner that’s made with some of the most sought-after hair care ingredients, including: argan oil, vitamin E, evening primrose, and hydrolyzed pea protein. When you use the spray bottle to lightly mist it through damp hair (avoiding the roots) just prior to brushing and styling, Trader Joe’s Leave In Conditioner will effectively help smooth and detangle for easy styling. Plus, its moisturizing ingredients help protect against potential damage your hair can sustain from blow dryers and other heat styling tools. In fact, this Conditioner can protect hair from heat up to 450°F—which comes in especially handy if you’re regularly using irons or straighteners. We call that h-air-conditioning!

In addition to its detangling and heat protection powers, Trader Joe’s Leave In Conditioner Spray also boasts a salon-worthy scent. Imagine a coastal breeze, carrying floral notes of rose, apple blossom, and jasmine, with hints of bright raspberry & lemon, over a base of bergamot & white musk. Did we leave anything out? Only that, if you stop by your neighborhood Trader Joe’s today, you can pick up this Leave In Conditioner for about one-fifth the price of similar products on the market!

079274.item_story_marketing:
One might think of the ice-cold waters of the Norwegian fjords as being inherently inhospitable, but they’re actually the ideal environment for certain species of fish, including herring, Greenland sharks, and Atlantic salmon. In fact, it’s within these waters that our supplier farms this meaty, mild-flavored salmon, and just a few miles away from said fjords’ shorelines, they gently smoke them and slice them super thin to accentuate their naturally tender texture. It all results in a delightfully savory, delicately smoky seafood treat, which we call Trader Joe’s Norwegian Smoked Salmon. 

While we’re particularly partial to enjoying Trader Joe’s Norwegian Smoked Salmon on a bagel with Whipped Cream Cheese and Capers, that’s just the beginning, as far as we’re concerned. It’s also excellent atop an English Muffin with a poached egg and Hollandaise for a satisfying salmon Benedict, or roughly chopped and mixed into scrambled eggs or placed into an omelet. And outside of its breakfast uses, we also find it’s great for including in seafood chowders, sandwiches, and pastas, and even simply serving over a leafy green salad or bowl of steamed rice.

079277.item_story_marketing:
Whose idea was it to put carrot in a cake anyway? In Medieval Europe, sugar was so inaccessible that the populace had to get creative with satisfying its sweet tooth. Abundant in quantity and sufficiently sweet, carrots got the job done—and then some. Not only did they contribute understated sweetness; they also increased moisture content to keep desserts fluffy. Taking notes from both Medieval masses and grandmas of yore, Trader Joe’s festively spiced Carrot Mini Sheet Cake evokes nostalgia with every bite.

Shredded carrots and warm spices are baked together in a sweet and nutty base. Speaking of nuts, walnuts lend just enough bite to contrast the cake’s moist and tender crumb. As with our mainstay Mini Sheet Cakes, cream cheese icing ribbons top off each slice with a tinge of tanginess and creamy texture.

There’s no baking or heating necessary for this scrumptious cake. Go right ahead and serve after weeknight dinners, add candles for birthday celebrations, or gift a whole sheet to the carrot cake lover in your life.

079289.item_story_marketing:
Ever wonder why some olives are green and some are black? It’s all about how they’re cured: when picked right off the tree, olives are actually quite inedible. They naturally contain a few phenolic compounds that are extremely bitter to the human palate, but which can be removed by curing them in an alkali solution. In the early 20th century, a speedy curing process was developed using a combination of curing solutions, compressed air, and heat treatments to oxidize these compounds out, which results in a softer texture, milder flavor, and deep black hue. Olives cured the old-fashioned way, like Trader Joe’s Medium Green Ripe Pitted Olives, take much longer to cure, but retain their original green color, are relatively firmer in texture, and comparatively richer with buttery, briny flavor.

So, which situations call for which kind of olive? It really depends on your mood: while both Black Olives and Green Olives make a terrific topping for pizza, pasta, and salads, we find that our Green Manzanilla Olives’ bolder profile and meatier texture make them a more favorable option for those that enjoy more overt olive flavor. Similarly, that also makes them a great choice for inclusion in charcuterie boards and antipasto platters, where their bright green color will also add some verdant, visual variety. And of course, if you enjoy olives as much as we do, they’re also stupendous for simply snacking on by the handful.

079301.item_story_marketing:
Granted, not every grocery store will go out of their way to ask a question like “don’t you think your dog would enjoy a waffle, every now and then?” But that’s certainly the kind of store Trader Joe’s has always aspired to be, and we’re proud to say that Trader Joe’s Harvest Brunch Turkey, Apple & Pumpkin Waffle Recipe Dog Treats are a truly excellent answer to that question. Made with hearty turkey, and fall-festive fruits and veggies, and seasoned with dog-friendly herbs like basil, sage, and thyme, these marvelously meaty Waffle-shaped treats are a wonderful way to share one of our favorite breakfast dishes with your favorite, four-legged friend.

As proud as we are of the ingredients inside these wonderful Waffles (like turkey, apple, pumpkin, and rice flour), we’re even prouder of what’s not included: these Treats are free of wheat and corn, and contain no artificial colors or flavors. While they make a magnificent motivational treat for training purposes, they’re also great for just giving to your dog as an occasional fun, full-flavored snack. And since we offer each 4.5-ounce pouch for such a pronounced value, they’re a lovely way to treat your pooch without breaking the bank.

079323.item_story_marketing:
Dogs like to chew on stuff, which is why bully sticks are one of their favorite treats. They provide something tough to chew on, with a beefy flavor dogs love. But in the past, Trader Joe’s has not sold traditional bully sticks made from pizzle because they often require exposure to radiation for the elimination of bacteria. Plus, the cost to source them can make it hard to provide a real value for our customers. Despite these challenges, our expert TJ’s Pet Food developers have found a way. The happy result is Trader Joe’s Bully Chewers!

Our Bully Chewers very much resemble common bully sticks. They are long, brown cylinders with a hard texture. But instead of being made from beef pizzle, our Chewers are mostly made from beef skin. The rolled skin is sprinkled with powdered beef pizzle for flavor, but this recipe does not require irradiation and remains safe for your pet to enjoy.

Bully Chewers are 70% protein, low in fat, and the chewing they promote helps keep your dog’s teeth clean. Best of all, we’ve found that dogs love them! And if your dog loves them, then we’re certain you’ll love them, too—especially when you discover what a value they are at our price. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Bully Chewers in our stores, every day.

079345.item_story_marketing:
Bright yet mellow, tart yet sweet—Trader Joe’s Citrus Berry Herbal Tea is full of contrasts that somehow work perfectly together. Dried orange peel and lemongrass offer a bright, Citrus-y zing, while dried strawberries and blackberry leaf bring the bold, Berry flavor. Hibiscus lends the Tea its tartness and beautiful red hue, dried apples and licorice root sweeten the blend a bit, and rose hips round out the flavor profile with mellow, floral notes. All in, you get a cheerful cup of Herbal Tea that’s layered but never overwhelming. 

Brew it hot, and the Tea’s flavors unfold slowly—citrusy at first, then deep and slightly jammy. Iced, it’s crisp and refreshing, making it an easy choice for warm afternoons or a midday reset. Since it’s naturally caffeine- free, there’s no wrong time to enjoy a cup. Whether you’re steeping it for a slow morning or just looking for an anytime alternative to the usual herbal standbys, our Citrus Berry Herbal Tea earns its spot on your shelf. Look for it in our coffee and tea section for a limited time, while supplies last.

079365.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Cheesy Bagels are hearth-baked Bagels with a plain bagel base, delightfully doughy on the inside. On the outside, they boast a cheesy, chewy crust that comes from shredded Asiago cheese that’s been pre-melted on top.

Take one of these pre-sliced Bagels, drop it into your toaster, and wait for the ding. Actually, you’ll know it’s almost done when you begin to smell the alluring aroma of Asiago as it heats up. Since they already have a “topping,” a little TJ’s Cultured Salted Butter is enough to make this Bagel ready to enjoy. However, we think our Cheesy Bagels are also particularly delicious when paired with TJ’s Chive & Onion Cream Cheese, or topped with a fried egg and a few drops of Habenero Hot Sauce.

079429.item_story_marketing:
A box of chocolates is all well and good, but if you ask us, life is much more like a bag of Trader Joe’s Sweet & Spicy Cracker Mix. As in life, this Mix is full of character, complexity, and both sweetness and spice in equal measure. It’s made for us by a supplier in Thailand, who fills each pouch with crispy, crunchy Rice Crackers in a variety of shapes and textures, half of which have been dusted in sugar, while the other half are covered in a spicy paprika-and-chile-powder coating. That means that every handful has a unique ratio of sweet and heat, and every time you snack, it’s going to be a bit unpredictable, delightfully adventurous, and in the end, satisfying, all the same —much like life, we’d say. 

And indeed, Trader Joe’s Sweet & Spicy Rice Cracker Mix is well suited for any snacking situation that life may throw at you, be it a weekend binge watch of your favorite new show, a game night with friends and family, or even just a random craving for something savory and sweet. We also find that the wide range of textures represented across the traditional Rice Cracker shapes (some are smooth, some are twisty, some are ridged) are especially great at piquing the palate when complemented by a smooth, refreshing beverage. We recommend one of our delicately fruity sparkling water options, or crisp and easy-drinking beer.

079481.item_story_marketing:
As if one needed yet another reason to love butter, we invite you to consider the transformative power that Trader Joe’s Butter with Parmesan, Garlic & Herb brings to the table. It’s made for us in small batches by a creamery with an uncommon knack for compound butters, who mixes in a hefty portion of Parmesan cheese along with dried garlic and parsley into smooth, salted butter. (What do we mean by hefty? Our supplier mixes in so much Parmesan that each four-ounce roll is roughly 25% cheese, by weight!) It all results in a splendidly savory and oh-so-spreadable butter that’s ready to bring some rich, full flavor to all sorts of culinary contexts.

Try melting a bit of our Butter with Parmesan, Garlic & Herb over a plate of soft, scrambled eggs at breakfast, spreading it over a grilled cheese sandwich at lunch, or adding a pat to a freshly baked potato at dinner. For some easy, delightfully umami-rich snacks and sides, melt some of this Butter in the microwave and slowly drizzle it over a bowl of popcorn, a plate of corn of the cob, or a sheet pan of your favorite roasted veggies. And if you’re ever in need of some quick garlic bread (and who isn’t, really?), simply spread a bit over a split baguette, toast in the oven at 400°F for about 10-12 minutes, and enjoy!

079482.item_story_marketing:
Maple-mania at Trader Joe’s knows no bounds during the fall—even our dairy case is getting in on the fun, with Trader Joe’s Butter with Brown Sugar & Maple Syrup! It’s made for us in small batches by a creamery with an uncommon knack for compound butters, who mixes rich brown sugar and deep, dark, grade-A maple syrup into smooth, salted butter. It all results in a sublimely sweet-savory flavor profile and oh-so-spreadable, punctuated-by-pops-of-sugar-crystal texture that simply screams “autumn.”

Our Butter with Brown Sugar & Maple Syrup is a boon to breakfast dishes of all kinds, from the expected (placed on a stack of pancakes or waffles, spread over a toasted English Muffin or flaky croissant) to the unconventional (melted over crispy Hashbrowns or a cheesy omelet, used in a breakfast sausage sandwich or savory grits). That said, it’s an excellent asset at the dinner table, too—especially with rolls during a holiday feast or family get-together. We recommend placing a pat on a freshly pan-seared or air-fried Salmon Fillet and letting it melt, just prior to serving.

079497.item_story_marketing:
When life gives us lemons at Trader Joe's, we imagine all of the wonderful lemon bars, poultry marinades and garnishes, cocktails, and of course, lemonade we can get started on. And when life gives us strawberries and lemons, we make Trader Joe's Organic Strawberry Lemonade, a tasty and refreshing juice that can be enjoyed anytime!

Our Organic Strawberry Lemonade sources natural, certified organic ingredients to make each half-gallon of this tangy and tart beverage. It's also free of high fructose corn syrup, preservatives, and artificial flavors. Whether you're setting up a lemonade stand with your children, hosting a summertime BBQ in need of refreshments, or enjoying a sweet afternoon pick me up, Trader Joe's Organic Lemonade has a home on your shopping list!

Finally, after months of testing and tasting (yum), we’re pleased to welcome Trader Joe’s Vanilla & Cream Yogurt cups to our refrigerators... and yours.  

Made with pasteurized milk from cows never treated with rBST, this classic, sweetened Yogurt gets its Vanilla & Cream flavor from natural Vanilla  flavor and, well,  Cream! It’s rich, it’s creamy, and it’s ready-to-go—each package comes with four, four-ounce cups, perfectly portioned for lunchboxes, afternoon snacks, and quick breakfasts on-the-go. We can hear you now: “All this for less than 70¢ a cup?! Yogurta be kiddin’ me, Trader Joe’s!” But we’re not kidding you, dear customer. Quite the contrary; we take yogurt—and value—very seriously.

Finally, after months of testing and tasting (yum), we’re pleased to welcome Trader Joe’s Raspberries & Cream Yogurt cups to our refrigerators... and yours.  

Made with pasteurized milk from cows never treated with rBST, this classic, sweetened Yogurt gets its Raspberries & Cream flavor from raspberry purée, cream, and natural flavor, and its color comes from fruit & veggie juice—not artificial food dyes. It’s rich, it’s creamy, and it’s ready-to-go—each package comes with four, four-ounce cups, perfectly portioned for lunchboxes, afternoon snacks, and quick breakfasts on-the-go. We can hear you now: “All this for less than 70¢ a cup?! Yogurta be kiddin’ me, Trader Joe’s!” But we’re not kidding you, dear customer. Quite the contrary; we take yogurt—and value—very seriously.

Colombian chocolate is truly among the finest in the world. Rich and complex with subtly citric and fruity notes throughout, it’s the kind of chocolate with a breadth of flavor that stands up on its own, even without added sugar. Which is precisely why there’s No Sugar Added to Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Thins On the Go. They’re made for us by an expert supplier in Colombia using Colombian cocoa, cocoa butter, and allulose, rather than sugar. They’re also studded with roasted cocoa nibs for a crunchy pop of texture, then seasoned with just a touch of sea salt for a slightly savory edge in each and every satisfying bite. 

Each pouch contains 12 individually wrapped, easy-to-transport Thins, making these a capital confection for carrying On the Go. Whether or not you’re watching the amount of sugar in your diet, they make a fantastic inclusion in work and school lunches, they’re great for grabbing on your way out of the door to enjoy while running errands, and are superb for simply snacking on as an anytime indulgence.

079515.item_story_marketing:
Combining the consummate richness of Colombian Chocolate with the captivatingly Crispy crunch of puffed Rice, Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Sticks with Crispy Rice are truly triumphant on both a taste and textural level. They’re made especially for us by a bean-to-bar supplier in Colombia, who uses 60% Dark Chocolate so that every bite strikes a balance between approachable sweetness and deep, fruity, almost floral complexity. After they mix this molten Dark Chocolate with airy, Crispy Rice, they pour it into bite-sized, Stick-shaped molds, so that once they cool, they’ve taken on the ideal form for a quick and easy anytime indulgence.

We’re particularly fond of bringing a bag of Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Sticks as a movie snack, pairing a Stick or two with a shot of espresso, or using them to provide some sayifyingly sweet contrast on a charcuterie board or cheese plate. They’re great for sharing with friends and family during a board game night, or accessorizing a dessert plate during a dinner party. We also find that their Stick format makes them an especially apt choice for dunking into something sweet, like ice cream or a ricotta-based dessert dip, or something semi-savory, like a bit of Creamy No Stir Peanut Butter Spread.

079518.item_story_marketing:
If you have a pet, you probably love your pet—and if you love your pet, you want the very best for them, even down to their treats. When it comes to pet treats, Trader Joe’s Freeze-Dried Just Salmon for Pets is definitely among the very best! These treats are not just salmon scrapings that have been re-formed to resemble chunks. In fact, these treats are made from one ingredient: whole, skin-on, Atlantic Salmon fillets. Nothing is wasted when the whole fillets—skin intact—are cubed and then Freeze Dried. And nothing is added. It’s Just Salmon for Pets!

Now, you may wonder why we say “Pets” and not “Dogs” or “Cats.” Well, that’s because we’ve found this Freeze-Dried Salmon to be appealing to both dogs and cats alike. And the lighter texture and smaller pieces work for both kinds of furry friends.

Being Just Salmon, these treats are packed with essential protein and omega fatty acids. Nevertheless, they are not meant to replace meals. We recommend Freeze-Dried Just Salmon for Pets as snacks between meals, or for training rewards. For finicky eaters, these crunchy fish bites also make a great food topper to kick start your Pet’s real meal. You’ll find Freeze-Dried Just Salmon for Pets in the pet food section of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, every day.

079525.item_story_marketing:
When covering all your bases for a dinner party, holiday feast, or really any kind of get-together where great food is involved, don't forget to pick up something special and spirited as an after-dinner treat-something like Trader Joe's Espresso Martini. Modeled after the cocktail craze that's been sweeping bar menus these past few years, this pre-mixed and totally ready-to-drink Espresso Martini is made with a base of vodka, espresso, and a touch of vanilla so that every sip is rich, sweet, and strikingly smooth-ideal for serving alongside something chocolatey and decadent. 

Of course, that's just one of many situations in which a pre-made Martini might make the evening that much more elegant. It's excellent for keeping in the fridge as an instant way to elevate a Friday evening. It makes an alluring accompaniment to cheese boards and hors d'oeuvres platters. And, since each bottle contains roughly four servings, it's a bit like an instant-cocktail-party-in-a-bottle for you and three friends, and all for a price that's less than what you'd pay for a single espresso martini at most cocktail bars! Now, isn't that sweet? That's that Trader Joe's Espresso Martini!

079548.item_story_marketing:
Korean Style Yangnyeom Sauce According to food historians, Yangnyeom Sauce was invented by a restaurant owner in Korea as a response to complaints that the skin on his establishment’s fried chicken was far too crunchy. Rather than change his batter recipe, the restauranteur whipped together a sticky-sweet and spicy sauce of gochujang, sugar, and various savory spices to serve over the chicken, thus softening it. Beyond the textural benefit, customers fell in love with the sauce, and yangnyeom (Korean for “seasoned,” pronounced “YANG-nyum”) chicken soon became a certified bar food craze. 

Inspired by this bit of on-the-fly ingenuity, Trader Joe’s Yangnyeom Sauce offers all the same satisfying gochujang spice and sugary sweetness that made yangnyeom chicken famous. And while it is indeed incredibly delicious on some crispy-fried chicken, that’s just the beginning, as far as we’re concerned. We recommend trying it on everything from roasted veggies to grilled short ribs, air-fried salmon, shrimp tacos, and omelettes. Frankly, we’ll even use it as a dip for French fries... or as sauce on a homemade Pizza topped with Pepper Jack Cheese, Spicy Chicken Nuggets, and cilantro or green onions (trust us on this one—it’s delicious.)

079569.item_story_marketing:
Instantly recognizable from its vibrant, ruddy hue and sharp, Cheddar-like flavor, Trader Joe’s Red Leicester Cheese comes to us from a farmer-owned cooperative that’s been in the cheesemaking business for well over a hundred years. From their farms, located in this Cheese’s namesake county of Leicestershire in England, they carefully craft, age, and shape each puck-sized wheel to ensure only the highest quality, most perfectly matured Leicester makes its way to our stores. After that, they coat each wheel in deep red wax, so that when you take it home, peeling it open to serve feels a bit like opening up a culinary gift to yourself.

With its signature rich, red-orange color (courtesy of annatto, a natural coloring derived from the seeds of the achiote tree) and delightfully nutty, savory, and delicately sweet flavor profile (courtesy of the expertise provided by our esteemed supplier), Trader Joe’s Red Leicester truly stands out on any cheese board or charcuterie plate. It’s also renowned within the greater cheese world for its marvelous meltability: we recommend trying it sliced on a burger, mixed into mashed potatoes, or shredded and served over hot scrambled eggs.

079580.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s recognizes the great joys of grilling burgers by supporting all you home grillers with the very best ground beef options—and it doesn’t get much better than Trader Joe’s Angus Chuck, Brisket, Sirloin Ground Beef Patties! The Aberdeen Angus cattle breed yields muscle with plenty of fat marbling, which translates into juicy, tender meat. More specifically, this blend incorporates cuts from the shoulder (Chuck), chest (Brisket), and rump (Sirloin). The slightly fattier composition of the Brisket (20% of the blend) and Sirloin (5%) each contribute amazingly rich flavor, while the leaner and more conventional ground Chuck (75%) brings additional ‘beefiness.’ 

This C.B.S. blend is about 75% lean/25% fat, which is ideal for quick, hot grilling. The pre-portioned one-third-pound Patties remain tender & juicy and each finished burger remains big enough to fill a TJ’s Brioche Bun. As far as condiments go, our uniquely flavorful blend welcomes bolder flavors, like Blue Cheese Dressing and Dip, Hot Honey Mustard, or Pickled Red Onions. You’ll find them in our fresh meat cases every day—even after outdoor grilling season has come and gone!
079580.item_story_qil:
One of the great joys of the warmer months is grilling your own burgers at home. Trader Joe's has always been 
an enthusiastic supporter of home-grillers, with our top-quality ground beef options, such as 85/15 Organic 
Grass Fed Ground Beef [sku 92558], and 80/20 Ground Beef Patties [sku 55923]. For those looking for a ready-
for-the-grill burger with a uniquely flavorful twist, you'll want to try Trader Joe's Angus C.B.P. Ground Beef 
1/3 lb. Patties.

This is a Ground blend of three different whole-muscle cuts of Angus beef. Angus refers to the more muscular 
Aberdeen Angus cattle breed, which yields meat with plenty of fat marbling. This marbling translates into juicy, 
tender meat. More specifically, this C.B.P. blend incorporates Angus cuts from the shoulder (Chuck), chest 
(Brisket), and rump (Picanha). The Brisket (20% of the blend) and Picanha (5%) each contribute amazingly 
rich flavor, with their slightly fattier composition, while the leaner and more conventional ground Chuck 
(75%) brings additional 'beefiness' and balance.

All of this amounts to a Ground Beef blend that is about 75% lean/25% fat-ideal for quick, hot grilling. And 
the substantial size of these pre-portioned 1/3 lb. Patties allows them to remain tender & juicy, even when 
cooked over the flames. The resulting bigger burgers will also easily fill TJ's Brioche Buns [sku 61752] to satisfy 
even the hungriest BBQ-goers-but only for a limited time. Find 21.3-ounce (1 lb. 5.3 oz.) packages of four 
Trader Joe's Angus C.B.P. Ground Beef Patties in our refrigerators, while the summer grilling season lasts.

Angus C.B.P. Ground Beef 1/3 lb Patties

079580.name: BEEF ANGUS C.B.S. BLEND HAMBURGER PATTIES

079590.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe's White Stilton with Mango & Ginger adheres to the same requirements as the famous Blue to earn its “Stilton” designation: It’s produced for us in Cropwell Bishop, a village in Nottinghamshire—one of only three English counties approved for Stilton production. It’s made only from locally pasteurized cow’s milk. It’s formed into a cylindrical shape—but not pressed—and its crust is naturally formed. Where this White differs from its Blue cousin is in what’s inside. 

Eschewing the friendly blue-green fungus, our White Stilton contains something that is arguably more palatable: mango and ginger. Visually, it’s stunning. Bits of fruit and root appear throughout—easy compliments to the creamy, crumbly texture of the cheese. The infusion of dried mango conveys a sweet and fruity taste, which is enhanced by the spice of the crystallized ginger. Our Mango and Ginger Stilton is fabulous when crumbled on a salad, or melted on a steak. It presents well on a cheeseboard with walnuts, fresh pears, and ginger snap cookies. It pairs equally well with a glass of fruity Riesling, spiced Gewürztraminer, or dry Chenin or Sauvignon Blanc. However you slice it, this mild, semi-soft White Stilton goes down easy. The only requirement we’ll add is that you grab some before it’s gone!

079601.item_story_marketing:
Is your everyday nut mix in need of some enhancement? Is your charcuterie board not as charming as you’d like? Does your cocktail party’s snack selection leave you cold? It sounds to us like you could use a change in elevation—and we have just the Mix to take you there. Trader Joe’s Elevated Nut Mix is a sublimely simple blend of delicately roasted and lightly salted pecans, almonds, cashews and macadamias. And that’s it.

So what exactly makes this Mix so Elevated? First, there’s the quality of the Nuts involved. We’ve sourced whole, intact Nuts (rather than bits or pieces) from three different countries on three different continents (pecans & almonds from the U.S.A., cashews from Vietnam, and macadamia nuts from Kenya, to be precise) to find only the tastiest, most toothsome Nuts available. Second, they’ve been salted just enough to let their individual natural flavors come together together on the palate, so that it creates something more than the sum of its parts. And third, though the eating experience is Elevated, our price has a decidedly downward disposition, relative to other grocer’s comparable mixes—and that’s always elevates our mood.

079606.item_story_marketing:
While it’s true that “necessity is the mother of invention,” it’s worth mentioning that necessity’s also a pretty amazing chef. Take something like smoked trout, for instance. Originally, treating trout with smoke was purely practical—a method of preservation pre-dating the advent of refrigeration. Nowadays, though, we primarily smoke trout because—by a fantastic culinary coincidence—a little bit of smoke happens to make trout taste terrific. And doubly so when you use a delicately flavored hardwood on lightly salted rainbow trout, as our supplier has with Trader Joe’s Oakwood Smoked Trout Fillet.

Mildly smoky and with a moist and flaky texture, this Oakwood Smoked Trout is a remarkably versatile protein. It can be crumbled onto salads, used to top sandwiches or bagels, or mixed into a hearty egg scramble. It makes an excellent addition to a charcuterie board, or centerpiece of a trendy tinned fish spread, along with our Lightly Smoked Mussels and Grilled Sardines. And for an easy, hearty, appetizer dip with crackers, we recommend flaking it with a fork and mixing with Whipped Cream Cheese, Capers, and finely chopped Chives.

079614.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Corn & Chile Salsa is definitely corny. In a good way. It’s an a-maizing condiment, beginning with a base of sweet corn, and blended with finely diced red bell peppers, onions, jalapeño peppers, and a bit of sugar. By “a base of sweet corn,” we mean, “lots and lots of sweet corn.” As in, 1.8 ears of corn in every jar – we have taken them off their cobs to make them fit. (We’ve sold enough of this salsa that over time, this has added up to more than 41,313,173 ears of corn.) It has a little kick, but it’s not what we’d call hot.

Pile it into tacos or burritos, scoop it up with Organic Corn Dippers, spoon it over salads or chili or soup, use it as a dip for veggies, fold it into scrambled eggs, serve it as a side dish with grilled chicken or fish, or even use it in place of traditional relish on a hot dog.

079616.item_story_marketing:
Need something to help you step into the fall spirit? It’s easy—all you need is Trader Joe’s Pumpkin Loaf! It starts, unsurprisingly, with Pumpkin purée, which gives the wheat flour-based Loaf an incredibly moist and not too dense crumb. A parade of spices—cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, ginger, and cloves, to be exact— intermingle with notes of vanilla to create the classic spice profile one would expect to find in autumnally- inspired baked goods. Topping it off is a crowning layer of crunchy sugar and a generous dusting of aromatic, fall-forward spices, ensuring every bite is is imbued with the spirit of the season.

Almost as delightful as the Pumpkin Loaf itself is its open-and-enjoy nature—all you have to do is slice and serve, perhaps alongside a glass of iced Pumpkin Spice Flavored Cold Brew Concentrate Coffee or a hot cup of Colombia Supremo Coffee. If you’ve got a bit more time on your hands, you might toast a slice and drizzle with Creamy Salted Almond Butter and Pumpkin Butter. Gilding the lily? Maybe. Scrumptiously satisfying? You bet!

If all you need is Loaf, then make haste—these Pumpkin Loaves are limited to the fall season!

079628.item_story_marketing:
Located about 50 miles out from the Korean mainland’s southern coast, Jeju Island has an ancient nickname: “Samda-do,” or “Island of Three Abundances,” referring to Jeju’s prevalence of rocks, wind, and women. All three abundances were ultimately a consequence of the fact that Jeju is a relatively isolated volcanic island: the rocks a result of the dormant volcano at its center, the wind coming from the ocean on all sides, and the women an artifact of the island’s male-dominated seafaring economy creating a comparatively matriarchal society back on shore. While much has changed in the centuries since Jeju earned its nickname, its volcanic nature (and more importantly, fertile volcanic soil) certainly hasn’t, which is why it remains one of the best places in the world to grow green tea for matcha. And that’s precisely what you’ll find in our convenient new Trader Joe’s  Instant Jeju Matcha Latte Packets.

Indeed, inside each packet, our supplier has placed rich and aromatic Matcha powder from Jeju, along with a mix that includes skim milk powder and sugar. That means that all you’ ll need to Instantly create a sweet, smooth, and flavorful Matcha Latte is a cup, eight ounces of hot or cold water, and the time to mix it, sip it, and savor it to your satisfaction—no whisk required. Since it can be enjoyed hot or cold, we find it’s suitable for all sorts of weather and all times of day, especially when paired with an Almond Croissant, a yogurt parfait, or a bowl of fresh strawberries.

079654.item_story_marketing:
If you’ve tasted Trader Joe’s Crisps (Raisin Rosemary, Fig & Olive, et. al), you know our exacting cracker standards have contributed to some of the most reliably tasty cheese vehicles, dip delivery vessels, and out-of-hand snacks to grace our shelves over the past 15 years—and counting! Unless, of course, you adhere to a gluten free diet, in which case, you likely have yet to experience their fantastically flavorful crunch. Well, that changes today, with the introduction of Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Cranberry Raisin Toasts!

Made for us in the U.K. by gluten free cracker experts, these snappy, oblong Toasts are made with a blend of rice, tapioca, and potato flours, combined with a base of egg whites and tangy buttermilk. Positively brimming with sweet, chewy dried Cranberries and Raisins, they’re balanced with savory pumpkin seeds and aromatic rosemary. The thinly sliced construction of these two-bite Toasts makes them ideal for afternoon snacking, while their crisp crunch provides a welcome foil to a swipe of Goat’s Milk Creamy Cheese [sku 98825] or velvety slices of Triple Crème Brie. TL;DR: they’re a standout cracker selection that’s sure to appeal to both gluten free and gluten-ful crowds, for practically any occasion.

While similar crackers sell elsewhere for double the price, these terrific Toasts are available every day on the cracker shelves at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, for a price that won’t break the bank. We’ll toast to that!

079658.item_story_marketing:
Looking to take your tastebuds to cloud nine? Look no further than Trader Joe’s Strawberries & Cream Cloud Cake! Made for us in Sweden, this sweet ode to summer floats somewhere between a nostalgic strawberry shortcake and an elegant treat from a European pâtisserie. Each Cake is comprised of two layers of moist sponge cake, a creamy custard filling, a fluffy cloak of whipped cream, and a generous pile of sweet & saucy strawberries surrounded by additional dollops of whipped cream. Sounds heavenly, doesn’t it?

Sized to serve six and sold frozen, this Cloud Cake is precisely the kind of dreamy dessert you’ll want to have on hand all summer long—ready to thaw, slice, and serve whenever the occasion for indulgence arises. (Think birthday parties, brunches, potlucks, picnics, bridal showers, and beyond!) Simply defrost it in the fridge overnight, and it’s ready to go—no baking or assembly required. You’ll find 17.64-ounce Trader Joe’s Strawberries & Cream Cloud Cakes in our freezers all summer long.

079675.item_story_marketing:
There’s a group of ingredients that have been trending online for quite a while amongst lovers of savory, comforting recipes. This combination comes in the form of casseroles, skillet meals, sheet-pan recipes, sandwiches, salads, and even dips. In fact, this combo is the inspiration for Trader Joe’s Chicken Uncured Bacon Ranch Dip! 

Our version starts with a mixture of sour cream, shredded sharp Cheddar, cream cheese, mayo, and buttermilk. This creates a rich, creamy, cheesy base with a hint of tanginess. Then we add plenty of shredded, rotisserie- style Chicken breast and pieces of Uncured Bacon. (Uncured, meaning there are no nitrites or nitrates added, except what’s naturally occurring in sea salt and celery juice.) As if cheese, Chicken, and Bacon weren’t enough, we finish the recipe with a custom, Ranch-style seasoning blend of herbs & spices, including chives, parsley, dill, garlic & onion.

While you can eat it cold, this Dip is really made to be heated. That’s as easy as putting it in a microwave-safe bowl, and heating it 2-3 minutes at 30-second intervals until it’s heated through. Then comes the dipping! The dip-list is limitless, but you might start with celery sticks, Les Petite Carrots of Many Colors, Pita Bite Crackers, Tortilla Chips, and slices of toasted Organic Baguette.

079681.item_story_marketing:
Provolone Cheese is an age-old Italian creation that brings a mildly creamy flavor to plenty of dishes. Trader Joe’s Sliced Provolone Cheese makes this exemplar cheese variety available in a pre-sliced form ready to enjoy atop sandwiches, wraps, and other cold cut classics a plenty.

A cousin of mozzarella, Provolone Cheese is a cow’s milk, semi-hard formaggi a pasta filata (Italian for “spun paste cheese”). It undergoes kneading of the fresh curd in hot water to give that famously elastic, rubbery texture that Provolone Cheese is known for. This mass of curd created from the stretching process is then aged to harden, and therefore differentiate, the Provolone from its mozzarella cousin. Like all pulled curd cheeses, a bit of Sliced Provolone Cheese is wonderful, and arguably more flavorful, when melted. This should direct your mind to the world of paninis, casseroles, baked pasta, and hoagies as a perfect pairing for our Sliced Provolone Cheese. Each slice was made for two slices of fresh bread, to be flashed in heat, and to evoke images of ooey gooey goodness.

079689.item_story_marketing:
There once was a young boy who enjoyed a bowl of Chicken Chile Verde every day. The boy loved the mixture of tender dark & white meat Chicken. He also loved the savory Chile Verde that was made with a combination of crushed tomatillos, green chiles, jalapeños, and Anaheim peppers. One day as the boy sat down for his daily bowl, he noticed his spoon was not in its normal place. After searching high and low, the boy considered using his hands. “Too messy,” he thought. Then he considered tipping the bowl so he could spill the Chile Verde directly into his mouth. It was not soup, so this did not work.

Just when the boy was about to give up, a heavenly aroma, like that of freshly baked bread, came wafting into the room. He followed his nose to find his mother rolling, pressing, and cooking flour tortillas. She saw him and the hungry look in his eyes. Without exchanging a word, she handed him one of the tortillas and he immediately rushed back to his table where he neatly wrapped up the contents of his bowl. The hungry boy didn’t hesitate to take a bite and soon found that the tactile sensation of holding the warm Chicken Chile Verde in his hands, along with the pleasantly chewy texture of the tortilla, made this the most enjoyable Chicken Chile Verde he had ever eaten!

Though we can’t verify the historical authenticity of this story, we can absolutely confirm that this serendipitous recipe is uncannily similar to our recipe for Trader Joe’s Chicken Chile Verde Burritos, which are now conveniently available in our freezers. Each 14-ounce package (containing two Burritos) is ready to go from freezer to hand in about two-and-a-half microwave minutes. No bowl or spoon required.

079708.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s has all the shapes in our bakery section: circular bagels; slender baguettes; flat-breads... We thought it was about time we got around to boules. Trader Joe’s Sourdough Boules not only bring their unique ball shape, but they also bring delicious bread that rises to so many excellent eating occasions.

Our Boules are made with a wild yeast Sourdough starter and long fermentation, to build a light, airy crumb— and to yield the slightly nutty, slightly tangy taste that one expects from sourdough. The seven-ounce, round loaves—about five inches in diameter by three inches tall—are baked until the crust is golden brown and delightfully chewy, with a satisfying, open crumb.

All these traits mean Trader Joe’s Sourdough Boules are great sliced and toasted for breakfast with TJ’s Cultured Salted Butter and Organic Reduced Sugar Strawberry Preserves. For lunch, try some topped with a Teeny Tiny Avocado. Speaking of shapes, you can cut a Boule into cubes and toast them for the best croutons you’ve ever had on your salad! And if soup is on the menu, why not turn your Boule in to a bowl, then fill it with TJ’s New England Clam Chowder. However you choose to enjoy it, you’re guaranteed to have a Boule!

079711.item_story_marketing:
What’s a burger without a bun? A house without a floor or roof, that’s what—and we may be grocers, not architects, but we’re pretty sure that houses generally need floors and roofs. That’s why we offer a bevy of bun varieties on our bakery shelves, including Trader Joe’s Potato Buns. Available May through September on our bakery racks, these soft and savory Buns will provide all the structural support your burgers need for all your summer grilling or pan-fried patty needs—and they’ll taste great while doing so, too. 

Trader Joe’s Potato Buns are made from a traditional Pennsylvania Dutch-inspired recipe that swaps a bit of wheat flour for potato flour for extra body and a soft, moist texture. It’s a style that’s popular among the more elevated burger chains out there (for good reason!), and while we find it’s especially suited for our Chuck, Brisket, & Sirloin Patties, you really can’t go wrong with any patty pairing. Want to build a better burger? Give these Potato Buns a try with our Caramelized Onion & Bell Pepper Turkey Patties and plenty of melted Swiss cheese, a hearty Shrimp Burger or Salmon Burger with a citrus-y slaw, or a Quinoa Cowby Veggie Burger with plenty of spicy BBQ sauce.

079712.item_story_marketing:
Pop quiz: How long does it take to grow an Orchid? Believe it or not, it takes more than two years! They’re grown at high temperatures in high humidity; once mature, they’re moved into colder temps that cause them to bloom. Their blooms last anywhere from six to eight weeks, and since they require very little water, you can head out for a last-minute trip without needing to find a plant-sitter. And today feels like an ideal time to explore the Orchid offerings at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

Now for the extra credit: who has the best values around on plants & flowers? Your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, of course!

079720.item_story_marketing:
When you read the words “juicy burger,” turkey is not likely the first meat that comes to mind—but what if it was? Our product developer set out to answer this very question while working to create summertime stars for grilling season (May to September, to be precise), and much to our tasting panel’s delight, he emerged victorious from the test kitchen with Trader Joe’s Caramelized Onion & Bell Pepper Turkey Patties.

Made with 100% thigh meat, these grill-ready Turkey Patties are unbelievably—dare we say impossibly—juicy. The Caramelized Onion brings plenty of umami to the table, while the vegetal sweetness of the Bell Pepper deftly complements the savory Turkey in each tender bite. Thanks to their fuss-free prep and quick-cooking nature, you’ll have more time to ponder your preferred burger accoutrements (Brioche Bun? Sliced Swiss Cheese? Aioli Garlic Mustard Sauce? Yes, yes, and oh, yes!), as well as more time to bask in the glow of a relaxing summer’s evening. For a limited time, you’ll find this incredibly priced, grilling season must-have in the refrigerators at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

079722.item_story_marketing:
Is it possible for an apple to be an overachiever? Pink Lady® apples would say yes. As the first apple cultivar to blossom and the last to be harvested, they soak up about 200 days of sunshine before landing in your kitchen. As a result, they boast an especially crisp bite, rosy-blush color, and balanced, sweet-tart flavor—flavor that’s amplified in Trader Joe’s Pink Lady® Apple Chips.

It all starts in Washington state, where our supplier harvests the Apples at peak freshness. They’re thinly sliced, then vacuum crisped until delightfully crunchy. What’s vacuum crisping, you ask? It’s a gentle frying method that uses a vacuum-sealed chamber to crisp the Apples at low temperature with minimal oil, helping preserve and magnify their flavor. They’re topped off with a dusting of cinnamon sugar, culminating in sweet, effervescent Apple Chips with a paradoxically juicy finish.

Snack on gluten free Pink Lady® Apple Chips right out of the bag, or crumble them over Plain Whole Milk Greek Yogurt or French Vanilla Ice Cream (perhaps with Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce on top?). Speaking of caramel sauce, you can always use it as a dip for your Apple Chips, or drizzle it over them for a dessert-y spin on nachos.

As a result, they boast an especially crisp bite, rosy-blush color, and balanced, sweet-tart flavor-flavor that's 
amplified in Trader Joe's Pink Lady® Apple Chips.

It all starts in Washington state, where our supplier harvests the Apples at peak freshness. They're thinly 
sliced, then vacuum crisped until delightfully crunchy. What's vacuum crisping, you ask? It's a gentle frying 
method that uses a vacuum-sealed chamber to crisp the Apples at low temperature with minimal oil, helping 
preserve and magnify their flavor. They're topped off with a dusting of cinnamon sugar, culminating in sweet, 
effervescent Apple Chips with a paradoxically juicy finish. 

Snack on gluten free Pink Lady® Apple Chips right out of the bag, or crumble them over Plain Whole Milk 
Greek Yogurt [sku 69707] or French Vanilla Ice Cream [sku 78576] (perhaps with Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce 
[sku 95214] on top?). Speaking of caramel sauce, you can always use it as a dip for your Apple Chips, or drizzle 
it over them for a dessert-y spin on nachos. 

Pink Lady® Apple Chips
079722.name: PINK LADY APPLE CHIPS

Trader Joe’s Crispy Chicken Chips Dog Treats are the tangible answer to that rhetorical question!

These super premium Chips for Dogs are made from just two ingredients: 100% USDA Chicken breast meat and salt. This means they don’t contain other stuff, like grains, soy, dairy, and corn. They provide the delicious Chicken flavor that Dogs crave, delivered in thin, Crispy Chips that pups love to crunch. 

In fact, Dogs love Trader Joe’s Crispy Chicken Chips so much, you’ll have to remind yourself that they are meant to be given as supplemental treats, rather than as a replacement for your dog’s regular diet. In this respect, they’re just like your favorite Trader Joe’s snack chips! You’ll find stand-up, resealable pouches of these Crispy Chicken Chips Dog Treats every day in our pet food section.

079732.item_story_marketing:
Originally invented in the Joseon Dynasty as a royal dish, reserved for official banquets and state dinners, japchae is still associated with celebrations in modern-day Korea, and is often served at birthdays, weddings, and other formal festivities. Way back in the 17th century, it was primarily a veggie-based stir fry (“japchae” itself simply translates to “mixed vegetables”). It wasn’t until the 1900s that sweet potato-based glass noodles, a product of culinary cross-pollination from China, made their way into the dish, to make Japchae what we know today. All of which is to say, though japchae may have changed over the years, it’s still a celebration- worthy dish that’s emphatically fit for royalty.

Coming to us straight from a supplier in Korea, Trader Joe’s Japchae Fried Rice recontextualizes this iconic entrée into something even heartier and homier. It’s made with a base of white rice and glass noodles, along with a mix of thinly sliced shiitake mushrooms, cabbage, peppers, onions, and carrots, all of which are seasoned with soy sauce and sesame oil. After just a few minutes in the microwave or on the stovetop, it serves up beautifully, offering rich aromas, savory and umami flavors, and a wide spectrum of tender textures. And for an extra special treat, we especially like it topped with a freshly fried egg.

079742.item_story_marketing:
While some folks love nothing more than biting into a hearty crust on a sandwich, others proclaim a teary “Et tu, Mama?” when presented with a sandwich whose filling is obscured by the bread’s seemingly offensive edges. And while a ready-to-eat sandwich sans crust is not a new culinary invention by any stretch of the imagination, the ones you can find elsewhere often contain less than desirable ingredients and artificial preservatives— which is why we’re thrilled to present Trader Joe’s Crustless Peanut Butter & Strawberry Jam Sandwiches as a truly tasty alternative!

Their construction is straightforward: salted peanut butter and bright strawberry jam are encased in a chewy white bread whose crusts have been crimped and removed, sealing the sweet & salty filling inside. Simply thaw at room temperature for an hour (or in the refrigerator for two), and you’ll have a handy vegan PB&J in your hands. And because they’re kept frozen until needed, you’ll always have a PB&J handy wherever the day’s adventures take you, or when your hands and/or to-do list are otherwise full. You’ll find them in the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, every day.

079744.item_story_marketing:
Picture this: you’ve just finished a romantic dinner with your one and only, a dinner made by you, with tender loving care. While your present company might be expecting the standard dessert indulgences, we’d like to propose an alternative: instead of bringing out the chocolate cake (or perhaps in addition to bringing out the chocolate cake), surprise your beloved with a bouquet of Trader Joe’s Strawberry Hold the Cone! Mini Ice Cream Cones!

Identical in size and shape to their everyday Chocolate, Vanilla, and Chocolate Chip Hold the Cone! counterparts, these latest Cones put a sweet, Strawberry spin on what has become one of our most popular products of all time. Their construction is rather simple, yet delightfully deliberate. Each Mini sugar Cone is lined with a rich, chocolatey coating to help ensure maximum “cone life” (yes, that’s a real term), then filled with teeny-tiny scoop of creamy, bursting-with-Strawberry-flavor ice cream (made with plenty of strawberry purée). Finally, the Cones are dipped, ice cream-side down, in that same chocolatey coating that lines the cone... and the result is an all-occasion Ice Cream novelty to remember. Move over, chocolate-covered strawberries—there’s a new berry-licious treat in town.

079747.item_story_marketing:
There’s something sublimely simple about a stately, square, wheat cracker. Slightly sweet and elegantly salty, the humble wheat cracker can be counted on in all kinds of culinary contexts, including (and perhaps especially) enjoying as a standalone snack. It’s been a while since we’ve carried such a cracker on our shelves, and the time felt right to reintroduce one to our snacks section—we just had to be sure that the one we brought in was as satisfyingly crispy as those we’ve enjoyed in the past, while still substantial enough to hold up to heavy-duty cheese slices and hearty dips. After a few rounds through our tasting panel, we knew we had it with Trader Joe’s Wheat Crisp Crackers.

Made for us by a Canadian supplier, who bakes each Cracker to a crispy, crunchy, gloriously golden brown, our Wheat Crisp Crackers make a capital companion to any cheese plate or charcuterie board, where their subtle blend of savory and sweet can complement even the most complex of flavor profiles. They more than hold their own when used to scoop up hummuses and other savory dips, and take particularly well to being topped with fruit spreads, cream cheeses, and combinations thereof, too. And, of course, they’re also great for simply snacking on while catching up on a TV show, or catching up with a friend.

079753.item_story_marketing:
To create this beloved sauce, we partnered with a supplier located in Puglia (the heel of the “boot”), where the hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters of this Mediterranean region are ideal for growing tomatoes. In fact, our supplier not only makes this sauce, but also grows the sweet, juicy tomatoes that make it so special. The rest of the ingredients are simple and fresh, including olive oil, diced onion & chopped garlic (not powders), chopped fresh basil, and sea salt. The only “dried” ingredient is oregano, which was chosen purposefully for its more concentrated flavor. 

What will you do with Trader Joe’s Caro Sugo Italian Tomato Basil Pasta Sauce? The answer is: anything you like! As you can imagine, it’s delicious with your favorite TJ’s pasta or ravioli. Try it with our Homestyle Angus Beef Meatballs on a Sandwich Roll topped with melted Sliced Provolone. You’ll also find this Tomato Sauce shines on pizzas, in shakshuka, or even as a dipping sauce for our Breaded Mozzarella Cheese Sticks!

They are delightfully crisp and crunchy, and their simple recipe imparts classic Sugar-Cookie flavor, which is enhanced by a generous dusting of cinnamon and coarse sugar on top. And not only can you enjoy them in autumn, but you can also enjoy them all year long.

079789.item_story_marketing:
At this point, chocolate and peanut butter are more than just an iconic pairing—they’re the “it” couple of the candy aisle. After so many years of celebrated sweet and savory service, we thought this duo deserved a proper honeymoon—so we’ve sent them off to our trail mix section in the form of Trader Joe’s Chocolate & Peanut Butter Lover’s Nut Mix. Every batch is made with a base of roasted almonds and cashews, into which our supplier sprinkles miniature peanut butter cups and cocoa-dusted, dark-chocolate-covered almonds, along with crisp mini pretzels and our very own Tiniest Chocolate Chip Cookies for even more crunch.

Together, this harmonious Mix creates a sweet-savory symphony on the palate—the crumbliness of the mini cookies contrasts beautifully with the crunch of the almonds, while the buttery flavor of the cashews complements the salty snap of the mini pretzels most agreeably. Which all leads, of course, to the stars of the show, the Chocolate-covered almonds and Peanut Butter cups. We recommend enjoying this Mix as a movie snack (especially while snuggling up to a loved one), breaking it out for a board game night, or simply munching on as a fun, full-flavored treat, whenever a craving for something sweet, savory, and crunchy strikes.

079817.item_story_marketing:
Champ. Boxty. Colcannon. The list of Irish, potato-based delicacies is a like an all-star, comfort food showcase. We set out to create a snack that recontextualizes these dishes’ iconically Irish mix of hearty potatoes, rich, creamy butter, and aromatic alliums into a chip, and our search took us directly to the source. Now, coming to us from an Irish supplier, Trader Joe’s Garlic Butter Irish Potato Chips are made with crinkle-cut, authentically Irish potatoes and flavored with authentically Irish butter and garlic, so that every bite is crisp, exceptionally savory, and oh-so satisfying.

Salty, buttery, and delightfully garlicky, with a charmingly toothsome texture, our Garlic Butter Irish Potato Chips are excellent as a standalone snack or as an accompaniment to a sandwich, soup, or salad. (We’re particularly keen on layering a few Chips into a sandwich, for an extra bit of crunch and flavor.) In a feat of epicurean engineering, they’re also sturdy and substantial enough to carry all kinds of creamy dips and condiments. We recommend pairing them with our Caramelized Onion Dip for a full-flavored, gameday appetizer, or our Spinach & Kale Greek Yogurt Dip for a deconstructed take on colcannon.

079820.item_story_marketing:
Guacamole, salsa, and queso dip are the holy trinity of scoopable Mexican restaurant appetizers. Peruse the refrigerators at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, and you’ll notice we’re two for three on this front, with a plethora of guacamole and salsa options from which to choose. With the debut of Trader Joe’s White Queso Dip, we’re finally three for three!

Our Queso starts with tangy white cheddar—it’s 50% of the recipe, in fact! We mix in cream for extra richness, plus sea salt and onion for savory aromatics. Mild red & green bell peppers add a touch of sweetness (and festive red & green speckles throughout), while diced jalapeños lend a just-right amount of heat. Go ahead, shovel a tortilla chip-full into your mouth—your tastebuds will love this Queso’s restaurant quality flavor, and your wallet will appreciate you skipping the takeout.

For vegetarian nachos, drizzle a generous helping of Queso over a plate of White Corn Tortilla Chips, then cover them with crumbled Soy Chorizo and Hot & Sweet Jalapeños, if you’re feeling especially spicy. Or, pay homage to Tijuana, Mexico’s quesabirria tacos by spreading some Queso Dip onto Corn Tortillas, topping them with Beef Birria, folding them over into tacos, and pan frying until crispy and melty. Don’t forget to save the birria juice for dipping!

079824.item_story_marketing:
A favorite among many Hawaiian households since at least the 1980s, the first recipes for furikake mix were traditionally made with breakfast cereal as a base. Home chefs would slather that cereal in a savory mix of dried seaweed, fish flakes, and sesame seeds (better known together as furikake), mixed together in melted butter, then bake it to a golden brown. For our take on this Hawaiian hit, we’ve omitted the fish flakes in our furikake formulation, though we’ve expanded on the crunchy base quite dramatically, as modern furikake mixes are wont to do. As such, Trader Joe’s Furikake Snack Mix contains a whole host of savory, spicy, and even sweet snack-y bits, including mochi crisps, sesame sticks, corn chips, waffle crisps, and wasabi style peas, which our supplier seasons with butter, salt, sesame seeds, seaweed, and an umami-forward mix of mushroom, garlic, and onion powder. 

This vivid variety of flavors and textures means that every handful, and even every bite within a handful, is delightfully different: sometimes you get the yielding crunch of the mochi, sometimes you get the satisfying pop and invigorating heat of a wasabi style pea, and you always get a whole lot of umami going on. We recommend bringing out a pouch of this Mix in any situation that calls for snacking: family movie nights, pool parties, or even mini-picnics at the park. We’re also big fans of serving them alongside suitably savory fare: they’re an especially excellent accompaniment to a burger, hot dog, or poke bowl.

079858.item_story_marketing:
Feta Cheese is undeniably one of the most famous cheeses produced across the world. As a matter of fact, feta cheese makes up approximately 70% of its homeland’s, Greece’s, total cheese consumption. This soft and pasteurized cow’s milk cheese is a salty, tangy, and unique offering, unmatched in the wide world of cheeses.

While across the feta world, each cheese maker may have minor differences in taste and texture, but on the whole, feta is a curd cheese that has a salty flavor and crumbly, grainy texture that is sometimes moistened by a salty brine once in its packaging. However, Trader Joe’s Feta Cheese isn’t packaged in a saline brine, making for a dry and tangy, but more neutral and less salty cheese than its brined siblings. Grab a package to bring a soft, sliceable cheese to your next charcuterie tray or Mediterranean-tinged meal!

079860.item_story_marketing:
Macarons are uncommonly elegant treats any time of year, but there’s something particularly lovely about enjoying them on a sunny summer’s day. This is especially so when the macarons you’re enjoying are Trader Joe’s Raspberry, Vanilla & Blueberry Macarons, which combine the delicate, chewy texture of classic, meringue-y, almond-based macarons with some of summer’s best and most berrylicious flavors. 

Crafted for us in France, where they know a thing or two about macarons, each box of twelve contains four Raspberry Macarons (flavored with real raspberries), four Vanilla Macarons (flavored with vanilla bean specks & other natural flavors), and four Blueberry Macarons (flavored with blueberry purée & lemon concentrate). They get their respective red, white, and blue hues from fruit & veggie juice and spirulina extract, and they’re quite picturesque when presented on a platter at a picnic or party. Simply allow them to thaw at room temperature for about one hour and serve! We recommend pairing them with a pot of Citrus Berry Tea, a frosty glass of Sparkling Strawberry Juice, or a flute of your favorite sparkling wine.

079862.item_story_marketing:
Combining the patisserie polish of a classically French lemon meringue tart with the tropical flavors of ripe passion fruit, every bite of Trader Joe’s Passion Fruit Meringue Tartelettes is tangy, buttery, and so very satisfying. They come to us from an expert baker in France, who starts with a crisp, crumbly tart shell that they fill with a full-flavored Passion Fruit curd, then top with a perfectly-piped dollop of Meringue prior to baking. Once you pick up a package from our freezers, it’s just a matter of removing the Tartelettes from the outer packaging, allowing them to thaw for at least two hours within your refrigerator, then serving. 

Seriously, a short thaw in the fridge is all that separates you and whoever you’re sharing dessert with (if you’re planning on sharing, that is) from forkfuls of sweet, tart, Passion Fruit bliss. We recommend spending that thaw time deciding what kind of refreshment you’ll serve alongside it: we recommend a nice, hot cup of Organic Blood Orange Rooibos . Just be sure to pick up a package while you still can—our Passion Fruit Meringue Tartelettes are only available during the spring, and supplies are decidedly limited!

Combining the patisserie polish of a classically French lemon meringue tart with the tropical flavors of ripe 
passion fruit, every bite of Trader Joe's Passion Fruit Meringue Tartelettes is tangy, buttery, and so very 
satisfying. They come to us from an expert baker in France, who starts with a crisp, crumbly tart shell that they 
fill with a full-flavored Passion Fruit curd, then top with a perfectly-piped dollop of Meringue prior to baking. 
Once you pick up a package from our freezers, it's just a matter of removing the Tartelettes from the outer 
packaging, allowing them to thaw for at least two hours within your refrigerator, then serving.

Seriously, a short thaw in the fridge is all that separates you and whoever you're sharing dessert with (if you're 
planning on sharing, that is) from forkfuls of sweet, tart, Passion Fruit bliss. We recommend spending that 
thaw time deciding what kind of refreshment you'll serve alongside it: we recommend a nice, hot cup of 
Organic Blood Orange Rooibos [sku 68189] . Just be sure to pick up a package while you still can-our Passion 
Fruit Meringue Tartelettes are only available during the spring, and supplies are decidedly limited!

Passion Fruit Meringue Tartelettes
079862.name: PASSIONFRUIT MERINGUE TARTELETTES

079863.item_story_marketing:
Mention mole [MO-lay] and many people think of chocolate, and there are, in fact, sensational versions of mole that include chocolate. If you zoom out, however, you soon see the true ways of mole are manifold. After all, the very definition of this Aztec-derived word speaks to its myriad manifestations: sauce. Trader Joe’s Chicken Mole is not a chocolate-based version; it is rather sensational.

Inspired by recipes from Central Mexico, we simmer boneless, skinless Chicken leg meat in a Mole rojo (“red”). This tomato-based iteration is made with dried guajillo and pasilla peppers, which serve to darken the color of the sauce, while also adding some spicy heat. The flavor is further deepened with spices that include garlic, onion, coriander, and cinnamon.

After cooking, the tender pieces of Chicken in the rich Mole are flash frozen, so all you have to do when you get the 16-ounce package home is heat it (in the microwave or on the stovetop) and eat it! Tuck this Mole into some TJ’s Organic Yellow Corn Taco Shells, or wrap it in your favorite TJ’s Tortillas with some cheese and bake with our Enchilada Sauce. Or simply enjoy the authentic Mole flavor served atop a bed of our Spanish Style Rice with a scoop of TJ’s Organic Chunky Homestyle Guacamole.

079898.item_story_marketing: Our crust-conscious supplier starts with wheat-flour dough that is allowed to rise for a full 24 hours before it’s hand-stretched and topped. Then the Pizza is spread with a simple, savory tomato sauce, and topped with a blend of mozzarella, provolone, and Parmigiano Reggiano—and finally crowned with slices of savory, Uncured Pepperoni. Oak and beech from the mountains between Emilia-Romagna and Tuscany are used to fuel wood burning ovens in which the pies are pre-baked at about 750°F. They’re finally frozen and sent to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, so you can heat & eat an authentic Uncured Pepperoni Pizza whenever you like!
079898.item_story_qil:
Japanese in its origin, kaizen is a philosophy of continuous improvement-ongoing change for the better. At 
Trader Joe's, it's through our commitment to kaizen that we strive to make our store and our products the best 
they can be for our customers. To that end, when our Italian supplier presented us with an opportunity to 
revisit the crust formulation for our frozen Pepperoni Pizza, we leapt at the chance¿

Our crust-conscious supplier starts each Trader Joe's Uncured Pepperoni Pizza with wheat-flour dough 
that is allowed to rise for a full 24 hours before it's stretched, by hand, to an ideal pizza proportion. They 
then top this crust with simple, savory tomato sauce and a blend of mozzarella, provolone, and Parmigiano 
Reggiano cheeses, before finally crowning it with slices of savory Uncured Pepperoni. Oak and beech from 
the mountains between Emilia-Romagna and Tuscany are used to fuel wood burning ovens in which this pie 
is pre-baked at about 750°F. After all that, it's finally frozen and sent to your neighborhood Trader Joe's, so you 
can heat & eat an authentic Italian Pizza whenever you like! 

Uncured Pepperoni Pizza
079898.name: UNCURED PEPPERONI PIZZA

079900.item_story_marketing:
Mushroom lovers, rejoice! Trader Joe’s Sliced Shiitake Mushrooms are here to rescue all your mushroom-y meals—and your time—from the clutches of mundane prep work. These funky fungi come thinly sliced, blanched, and individually quick-frozen (or “IQF,” for the uninitiated), with absolutely nothing added. All the hard work—washing, slicing, and blanching—has been done for you.

Native to Asia (ours come from Vietnam), Shiitakes are known for their rich, earthy flavor and meaty-yet- buttery texture when cooked. Simply add the amount of Sliced Shiitake Mushrooms you need to a dry pan, sauté them until any excess moisture dissipates, then season them as desired (or don’t!), and you’ve got yourself some tender, umami-packed ’shrooms! You can also skip the sautéing and add them directly to soups, stir-fries, pasta sauces, pizzas, and anything else your mushroom-loving heart desires.
