079901.item_story_marketing:
“The secret of happiness, you see, is not found in seeking more, but in developing the capacity to combine olives and hummus.” —Socrates

Okay, we admit that Socrates definitely didn’t say that, but our product developers probably did when they dreamed up the mezze marvel known as Trader Joe’s Olive Tapenade Hummus. In the center of each tub lies a just-right amount of briny Olive Tapenade made with black olives, manzanilla olives, capers, and olive oil. Not to be outshined by its piquant partner, the Hummus base is special in its own right. With twice the tahini of traditional hummus, it’s especially smooth and nutty with complementary sweet and savory flavors. Mix both spreads together, and you have a bold, balanced Olive Tapenade Hummus that’s sure to get a smile out of even the biggest of stoics.

If you have the virtue of patience, plate your desired amount of Hummus and bring to room temperature before enjoying as a dip for veggie sticks, Pita Bite Crackers, and Papadum Lentil and Chickpea Crisps. Or, spread it over a piece of Lavash Bread and top with cooked Gyro Slices & chopped cucumbers, then roll it all up into a Middle East-inspired wrap.

079955.item_story_marketing:
There are few flavor profiles out there as satisfyingly savory, captivatingly creamy, and remarkably rich in umami as a classic Caesar salad, so we’re always working to find ways to place it into new culinary contexts. Our latest foray into Caesar-ified fare, Trader Joe’s Caesar Salad Dip, might be our most ambitious experiment yet. That’s because our supplier packs each tub with a creamy base that includes Caesar-y seasoned sour cream, mayo, anchovy paste, and Parmesan cheese, as well as finely shredded Romaine lettuce to give every bite some crisp, leafy contrast.

Excellent when enjoyed as an appetizer with your favorite chip, cracker, or crostini, Trader Joe’s Caesar Salad Dip is a game-changer for game-day get-togethers, a coup for cocktail parties, and an asset to everyday, anytime snacking. Just like the Salad that inspired it, its full flavors and rich textures make an excellent lead-in to all sorts of savory entrées, like a freshly seared steak or air-fried salmon fillet. We also like it as a sandwich spread, too—in fact, we find that it makes an especially excellent sandwich when spread over a split, toasted baguette and topped with Simply Roasted Chicken Breast.

079959.item_story_marketing:
When most people go to make a sandwich, they don't start with the meat and cheese, or mustard and lettuce. 
They start with the bread, of course! It's a logical place to start. And Trader Joe's Sandwich Starters are not 
only a logical place to start, they're also a delicious way to begin!

Our Sandwich Starters are moist and pleasantly chewy, with olive oil and sea salt included in the recipe for a 
subtly savory flavor. What makes Sandwich Starters even more unique is that they come connected, so you can 
easily select the size of your sandwich. Are you super hungry? Use three connected Buns. Just need a snack? 
One Bun oughta do! 

Additionally, Sandwich Starters are Pre-sliced, so once you've selected your size, all that's left to do is load 
up the insides. Pile on TJ's Oven Roasted Turkey Breast, Organic Uncured Black Forest Ham, or Delicatessen Sliced Roast Beef. Have a Euro-style lunch when you stack up our Spanish Inspired Charcutería. When it comes to cheese, why not stick with the Pre-sliced theme and add TJ's Sliced Colby Jack or Sliced Provolone. Of course, we also have all the spreads, lettuce, tomatoes, pickles... Maybe it's fair to call your entire neighborhood store your Trader Joe's Sandwich Starter! And when it comes to the bread, you'll find these Pre-sliced Sandwich Buns on our bakery shelves, every day.

079998.item_story_marketing:
What’s a burger without a bun? A house without a floor or roof, that’s what—and we may be grocers, not architects, but we’re pretty sure that houses generally need floors and roofs. That’s why we offer a bevy of bun varieties on our bakery shelves, including Trader Joe’s Pretzel Buns. Available May through August on our bakery racks, these Pretzel Buns offer all the savory delights of a soft Pretzel, and all the Epicurean- architectural advantages of a classic burger Bun, all in one! 

They’re made for us by pretzel experts out of Wisconsin, who know just the right ratio of ingredients needed to get that rich, mahogany color, delightfully chewy consistency, and malty flavor in every bite. We find that their flavor profile and texture make them a real boon to burgers, and many other styles of sandwich, as well: we especially recommend piling them high with any of our deli meats (our Uncured Pastrami or Bresaola are particulary great choices), cheeses, and condiments on offer. Of course, since these are Pretzel Buns we’re talking about, mustard is a must-have on any burger or sandwich you build with them. Be sure to keep your toolbox (AKA pantry) stocked with plenty of Whole Grain Mustard or Organic Yellow Mustard for a job well done.

080035.item_story_marketing:
When is a salad dressing more than a salad dressing? How about when it’s also a great dip, condiment, marinade, sauce for a uniquely sweet and spicy pizza... All of these would make an entirely apt description for Trader Joe’s Thai Style Peanut Dressing, but, truth be told, “Trader Joe’s Thai Style Peanut Dressing (and Dip, and Condiment, and Marinade, and Pizza Sauce...)” just wouldn’t quite fit on the bottle. It’s made for us using the same recipe as the dressing found in Trader Joe’s Crunchy Slaw, a longtime Crew and customer favorite in our West Coast stores, where its complex mix of sweet, savory, and spicy flavors earned it a spot as a solo act in Trader Joe’s across the country.

Our Thai Style Peanut Dressing is so versatile, that even within just the context of salads, it’s marvelously multifaceted: we recommend it for everything from light, leafy salads to hearty slaws, all the way to creamy pasta and potato salads, too. As for its dip qualifications, give it a spin with spring rolls or savory meat skewers. As a condiment, it’s excellent on burgers and bánh mì-inspired creations. It makes a magnificent marinade for grilled chicken wings or steak, and a super sauce for a Thai-style pizza with chicken breast, cilantro, and sliced green onion.

080040.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe's Hard Top Chocolate Shell Topping is a liquid ice cream topper that hardens once it’s poured or drizzled over your cold ice cream. It’s similar to the delicate (but solid) texture you find around a classic ice cream bar, or that nostalgic shell surrounding your dipped frozen banana at the beach. What may be different between Trader Joe’s Hard Top Shell Topping and those other hard-shell toppings is the fact that ours is no mere “chocolatey” coating—it’s made with cocoa powder and real dark Chocolate (including cocoa mass and cocoa butter). And you can taste the difference!

Store the container at room temperature (do not refrigerate) and when you are ready to use, shake very well, open the flip-top, and pour over your bowl of ice cream or your cone. (NOTE: If Topping becomes thick or oil separation occurs, warm the bottle in a bowl of hot tap water for 5 minutes.) Almost immediately, a shell will form, and you’ll be ready to enjoy the snappy crunch and rich chocolate flavor in contrast to the smooth and creamy frozen dessert underneath. We expect to have Chocolate Hard Top on our shelves through the summer, so now’s the time to put it at the top of your shopping list!

080076.item_story_marketing:
You’ve probably heard of kombucha, and maybe you’ve heard of kefir... but have you heard of water kefir? If not, the shelves of Trader Joe’s just might be the place to learn about it, courtesy of Agua de Kefir™ Guava Paloma. It comes to us from the folks at GT’s®. whose work you may recognize from the fabulously flavorful kombuchas that we carry in our refrigerators. Inspired by the classic paloma cocktail, this flavorful, fermented drink combines the tart and tropical flavors of grapefruit juice and guava purée (along with a bit of habanero juice for a subtle hint of spice) with tangy (and decidedly dairy-free) water kefir that provides billions of probiotic bacteria in every single bottle.

Each bottle of Agua de Kefir™ Guava Paloma starts with tiny kefir “grains,” which are actually grain-free, dairy-free granules made from a combination of lactic acid, bacteria, & yeast. When these “grains” are placed in reverse osmosis-filtered water along with organic cane sugar, they literally begin to eat the sugar & ferment. This fermentation yields carbon dioxide & more lactic acid, creating a stable environment for the cultures to grow and multiply. (Kombucha & “regular” kefir—the dairy kind—come from similar processes, but the kefir grains are activated in tea and milk, respectively, instead of in water.) And on top of all these probiotic properties, we’re happy to report that Agua de Kefir™ Guava Paloma is also remarkably refreshing. We recommend bringing a bottle along for a work lunch, for sipping during a hike, or as a pick-me-up after a strenuous yoga session.

080147.item_story_marketing:
With their deep, dark juice and lusciously sweet taste, Concord grapes are utterly ideal for making jellies that are jam-packed with flavor. Take Trader Joe’s Organic Concord Grape Jelly, for instance. It’s made for us by a trusted supplier with a proven track record of phenomenally flavorful fruit preserves. They use a mix of Organic Concord Grape juice concentrate and organic sugar (rather than corn syrup) to create a super smooth, joyously juicy, and potently purple Jelly that will elevate everything from breakfast breads and bagels, to homemade jelly donuts and Danishes, to, of course, an everyday PB&J.

Speaking of sandwiches, our Organic Concord Grape Jelly is conveniently contained within a squeeze bottle that’s been affixed with a ribbon-style oblong opening on the cap. This way, the Jelly comes out in a nice, straight line for ease of application on all sorts of sandwich breads. We also find that it makes it easier to spread over a cheese board to provide a bit of complementary fruitiness to an aged Cheddar or Manchego. And even beyond sandwiches and cheeses, this Jelly is just the thing for adding a delightful depth of flavor to homemade barbecue sauces, marinades, and slow-cooker sauces for simmering a batch of Party Size Mini Meatballs.

080233.item_story_marketing:
Coffee is one of the most celebrated flavors in our stores. Coffee ice cream, coffee chocolate, coffee granola, coffee coffee... For that last one, the sub-list is even longer, from whole beans in a bag to concentrated cold brews in a bottle—and everything in between. It seems like we’ll never run out of new ways to deliciously deliver that famous buzz, and Trader Joe’s Cold Brew Coffee is ongoing proof of that!

The stubby glass bottle is filled with a 10-ounce, single serving of ready to drink Coffee—but it’s not just any Coffee. Our roaster starts with 100% Arabica coffee beans from Mexico (80%) and Colombia (20%). These world-class beans are treated to a medium roast, then subject to a slow-brewing process in which the grounds are immersed for a long period of time in ambient (aka room temperature) water. This time-intensive process results in a finished brew that’s supremely balanced, with hints of citrus and a reined-in acidity that highlights the nutty notes and chocolate flavors.

Unscrew the top and drink this Cold Brew straight from the bottle. Or, you can pour this smooth brew into a glass filled with ice and add a splash of milk, creamer, or your favorite TJ’s non-dairy beverage! You’ll find Trader Joe’s Medium Roast Ready to Drink Cold Brew Coffee in our refrigerators, next to the fresh juices.

080325.item_story_marketing:
Passionate about Passion Fruit? So are we. In fact, there might be only one thing we feel just as passionately about: great value. Thankfully, Trader Joe’s Cubes of Just Seedless Passion Fruit Puree delivers on both, making it easier than ever to incorporate the tropically tangy flavor of Passion Fruit, for a fraction of the price of a single fruit.

Our Cubes of Just Seedless Passion Fruit Puree are made from ripe Passion Fruit harvested in Vietnam, where they are then pressed, strained to remove the seeds, and frozen into convenient cubes. That’s it. Never cooked, no added sugar, artificial flavors, or preservatives—just pure Passion Fruit Puree portioned and ready for whenever inspiration strikes. Freezing the puree soon after processing helps preserve its vibrant golden color and bright tropical flavor, so each cube delivers the fresh taste of Passion Fruit without the peeling, scooping, or straining. We estimate it takes one large Passion Fruit to yeild a single cube—you get 15 cubes per package, making this a supremely passion-provoking value.

How do we love thee? Let us count the ways. Pop a couple of cubes into your morning smoothie, blend into frozen cocktails or mocktails, or stir into sparkling water or iced tea. Need a quick topping? Just thaw several cubes and add atop yogurt, cheesecake, pancakes, or vanilla ice cream. Its natural tangy sweetness also makes these cubes a welcome addition to homemade dressings and marinades. Now you can embrace the flavor of ripe Passion Fruit whenever your passion stirs, while supplies last!

080326.item_story_marketing:
True pomegranate fans know that pure pomegranate juice isn’t just a drink, it’s an experience. Without the addition of sugar or other fruit juices, a glass of 100% pomegranate juice is a powerful thing: each sip is bursting with rich, pomegranate flavor in a sensational mix of sweet, tart, and dry. We’re all about facilitating phenomenal flavor experiences here at Trader Joe’s, which is precisely why we’re introducing Trader Joe’s 100% Pomegranate Juice to our shelves. Pomegranate fans, prepare yourselves accordingly.

Although we have 100% Organic Pomegranate Juice in 1-quart bottles, we decided to bring a single-serving portion to our customers, but this time, not from concentrate! This new submission is a sensational mix of sweet, tart, and dry, and can be consumed in one sitting. Every bottle of Pomegranate Juice is made entirely from two large Turkish pomegranates—and nothing else—as in, no added sugar, no preservatives, no other fruit juices, just pure pomegranate-tude.

Enjoy this Pomegranate Juice straight from the bottle! But to really do it right, enjoy chilled or with ice. To get even more creative, blend into smoothies or mix into cocktails & even mocktails.

080331.item_story_marketing: Strawberries are sweet, flavorful, and an excellent source of Vitamin C. Strawberries can be used in a variety of salads, appetizers, snacks, and beverages. Try slicing off the top layer of brie and layer sliced strawberries, slivered almond, and a drizzle of honey and serve with warm bread. Or, combine arugula with sliced strawberries, crumbled feta, pistachios, and finish with lemony vinaigrette.
080331.name: R-STRAWBERRIES ORG 1 LB

080336.item_story_marketing:
Grown for us in the U.S. and Mexico, our Shishito Peppers are small-ish, slender, and brilliantly green. They’re grassy and peppery with faint notes of citrus; their delicate skins and slightly pleated exteriors provide a satisfying crunch when enjoyed raw, and a tender bite when cooked. Because some (approximately one in ten) Shishitos are actually quite hot, the act of popping these Peppers is a bit of an adventure... and the suspense is all part of the fun!

You can eat Shishitos raw, though we suggest cooking them for maximum enjoyment. Toss your Peppers in olive oil, then add them to a hot skillet and cook over high heat for 5-7 minutes, until they char and blister. Or arrange them on a foil-lined baking sheet and roast them in the oven as part of an easy-peasy, one-pan dinner. 080337.item_story_marketing:
Hummus is one of those dishes that demonstrates the true benefits of simplicity. Typically, most hummus starts with a base of just four primary ingredients: chickpeas, tahini, garlic, and lemon juice. From there, you’re free to use it as your canvas—we’ve certainly done so, incorporating other flavors like Roasted Red Pepper, Olive Tapenade, and Crunchy Chili Onion. But even aside from adding flavors, just adjusting the proportions of one of the existing base ingredients yields remarkable results. Take Trader Joe’s Dreamy Creamy Hummus, for instance. Here, our supplier simply increases the ratio of tahini within their recipe to create a texture so thick, rich, and exquisitely Creamy that it’s simply Dreamy.

With its luxuriously smooth consistency and savory, ever-so-slightly tart flavor profile, our Creamy Dreamy Hummus makes and excellent (and easy) appetizer. Simply pair it with something crunchy and dippable, like our Pita Chips or Papadums. It’s also always welcome as part of a mezze plate or crudités platter, and acts as a truly stupendous spread for a grilled veggie sandwich, a Shawarma Chicken wrap, or pita pocket filled with Falafel.

080342.item_story_marketing:
Like many traditional foods, bresaola originated out of pure necessity. Way back in the medieval era, fresh meat was scarce during Northern Italy’s frigid winters, so locals would prepare by salting, seasoning, and dry-aging beef to preserve it—much in the same way one would with fresh pork for prosciutto. During the dry-aging process, the beef would lose most of its moisture, reducing its total weight by nearly half and concentrating its rich, meaty flavor significantly. While preservation techniques have certainly evolved, global appreciation for bresaola’s bold and beefy flavor has only grown over the centuries, which is precisely why we’ve brought in Trader Joe’s Sliced Bresaola to our refrigerator cases.

Sliced thin and ready to serve, right out of the package, our Bresaola makes a fantastic filling for a homemade deli sandwich, a terrific topper for a plate of pasta, and an inspired choice for including in a charcuterie board. It astounds as part of a classic Italian appetizer when served with Arugula and Shaved Parmigiano Reggiano, and satisfies when enjoyed on its own as a simple, savory snack. We also emphatically endorse enhancing it with a little Sicilian Lemon Juice and Oregano or Balsamic Vinegar of Modena.

080347.item_story_marketing:
Wouldn’t it be wonderful if all of life’s celebrations, from the smallest win to the most towering triumph, could be commemorated with cake? Just imagine it: Cracked a great joke in the group chat? Cake. Grabbed an extremely decent parking spot? Cake. Made a really delicious cake for your kid’s birthday party? Cake! Of course, while such a world may be fun to think about, it would be a little impractical in reality (the required increase in baking infrastructure alone...). It’s a good thing that Trader Joe’s Celebration Cake Pretzels are here to bridge the gap. Made with a base of crispy, crunchy, lightly salted mini Pretzels, each one is covered in a sweet and rich vanilla frosting-flavored candy coating, then studded with rainbow nonpareils for even more sweetness and crunch. 

Now, whenever you feel like a little Celebration is in order, just reach for a bag of these candy-coated Pretzels and let the festivities commence. And in addition to their handiness in spontaneous jubilation, we also find that they’re quite excellent in more pre-planned contexts, too: they make a marvelous mini-dessert in a school lunch, a fantastic topping for ice cream when roughly crumbled, and a delightfully decorative element on a springtime dessert board. Just be aware that supplies are limited, so be sure to pick up a pouch or two before the party’s over!

080359.item_story_marketing:
Just think of all the things your skin does for you: it protects you against the elements, regulates your body temperature, and helps you sense the world around you—to name just a few. After all that work, doesn’t your skin deserve to get a little pampering at the end of the day? We certainly think so, which is exactly why we carry Trader Joe’s Night Cream on our shelves. It’s made with a formula that includes shea butter, argan oil, and marula oil, along with sodium hyaluronate to draw moisture to the skin, probiotic, fermented mushroom complex to restore the skin’s natural pH, and Irish sea moss extract to act as an antioxidant.

As part of your nighttime routine, simply apply this Night Cream to the face and neck (after washing and drying your face), taking care to avoid the eyes, then let it work its magic overnight. You’ll wake up to remarkably refreshed and marvelously moisturized skin, which will be even better prepared to work for you throughout the day—the better you treat your skin, the better it will treat you. And as if that wasn’t refreshing enough, we’d be remiss if we didn’t point out our unbeatable retail: we’ve seen similar creams sell elsewhere for double, triple, or even octuple the price! Your wallet deserves a bit of pampering too, after all.

080421.item_story_marketing:
If you think of the modern snacking scene as a sports team, miniature pretzels would be the ultimate team player. Unflashy and endlessly dependable, the miniature pretzel is always there to offer support in all kinds of snacking situations, from movie watching, to school lunch supplementing, to idly munching while enjoying a cocktail or ice cold beer. And among the modern miniature pretzel scene, Trader Joe’s Mini Pretzel Twists are true MVPs. Made with a carefully calibrated ratio of wheat flour, malted barley flour, oil, yeast, and salt, these superlatively crisp and crunchy Twists consistently deliver a simple, yet satisfyingly savory eating experience.

Great for eating solo or serving alongside a refreshing beverage, Trader Joe’s Mini Pretzel Twists have a resoundingly airy crunch to complement their classically malty and salty flavor profile. We particularly like pairing them with a nice sandwich or burger, they’re great when crumbled over an ice cream sundae or blitzed in a blender to create a cheesecake crust, and also scoop up dips with aplomb. Try using one to scoop up a bit of Unexpected Cheddar Spread, and you’ll see what we mean.

080463.item_story_marketing:
Our cheese buyer relishes the challenge of developing new products that bring the proverbial party wherever they’re served. Case in point: Trader Joe’s Brie Cheese Flavored Spread. Our Wisconsin-based supplier (a third-generation, family owned creamery) combines velvety Brie with rich cream to create this Spread’s unbelievably creamy texture and marvelously mild flavor—essentially, it offers all the best qualities of Brie, minus the rind. What’s not to love?! 

From crackers to crudités, pretzel sticks to sandwiches, this Spread’s uses are only limited by your imagination. And whether you’re hosting a holiday shindig, or simply whipping up a celebration for one, you’re sure to appreciate its eminently spreadable (dare we say spoonable?) nature, as well as its convenient, lidded-tub packaging (no more forgotten wedges in the back of the cheese drawer!). Did we mention this Spread’s un- Brie-lievable value? You’ll find six-ounce tubs in our cheese case, every day.

080470.item_story_marketing:
If strawberries and watermelons had dreams, we're fairly certain they'd dream of becoming Trader Joe's Strawberry & Watermelon Marshmallows. And who could blame them? Whipped up for us in Spain by one of Europe's premiere 'mallow-makers, they're everything a summer sweet-treat should be: fruity, fluffy, and fun to eat!

Shaped like mini versions of their namesake fruits, these whimsical, pillowy Marshmallows get their sweet Strawberry & Watermelon flavors from strawberry powder, watermelon powder, and natural flavors and take their cheerful pink and green hues from vegetable juice, spirulina extract, and turmeric. You can, of course, enjoy them straight out of the bag, anytime your sweet tooth strikes. You can also float them atop a summery ice cream soda made with TJ's French Vanilla Ice Cream and TJ's Sparkling Strawberry Juice or TJ's Sparkling Watermelon Juice - whichever flavor you favor. No matter how you slice it, TJ's Strawberry & Watermelon Marshmallows are confectionary delights-delights you'll find only in the candy section at your neighborhood Trader Joe's this June & July.

080507.item_story_marketing:
As longtime fans of tinned fish, we’re elated over the recent renaissance of sardine appreciation (sardinaissance?) that we’ve seen among certain foodie types. We’ve decided to mark the occasion with a wave of products that give the dependably delicious sardine its due celebration. One such product, Trader Joe’s Milk Chocolate Sardines with Sea Salt, could do with some extra explanation: dear reader, these are not Chocolate-covered Sardines. Although we can’t bring ourselves to fully rule out that such a combination wouldn’t be appealing to some, these are, in fact, Sardine-shaped Chocolates.

And they are excellent ones at that! Our supplier, a bean-to-bar chocolatier out of Slovakia, seasons the Milk Chocolate with which these Sardines are made with a bit of Sea Salt, both to provide a fascinating flavor contrast on the palate, and to subtly evoke a real sardine’s briny domain. They also individually wrap each Milk Chocolate Sardine in decorative foil, and pack them in a fun little box that resembles an old-fashioned sardine tin. We find they make a lovely gift for any tinned fish-ionados in your life, and add a wonderful touch of whimsy when used to decorate a nautical-themed dessert board.

080527.item_story_marketing:
Lots of people say “cal-ZOwn.” Italian speakers say, “cal-tzO-nay.” So, which is correct? We suppose it’s a matter of perspective. Though we may not be keen on judging pronunciation, we are fully committed to judging the quality of a calzone—say it however you like! To that end, let us just say that Trader Joe’s Meatball Calzone is unequivocally delicious. 

Calzones are oven-baked turnovers made with bread dough and typically filled with savory ingredients. Like folded pizzas, they commonly contain tomato sauce, cheese, and meat or veggies. This one is loaded with Meatballs made from a combination of ground pork and ground beef bound together with some egg and seasoned with Parmesan cheese, onions, garlic, parsley, and black pepper. Along with the Meatballs, you’ll also find a rich tomato sauce and plenty of melty mozzarella cheese tucked inside the tender wheat flour dough. 

Of course, the mozzarella’s not melty until you heat it. We recommend a twenty-minute bake in a 350°F conventional oven—or 15 minutes in your air fryer. You can also microwave it for four minutes, if your Calzone craving just can’t wait! Serve this Calzone with a sprinkle of torn fresh Basil or a shake of Aglio Olio Seasoning Blend and Shredded Parmesan on top. Don’t forget a side of Trader Joe’s Thick, Bold & Spicy Red Sauce for dipping. However you present it, Trader Joe’s Meatball Calzone is definitely a legit way to say “Delicious!”

080530.item_story_marketing:
Have you ever traveled all the way to Italy just for a pizza? Well, we have—so you don’t have to! In fact, we’ve done so several times over, most recently in the name of improving upon our already tasty Trader Joe’s Margherita Pizza... and improve, we did. 

ade for us in the Modena province by one of our very favorite Italian pizza partners, this classic Margherita Pizza starts with a hand-stretched, Amalfi style crust, the dough for which is fermented for a full 24 hours prior to kicking off the pizza-making process. This new-and-much-improved crust is thin, soft, and bubbly, with a slightly thicker, chewy edge. In this Pizza’s previous iteration, they topped said crust with a standard tomato sauce; in this version, however, they top it with a passata—a.k.a. a traditional Italian tomato sauce made by sieving ripe tomatoes into a silky-smooth purée, allowing the pure, tomato flavor to really shine. The pies are finished with fresh mozzarella rounds, shredded Grana Padano and carefully placed basil leaves, then baked in wood-burning stone ovens, flash-frozen, and sent to sail the culinary seas... all the way to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. Mangia!

080568.item_story_marketing:
Tortillas are far more than just a staple for a satisfying meal. In many cultures—particularly in Mexico and throughout Latin America—they’re a fundamental part of identity, history, and daily life. Trader Joe’s Organic Flour Tortillas honor that tradition, while bringing everyday versatility to your own kitchen and are poised to become a staple in your household, too.

Made with organic wheat flour, our Organic Flour Tortillas are soft, pliable, and pleasantly chewy—ready for any and all applications. Though they’re perfectly sized for burritos, our 10-inch Organic Flour Tortillas can be enjoyed in practically any context that calls for a flour tortilla: as the foundation for burritos and cheesy quesadillas, or the vehicle of choice for scooping up sizzling fajitas. We also love them filled with meats and cheeses and rolled up to create school-and-work-ready-wraps, or rolled and sliced into pinwheel appetizers for potlucks and picnics. For a quick, churro-inspired snack, warm a Tortilla on the stovetop, slather it with butter, then sprinkle with cinnamon & sugar. (Yum.)

080584.item_story_marketing:
Some days, there’s just nothing better than a burger. On others, a big, well-laden salad is just the thing. On many days, though—most days, we’d argue—a burrito is pretty hard to beat. For those days, we carry Trader Joe’s Beef, Bean & Cheese Burrito, made for us with a classic, hearty, homestyle recipe of spiced ground beef, chopped onions, shredded white Cheddar, and savory-seasoned pinto beans, all tightly wrapped in a soft flour tortilla. After just a few minutes in the microwave (or a little longer in a conventional oven), these Burritos make a seriously satisfying option for an easy work lunch, or even a quick, on-the-go snack. 

Full-flavored and filling, every bite of this Beef, Bean & Cheese Burrito offers a nice mix of meaty and melted- cheese textures, a whole host of savory seasoning sensations, and a provocative level of pleasantly peppery heat. While it can be enjoyed totally on its own, or even straight from the fridge (if cold burritos are your thing), we’re particularly partial to pairing it up with a few savory sides and sauces. We recommend a handful of Truly Tortilla Chips and your favorite TJ’s salsa or guacamole, and a few dabs of our Habanero Hot Sauce (if fiery-hot burritos are your thing.)

080590.item_story_marketing:
One of the most remarkable things about tofu (and believe us, we could fill a book with all the remarkable things about tofu) is how widely its uses can range based on just a small change in texture. Standard Tofu is a staple of stir fries and marinates marveously well. Super Firm Tofu can be a stand-in for all sorts of meats, and even holds up to deep frying. And then, of course, our superlatively soft Trader Joe’s Organic Silken Tofu can act as everything from a cheese, cream, and egg substitute, to a hearty inclusion in spicy soups, to a creamy dessert in its own right. 

Delightfully delicate and mild-flavored, our Organic Silken Tofu makes a mean mapo tofu, a superb sundubu- jigae soup, and a masterful chocolate mousse. It can be enjoyed hot or cold, mixed into sauces, and even blended into smoothies. From the simple (lightly boiled, topped with Crunchy Chili Onion, and enjoyed by the spoonful) to the slightly more involved (mixed with Turmeric and Nutritional Yeast and fried like scrambled eggs), Trader Joe’s Organic Silken Tofu is a versatile, velvety-textured addition to your culinary toolbox.

080600.item_story_marketing:
At Trader Joe’s, a potato chip is far more than just a potato chip. It’s an opportunity to explore flavor profiles both simple and complex. Indeed, as much as we love a baroque breakdown of a three-course meal in the form of a chip, we equally adore getting down to basics, as we’ve done in the case of Trader Joe’s Kettle Cooked Rosemary & Sea Salt Potato Chips.

Here, the pure, piney, savory, and subtly citric flavor of Rosemary is set against the backdrop of the crisp, crunchy, and bubbly texture of a Salted, expertly Kettle Cooked Potato Chip. The simplicity of such an arrangement allows both elements to truly shine, creating an elegant eating experience that pairs with cheeses, charcuterie, or a wine flight just as well as it does with a sandwich, salad, or cheeseburger. And at our price, it’s a genuine steal, compared to what many other big brands are charging for their chips, nowadays. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Kettle Cooked Rosemary & Sea Salt Potato Chips in our snacks section, now through the end of autumn.

080602.item_story_marketing:
First, a bit of translation... Riso means “rice” in Italian. The suffix -otto can mean “small,” or “cute.” Put them together and you get risotto, a creamy rice-based dish that is possibly cute and definitely delicious. Informally, risotto has been affectionately known in culinary circles as a “labor of love” because of the high attention and large amount of time required to cook the rice—one ladle of broth at a time with constant stirring. 

Recognizing the deliciousness of risotto and desiring to make it as accessible as possible for our customers, we’re present Trader Joe’s Simply Risotto. It’s reminiscent of the famous risotto of Milan. Our supplier in Italy starts with carnaroli rice (a starchy, medium grain rice that is considered the best rice for risotto) and proceeds with a labor of love that includes sunflower & olive oils, onion, vegetable broth, saffron (characteristic of risotto alla Milanese), cultured butter, and cheese. The culmination is a truly comforting concoction of toothsome rice in a thick, pale yellow sauce that is buttery & cheesy, with a hint of saffron aroma & flavor. 

One of the best things about this labor of love is that we (and our supplier) did the labor, so you can do the loving—including how much you’ll love the fact that Simply Risotto heats from frozen in the microwave in 4-6 minutes. And of course, you’ll love the fact that you can enjoy it as-is—or add meat, seafood, or vegetables to suit any eating occasion.

080616.item_story_marketing: Spain is a veritable treasure trove of olive groves – its rolling hills are home to some of the world’s most flavorful olives, including those of the Picual, Picudo, and Hojiblanca varieties, which are used in our Extra Virgin Spanish Olive Oil. This blend of olives produces oil that is light green in color and a bit fruity, with a refreshing verdant flavor. Use this oil in dressings or marinades or for dipping your favorite crusty bread. In addition to flavor, a big benefit of Spanish olive oil is value.
080616.item_story_qil:
After tasting this delightfully flavorful olive oil, all we can say is, "¡Viva España!"

Come on, you know us better than that, don't you? Our products always have a story to tell. And here's the story 
of Trader Joe's Spanish Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil. 

Even now, in 2019, people still think first of Italy when thinking of olive oil. And while some very fine olive oil 
is produced in Italy, there is remarkably flavorful olive oil being produced in so many other places. Trader Joe's 
is a limited assortment store, meaning we don't carry 24 varieties of ketchup or a wall-full of mayonnaise. We 
tend to make exceptions to the whole "limited assortment" thing, though, when it comes to olive oil. There's 
just so much good stuff. From all over the world, really, from Italy to California, and Tunisia to Spain. Spain is 
a veritable treasure trove of olive groves - its rolling hills are home to some of the world's most flavorful olives, 
including those of the Picual, Picudo, and Hojiblanca varieties, which are used in our Extra Virgin Olive 
Oil from Spain. This blend of olives produces oil that is light green in color and a bit fruity, with a refreshing 
verdant flavor. Use this oil in dressings or marinades or for dipping your favorite crusty bread.  

In addition to flavor, a big benefit of Spanish olive oil is value. We're selling each 16.9 fluid ounce bottle of 
Trader Joe's Spanish Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil from Spain for $5.49, every day.

080616.name: EV OLIVE OIL 100% SPANISH ORGANIC

080626.item_story_marketing: When making a salad from scratch, it’s important to begin with a good bed of leafy greens. And when you’re looking for just the right leaves to save you some green, we say: leave it to the produce pros at Trader Joe’s! We’ve got a wide selection of superior salad greens in our refrigerators for remarkably reasonable retails, and Trader Joe’s Organic Baby Red Butter Lettuce & Baby Arugula are among the best of them. Each bag contains a roughly equal ratio of fresh, Organic leaves of tender Baby Red Butter Lettuce and Baby Arugula, which are pre-washed and ready-to-use, right away. Amazing! Now, making a salad at home has never been faster, easier, or had more delicious results. Simply toss this Baby Butter Lettuce and Arugula with your favorite toppings and dressing (and maybe a protein, if you’d like to make it more of an entrée salad), and you’re ready to go! We find that the mildly earthy sweetness of the Butter Lettuce makes an excellent complement to the pepperiness of the Arugula, and that together, their combination makes an excellent complement to a tangy vinaigrette or creamy ranch, in turn.

080665.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Freeze Dried Strawberries are strawberry slices that have undergone a special freeze-drying process so they remain extremely flavorful, but unlike so many conventionally dried berries, they’re free of added sugar and they pack a bit of a crunch. They’re great for snacking anytime – we’ve discovered that kids, especially, find them not only delicious but fascinating as well. Lest you think they’re only for kids, we’ll go on record as grown-up fans of these crunchy little berries – they’re especially delightful added to cereals for a little extra flavor and crunch. Of course, given their history as a backpacking staple, they’re perfectly at home on the trail, as part of a mix or on their own.

Trader Joe’s Freeze Dried Strawberries come in a 1.2 ounce resealable bag – that may not sound like much, but it takes ten times that amount (12 ounces) of fresh, ripe strawberries to produce this much freeze dried fruit. We recommend that you keep the bag tightly sealed after opening to preserve the crunch, though in the spirit of full disclosure, we’ll admit they don’t usually last long enough that this ever becomes an issue.

080716.item_story_marketing: You might say we’ve been on a roll when it comes to highlighting high-quality Danish pastry on our bakery shelves. And rolling into your neighborhood Trader Joe’s this summer are none other than our ready-to-eat Trader Joe’s Cinnamon Buns! Made by the trusted Danish bakers who craft our beloved Cinammon Twist these decadent Buns are part of a long baking tradition of sweet buns from Northern Europe. Our expert bakers start with a soft, yeasted dough that undergoes an intense, hours-long mixing and rising process. Then, these bouncy Buns are given their signature swirl of cinnamon-molasses gooeyness, baked to a golden brown and then generously topped with cream cheese frosting. If you’re in a hurry, just eat from the package! If you have more time, enjoy them as part of a luxurious breakfast spread—pair with a savory egg and sausage scramble with our Maple Chicken Breakfast Sausage, a fresh Greek parfait with seasonal berries, and a cup of Trader Joe’s Joe Light Roast Ground Coffee.

080742.item_story_marketing:
Since their launch in 2018, the specialty bakery-quality and unmatched value of Trader Joe’s Mini Sheet Cakes have earned them cult favorite status among our customers. Well, almost all of them. After months of development with a trusted bakery partner, and taste-testing more than 10 recipes (it’s a tough gig, we know), gluten free customers can now partake in the #pursefork craze, thanks to Trader Joe’s Yellow Mini Sheet Cake! 

Our Yellow Mini Sheet Cake is built on a magical buttermilk cake base, including plenty of vanilla extract and a blend of rice flour, potato starch, cornstarch, and tapioca starch. We’re calling it magical because the resulting Cake truly stands up to the expectations established by its predecessors. It’s moist and flavorful with a tender crumb, as any good cake should be—only this one is gluten free! Upon that base sits a thick layer of rich chocolate buttercream (also made with vanilla), creating that beloved Yellow Cake-chocolate frosting combination, and delivering from-scratch flavor without the wait (or the cleanup!). 

No matter how you enjoy this Yellow Mini Sheet Cake (on a plate with a scoop of ice cream while donning a cone-shaped party hat, or fork-to-mouth out of the container on a random Tuesday), one bite will have gluten- free and gluten-ful fans alike proclaiming, “It’s out-of-this-world delicious and it’s a great value?? Trader Joe’s does it again!”

080748.item_story_marketing:
If someone asked you to close your eyes and think of the most classic, old-fashioned, reliably delicious candy you could, you’d probably end up picturing something like Trader Joe’s Butter Caramel Hard Candies. And if someone then offered one of these Candies to you, you would instantly realize why they’re so classic: starting with their round, rich, and Butter-y flavor, and ending with the elegant way they melt upon the tongue, they’re like an elevated version of a timelessly tasty treat, brought to us by an expert candy supplier in Poland. 

Made in small batches using the time-honored hard-boiling method, these Butter Caramel Hard Candies hit just the right balance of sweetness and creaminess on the palate, with just a touch of salt to bring the whole flavor profile into focus. They’re great for snacking on while on the go, packing into a work or school lunch for an after-meal sweet treat, or keeping in your purse or briefcase (they’re individually wrapped, we ought to mention) for whenever your sweet tooth strikes. This time-honored candy comes with another time-honored Trader Joe’s tradition—a great price!

080794.item_story_marketing:
As much as we appreciate a good cold brew, we don’t always appreciate as much the price that cold brew can command when ordered from a coffee shop. That’s why we‘ve created so many ways to get your morning cold brew at a significant value within our stores, be it in the form of our many convenient cold brew concentrates, or, more recently, our Ready to Drink Black Cold Brew Coffee. It’s crafted for us by a renowned coffee supplier in Turkey, who’s able to produce bold, yet delightfully smooth Cold Brew at a scale that keeps prices down without sacrificing a single smidgen of quality. And since it comes in a single-serve can, it’s ideal for grabbing and enjoying on the go. Now that we can all appreciate.

Made with a mix of Arabica beans from South and Central America, Trader Joe’s Ready to Drink Black Cold Brew Coffee is rich and robust, with a delicately fruity sweetness (though, we should add, it doesn’t contain any sweeteners) and an easy-going finish. When chilled, it tastes great right out of the can, and serves spectacularly well over ice, especially when accessorized with our Vanilla Cold Foam Creamer. And since each can sells for less than two bucks, there’ll be additional room in your budget to pair with a pastry from our bakery table, too...

080795.item_story_marketing:
Salsa macha is a condiment of Mexican origin that’s less like a tomato salsa, and more like a chili oil, similar in some respects to Trader Joe’s Crunchy Chili Onion [sku 62480]. On a recent trip to Oaxaca, one of our buyers discovered a delicious version of salsa macha in a local market that exchanged the typical peanut base for a trio of seeds. This became the inspiration for Trader Joe’s Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Pepita Salsa Macha!

Crunchy Salsa Macha has almost all of its ingredients listed on the front of the label. All that’s left to mention on the back is olive oil, garlic powder, Pequin chile peppers, and salt. Just by its makeup, you can surmise that it has a lively texture, with its nutty trio of Sesame seeds, Sunflower Seeds and Pepitas (aka pumpkin seeds). The seeds are suspended in olive oil that’s further enlivened by some spicy, Pequin chiles, which have their origin in Mexico where this salsa is made for us.

This versatile condiment has so many yummy uses, including (but not limited to): dipping bread and tortilla chips; drizzling over tacos, roasted veggies, and pizza; adding to salad dressings and soups; marinating poultry or beef; using as a cooking oil for frying eggs; replacing garlic butter on your toasted bread... We would even go so far as to say that Trader Joe’s Salsa Macha creates a tantalizing dessert atop a scoop of French Vanilla Ice Cream! Every day, you’ll find six-ounce jars of Trader Joe’s multi-purpose Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Pepita Salsa Macha in our condiment aisle.

080796.item_story_marketing:
Candy is associated with all kinds of fun activities: going to the movies, taking a road trip, trick-or-treating... We think that a candy’s character should match the fun it promotes, and Trader Joe’s Watermelon Freeze Dried Candies have a fun factor that is off the charts!

What makes these Candies so fun? For starters—just look at them... The bite-sized puffs look like they’re attending a hippie jam-band concert! Of note is the fact that all those bright and beautiful pastel-toned colors are the result of natural ingredients, including: spirulina, paprika, vegetable juice, turmeric, and fruit juice. (In case you’re wondering, you can’t taste the paprika, turmeric, and other hue-inducing ingredients.)

But these Watermelon Freeze Dried Candies don’t just look fun, they are fun! Pop a couple of these airy, Freeze Dried puffs in your mouth and you’ll experience a delicate crunch that quickly retreats as they melt, revealing big, bold, sweet, tangy, and slightly sour flavors. And the fun doesn’t end there! As they melt, these Candies gently fizz on your tongue. Another fun fact? You’ll find Trader Joe’s Watermelon Freeze Dried Candies on our shelves, every day.

080797.item_story_marketing:
Nearly every one of Shakespeare’s 154 sonnets makes some mention of flowers—roses, most frequently of all. Just imagine, then, how rhapsodic he would have waxed at the sight of Trader Joe’s Onion Flowers! “From sav’ry snackings we desire increase/That these breaded Onions might be air-fried/But appetizers should by time release/At Trader Joe’s, where they can be tried,” he might have said. Of course, since the Bard of Avon sadly never had access to a Trader Joe’s, we’ll simply have to wax for him—as will you, once you try these crispy, crunchy, blossom-cut Onions for yourself.

This classic appetizer is brought to us by a supplier in Thailand, who cuts each Onion into an attractive, flower- like pattern, dunks it in a savory-spiced (and also, as it happens, vegan) batter, and fries it to a golden brown. At home, it takes less than 15 minutes in an air-fryer (or a little longer in a conventional oven) to crisp up beautifully. We recommend serving them as hearty hors d’oeuvres at a game day get-together, cocktail party, or board game night. We also emphatically recommend pairing them with something savory, spicy, and/or creamy to dunk the Onion “petals” into—our (also vegan) Spicy Dynamite Sauce is always an excellent option.

080805.item_story_marketing: The Poggio Al Casone estate in Tuscany produces Casone Toscana, an Italian red wine our customers have really been enjoying—so much so that webrought in another wonderful wine from this esteemed estate, Terre del Casone Toscana Vermentino. The Vermentino varietal may be new to some, but Sauvignon Blanc lovers will find its profile to be quite appealing and familiar. Tuscan-born Vermentino grapes are crushed, pressed, and fermented at a low temperature. The resulting wine does not undergo any further aging, which preserves its natural freshness and promotes an intense bouquet of white flowers on the nose. Hints of peach and herbs balanced by mineral notes appear within each sip, then quickly retreat, staying true to the dry, crisp character of this light-bodied white wine—a wine that pairs well with everything from crostini slathered in a whipped Feta spread to forkfuls of Pizza Ranch Salad.
080805.name: TERRE DEL CASONE TOSCANA IGT VERMENTINO

080806.item_story_marketing:
The Poggio Al Casone estate in Tuscany produces Casone Toscana, an Italian red wine our customers have really been enjoying—so much so that webrought in another wonderful wine from this esteemed estate, Terre del Casone Toscana Rosso Governo All’Uso Toscano.  This wine is a blend of Sangiovese (80%), Cabernet Sauvignon (10%), and Ciliegiolo (10%).  Of particular interest here is the fact that this wine is made via the Governo All’Uso method, which requires the winemaker to save some grapes from the original batch, partially dry them (think: raisins), then add them back into the fermented wine to spark a second fermentation. The finished ruby-red, medium-bodied wine presents notes of cherry and raspberry, with concentrated flavors of dried cherries and intense red fruits on the palate. It’s robust and rich, yet eminently approachable on account of its soft, silky tannins—a direct result of the second fermentation.

Pick up a bottle to share with your beloved over a steak dinner... or pick up two bottles to share with friends, alongside heaping helpings of Spaghetti Triangolett tossed in spicy red sauce... or pick up three bottles, because at this price, why not?
080806.name: TERRE DEL CASONE TOSCANA IGT GOVERNO ALL USO TOSC

080840.item_story_marketing:
As the saying goes, breakfast is the most important meal of the day. We like to think that breakfast can also be the most interesting meal of the day. That’s why we love Trader Joe’s Super Nutty Oat Clusters Cereal, a captivatingly crunchy collection of light, crispy flakes; crunchy oat clusters; and three types of nuts - almonds, brazil nuts, and pecans. All in all, this cereal is a sweet combination of those three nuts and four grains - oats, rice, corn, and wheat. Every bite boasts a wide variety of crunchy textures and toasty flavors, plus a lively note of rich toffee, turning any rote, mundane breakfast into something a little more special. 
 
Enjoy Trader Joe’s Super Nutty Oat Clusters in the classic way, poured into a bowl with milk or non-dairy alternative (such as a dairy free beverage like our Non-Dairy Oat Beverage for even more variety). Enjoy it mixed with your other favorite nuts or dried fruit for a quick trek mix to stow on the go. And for a texturally tantalizing sweet treat, simply sprinkle it over your favorite yogurt with a spoonful of your favorite fruit preserves for an effortless parfait.
080840.name: CLUSTERS NUTTY OAT

080861.item_story_marketing:
What do you reach for when you’re hungry and hurried, but your next meal is still hours away? It’s a tough call, to be sure, especially when you consider the sheer magnitude of snacking options available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. We have myriad munchies and mini-meal possibilities in every aisle! If you’re seeking snacks with staying power, don’t overlook our refrigerated case! Seriously, our refrigerators offer some excellent options. Take Trader Joe’s Mini Uncured Salami Sticks, for example—they satisfy salty-snack cravings and provide 17 grams of protein in the process.

We’ve conveniently divided each package of Mini Uncured Salami Sticks into two, individually sealed, one-ounce servings. Peel back the film, and you have a Mini, meaty feast on (and in) your hands—a feast in the form of a snack-sized helping of slim, perfectly chewy Salami Sticks made from savory Uncured pork with smoke flavor added. (No nitrates or nitrites are added, except those naturally occurring in sea salt and cultured Swiss chard powder). Enjoy a package of Trader Joe’s Mini Uncured Salami Sticks on their own to mightly carry you between meals. Or, to lean into the “antipasto-on-the-go” theme even further, pair them with a pouch of TJ’s Marinated Artichokes and a TJ’s Sharp Cheddar Cheese Snack Pack or two.

080862.item_story_marketing:
Henri Laffard NV Champagne Brut is masterfully crafted by the Bernard Remy family in Allemant, exemplifies the artisanal excellence of the Côtes des Blancs region of Champagne. This elegant cuvée showcases a harmonious blend of grapes sourced from premier terroirs across Champagne, including the prestigious Côtes des Blancs, Sezannais, and Vallée de la Marne. The wine opens with a graceful stream of fine, persistent bubbles that dance in the glass, leading to an expressive bouquet of ripe apricot and white peach, complemented by subtle notes of toasted almonds and honeyed brioche. The palate reveals a sophisticated interplay of creamy texture and vibrant acidity, culminating in a luxuriously balanced finish that lingers with remarkable inesse.

This versatile champagne pairs beautifully with fresh oysters, butter-poached lobster, or delicate mushroom risotto, though it's equally captivating as an aperitif. The meticulous attention to detail by second-generation winemaker Rudy Remy, alongside his father Bernard, shines through in every sip of this refined champagne.
080862.item_title: Henri Laffard Grand Reserve Brut Champagne
080862.name: HENRI LAFFARD NV CHAMPAGNE

080865.item_story_marketing:
If you’re feeling snacky, you’ve come to the right place! Trader Joe’s stocks snacks of all sorts to satisfy your cravings and help sustain you until your next meal. Trader Joe’s Uncured Salami Snacker is just one tasty and convenient example.

We call it a Snacker because the three-ounce package is ideal for one peckish person. Open it up to find bite-sized slices of tangy, savory, Uncured Genoa Salami and mild, creamy provolone cheese. With 21 grams of protein per package, our Snacker will satiate your hunger—for comparision, 21 grams is similar to the amount of protein in three large eggs or a quarter-pound beef patty. And if lunch or dinner is a longer way off, you can easily (and deliciously) pair Trader Joe’s Uncured Salami Snacker with your favorite TJ’s crackers, like buttery Golden Rounds, or our mildly sweet, Wheat Crisp Crackers. Of course, nothing’s stopping you from improvising a sandwich if you have a TJ’s Ciabatta Roll handy.

Grab an Uncured Salami Snacker mid-afternoon when you swing by your refrigerator. Drop one in your lunch box for whenever you’re feeling snacky. Or... drop by Trader Joe’s and pick up a Snacker any time to hack your hunger. You’ll find them every day in our refrigerators!

080873.item_story_marketing:
Have you noticed that most of the products at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s in Trader Joe’s label? It’s not just that we like seeing our logo. (It is handsome though, right?) There are many good reasons, including the fact that when our name is on the package, we have more control over ingredients, production, price—and everything else. Sometimes, we’ll sell another brand just until we have the opportunity to create a private label version for our customers. Trader Joe’s Diced Uncured Pancetta is a great example of this!

Our Trader Joe’s Pancetta is Uncured, meaning it’s produced with no added nitrates or nitrites—except those naturally occurring in sea salt and cultured celery powder. It’s minimally processed, made with pork belly that’s imported from Italy, and it’s Diced and ready to incorporate into a variety of dishes. After sautéing Pancetta in a pan to render the fat and crisp up the cubes, make a classic carbonara pasta. Or use that rich pork flavor as a base for a sauce or stew. The crisped, melt-in-your-mouth Pancetta can also be used as a savory garnish scattered on salads, risotto, or Mashed Potatoes. Or toss it with whatever cooked vegetable you’re serving, from green beans to Brussels Sprouts!

080875.item_story_marketing:
Some foods are fantastic in their own right, but are made that much better when enjoyed together. For example, a plate of savory salami is doubly delicious when partnered with a creamy, piquant cheese. Our buyer had this culinary coupling in mind when she created what is now Trader Joe’s Deli Duo, a collection of conveniently sliced, uncured Genoa salami and Provolone cheese. The mouthwatering salami is gently spiced with white pepper and garlic, and made without nitrates or nitrites (except for those naturally occurring in sea salt and cultured Swiss chard powder). Its savory nature and satisfying chew are deftly complemented by the creamy, faintly sharp note of the Provolone. Talk about a dynamic Duo!

Want to make a quick Italian-style sub sandwich? Deli Duo is the answer. Assembling a last-minute charcuterie board for a cocktail party or to satiate the appetites of unannounced guests? Deli Duo to the rescue. In search of an instant afternoon snack? You guessed it—Deli Duo! And if you guessed that you’ll find packages of Deli Duo in the refrigerators at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s for an excellent value, you guessed right!

080876.item_story_marketing:
Antipasto, which simply means “before the meal” in Italian, is traditionally an appetizer served as the first course of a formal meal. The original antipasto aims to stimulate the appetite and set the stage for the dining experience, but Trader Joe’s Antipasto Prosciutto & Mozzarella Cheese Stick can completely stave off hunger!  

These Prosciutto and Mozzarella Sticks are made with all-natural ingredients and contain no added nitrates or nitrites (except those from sea salt). They’re also packed with protein—an impressive 10 grams per serving. Now, let’s talk flavor: the mild, full-fat mozzarella cheese and the salty, delicate prosciutto ham naturally complement each other, creating a creamy, tender texture that is balanced and delicious.

If you want to go all-in on the protein, pair an Antipasto Stick with a bag of our Just A Handful of Raw Almonds. You can also pair these Sticks with TJ’s Green Olive Flats Italian Lingue Crackers for a briny bite that mimics the classic antipasto flavors of olives, meat, and cheese. Find these Sticks alongside our other ready-to-eat delights in the refrigerators.

080885.item_story_marketing:
As true TJ’s enthusiasts may recall, our Daily Facial Sunscreen was an instant, runaway hit when we launched it in our stores back in 2022. Much to the dismay of ultraviolet rays everywhere, customers craving lightweight, invisible sun protection couldn’t get enough of the stuff! That is still true to this day, and in the years since, many customers have requested a Mineral version, too. Well, folks... ask and ye shall receive! 

Like its predecessor, Trader Joe’s Daily Facial Mineral Sunscreen offers fragrance-free, oil-free, oxybenzone- free SPF 40 protection and a weightless, matte finish. As a Mineral formula, however, it relies on non-nano zinc oxide to create a physical barrier between your skin and the sun’s harmful rays, gently sitting on top of the skin rather than being absorbed into it. Mineral sunscreens usually leave a ghostly white cast... but not TJ’s Daily Facial Mineral Sunscreen! Once applied to the face, our formula is nearly invisible. It’s Mineral Sunscreen, minus the mess, for a price that can’t be beat—quite the sunny proposition, indeed.

080887.item_story_marketing:
The annual arrival of peonies in our stores is one of the most buzzy times for our plants & flowers section—and we don’t mean because of bees. The short peony blooming season means our customers clamor for these very fragrant, very beautiful blooms to beautify their living spaces. Now, with the (loosely) corresponding arrival of Trader Joe’s Peony Scented Bath Fizzer, peony season isn’t just buzzy, it’a also fizzy! 

These bath fizzers have a flower form, suggesting the shape of a peony bloom. They’re colored pink (like the most popular peony shade we sell) and are flecked with mica powder to provide an alluring shimmer and sparkle. Just fill your bathtub with warm water, drop in an unwrapped Bath Fizzer, and let the lush aroma take hold of your senses. As you witness the Fizz and breathe in the bright bouquet of Peony, sink your body into the water to experience the soothing effects of moisturizing kaolin clay and cocoa butter on your skin. 

Follow the buzz and pick up a bunch of our five-ounce Peony Scented Bath Fizzers to ensure that your bath times are fragrant and fizzy—and that your Mother’s Day gifts are sufficiently sweet and snazzy!

080891.item_story_marketing:
Before the fireworks and festivities of the summer’s celebrations truly kick off, you’ll want to make sure you have a few essentials on hand: a good picnic chair, some strong sunscreen, and, of course, some stupendous seasonal sweet treats. While we’re not yet in the picnic chair business (never say never, though!) we certainly have the other two covered, and in the case of sweet treats, a standout new to this year’s selection is Trader Joe’s Flat Taffy. This confection comes in an iconic Red, White & Blue color scheme derived from vegetable juice and spirulina extract, and serves superbly at a barbecue, pool party, or any other summer get-together.

Soft, sweet, and chewy, our raspberry-flavored, multi-hued Flat Taffy is a traditional treat made by a supplier that’s been in the candy game since 1920—which is fitting, since it has a classic, oh-so-Americana, boardwalk feel. Eye-catching and appetizing, Flat Taffy will excel as part of a summer-y dessert spread, and will go easy on your party budget, too.
080891.item_story_qil:
Soft, sweet, and chewy, our raspberry-flavored, multi-hued Trader Joe's Flat Taffy is a traditional treat made 
by a supplier that's been in the candy game since 1920-which is only fitting, since it has an oh-so-Americana 
boardwalk feel. Like the midway candymakers of old, our supplier makes each piece of Flat Taffy by hand, 
employing a mix of tapioca syrup and cane sugar to bring the sweetness, natural flavors to give it its bright, 
raspberry profile, and spirulina extract and vegetable juice to provide its red, white, and blue color scheme.

Speaking of that red, white, and blue hue, we find that Trader Joe's Flat Taffy makes an especially fun and festive 
sweet treat for summertime celebrations-nothing quite pairs with a fireworks display like a satisfyingly chewy 
candy. When cut into segments, it also makes an eye-cathing accent to dessert plates, and a great garnish for a 
summer-y cocktail or mocktail. Just make sure not to get caught flat-footed-our Flat Taffy is only available in 
our candy section through the end of summer.

Flat Taffy

080927.item_story_marketing:
“Beau fleuve!” the 17th century French explorer exclaimed as he witnessed the picturesque river emptying into Lake Erie. But to the English settlers who came after, the French words for “Beautiful river” sounded a lot like “Buffalo!” Thus, this area where western New York state meets the shores of Lake Erie received it modern name—or so the legend goes. A couple hundred years later, the city of Buffalo, New York gave its name to the spicy wing sauce invented in a nearby local bar.

Today, we’ve borrowed the name for our Buffalo Ranch Popcorn! (We considered Beau Fleuve Popcorn, but that name suggested a soggy snack.) In fact, the five-ounce bag of Trader Joe’s Buffalo Ranch Popcorn contains fluffy butterfly Popcorn kernels—the variety with unpredictably shaped ‘wings’ sticking out—that have been popped in coconut & sunflower oils and generously seasoned with a bold, Buffalo Ranch seasoning. The spicy-herby-tangy blend sticks in all those lovely corny crevasses so that every bite is loaded with Buffalo- style heat and creamy-Ranch coolness.

Take a bag to the movies. Take it to the beach. Take it on a hike... to the river! Wherever you decide to roam with Trader Joe’s Buffalo Ranch Popcorn, you’re going to enjoy it. But don’t miss your chance—bison… er, buy some now before this limited snack runs out!

080933.item_story_marketing:
The days are growing shorter, the air is getting crisp, and the plants & flowers section at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s positively runneth over with values—the kind of big, bloomin’ buys that really put the “ahh” in autumn. And while you’ll still find everyday favorites like bountiful mixed bouquets and opulent orchids, now is the time to turn your attention to fall’s floral MVP: the mighty Mum.

Available in a cornucopia of colors that rival the fall foliage, Chrysanthemums are the season’s ultimate multitaskers—they’re festive porch-perchers, centerpiece scene-stealers, and general mood-lifters, all rolled into tightly packed puffs of petals. Though exact varieties we offer will vary from week to week and region to region, but they’re all equally mum-erable. Plus, unlike more delicate flora that faint at the first sign of a fall breeze, these sturdy blooms are unflustered by a little brisk weather. Mum’s the word, and Trader Joe’s is the place—all season long.
080933.item_story_qil:
Chrysanthemums, often called mums or chrysanths, are of the genus 
Chrysanthemum constituting approximately 30 species of perennial flowering 
plants in the family Asteraceae which is native to Asia and northeastern Europe. 
Other members of the Asteraceae family include marigolds, dahlias, and zinneas. 
Chrysanthemums were first cultivated in China as a flowering herb as far back as 
the 15th century BC. The flower was brought to Europe in the 17th century. The 
name Chrysanthemum is derived from the Greek words, chrysos (gold) and 
anthemon (flower). 
 
Trader Joe's Big Bunch Chrysanthemums come in a wide array of colors, and

For what could possibly be greater than sliced bread? How about sliced cinnamon swirl bread! Indeed, Trader Joe’s Sliced Cinnamon Swirl Bread represents a seriously sweet and Cinnamon-y upgrade to your everyday slice of bread, available now on an everyday basis at the bakery section of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. 

Brought to us by a bakery supplier, whose expertise with Cinnamon-based baked goods is second to none, each loaf contains a Swirl of Cinnamon sugar throughout, creating a delightfully flavorful (but not overly Cinnamon-spicy) eating experience in every bite. It’s great when enjoyed by the slice straight out of the bag, and when toasted, takes on an even more rich and aromatic quality. And for an unbeatable sweet breakfast treat, our Sliced Cinnamon Swirl Bread serves spectacularly well as the foundation for French toast.

080967.item_story_marketing:
Whether you’re in need of a striking center-of-the-plate option for a big family feast, or just something dependably delicious for weeknight dinners and meal prep, Trader Joe’s always has a plethora of proteins at the ready. Take, for instance, Trader Joe’s Seasoned Lamb Shoulder Rack. Made with Lamb sourced from Australia, each of these hearty, hefty Shoulder Racks comes pre-Seasoned with a mix of sesame seeds and aromatic herbs, which means that that they’re ready to cook just as soon as you bring them at home. And it also means that it’s never been easier to have a texturally tender, superbly savory-spiced protein prepped for whatever kind of meal you’re working with.

Speaking of being ready-to-cook, we find that this Lamb Shoulder Rack is particularly great when grilled on the barbecue or roasted in the oven. In fact, we heartily recommend slow-roasting this Rack for an especially tender bite: about two and a half hours at 300°F should give you the best results. From there, you’re free to accessorize with your favorite sides, like some buttery mashed potatoes, sweet potato au gratin, air-fried asparagus, or dreamy creamed spinach.

080971.item_story_marketing:
The Whole Milk profile means richer, creamier flavor that pairs so well with cake, cookies, cereal, coffee, and more. And these traits can even re-invigorate that nostalgic idea of enjoying a tall, cold glass of milk! To support all the Whole Milk lovers, we offer a variety of options for different tastes and preferences, and now we’re adding one more variety to our dairy deck: Trader Joe’s Organic A2 Whole Milk.

What is A2? Glad you asked. Regular milk contains two variations of beta-casein protein: A1 and A2. Several years back, super-smart scientists in New Zealand discovered that some cows were producing milk with only A2 beta-casein. This “A2” milk didn’t have a different flavor. It didn’t even have a different nutrient profile. What it did have going for it, different than regular milk, was the prospect of being easier to digest for some people. These scientists realized that you could easily discover which cows were producing A2-only milk using a simple genetic test. The rest is history—including the advent of A2 Whole Milk in the dairy case at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s!

081000.item_story_marketing:
If you asked someone to name the top foods associated with fine dining, it would probably take them quite a while before they got to granola. But if you think about, all the elements are there for granola to go gourmet: a variety of textures, a curated selection of ingredients, and a chance to showcase how they all interact with one another. This was exactly what one of our product developers experienced when enjoying a post-dinner granola at a renowned restaurant, and that’s exactly what inspired us to try our own hand at haute cuisine oats with Trader Joe’s Homestyle Cherry Pistachio Pecan Granola.

Striking just the right balance of rustic and refined, this Granola is made with a mix of crisp rolled oats, sweetened and dried Montmorency cherries, crunchy Pistachios, Pecans, and pumpkin seeds, and coconut flakes. Our supplier flavors all these elements with brown sugar, maple syrup, and a touch of extra virgin olive oil, to provide a pleasant push-pull of savory and sweet on the palate. In the morning, it makes a beautiful breakfast when mixed with milk, and the evening, it’s a delightful dessert, especially when enjoyed in the context of a parfait, or when sprinkled over ice cream as part of a sundae.

081001.item_story_marketing:
While cocktail trends may come and go, few drinks have stood the test of time quite as well as the classic margarita. For over 80 years, the margarita has reigned as the first choice for enjoying at parties, by the pool, or alongside a sizzling fajita platter. As proud proponents of parties, poolside refreshment, and especially sizzling fajita platters, we’re glad to do our part with the triumphant re-introduction of Trader Joe’s Organic Margarita Mix to our shelves! 

It now comes to us from a new supplier, who uses a sublimely simple mix of organic lime juice & concentrate, organic agave syrup, and organic natural flavors to truly nail that familiar sweet-sour-tangy Margarita flavor profile. Speaking of simple, we find that a 2:1 ratio of this Organic Margarita Mix and your favorite tequila (may we humbly recommend our very own Tequila Blanco [sku 62093]?) will consistently result in a beautifully balanced, perfectly portioned Margarita, taking all the guesswork out of bartending duties when friends are over. Now, all that’s left is to get those fajitas sizzling!

081022.item_story_marketing:
At Trader Joe’s, we offer one of the best values on Eucalyptus in town. The exact varieties we offer will vary from season to season, but one thing remains consistent: no matter the variety, our Eucalyptus is eu-niversally eu-seful! (We had to… )

Whether you display it in a vase on its own or add it to an existing arrangement, Eucalyptus is an easy & affordable way to enhance the aesthetic of any room in your home. (And if you’re displaying it solo, you don’t even need water—just hang it upside down to dry it first!) Another keen option? Bundle it with some twine, hang it from your shower head, and enjoy a blissful, spa-like experience every time you shower!

Pro-tip: to maximize its invigorating scent-potential, gently roll over the stems with a rolling pin first to release its essential oils.
081022.name: EUCALYPTUS

081037.item_story_marketing:
If you’ll indulge us to wax a little philosophical for just a moment, there’s a good reason that so many comfort foods are based on pairings (macaroni and cheese, milk and cookies, peanut butter and jelly, et cetera). It’s because that feeling of comfort so often comes from a sense of togetherness—it’s the memory of first eating something hearty and flavorful with friends and family, the sense that whoever first prepped that dish for you was really taking care of you that provides that comfort, just as much as the food itself. In this spirit, we’ve dedicated this everyday Resuable Bag to just a few of these iconic Comfort Food combos, to keep that feeling of togetherness going whether you’re grabbing your groceries, toting picnic supplies, or just moving odds and ends to and fro.

Of course, our Comfort Food Resuable Bag offers more than just convenient, stylish conveyance. With its delightfully decorative design, emblazoned with images of the aforementioned mac & cheese, milk & cookies, and PB&J (along with bacon & eggs and ketchup & fries), we find that it also makes a great gift bag for sharing your favorite Trader Joe’s treats with a loved one. Like we said: camaraderie is what Comfort Food is all about!
081037.name: BAG COMFORT FOOD

081050.item_story_marketing:
A savory staple across countless cuisines in the Middle East, North Africa, and Mediterranean, labneh is a style 
of strained yogurt that's very similar to what we might more commonly call "Greek-style" yogurt, here in the 
States. Creamy, tangy, and often remarkably cheesy, labneh is enjoyed in all sorts of contexts within the many 
cultures that lay claim to it, including as a breakfast dish with poached eggs and herbs, drizzled with olive oil 
as part of a mezze platter, or spread on carbs of all kinds. Drawing inspiration from all of these uses, Trader 
Joe's Roasted Tomato Labneh Dip combines labneh's signature tanginess and smooth texture with irresistably 
aromatic herbs and rich, sweet, and robust Roasted Tomatoes into one seriously versatible Dip.

Try dunking Trader Joe's Roasted Tomato Labneh Dip with pita chips, fresh Lavash, or really 
anything tasty and dunkable-carrot sticks, pitted olives, French fries, you name it. Try spreading it on a 
sandwhich, a Falafel wrap, or even just a slice of sourdough toast. Try dropping it by the spoonful 
over salads, hearty grain bowls, or tomato-based soups. Whatever you do, just be sure you try it! It's a tart, 
cheesy, herby, phenomenally full-flavored eating experience, and it's now available at your neighborhood 
Trader Joe's.

Just in case you haven’t been keeping tabs on these things the way we have, we feel obligated to inform you that the Korean street food scene has made some truly stunning advancements in the field of corn dog craftsmanship over the past few decades. One of the most striking and satisfying of these advancements has to be the addition of bits of potato to the outside batter before frying to a crisp, golden brown—a genuine game-changer, in terms of both taste and texture. This breakthrough, in addition to some great strides in the arena of cheese-based (rather than frankfurter-based) corn dogs, served as the express inspiration for our latest frozen appetizer sensation, Trader Joe’s Potato Cheese Sticks.

They’re made for us by a Korean supplier, and they really must be tasted to be believed. Each bite starts with the captivating crunch of the first layer of lightly sweet batter, which is generously dotted with cubes of crisp and savory Potato, followed by your teeth sinking into the stretchy, melty, gloriously gooey Cheese at the center. They’re excellent on their own, and doubly delicious when dunked into some ketchup or Hot Honey Mustard. And since they take only a few minutes in the air fryer (or a little longer in the conventional oven) to prepare, they also make an extremely easy, cheesy, carnival-y treat.

081056.item_story_marketing:
While the Philippines may not technically have an official national dish, you’d be hard pressed to find a more iconically Filipino dish than adobo. More of a cooking process than a specific recipe, most modern adobo dishes involve braising proteins or veggies in a tangy, savory mix of soy sauce and vinegar, and further seasoning them with classic flavors like garlic, black pepper, and bay leaf. That’s the flavor profile you’ll find in Trader Joe’s Chicken Adobo, our convenient, heat-and-eat tribute to this homey, hearty, full-flavored dish, which also includes a hefty portion of fluffy jasmine rice flavored with bits of oven-roasted garlic —itself a tribute to traditional Filipino garlic rice.

While adobo gets its name from the Spanish “adobar” (“to season” or “to marinate”), the earliest forms of adobo well pre-date Spanish colonization of the Philippines, and call back to an ancient practice of using vinegar as a preserving agent, as much as a flavoring ingredient. In Trader Joe’s Chicken Adobo, that vinegar base provides both zest and a balancing bit of acidity, which beautifully brings out the tenderness of the dark meat chicken. And since it cooks from frozen to steamy and ready-to-eat in a matter of minutes in the microwave, our Chicken Adobo makes a great work lunch option, as well as an easy weeknight dinner-for-one—especially when paired with a crisp, cucumber-y salad on the side, and something citrus-y and sparkling to drink.

081059.item_story_marketing:
We love all things coffee here at Trader Joe’s, and La Colombe® Vanilla Draft Lattes fit in perfectly with our present offerings. Because this isn’t just any coffee—it’s everything you enjoy about an iced latte, vanilla espresso, and frothy, Draft cold brew, all mixed into one. The folks at La Colombe® makes each batch by blending fresh milk with roasty cold brew coffee, sweetening it with cane sugar, flavoring it with Vanilla extract, then infusing it all with food grade nitrous oxide via a pin-sized valve in the bottom of the can. The result is an exceptionally silky-smooth and rich Vanila Draft Latte, complete with a frothy layer of foam—just like you’d find in a café.

Enjoy a chilled Vanilla Draft Latte anytime you need a pick-me-up. Pour it over ice cream for an over-the-top affogato. Or, trying using it in a morning or pre-workout smoothie—we suggest blending the whole can with a frozen banana and a tablespoon of Cocoa Powder, or combining it with 1 cup of Greek Style Nonfat Plain Yogurt and 1.5 cups of our Fruits & Greens Smoothie Blend.
