081060.item_story_marketing:
This truly is a golden age of getting one’s greens in. We’d reckon that there’s never been a time in human history when so many easy and delicious vegetable options have been so available and for so reasonable a price—and Trader Joe’s Roasted Green Vegetables is a prime example. It’s made from a simple, yet profoundly effective mix of pre-chopped, cruciferous Vegetables like kale, broccoli, and Brussels sprouts, along with tender, proteinaceous, pre-shelled edamame, that are all flavored with olive oil, garlic, onion, salt, and pepper, and Roasted to perfection. Now, creating a hearty and flavorful veggie side dish for your next meal is as easy as heating up a tray in the microwave or conventional oven, serving, and enjoying! 

In fact, our favorite thing about these handy, vegan Roasted Green Vegetables is their potential for freeing up the rest of your meal planning—with the veggies out of the way, you have all the more time to consider what protein and starch to serve with them. We recommend trying them out with a seared steak and potatoes, grilled chicken breasts over pasta, marinated tofu and brown rice, or pan-fried salmon with noodles. And if you feel like personalizing your Greens, the sky’s the limit: we like them topped with a bit of grated Parmesan, a drizzle of Organic Balsamic Vinegar, or any number of our savory sauces and seasoning blends.

081062.item_story_marketing:
If Trader Joe’s All the Things Cookies literally contained ALL the things, they would be very large. Instead, we’ve gone for more figurative interpretation, meaning, these Cookies are loaded with good stuff—All the Things required for an amazing cookie encounter. 

The base is a butter Cookie. (We do mean this literally!) Butter is the second ingredient (after flour), and makes up 24%—almost a quarter of the recipe. A variety of fun, multi-textured Things are mixed into the Cookie dough before baking, including corn flakes, pretzels, marshmallows, semisweet chocolate chips, and crispy rice. Once baked, these circular, golden-brown confections entice with a sweet, buttery aroma. Each crunchy bite may lead to a piece of salted pretzel, or a cluster of rich chocolate chips. The marshmallows have taken on an almost toffee-like candy character. And the corn flakes and crispy rice bring a lighter, crisp crunch to the whole experience. 

All the Things Cookies are available all the time—and we mean this literally, too! Every day, you’ll find nine- ounce tubs of about 14 cookies alongside all the rest of our delicious and varied Trader Joe’s cookies.

081067.item_story_marketing:
The combination of sweet & spicy flavors in a single dish is a global cultural phenomenon. It’s also a phenomenon in that microcosm of the globe we call your neighborhood Trader Joe’s! We sell Hot & Sweet Jalapeños, Sweet & Spicy Rice Cracker Mix, and Mildly Sweet & Spicy Beef & Broccoli—to name just a few such products. Now, we’re bringing this sweet & spicy profile to our guacamole selection with a fresh Mango Habanero Guacamole. 

Chunks of golden Mango provide the sweet. The spicy comes from a combination of jalapeño peppers and Habanero pepper purée. These sweet & spicy components are complemented by just a handful of other fresh (never frozen) ingredients, including onion, red bell pepper, and cilantro. Of course, we can’t forget the avocados! Our Mexican supplier acquires Hass variety avocados from nearby farms and scoops them by hand to create the creamy and delicious Guacamole base. 

If you normally enjoy guacamole, then you’ll know exactly what to do with Trader Joe’s Mango Habanero Guacamole: scoop it with Organic Blue Corn Tortilla Chips; dip your Southwest Style Chicken Quesadillas; add some inside your Beef, Bean & Cheese Burrito; pop some on top of your Green Chile Chicken Bowl... You’ll find it in our refrigerators, every day!

081085.item_story_marketing:
We have no guilt in admitting a freshly opened bag of Trader Joe’s Shredded Mozzarella Cheese is a tempting shortcut to eschew any skinned knuckles and wasted time grating your own mozzarella. While taking the time to make it yourself has its place, we really try our best to deliver you the freshest, softest, and stretchiest Shredded Mozzarella Cheese we can find!

Whether oozing off of a slice of pizza or layered in a pan of lasagna, Trader Joe’s Shredded Mozzarella Cheese is ready to include in many dishes for a melted, stringy, and flavorful cheese addition. Our mozzarella fior di latte, the Italian terminology for cow’s milk mozzarella, is made with pasteurized part-skim milk, cheese cultures, microbial enzymes, and just a few other preservative ingredients. Pasta filata, again, an Italian term, but this time for the mozz making process, is as simple as starting with fresh whey and cheese cultures, adding the microbial enzymes, and then heating in water to form a stringy and elastic cheese that can be kneaded and then shredded; ready for you to sprinkle and melt on whatever you’d like!

081087.item_story_marketing:
“Location, location, location.” It’s an old aphorism about what the three most important things in real estate are, but it might as well apply to butchery, too. Take skirt steak, for instance. Located in the plate portion, between the brisket and the flank of a cow, skirt steak is a tender, easy-grilling cut of beef that’s ideal for marinating and grilling. However, just the outside portion of the skirt steak (what’s known as “entraña” in Argentina) is an even more tender, well-marbled, and noticeably beefier-in-flavor cut that’s an eating experience all its own. It’s a small difference in location, but as you’ll see in every toothsome, full-flavored bite of Trader Joe’s Angus Beef Outside Skirt Steak, it makes all the difference.

Like all skirt steak, Outside Skirt is best prepped fast and with high heat, to preserve its buttery bite. We like to give it a quick marinade of lime juice, crushed garlic, and a glug of TJ’s EVOO before throwing it on the grill. It’s a superb steak, especially when enjoyed over a bed of grilled onions, with roasted potatoes and a dollop of Chimichurri, and it’s also terrific for tacos. Normally, you’d likely need to visit a specialty butcher to find entraña of this quality—it’s not something most grocery stores carry. Which is why we’re so excited to announce that Trader Joe’s Angus Beef Outside Skirt Steak is available in our refrigerators every day!

081133.item_story_marketing:
For a taste of Turkey at home, allow us to introduce you to Trader Joe’s Simit Turkish Sesame Bread. Simit can be found on street carts and bakeries throughout the country, and although these beauties may resemble bagels, they are distinctly different.

Simit is not boiled but baked and has a characteristic twist throughout. While its interior is chewy and nutty, its exterior is crispy and dense. Our Simits are made “Ankara style,” on the smaller size, conveniently-sized, with a crisp texture. Sticking to tradition, these circular breads are coated with a molasses-based solution that adds a bit of shine, helps with browning, and allows sesame seeds to encrust their surface.

To ensure freshness, each package contains two smaller, individually sealed bags, containing two Sesame Breads in each. They come frozen and can be eaten as soon as they thaw. To awaken all the unique flavors and textures, though, we recommend heating from frozen in a 350°F. oven for 4-5 minutes. Enjoy on their own, serve with your favorite TJ’s Hummus or bit of TJ’s Glaze. Slather with Cultured Butter, Feta Cheese, or Raspberry Preserves as a breakfast treat or daytime snack.

081171.item_story_marketing:
Only a language as beautiful as Italian could make the word “drowned” so euphonious as “affogato.” Because “drowned” is what “affogato” literally translates to—an evocative reference to the act of pouring hot coffee over a scoop of cold ice cream. A gem of gelato shops the world over, we love the way an affogato mixes flavors, textures, and temperatures. So, when our buyers found this instant Affogato, we instantly knew we had to bring it to our freezers.

Made with a totally vegan recipe, each package of Trader Joe’s 2 Affogatos Vanilla Non Dairy Frozen Dessert contains two cups of Vanilla Non Dairy Frozen Dessert, each of which comes with its own packet of instant coffee. All you need to do to enjoy your very own Affogato is open up a cup, pour the contents of the instant coffee into the little well that’s already been made within the Non Dairy Dessert, then follow that up with an ounce of hot water. All at once, that iconic interplay of hot & cold and sweet & bold will unfold before your very eyes, and you’ll be ready to enjoy. We recommend it as an after-dinner treat, an afternoon indulgence, or as an anytime pick-me-up. Divertiti!

081173.item_story_marketing:
For our new signature pasta, we’re borrowing a page from Nonna’s cookbook with the Sicilian dish “Pasta alla Norma.” The classic recipe usually features noodles tossed with eggplant, tomato sauce, basil, and regional cheese—simple yet elegant.
 
Our latest addition to the frozen case is a modified version of the original that adds more body and savory flavor without sacrificing taste. Trader Joe’s 3 Cheese Pasta with Eggplant’s penne pasta stays almost al dente, offering a rich and mouthwatering experience with enough vegetables to make it toothsome and hearty while still vegetarian! The layered flavor of the tomato sauce is enhanced by the creamy bechamel, complemented by mozzarella, provolone, and hard grating cheeses. Close your eyes and you just might get transported back to Nonna’s kitchen!

3 Cheese Pasta with Eggplant  comes in two single-serving paper trays that heat up beautifully in the microwave or oven, without the pasta drying out or overcooking. It makes a quick, portioned lunch or a dinner for two, ready in minutes! For a beverage pairing, consider a recommendation from Pavarotti, the Italian opera legend, who was said to have loved the original alla Norma with the chilled, sparkling red wine Medici Lambrusco Reggiano, from Northern Italy.

With its luxuriously soft and airy texture texture, and delicately sweet flavor, we find that it’s especially suited for using as a topping for a brownie, a bowl of (also vegan!) And with the holidays just around the corner, you’re going to want to make sure you’ve Whipt™ at the ready for adding a dollop to a slice of cake after the big meal!

081214.item_story_marketing:
When it comes to mealtime envy, dogs have mastered the art of the thousand-yard stare at the dinner table—and with Trader Joe’s Freeze-Dried Beef Meatballs for Dogs, your pup finally gets a seat at the feast! These bite-sized, grain-free morsels are made with 99% beef and beef liver, sourced right here in the U.S.A. They’re aptly seasoned with salt, sage, and rosemary, then gently freeze-dried to lock in their rich, meaty flavor and protein-rich goodness. The result? A Meatball snack so savory, your pup won’t even miss the spaghetti.

Beyond their Italian-inspired charm, our Freeze-Dried Beef Meatballs for Dogs are as practical as they are drool-worthy. They’re just the right size for a one-bite reward (and easy to break apart for more petite pooches), with no added fillers, binders, or artificial extras to muddy the recipe—just a pinch of mixed tocopherols (vitamin E) to keep them fresh. Each 10-calorie treat delivers a minimum of 31% crude protein and 30% crude fat, making them as smart for training as they are for casual, between-meal snacking. You can even crush and sprinkle them over your doggo’s dinner for a full-on Meatball moment—let Fido live la dolce vita!

081215.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Freeze Dried Apricots are Turkish Apricots, harvested at peak ripeness, cut into slices, and Freeze Dried. Nothing else is added to this single-ingredient snack. Inside the bag, you’ll find lots of non- uniform shapes, all of them bite-sized, all of them crunchy & light. Each bite delivers fruity Apricot flavor, along with a healthy measure of tartness, puncuated by sweetness that varies from piece to piece.

Munch them straight from the bag for heightened crunch value, or for a more laid-back approach, let them dissolve on your tongue for a few seconds as you meditate on the flavor. Enjoy their tangy, crunchy character atop sweet, creamy ice cream or yogurt; mix them into a bowl of hot or cold cereal; add them to homemade muffins or pancakes; toss them with your favorite TJ’s trail mix...

You’ll find 1.4-ounce, resealable pouches of Trader Joe’s Freeze Dried Apricots in our nuts & dried-fruit section for a limited time. They’ll be available February through June to top your list of dried-fruit favorites!

081224.item_story_marketing:
Let’s take a moment to appreciate the sheer range of chocolate, shall we? Beyond the classic milk and dark chocolates (which already present an extraordinarily wide variety of expressions between them), there’s a whole world of fantastically flavored white chocolate out there, too. By making use of the creaminess of cocoa butter as a base, chocolatiers the world over have been able to explore flavor profiles ranging from mild and mellow to big and bold. One such example of such wizardry is Trader Joe’s Blonde Bar. It’s made for us by a third-generation, bean-to-bar confectioner in Italy, who flavors their white chocolate with rich, lightly salty caramel to achieve its beautifully Blonde hue, and mixes in bits of crumbled-up sugar cookies to provide pleasant pops of crispiness as you eat.

After more than twenty-five iterations, our tasting panel finally landed on the final version of Trader Joe’s Blonde Bar, because we knew we needed to get it just right. With one taste, we know that you’ll agree that it was well worth it. Each and every bite is creamy, sweet, and silky-textured, with nice little bits of cookie to engage the palate throughout. It can be enjoyed, by the square, entirely on its own, it can serve as the star of a wine-and-chocolate tasting, and it truly excels when paired with a bold-flavored coffee drink or creamy milk tea.

081225.item_story_marketing:
There’s just something about the combination of chicken, pineapple, and teriyaki that just *clicks*. Whether it’s in the form of a grilled chicken sandwich topped with pineapple slices and teriyaki sauce, or teriyaki-tinged chicken fried rice with little chunks of pineapple, this unlikely trio of sweet, savory, and succulent elements always keeps us coming back for more. In fact, we recently went back to the supplier of our ever-popular Chicken Meatballs with one request: give us your best version of chicken, pineapple, and teriyaki in a delectable, dippable, pop-in-your-mouth-able form. And when they came back with these Pineapple Teriyaki Chicken Meatballs, our tasting panel immediately knew that we had something special.

Now available in our refrigerated cases on an everyday basis, Trader Joe’s Pineapple Teriyaki Chicken Meatballs are made with all-natural ground chicken, are certified gluten free, and arrive fully cooked, so that all you have to do is heat them up in the oven, microwave, or air fryer, then serve. On their own, they make a great savory snack or appetizer (especially when paired with something tangy to dip them in). They’re also awesome when tossed with your favorite noodles (we’re particularly partial to our Squiggly Noodles), and make a mean meatball sub with our Sandwich Rolls, too.

081238.item_story_marketing:
If you haven’t had a chance to try one of our non-dairy frozen desserts yet—even, and especially, if you’re normally a fan of dairy—consider the introduction of Trader Joe’s Vanilla Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert to be your formal invitation. Made with a base of creamy coconut milk and flavored with both vanilla bean paste and bits of ground vanilla beans, this veritably vegan Frozen Dessert is distinctly delicious, offering a superlatively smooth texture and remarkably rich and floral Vanilla flavors in every satisfying spoonful, without an overwhelming flavor of coconut.

It’s brought to us by the same Thai supplier who produces many of our other non-dairy sweet treats, and after just one taste, you’ll see why we’ve worked with them time and again: they’ve truly figured out a way to make coconut milk feel creamier and more luscious on the palate than most standard, dairy-based ice creams out there. As such, while this Vanilla Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert is great for simply enjoying in a bowl, cone, or sundae, we also find that it’s particularly suited for more complex dessert endeavors, too: we recommend using it in floats, no-bake ice cream cakes, homemade ice cream sandwiches, or milkshakes (either with our A2 Organic Whole Milk, or, if you prefer to keep it vegan, some chilled Organic Non-Dairy Unsweetened Coconut Beverage.)

081242.item_story_marketing:
Meatballs are one of those dishes that, while fundamentally hearty and delicious, even in their most basic, unembellished form, really benefit from a litte plussing up. In the case of Trader Joe’s Homestyle Angus Beef Meatballs, for example, our supplier has applied some truly appetizing upgrades. Their recipe starts with a base of tender, ground, 100% Angus Beef, to which they add a bit of panko breadcrumbs, to create an even more toothsome texture, along with onion and garlic purée, a blend of aromatic herbs like basil and oregano, as well as grated Parmesan and Romano cheeses for some extra umami. It all results in a super flavorful and texturally satisfying Meatball, which cooks quickly and easily at home.

Once fully cooked (which only takes 10 to 20 minutes in your air fryer or conventional oven), our Homestyle Angus Beef Meatballs make an excellent addition to soups, submarine sandwiches, and, of course, a classic plate of spaghetti, dressed with any of our marvelous marina options (Trader Joe’s Roasted Garlic Marinara Sauce is an especially inspired choice.) They’re amazing as appetizers when served with something rich and tangy to dip them in, like our Thick, Bold & Spicy Red, Sweet Dill Mustard, or Organic Kansas City Style BBQ sauces. And for a fun, flavorful twist on sliders, smash them in the frying pan, cook all the way through, and serve on a sliced Aloha Roll.

081246.item_story_marketing: So much depends upon the texture of a tortilla. Too firm, and it’ll crack when being folded into a taco. Too soft, and it’ll eat more like a crepe. To achieve the perfect balance (and, thus, a superlatively satisfyingly bite), we reached out to a vendor who uses an ingenious blend of corn and wheat in their recipe. This harmonious mix produces a tortilla that’s soft and pliable enough to properly fold around your favorite fillings, while still being strong enough to hold those fillings in the first place. Available exclusively in our West Coast and Southwest stores, Trader Joe’s Corn & Wheat Tortillas are a must-have whenever tacos, fajitas, or huevos rancheros are on the menu. We find that their tooth-sinking consistency and mild flavor makes them especially suited for loading up with Beef Birria, Pollo Asado, or well-seasoned ground beef—though you truly cant go wrong with any kind of protein or veggies, in our opinion. We’re also quite find of cutting them into triangles and frying them into chips—especially if you then smother them in salsa for homemade chilaquiles.

081279.item_story_marketing: Not in the mood to make your own pizza? Try a Tarte instead! Based on a 100-year-old recipe from the Alsace-Lorraine region of France, the Maître Pierre Tarte d’ Alsace defies categorization. And after nearly 20 years in the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, each luxurious, eight-ounce Tarte continues to represent an incredible value. It starts with a thin, delicate, folded crust that’s fired for exactly the right balance of rich flavor and crisp texture. Then, much to your palate’s delight, each Tarte d’ Alsace is topped with crème fraîche, caramelized onions, thinly sliced ham, and Gruyère cheese. Bake it in a 450°F oven for 8-10 minutes, and you’ll have an appetizer to astonish your guests, or pair it with a Pizza Ranch Salad, and you’ve got a complete dinner for two.

081294.item_story_marketing:
Antipasto means “before the meal” in Italian, and traditionally it’s an appetizer served as the first course of a formal meal. The original antipasto is meant to stimulate the appetite and set the stage for the dining experience, but Trader Joe’s Antipasto Salami & Pepper Jack Sticks could stave off hunger entirely! This summer, we’re adding them to our refrigerators!

These Salami and Pepper Jack Sticks are made with all-natural ingredients, and without added nitrates or nitrites (except those from sea salt). They’re also packed with protein—an impressive 10 grams per serving. When it comes to flavor, the slightly spiced pepper Jack cheese and the salty, mild salami are natural partners; their combintion creates a creamy, tender bite. Besides being a convenient, on-the-go snack for a quick protein boost, you can also pair these Sticks with Green Olive Flats Italian Lingue Crackers for a briny bite that mimics the classic antipasto flavors of olives, meat, and cheese. Find these Sticks alongside our other ready-to-eat sliced meat and cheese snacks in our refrigerators.

081299.item_story_marketing:
By many estimates, flatbread may just be the very first recipe that humanity ever developed. Verified archaeological evidence of flatbread production goes back all the way to 12,400 BCE, but many historians postulate that its origins may actually go back as far as 30,000 BCE. Needless to say, for a dish this foundational to the history of human culinary endeavor, it’s important that we found the best possible version to bring into our bakery section. And Trader Joe’s Flatbread is just that. 

Made for us by a bakery who just so happens to specialize in flatbreads, Trader Joe’s Flatbread is everything you’d expect it to be: soft, chewy, and just a touch savory, with a structure that’s pliable enough to wrap around hearty proteins and leafy greens, while sturdy enough to not tear or fall apart under those fillings’ weight. And in addition to its uses as a wrap, it’s also great for scooping up your favorite savory and/or cool and creamy dips—whether you do so straight out of the package, or cut them into wedges and fry them into crispy chips, first. And fittingly enough for such a foundational food, our Flatbreads also make a great base for an easy, homemade flatbread pizza with all your favorite toppings.

081300.item_story_marketing:
To create the vacation-in-a-jar that is Trader Joe’s Organic Guava Spread, our supplier starts with organically grown Guavas from Brazil picked at the peak of ripeness. The luscious pink fruit is simmered with organic cane sugar, fruit pectin, and a bit of water (plus ascorbic and citric acids) to create a thick, brick red, tart & tangy spread, teeming with tropical flavor. Simple? Somewhat. Tasty? You bet.

In contrast to the fruit’s limited seasonality, the uses for this superb Spread are actually quite wide-ranging. In addition to the more obvious stand-in for jelly on toast, bagels, or a PB&J, Organic Guava Spread is excellent slathered on pancakes and waffles. Its sweet-tart notes are a welcome complement to a savory, roasted pork tenderloin or grilled chicken & brie sandwich. And who wouldn’t want to level up their summer cheese board with a swoosh of this Spread on a cracker, topped with a cube of TJ’s Unexpected Cheddar Cheese? (Fun fact: this is exactly how the Spread was served and ultimately approved at the TJ’s tasting panel—the combo is absolutely worth tasting for yourself!). If your palate is piqued and you’re interested in taking your taste buds on a trip to the tropics, head to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, post-haste.

081307.item_story_marketing: As a category of dish, curry has a remarkably wide range of expression, from thick and umami-rich Japanese curries, to bold and aromatic Indian curries, to creamy, coconut-based Thai curries. Taking its cues from the Thai curry tradition, Trader Joe’s Thai Style Red Curry Soup hits some of the most popular notes in the Red Curry canon. A spoonful of this full-flavored, just-heat-and-eat Soup carries hints of ginger, garlic, lemongrass, and even a touch of chili heat. The herbs and spices flavor a sauce that carries chunks of white-meat chicken, hearty pieces of fresh pumpkin, bell peppers, and green beans. All these components come to life with a quick heat-up in the microwave or in a saucepan on the stove. And when paired with a mound of freshly steamed TJ’s Jasmine Rice from Thailand, our Thai Style Chicken Curry makes for a truly satisfying meal!

081314.item_story_marketing:
A celebrated snack across East and Southeast Asia, shrimp chips (also called “kropek” in the Philippines, “bánh phỔng tôm” in Vietnam, or “prawn crackers” elsewhere) are traditionally made by combining a starch (often tapioca) with ground shrimp and aromatic seasonings, forming them into little pucks, then frying them until they’re supleratively light, airy, and crispy. That’s certainly the tactic taken by the supplier behind Trader Joe’s Garlic Shrimp Chips, which have only a mild seafood flavor to them—the eating experience is really more about a broadly savory, garlicky, and umami-rich profile, with a pleasantly crispy crunch that leads into a remakably unique melt-in-your-mouth texture on the tongue.

If you’ve never had a Shrimp Chip before, now’s an excellent time to try. With their satisfying depth of flavor and lively notes of garlic and herbs, Trader Joe’s Garlic Shrimp Chips make an excellent standalone snack, and an able accessory to sandwiches, soups, fried chicken, and curries. And if you’ve never tried using a Shrimp Chip to scoop up some ceviche, Creamy Spinach & Artichoke Dip, or Organic Chunky Homestyle Guacamole? Well, now you have something truly special to look forward to.

081315.item_story_marketing:
Ethiopia’s Guji zone is among the highest-elevation coffee-growing regions in the world, with most farms situated more than a mile above sea level. Fittingly enough, that high altitude creates an especially elevated drinking experience in the region’s coffees: the lower night temperatures, higher atmospheric stress, and red, volcanic,  nutrient-rich soil of the Guji highlands all result in a hardier, denser, and sweeter coffee bean come harvest time. It’s a difference that’s elegantly apparent in every sip of Trader Joe’s Ethiopia Guji Light Roast Whole Bean Coffee, available at your neihghborhood Trader Joe’s for a limited time.

Grown for us in the Badeyi region of Guji, located in the central-southern highlands of Ethiopia, our supplier gives these Beans a Light Roast to leave as much of their sweet, rich, stone fruit-forward flavor intact as possible. We find that it’s well suited to pour-overs, which give you the opportunity to pick out its complex peach and caramel flavors at your leisure. Of course, however you prepare it, this Coffee will make a prime pairing for a ricotta toast, parfait, or crispy Chocolate Croissant.
081315.name: COFFEE SMALL LOT ETHIOPIAN GUJI

081316.item_story_marketing:
Botanically, apples and watermelons don't have much in common. Apples are typically small, grow on trees, 
and are members of the rose family of flowering plants, while watermelons can get truly gargantuan, grow on 
vines, and are much closer to cucumbers, genetically speaking. What they do have in common, however, is 
that they take to sour flavors spectacularly well. And together, they do so in a conveniently snackable form in 
Trader Joe's Organic Sour Apple Watermelon Fruit Leather Wrap.

They're made for us by the same supplier as our other iconic Organic Fruit Wraps; you may be familiar with our Apple Raspberry, Apple Wild Berry, Apple Blueberry, and Apple Strawberry Wraps. These Wraps, however, are the first to go in a splendidly sweet-sour direction, combining  the joyous juiciness of Watermelon with the tantalizingly tart tones of Sour Apple. Perfect for packing along on car rides, enjoying on a hike, or simply snacking on during your morning commute, Trader Joe's Organic Sour Apple Watermelon Fruit Wraps are a great way to add some fun, fruity flavor to your day.

081341.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s is the spot for exquisite flowers at excellent prices. Whether you’re looking to show some love, marking a major milestone, attending a seasonal celebration, or simply treating yourself to something special (as the song goes, you can buy yourself flowers), we have you covered—and with our Easy Bouquet Wraps, we have you wrapped, too! For less than the price of a cup of coffee (coffee of questionable quality, no less), a classy, kraft paper Bouquet Wrap offers an instant upgrade to any bunch of blooms...
 
Available in two comely colorways (tan and tan-on-white), these sleeve-style Wraps come already assembled, complete with a length of raffia to tie everything together. Simply select one of our stunning Seasonal Bouquets, remove it from its existing sleeve, pat stems dry, and insert the Bouquet into the Wrap, then tie the raffia around the base and bask in your Bouquet’s bespoke, fresh-from-the-farm-stand feel!
 
If you fancy yourself a budding florist, you could also pick out 3–4 bunches of TJ’s single-variety stems (we recommend 2–3 floral varieties, plus one of our assorted greens options), arrange as desired, trim stems, and Wrap away! Think of the Easy Bouquet Wrap as your canvas... and our floral section as your prodigious palette. Pro-tip: For a truly dazzling display of floral abundance, build your bouquet by bunching 1–2 stems of each variety together at a time, repeating in sequence until all stems are incorporated.

081384.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s foods come in all the colors of the rainbow. Ensuring the absence of color also makes a showing on our shelves... or rather, in our freezers, we present our limited-edition Trader Joe’s Black Sesame Mochi. 

You may be curious how we could achieve such a darkened hue—or rather non-hue. The answer is ingenious and also really simple: Black Sesame seed paste. Our supplier infuses an ice-cream base of milk, cream, and cane sugar with a paste made from roasted, finely-ground Black Sesame seeds. This paste not only lends a rich gray-black hue, but also brings that characteristic nuttiness with a hint of savory to contrast with the flavor of the frozen sweet-cream. Surrounded by a rice-dough wrapper which has also been given the Black Sesame- seed treatment, the resulting couple-bite-sized frozen treat is intriguingly tasty, and an instant conversation starter during your dinner-party dessert course. No black-tie event on the calendar? These Mochi are also ideal for a sweet anytime snack, ready to enjoy after just 3-4 minutes resting at room temperature.

081415.item_story_marketing:
When it comes to our reusable bags, our customers have made themselves abundantly clear: the smaller the tote, the bigger the sensation! After introducing our original, limited-edition TJ’s Mini Canvas Tote Bags in 2024, we were so pleasantly surprised by their rapturous reception. So much so, in fact, that we decided to give TJ’s Pastel Mini Tote Bags a try this past spring, and, well,  all we can say about that is WOW. (Like, BIG WOW.) Now, just in time for the sweetest ‘n scariest season of all, we give you… Trader Joe’s Trick-or-Treat Mini Canvas Tote Bags! 

Sized at about 13 inches long, 11 inches tall, and 6 inches deep, our Mini Trick-or-Treat Canvas Tote Bags are ideal for candy-collecting adventures, seasonal gifting (bags filled with treats for your boo = boo-bags!), quick grocery runs, or any small haul that needs a sturdy, reusable carrier. Their bold, seasonal colorways—think classic Halloween black, pumpkin orange, ghoulish green, and a pop of purple—make them especially fun for October outings, but they’re just as handy as year-round lunch bags and toting the everyday essentials. If you’re a dedicated TJ’s Mini Tote collector (really, who isn’t?), these Trick-or-Treat Mini Totes are major must-haves. Grab one at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s today, before they vanish into the night!

081417.item_story_marketing:
People apply the phrase “go big, or go home” to all kinds of situations: sports, vacations, purchases...even food. GoMacro® is a family-owned protein bar company in Wisconsin that has “gone big” in our estimation. They’re making yummy bars from sustainably sourced, organic ingredients; using recipes that are as clean and balanced as can be. This “all-in” approach is precisely why we’ve started carrying GoMacro’s® Timeless Treasure Macrobars® in our stores.

Starting with a base of organic almond butter and organic coconut milk, each GoMacro® Timeless Treasure bar is then flavored with caramel-y, organic maple sugar and studded with vegan chocolate chips, along with a sprinkling of sea salt. It’s a nice mix of sweet, savory, and salty that definitely goes big on flavor, but goes even bigger on protein—each 2.3-ounce, 270-calorie bar contains 10g of it, in fact. And we’re talking organically grown, plant-based protein, as this bar is 100% vegan. (It’s also gluten-free, soy-free, certified kosher, certified organic...need we go on?) And since it’s available at Trader Joe’s on an everyday basis, you can trust that one area we didn’t go big with is its price...which means that a lot more GoMacro® Timeless Treasure Macrobars®can go home with you!

081429.item_story_marketing:
Living in the modern era can be complicated. On the one hand, we face questions about technology, ethics, and society that previous generations could never have imagined. On the other hand, modernity does occasionally produce snacks and sweets that previous generations could never have imagined, as well. Take Trader Joe’s Root Beer Float Cookie Pieces, for instance. This marvel of the modern age takes the experience of enjoying a sweet and creamy Root Beer Float, and distills it into a confection-coated sandwich Cookie—complete with popping candy to simulate the feeling of carbonation!

Fun, flavorful, and even a little fizzy, each Root Beer Float Cookie Piece starts with a vanilla sandwich Cookie, filled with popping candy-imbued vanilla crème, which our supplier enrobes in a toothsome, remarkably Root Beer-reminiscent candy coating. They make excellent sweet treats on their own. If you want to get a little postmodern, they also act as a magnificently meta topping when crumbled over a real root beer float.

Agreeing with these accolades, Trader Joe’s aims to bring a life of longevity and a taste of Mount Olympus to our customer’s refrigerators with our Strawberry & Cream and Bananas & Cream Yogurt Cups.

Prepackaged and ready to enjoy, these Strawberry & Cream and Bananas & Cream Yogurt Cups bring a dessert-like quality to any breakfast or packable lunch! Whether you toss one in your children’s lunch pails or dig in with a spoon at home, our yogurt cups are an extravagantly easy way to lose yourself in a very-berry, fruit basket fantasy. Let these single-serving yogurt cups become a base for packing more fruit into your diet or combine with your favorite granola for a nutritious snack!

081482.item_story_marketing:
Made for us in Canada by the supplier behind our seasonally popular Teeny Tiny Apple Pies  and Teeny Tiny Pecan Pies, Trader Joe’s Teeny Tiny Strawberry Rhubarb Pies might be mini in size (around 3” in diameter, to be specific), but they’re mighty in flavor. Each box holds four single-serve Pies... and each single-serve Pie is filled with a bright, punchy blend of Strawberry and Rhubarb, wrapped in a tender, flaky crust, and topped with a crunchy, coarse sugar. They’re satisfyingly sweet, a little tangy, and just the right amount of rustic—like a slice of summer you can hold in one hand.

Warm them up in your oven or air fryer for that fresh-baked taste and aroma, then serve them with teeny tiny scoops (or regular-sized scoops—your call) of TJ’s French Vanilla Ice Cream. Or, if you’re feeling fancy, top them with dollops of homemade strawberry whipped cream instead. (Pro tip: Organic Whipping Cream + Organic Cane Sugar + Freeze Dried Strawberries = bursting-with-flavor strawberry whipped cream!) Whether you’re hosting a brunch, having a picnic, or enjoying a midnight snack, these tiny Pies are ready to deliver. You can find them in the Bakery section, May to September.

081486.item_story_marketing: Brewed from a blend of Central and South American Arabica beans, Trader Joe’s Ready to Use Espresso Coffee is a full-strength, full-flavored Coffee that can be used 1:1, ounce-for-ounce, in any application that calls for Espresso. A quick, homemade café Americano? Of course. A home-mixed Espresso martini? Absolutely. How about an affogato with a scoop of gelato as a quick dessert? You know it! Bold and aromatic, with nice notes of caramel and cacao, it can be enjoyed by the one-ounce shot, simply as-is, and also mixes marvelously with water, milk, or your favorite non-dairy beverage. For best results, we recommend a 4:1 ratio of water to Espresso, or a 3:1 ratio of milk to Espresso.
081486.item_story_qil:
In today's coffee landscape, espresso has become much more than the luxury it was seen as not too long ago-for 
many folks, it's an essential element of their everyday caffeination routine. Despite its near-ubiquity, however, 
one stubborn fact remains: it can be a bit of a hassle to make at home. Unless you have the necessary equipment 
in your kitchen, plus a little extra time on your hands every morning (and who's got that, nowadays?), that can 
mean relying on a coffee shop for your daily shot (or two) of espresso. To that we say, "why not save time and 
money with Trader Joe's Ready to Use Espresso Coffee?" 

Brewed from a blend of Central and South American Arabica beans, this is a full-strength, full-flavored Coffee 
that can be used 1:1, ounce-for-ounce, in any application that calls for Espresso. A quick, homemade café 
Americano? Of course. A home-mixed Espresso martini? Absolutely. How about an affogato with a scoop 
of gelato as a quick dessert? You know it! Bold and aromatic, with nice notes of caramel and cacao, it can be 
enjoyed by the one-ounce shot, simply as-is, and also mixes marvelously with water, milk, or your favorite 
non-dairy beverage. For best results, we recommend a 4:1 ratio of water to Espresso, or a 3:1 ratio of milk to 
Espresso.

Ready to Use
Espresso Coffee

081496.item_story_marketing:
Historically, instant coffee has had a less-than-stellar reputation amongst coffee drinkers—so you can imagine the scrutiny with which Trader Joe’s Single Origin Instant Coffee packets were met when they first appeared at the tasting panel. But with one sip of its toasty, earthy, invigorating flavor (courtesy of 100% Arabica beans grown in Tanzania, at the base of Mt. Kilimanjaro), it was apparent that this elevated Instant Coffee lived up to the exacting standards set by Trader Joe’s coffee offerings, and we couldn’t wait to share it with our customers.

How easy is it to craft a cup of this Instant Coffee? Add a packet to a mug, stir in eight fluid ounces of hot water, and savor the bold, satisfying sip (or a slightly mellower one, if you’re a creamer connoisseur). In addition to the obvious on-the-go benefits (read: travel-friendly, no grinding, brewing, or cleanup required), the single- serve nature of this Single Origin Coffee is handy for amping up the flavor of brownies or a chocolate cake— simply dissolve a packet into the melted butter or liquid called for in the recipe and you’re in business.

Instant coffees of this caliber are quite difficult to find in the market; when you can find them, they have a difficult-to-stomach price tag to match. True to our reputation, however, we offer kosher-certified boxes of 10 Trader Joe’s Single Origin Kilimanjaro Instant Coffee packets for a price that won’t grind your budget. Wake up and smell the value!

081498.item_story_marketing:
The next time you’re looking for a plussed-up protein to give your next entrée a little something extra, we’ve got a tip for you—actually, scratch that, we have several Tips for you. Trader Joe’s Premium Angus Beef Tenderloin Steak Tips, to be precise! Made with toothsome-textured, flavorful cuts of Beef Tenderloin, these one-or-two-bite-sized Steak Tips make an auspicious center-of-the-plate option, no matter how you choose to prepare them.

In general, Beef Tenderloin contains fewer connective tissues and collagen than other cuts of meat, giving it its namesake tender, melt-in-your-mouth texture. And because these Tenderloin Steak Tips happen to be made from Premium Angus Beef, they have a nice marbling of fat that results in fuller, richer flavor on the palate. We like to use them in a stir-fry, where a light sear in the wok will help them retain their tenderness, which will in turn interplay with crisp, quickly-cooked veggies. That said, they also do well when skewered, seasoned, and grilled for kebabs, add a bold beefiness to a Stroganoff, and sing when simply sautéed in garlic butter and served with roasted potatoes.
081498.item_title: Premium Angus Beef Tenderloin Steak Tips
081498.name: BEEF PREMIUM ANGUS TENDERLOIN STEAK TIPS

081522.item_story_marketing:
If you’re a regular in our coffee & tea section, you’re likely familiar with our rotating roster of limited-edition Small Lot coffees—carefully sourced, single-origin offerings that tend to be available only in small quantities, and only for a short time. Trader Joe’s Costa Rica Medium Roast Whole Bean Coffee captures the spirit of our Small Lot releases—high quality, single-origin craftsmanship—and thanks to our longstanding relationships with some truly exceptional growers, we’ve been able to secure sufficient quantities to be able to offer it on our shelves every day.

Grown for us at high altitudes, these 100% Arabica beans deliver a balanced brew with nuance and character. Costa Rica’s temperate tropical climate and rich, volcanic soil promote slow and steady growth, allowing the coffee cherries time to develop rich, complex flavors. Once harvested, the beans are given a Medium Roast, which enhances their inherent sweetness and brings out delicately nutty notes. Whether served black or taken with a splash of TJ’s Organic Sweet Cream Creamer, each sip of TJ’s Costa Rica Medium Roast Coffee delivers a creamy body with approachable, rounded acidity—an uplifting cup, indeed.

081523.item_story_marketing:
Classic snickerdoodle cookies have a distinctive recipe, which includes the usual cookie-baking suspects (flour, sugar, egg, etc.), but typically substitutes margarine for butter and incorporates extra leavening to create a soft, subtly texturized top. A more obvious distinction is how warm snickerdoodles have been rolled in a mixture of cinnamon and white sugar to create their unmistakable look and flavor. So good! While we were dreaming of snickerdoodles—and simultaneously of summer—we saw fit to take a page out of the old snickerdoodle cookie book and bake our own summer-worthy version we call Trader Joe’s Strawberry Doodle Cookies.

Our Strawberry Doodles have many of those same distinctive recipe components that make snickerdoodles so special, including margarine and extra leavening. Our supplier expertly bakes them just enough to achieve firm edges, but still remain gloriously soft & chewy in the middle. The difference here is that instead of rolling the warm Cookies in sugar and cinnamon, these are rolled in a mixture of sugar and Strawberry powder made from crushed, freeze-dried strawberries. So, so good!

We also departed from the classic snickerdoodle recipe in another way: by adding fruity bits made from Strawberry and apple purées throughout, giving these Cookies even more texture and more summery vibe. Speaking of summery vibes, we recommend sandwiching a hearty scoop of Trader Joe’s Super Premium Vanilla Ice Cream [sku 45883] between two Strawberry Doodle Cookies for a sweet, strawberry-y treat that pairs well with sunglasses and a swimming pool. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Strawberry Doodle Cookies in our bakery section, late May through early September.

081527.item_story_marketing:
If the rise in popularity of hot honey has taught us anything, it’s that sweet and heat are truly meant to be together. Why? Because like any good complementary combo, sugar and spice simply bring out the best in one another. Take their co-starring turn in Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Popcorn, for instance. Set against the backdrop of a light, airy, and wonderfully buttery kernel of Popcorn, the sweetness of Honey powder brings the heat of Hot cayenne pepper into focus, while at the same, the spicy notes round out the sweetness, so that neither element overpowers the other. Talk about teamwork!

Savory, salty, sweet, and spicy, all at once, Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Popcorn eats a bit like kettle corn with a capsaicin-loaded twist. We find that it’s ideal for all sorts of snacking situations, and especially excels when employed as a movie snack. We recommend pouring some into a bowl and mixing it with even more sweet and spicy treats, like our Bite-Sized Candy Coated Milk Chocolate Candies or Thai Lime & Chili Cashews. And if you really want to double down on the heat-sweet synthesis, you can always mix in some of our Sweet & Spicy Pecans.

081528.item_story_marketing:
With an already impressive roster of coffee creamers in our dairy case (Oat Brown Sugar Creamer, Coconut & Almond Vanilla Creamer, et. al), you might think we would just sit back, rest on our laurels, and phone it in. No way. Instead, our intrepid product developers have decided to foam it in, with the exciting introduction of Trader Joe’s Cold Foam Vanilla Flavored Creamer!

This whipped cream-style can dispenses Grade A, kosher Cold Foam made with a combination of pasteurized skim milk and pasteurized cream that’s sweetened with cane sugar and imbued with natural Vanilla flavor. Lighter and airier than whipped cream, it’s not unlike a celebratory crown for your favorite TJ’s Cold Brew or Tropical Dragonfruit Cooler. Chill the can in your fridge, and when you’re ready, shake it well, turn it upside down, and press the nozzle to dispense to your heart’s content.

081539.item_story_marketing:
Has any other beverage made as successful a claim over an entire meal as the mimosa has for brunch? In some circles, brunch isn’t even brunch without a bit of bubbly and OJ involved. And being big brunch boosters ourselves, we wanted to make sure that everyone’s bases were covered, which is why we’ve introduced Trader Joe’s Orange Mimosa to our wine shelves. This sparkly, citrus-y, and satisfyingly sweet wine cocktail is pre-mixed and ready-to-serve. Simply chill the bottle, give it a few gentle turns upside down and right side up again (rather than shaking) before serving, and bingo: brunch is now, properly, brunch.

Bright, juicy, and easy-drinking, our Orange Mimosa is ideal for sipping during a slow, sun-soaked weekend, pouring at a pool party, or cheers-ing with your chums—any time. Our tasting panel likened it to brunch-in-a-bottle, carrying the spirit of an easy-breezy gathering with friends.
081539.item_story_qil:
Trader Joe's Orange Mimosa is uniquely blended for our customers, combining a lively, crisp 
white wine blend with fresh orange juice and a pleasant effervescence. While the focus is on offering a 
"classic" mimosa, we intentionally aimed for a more natural taste profile, with the result being a lower 
sugar level than versions of this type of product sold elsewhere. As indicated on the packaging, it's 
important to gently rotate the bottle to mix the sediment that will naturally occur.  

Rise and shine, brunch lovers! No mixers, no fuss-just pure citrusy bliss in a bottle. Whether 
you're hosting friends, toasting to the good times, or treating yourself to a well-deserved me moment, this 
refreshingly crisp sipper is here to elevate the occasion. With an 8% ABV, this is a great low-alcohol 
option to enjoy, if imbibing earlier in the day. Sure, it's a brunch superstar-think fluffy pancakes, buttery 
croissants, or creamy avocado toast-but who says Mimosas are just for mornings? Pair it with light 
salads, seafood dishes, or any celebration-worthy spread. Whatever the hour, it's a reason to raise a glass!   

Chill it, gently turn to mix, pop it open, and serve. As brunch and mimosas should not be limited to 
a season, this will be available year-round in the wine section!
081539.name: TRADER JOES ORANGE MIMOSA

081545.item_story_marketing:
Dubai-style chocolate is all the rage across social media these days, and for good reason—it’s delicious. Really, what’s not to love about a chocolate bar filled with sweet pistachio cream and crunchy kataifi? (For those unfamiliar: kataifi = vermicelli-like pastry “noodles,” made from finely shredded phyllo dough, often used in Middle Eastern & Mediterranean desserts.) There is so much to love about such a bar, which is precisely why we searched high and low for a version of this viral hit worthy of a spot on our shelves! Fortunately for all, we found it in Patislove® Dubai Style Pistachio Dark Chocolate.

While the original Dubai chocolate bar was crafted in—you guessed it—Dubai, most commercially available versions, including this one, are made in Turkey. To create their Dubai Style bar, Patislove® pours rich Dark Chocolate into a deeply grooved mold (to allow for easier portioning of the finished bar), allows it to cool, then stuffs it with an impressively flavorful Pistachio cream & kataifi filling. Pistachios make up 50% of the filling’s recipe, which is more than you’ll find in most Dubai-style bars, and the filling accounts for an entire third of the bar! This rich, textural treat is a must-try for chocolate lovers and trend-chasers alike—and it’s available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s now through July.
081545.item_title: Patislove® Pistachio Dark Chocolate Dubai Style
081545.name: DUBAI STYLE PISTACHIO CHOCOLATE BAR

Sheets of incredibly thin, cross-hatched, wheat-flour Wafers are spread with a light layer of Lemon-Flavored crème, and stacked, four high, then cut into cute, bite-sized cubes. Each Cookie delivers bracing citrus matched with sweet cream, all couched in a delicate, airy crunch. 

Pair them with Lemon Tiramisu on a plate for twice the sweet-tart splendor. Enjoy some with your afternoon chat companion, alongside a mug of freshly brewed matcha. Dunk them in a tub of Raspberry Skyr and savor the fruity, smooth-crunchy contrasts in every bite.

081576.item_story_marketing: Almond flavor and sparkling, this wine brings aromas of rich almonds, a hint of caramel apple, and subtle, toasty notes. The fine bubbles enhance the balanced blend of sweet and tart, with fruity and nutty flavors coming together perfectly. It’s a delightful choice that makes any occasion feel like a celebration.
081576.item_story_qil:
The search is over. After months of finding the right 
partner, panel tastings, label design (Sonny Deguzman, 
you can see him reflected in the bottle picture) and such, 
the much-requested Almond Sparkler is available. 
 
By using chardonnay as the base grape, we strove to

The wine is made using the Charmat process, where 
fermentation occurs in a pressurized tanks instead of in the

Almond extract is used for flavoring.

081613.item_story_marketing:
When dinner’s on the horizon and time’s in short supply, we find it’s always a relief to have a few packs of our fresh ravioli waiting in the fridge. And with such a wide variety among the ravioli available at Trader Joe’s, there’s always a flavor profile to fit whatever the mood might be. For example, on nights when you’re into understated elegance, our aromatic Porcini Mushroom & Truffle Triangoli are just the ticket. When you’re feeling a bit more whimsical and cheesy, our punchy Cacio E Pepe Ravioli are ideal. And when you’re feeling a little sweet, a little tart, and chock full of umami, Trader Joe’s Goat Cheese & Caramelized Onion Ravioli are the way to go. And for less than five bucks per package, and less than five minutes of cooking time!

Crafted for us by an expert pasta-maker in Italy, this rich and tasty Ravioli is made with extra thin sheets of pasta, stuffed with a mixture of tart and tangy Goat Cheese and sweet, full-flavored Caramelized Onions. When cooked al dente, the thinness of the pasta creates a delightfully delicate texture on the tongue, which communicates the flavor of the filling in a truly wonderful way. While you’re certainly welcome to serve this Ravioli in your favorite pasta sauce, we find it does just fine on its own, lightly tossed with a little extra virgin olive oil.

081671.item_story_marketing:
Cold foam is the hottest trend among the coffee crowd, and if you’ve had the chance to try it, you’ll know exactly why: cool, fluffy, and rich, adding a layer of cold foam to a glass of cold brew elevates even the most quotidian of caffeine breaks. If you haven’t had the chance to try it, you’re in luck, because Trader Joe’s Salted Maple Cold Foam Creamer is a great way to start! Available in our stores exclusively for the autumn season, this convenient Creamer couples the textural excellence of Cold Foam with the sweet and savory notes of Salted Maple to turn any iced coffee into a celebration of fall flavors.

Each canister comes equipped with a nozzle for easy application: just shake the can, remove the cap, and turn the whole can upside down, then gently press the nozzle, as you would a can of whipped cream. In an instant, you’ll have a homemade drink that would make any barista boast. It’s ideal for crafting all kinds of autumnal drinks (have we mentioned it also goes great with Earl Grey or matcha?).

081672.item_story_marketing:
Every year come fall, a selection of seasonal Joe-Joe’s Sandwich Cookies for humans starts to appear in our stores (see TJ’s Halloween Joe-Joe’s et. al). And every year come fall, we can only assume that dogs across the country wonder, “Where are our special sandwich cookies, Trader Joe’s?” Well, it’s finally Fido’s turn... introducing Trader Joe’s Maple and Sweet Potato Flavored Sandwich Cookies for Dogs! 

The construction of these canine Cookies mimics that of TJ’s Pumpkin Joe-Joe’s for humans—picture an orange-hued cream filling sandwiched between two crunchy, decidedly non-chocolate cookies. Our Sandwich Cookies for Dogs, however, are flavored with real maple syrup, sweet potatoes, and natural Maple and Sweet Potato flavor—stuff doggies really dig. Use them as special rewards after leaf-pile pounces, or to bribe your pup into posing for that pumpkin patch pic you’ve been planning. However you decide to dole them out, these Cookies are fetch-worthy fall treats your pup will never fur-get, at a price that won’t go too ruff on your wallet.

081676.item_story_marketing:
Gently fermented to develop its characteristic tang, chewy crust, and light, open crumb, Trader Joe's Sliced Apple Cinnamon Sourdough Bread boasts tender diced Apple and warm notes of Cinnamon and brown sugar throughout. Sweet and Cinnamon-forward, with a savory Sourdough edge that makes it a multipurpose carb of the coziest kind. Enjoy it as-is, right out of the bag, or toast and slather it with butter for a quick breakfast or snack. You might even use it as the base of an intriguing—and tasty—grilled cheese sandwich with Red Leicester, caramelized onions, and thinly sliced apple. 

It’d cost you quite a bit of dough to snag a similar loaf at a specialty bakery, but you’ll save some bread if you pick up Apple Cinnamon Sourdough from your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.
081676.item_story_qil:
An anytime taste of fall baked into a single slice of bread. A flour-filled fantasy? Well, dream no more! We've 
cracked the code and harnessed this whimsy into reality, in the form of a sweet (but not too sweet), moist 
cinnamon-forward loaf: Trader Joe's Sliced Apple Cinnamon Sourdough Bread! Once an autumn-exclusive, 
seasonal sensation, our Apple Cinnamon Sourdough Bread is now available every day!

Using an exclusive formulation and process, our expert bakers utilize a long and gentle fermentation process 
to maximize texture and flavor. Following this thoughtful starter step, the dough is folded with diced apples, 
brown sugar, and cinnamon. The result is a Bread with a characteristic sourdough tang, chewy crust, and light 
open crumb that's swirled with rich brown sugar, pungent cinnamon, and tender apple pieces.

Toast and slather with salted butter as part of a breakfast sweet treat or snack. It also makes a phenomenal 
bread pudding when layered and tossed in a mix of milk, beaten eggs, butter, and baked, then topped with 
Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce [sku 95214]. And if you're really feeling adventurous, try it in a savory but unique 
grilled cheese sandwich with our Unexpected Cheddar Cheese [sku 96923]. 

Sliced Apple Cinnamon
Sourdough Bread

081679.item_story_marketing:
The Belgian supplier for our Trader Joe’s Pumpkin & Spice Brioche Style Liège Waffles follows authentic Liège tradition by adding egg to the dough, which produces a dense, brioche-like flavor. For this seasonal version, they’ve also added Pumpkin purée and seasonal Spices, including cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg. In addition to the warm, autumnal flavors, Pumpkin & Spice Liège Waffles are winsome for their smaller (than breakfast-style waffles) size, their roundish shape, and their uneven edges. The charm of these imperfections is further enhanced by a sprinkling of coarse Pearl Sugar, which provides an unexpected and delicate crunch.

Trader Joe’s Pumpkin & Spice Brioche Style Liège Waffles are wonderful right out of the package, and since they’re individually wrapped, you can easily stash them in your purse or backpack for later. Or gently warm them and serve with a sprinkle of Organic Powdered Sugar, or a scoop of Trader Joe’s Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream for your dinner-party dessert. You’ll find them on our bakery shelves for a limited time, September through October.

081698.item_story_marketing:
We love apple pie any time of year, but it really is extra special in the autumn, isn’t it? Maybe it’s the soft bite of the cooked apple contrasting with the crisp fall air. Maybe it’s the sweet, cinnamon spice that feels inherently cozy. Whatever the reason, we can’t get enough of it, which is precisely why we’ve brought Trader Joe’s Apple Pie Spread to our shelves. 

Made for us by the same celebrated supplier behind our winter-seasonal Cinnamon Bun Spread, Trader Joe’s Apple Pie Spread is crafted from a base that includes chopped apples, brown sugar, and butter, along with cinnamon and sea salt. When spread over an English muffin, waffle, or piece of toast—we especially dig it on a toasted slice Pumpkin Loaf—it immediately evokes the feeling of sweet Apple Pie filling with every full-flavored bite. And for fun, seasonal sipping, it’s also great for mixing into cocktails, mocktails, and coffee drinks.

081710.item_story_marketing:
Packaged in a beautifully bespoke box, Trader Joe’s Italian Tomato Pasta Sauce Trio will delight even the most discerning foodies on your list. This handpicked selection of Sauces comes to us from Puglia, Italy, from a supplier who not only specializes in sauces, but also grows the very tomatoes that form their tasty base! With varieties including Roasted Vegetable, Cherry Tomato, and Puttanesca, each jar offers a true taste of Italy, bursting with bold tomato flavor in every spoonful.
 
The first Tomato Sauce features chunks of Roasted Vegetables (namely, zucchini, eggplant, and bell peppers), a blend that imbues it with mild, well-rounded flavor. The second is made with Datterini Cherry Tomatoes (also known as “Baby Romas”), resulting in a Sauce with a sweeter and more intense Tomato flavor, its brightness further enhanced with fresh garlic and basil. Lastly, the Puttanesca follows a classic Tomato Sauce recipe that includes chopped Kalamata and Chalkidi olives, capers, and anchovies, resulting in an unctuous, supremely savory experience. 
 
Each jar provides a generous 2-3 servings, enough to coat about half a pound of pasta.

081723.item_story_marketing:
The subtly sweet, slightly buttery flavor of raw almonds is delicious. Almonds are also a great vehicle for carrying other flavors—especially when those flavors build upon the natural almond profile. Trader Joe’s Maple Brown Butter Flavored Almonds are a big win, in part because they do just that!

Our supplier begins with California Almonds, sprinkles them with sea salt and expertly roasts them, then enrobes them in a Maple Brown Butter-Flavored coating that builds upon the naturally sweet Almond notes and enhances the nut’s buttery qualities with toasty caramelized flavor. Once enrobed, the Almonds are dusted with Maple-cocoa-powder, resulting in candied nuts with a rich, almost toffee-like taste, and impressive Maple notes. It’s been said they kind of taste like a pancake breakfast. You just might need to see for yourself!

Maple Brown Butter Flavored Almonds are ideal for snacking when you want something sweet & crunchy. You can also use them to decorate the top of your TJ’s Pumpkin Mini Sheet Cake, or to add a crunchy, nutty, Maple-y element to your Honeycrisp Apple Granola. We’re selling eight-ounce, re-sealable bags of kosher Trader Joe’s Maple Brown Butter Flavored Almonds for a limited time, September through December.

081727.item_story_marketing:
Sublime’s got a sister! That’s right, our Sublime Ice Cream Sandwiches [sku 90987]—consistently ranked by customers among their absolute favorite Trader Joe’s products—will now be sharing their freezer space with a sibling—one that we believe is also destined for TJ’s product glory!

Similar to Sublimes, Trader Joe’s Cookies ‘N Cream Ice Cream Sandwiches consist of two Cookies sandwiching Ice Cream. But instead of chocolate chip cookies, we used two, double-Chocolate Cookies flavored with rich cocoa powder and loaded with decadent Chocolate Chunks. Between these two Cookies is a generous scoop of ice cream that’s blended with a subtantial amount of chocolate Cookie crumbs.

The Sandwiches have a soft bite straight out of the freezer (like their sibling), and the creamy filling is a wonderful contrast to the chewy, Chocolate-Chunk laden Cookies. In a word, we might call this frozen treat “sublime”—but that just might be confusing!

What’s not confusing is where you can find Trader Joe’s Cookies ‘N Cream Ice Cream Sandwiches: in our freezers, every day, along with all our other awesome TJ’s ice-cream offerings.

081730.item_story_marketing:
Sometimes—like after a savory meal or in the middle of the afternoon—you just need a bite of chocolate to bring things back into sweet balance. If you’re going to just have a bite, we really think it should be chocolate of the highest quality. And since we’re spit-balling here, wouldn’t it be nice if it was also filled with a sweet surprise? Well... surprise! We’re actually not spit-balling, Trader Joe’s Filled Belgian Chocolate Bites are real and already here to meet your between-meal cravings in the most satisfying fashion.

The eye-catching, hot-pink-hued box has a window, through which you can spy an assortment of about twenty individually wrapped trapezoidal truffles with four distinct profiles. There’s White Chocolate with Hazelnut Praline and Crispy Rice Filling; Milk Chocolate with Almond Praline Filling; Dark Chocolate with Caramel Toffee Filling; and Dark Chocolate with Raspberry Filling. The filling-to-shell ratio is generous, so there’s plenty of interplay between the rich Belgian Chocolate and the nutty, caramelly, or fruity Fillings. In fact, the variety of flavors and textures—from bright & bittersweet, to rich & creamy—means these Bites might go from just being a treat in-between meals, to becoming the sweet star of your food day!

081732.item_story_marketing:
At Trader Joe’s, we don’t take ourselves too seriously, but we take the work we do very seriously. When it came time to create what is now Trader Joe’s Strawberry Ice Cream, our product developer spent months tinkering with the recipe to ensure it delivered the ideal balance of creamy, velvety goodness and bright, fruit-forward personality of Strawberry season. The Ice Cream’s cheerful pink color comes courtesy of fruit & vegetable juices (unlike others found elsewhere colored with artificial ingredients), and is made with milk from cows not treated with rBST. What more could one want in a cone (or bowl, or cup)? 

The Super Premium designation on this Ice Cream is a particular point of pride—to achieve it, an ice cream must have less than 50% overrun. Overrun refers to the amount of air whipped into the ice cream during the churning process – lower overrun equals richer, denser ice cream. We can’t reveal the exact percentage of overrun in this pint, but we can guarantee it’s significantly less than 50%! Since the proof is truly in the eating, pick up a pint of Strawberry Ice Cream at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s and taste for yourself!

churning process - lower overrun equals richer, denser ice cream. We can't reveal the exact percentage of 
overrun in this pint, but we can guarantee it's significantly less than 50%! Since the proof is truly in the eating, 
pick up a pint of Strawberry Ice Cream at your neighborhood Trader Joe's and taste for yourself! You'll find 
this serious value for Super Premium Ice Cream in our freezers. 

Super Premium
Strawberry Ice Cream

081741.item_story_marketing:
Hailing from the Yirgacheffe region of Ethiopia, Trader Joe’s Organic Fair Trade Shade Grown Ethiopian Coffee is a medium dark roast blend straight out of this birthplace of coffee. It is within the forests of the Kaffa region that arabica coffee was first found growing wild.

This coffee has got it all - it’s USDA organic, shade grown, and fair trade certified which supports fair sale prices given to farmers for the 100% arabica green beans they grow so well. And grown under a canopy of trees, our Organic Fair Trade Shade Grown Ethiopian Coffee is grown nestling itself amongst a diverse habitat in its natural setting as opposed to many modern, sun-tolerant coffee plants that are grown in direct sunlight. All of this comes together in harmony to receive its medium dark roasting to give a rich tasting, medium bodied coffee that takes on a slightly acidic tartness and floral aroma.

081754.item_story_marketing:
Originating in west Brittany, France in the 1860s, the kouign amann (pronounced QUEEN ah-MAHN, from the Breton “kouign” for “cake,” and “amann” for “butter”) has become quite popular among pastry appreciators over the past decade, and is considered by many a home-baker to be the crown jewel of their repertoire. Resembling something like a miniature, folded-up croissant cake, kouign amann are made with luxurious layers of carefully laminated dough, which are slowly baked and steamed to create a captivating, caramelized sugar flavor and phenomenally flaky texture. 

While wonderfully delicious, it perhaps goes without saying that they can be rather challenging to make at home, such that freshly-baked kouign amann can be difficult to come by. Until today, that is. Because Trader Joe’s Kouign Amann makes savoring a toasty, buttery Kouign Amann with your morning coffee as simple as proof overnight, bake, and enjoy! And since each 11.2-ounce box comes with four Kouign Amann, doing so will cost you about the same as what you might pay for a single pastry at a bakery or café. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Kouign Amann among our other frozen pastry options, through the end of the holiday season.

081757.item_story_marketing:
Is it possible for a big holiday meal to succeed without at least a few great side dishes? Perhaps—in that kind of squishy way that, theoretically, anything is possible. But why take the risk, especially when there are so many superb heat-and-eat sides available at Trader Joe’s? Take Trader Joe’s Creamy Corn, for instance. This newcomer to our freezers is made with crisp kernels of sweet Corn, which our supplier in Italy smothers in a fantastically rich and Creamy sauce made with milk, cream, butter, Cheddar cheese, and shallots.

It cooks quickly and easily from frozen, in your oven, microwave, or stovetop, after which it becomes dreamily steamy—not to mention Creamy—and ready to be served alongside a plate of roast turkey, a hearty baked potato, or really any entrée that could do with a complementary savory side. And like any great side dish, we find it makes an excellent ingredient in a leftover turkey bowl, the day after. Now through the end of the holiday season, you’ll find 14-ounce bags of Trader Joe’s Creamy Corn in our freezers.

081761.item_story_marketing:
There’s really nothing else in the world quite like vanilla. Headily aromatic, distinctly floral, and fascinatingly complex, vanilla is as unique as it is ubiquitous within the culinary canon of desserts. And among vanillas, Bourbon vanillas (so named for Bourbon Island, as the island of Réunion in the Indian Ocean was formerly known) are particularly prized for their full, rich flavor. And that’s precisely what you’ll find in each bottle of Trader Joe’s Vanilla Sugar. Made with a mix of ground Bourbon Vanilla pods from Madagascar and cane Sugar from the island of Mauritius, this all-in-one sweet sprinkle is a great way to add that one-of-a-kind Vanilla essence to sweets, pastries, and breakfast treats of all sorts.

Trader Joe’s Vanilla Sugar is available in our grocery aisle only during the fall and winter months, and we heartily recommend trying a bit on everything from buttered toast to Belgian Waffles, matcha lattes to milkshakes, and coffee drinks to cocktails and mocktails. It’s excellent on oatmeal, fantastic over fresh fruit, and incredible when used to lightly dust a bowl of ice cream. And when it’s time to decorate holiday cookies, we find that its rich brown hue (courtesy of its 15% ground vanilla pod content, by weight) makes it an apt aesthetic choice, too.

081772.item_story_marketing:
Want food on the table fast, without sacrificing flavor—or your budget? The freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s are always at the ready with meal building blocks to help you do just that. Case in point: Trader Joe’s Verdant Veggie Variety. 

Made for us by a Belgian supplier focused on flavorful Veggie varieties that pop on a plate and the palate, this Variety gets its Verdant influence from the likes of peas, kohlrabi, green beans, yellow beans, sugar snap peas, and yellow carrots. The tender-crisp blend is simply seasoned with salt, aromatics (including onion, garlic, fennel, and turmeric), plus a bit of lemon peel for verve, making it a savory, versatile side for just about any center-of-the-plate protein you have in mind—BBQ Cut Fresh Atlantic Salmon Fillets, perhaps? It’s also an amiable anchor to a warm pasta salad with your favorite protein and plenty of Parmigiano Reggiano. What’s more, our price on this pound of pre-seasoned, quick-cooking Veggies means you can get dinner on the table at a fraction of the cost of takeout. You’ll find them in our freezers, every day.

081774.item_story_marketing:
If Trader Joe’s had a made-for-TV holiday movie, we imagine an autumn romance heating up as the temperatures cool down, with some of our fall-inspired microwavable meals enjoyed by candlelight. The tension would grow as thick as creamy pasta sauce, until they finally confess their love: “You had me at Butternut Squash...”  

Trader Joe’s Butternut Squash Risotto is imported from Italy and begins with Carnaroli rice sautéed with diced Butternut, onion, and white wine, then cooked to an al dente texture in puréed Butternut Squash, and finished with grated cheese and savory herbs. It's microwavable and ready to enjoy in just a matter of minutes. Serve as a side with baked Wild Sockeye Salmon and a simple Cruciferous Crunch salad.
081774.item_story_qil:

cool down, with some of our fall-inspired microwavable meals enjoyed by candlelight. The tension would grow 
as thick as creamy pasta sauce, until they finally confess their love: "You had me at Butternut Squash..." 

Indeed, Trader Joe's Butternut Squash Risotto has the potential to bring couples together, featuring Carnaroli 
rice sautéed with diced Butternut, onion, and white wine-not to mention the herby insinuations of parsley, 
thyme, and rosemary. The rice is cooked to an al dente texture in puréed Butternut Squash, and finished with 
grated cheese, all resulting in a sumptuous and savory dish.

Trader Joe's Butternut Squash Risotto is microwavable and ready to enjoy in just a matter of minutes. Try 
serving it as a side with baked Wild Alaskan Sockeye Salmon [sku 68719] and a simple Cruciferous Crunch [sku 
52105] salad. We're selling 16-ounce packages of Butternut Squash Risotto, September through November. 
Now, we know what you're thinking: "Trader Joe's, you had me at value..."

Butternut Squash Risotto

081779.item_story_marketing:
We love sweet apple gummy candies. We love sour apple gummy candies, too. So, we did what any reasonable grocery store would do, and combined them. Then, after that, we did what any slightly whimsical grocery store would do, and gave those gummies a little extra twist! Indeed, inside every bag of Trader Joe’s Juicy Apple Gummy Candies, you’ll find a mix of sweet red Apple Gummy Candies and sour green Apple Gummy Candies, each filled with a joyously Juicy liquid center, so that every bite starts soft and chewy, and ends with a bonus burst of sweetness.

Made for us by the same French supplier behind many of the other beloved gummies in our candy section, these Juicy Apple Gummy Candies are both tasty and texturally intriguing. We love them as a movie snack, we adore them as a decorative element on cupcakes and other baked treats, and we truly dig them as part of an autumnal dessert display.

081781.item_story_marketing:
A classic sugar cookie is a miraculous thing. No, really, it is. At a glance, a sugar cookie’s ingredients are unremarkable, but when combined in just the right way, they manage to create a finished product that’s far greater than the sum of its parts. And the miracluousness continues in this simple Cookie’s ability to convey a feeling or a season simply by changing its shape or adding designs. 

Trader Joe’s Sugar Cookie Dough Pumpkins are mixed and measured, cut to size and imbued with a fall-focused design – each 10.8 ounce package contains 12 ready-to-bake discs of Sugar Cookie Dough with the unmistakable imprint of an orange Pumpkin in the middle. The real miracle of these Cookies, the one that results in you eating a delicious, warm-from-the-oven treat, happens in your oven. Why is that a miracle? Because that’s all you have to do. Remove just the number of Cookies you want to make, bake them at 350ºF for about 12 minutes, and you are ready to enjoy!
081781.item_story_qil:
Sugar cookie dough is famous for being rolled out thin and cut into recognizable shapes, especially around 
holidays-Valentine's hearts, Easter eggs, Thanksgiving turkeys, Christmas trees... So, you'd expect orange-
gourd based, autumnally oriented cookies to be shaped like Pumpkins, right? In fact, we've taken some creative 
liberties in making Sugar Cookie Dough Pumpkins, and we think the result is some standout, home baked 
sweets.

The Dough is made with expected ingredients (flour, sugar, butter, eggs, vanilla extract...) and has been pre-
mixed and pre-formed into circular, puck-like portions. It's a bonus that you get to skip this pre-work, but 
what really makes this Sugar Cookie Dough amazing is the fact that in the center of each off-white disk is the 
bright-orange silhouette of a Pumpkin-naturally colored with annatto and turmeric.

Place the unbaked Cookie Dough on a parchment-paper lined or lightly greased baking sheet (detailed 
directions are on the package) and bake them in a 350°F conventional oven for 12 to 14 minutes. As these Sugar 
Cookies bake, they stretch and expand-and the Pumpkin image grows with them! You'll find 10.8-ounce 
package of one dozen Trader Joe's Sugar Cookie Dough Pumpkins in our refrigerators, September through 
November.

Sugar Cookie Dough Pumpkins
081781.name: HOL COOKIE PUMPKIN SUGAR

081786.item_story_marketing:
All too often, grabbing a quick breakfast on the go can be a haphazard affair. But just because you’re pressed for time, that doesn’t mean your mornings have to be defined solely by barely-buttered toasts or hastily-mixed shakes. There’s a better way—namely, Trader Joe’s Harvest Vegetable Hash Egg White Bites. This autumnal addition to our every lineup of Egg Bites starts with a base of egg whites, cottage cheese, and asiago, to which our supplier adds a host of cubed, hearty harvest vegetables like sweet potato, onion, celery, and butternut squash, along with savory herbs and seasonings, including rosemary, sage, and white pepper.

After only a minute in the microwave (and another minute to let them cool), our Harvest Vegetable Hash Egg White Bites can easily be eaten while on the move, or savored while sitting with a cup of coffee or tea. They accessorize easily, too, with a spoonful of your favorite hot sauce, salsa, or our very own Crunchy Chili Onion. They also make an excellent breakfast sandwich when placed between two toasty English muffins.

081803.item_story_marketing:
Once again, the fine folks at Hardywood Park have delivered on a deeply flavorful dessert beer inspired by one of our classic candies. This time, the multi-award-winning Virginia brewery set their sights on our Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups, recontextualizing the iconic mix of rich cacao and sweet-savory peanut butter into a super decadent imperial porter. To achieve this feat, they’ve used an ingenious mix of chocolate malt, actual peanut butter, and other natural flavors. We think their Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Porter is nothing short of a triumph.

Big in flavor, big in body, Imperial strength yet superlatively smooth on the palate, Hardywood Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Porter makes a great after-dinner drink with a slice of Yellow Mini Sheet Cake, as well as a slow sipper on a warm evening. We recommend enjoying it chilled, straight out of the can, or poured into a frosty pint glass. We also recommend picking up a four-pack sooner, rather than later—our Hardywood collaboration beers always fly off the shelves.
081803.item_story_qil:
Hardywood Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Porter is rich, decadent and irresistibly smooth, with notes 
of rich dark chocolate and creamy peanut butter in every sip. This Imperial Porter delivers on the style, 
with boldness and extra heft compared to the typical Porter, along with a pleasantly intense flavor 
profile. At 9.2% ABV, the alcohol warmth is present but well-integrated, contributing to its smooth, rich 
finish.

have won award after award, this rich and tasty Imperial Porter is crafted with peanut butter, chocolate

classic Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups [sku 94064], which inspired the beer. 
 
Find this new release and potential new favorite in your local beer section.

Inside each box of Just the Clusters, you’ll find crunchy, granola-like clusters made from whole grains, rolled oats, real maple syrup, and crispy pecans.
