081821.item_story_marketing:
Since its invention sometime in the Middle Ages, brioche has been defined by its delicate, decorative qualities. In fact, thanks to its subtle sweetness and sometimes braided appearance, bakers have often classified it as a pastry rather than an ordinary bread. And that’s just regular brioche—we can only imagine what bakers of centuries past would have thought of chocolate brioche—let alone Trader Joe’s Double Chocolate Brioche. Even we haven’t seen a double chocolate version for sale outside of a café or bakery setting (not in the States, anyway), hence why we leapt at the chance to offer it to our customers!

Made for us in France by a bakery that knows a thing or two—or shall we say, a thing or deux—about brioche, Trader Joe’s Double Chocolate Brioche is everything you love about soft, eggy brioche... plus chocolate. (YES!) Specifically, the batter incorporates a generous amount of cocoa powder, and each loaf is studded with chocolate chips! The result is a loaf that feels just a little more dessert-like, but not overly so. (Its sweetness feels sophisticated, rather than sugar-forward.) Enjoy Double Chocolate Brioche by the slice, toasted and topped with salted butter, or use it to make an especially indulgent chocolate French toast. C’est délicieux!

081837.item_story_marketing:
While salad may be an easy lunch option, that doesn’t mean it can’t be a celebration, too. In fact, we find that certain salads call for a full-on fiesta—especially when they happen to combine the bold flavors of a Mexican cuisine-inspired salad with the plump texture of prefectly cooked shrimp. Need proof? Look no further than Trader Joe’s Fiesta Salad with Shrimp! Each ready-to-eat Salad contains a base of crisp romaine lettuce, seasoned black beans, roasted corn kernels, crunchy tortilla strips, and zesty pico de gallo, along with a hearty portion of shrimp, and a rich and creamy poblano dressing and lime wedge to tie it all together. 

Now, the everyday occasion of getting a grab-and-go meal from your neighborhood Trader Joe’s is practically a party in and of itself! While this Fiesta Salad is especially suited for work or school lunches, we find it’s also ideal for packing along on a picnic, carrying along in a cooler for a long car ride, or simply enjoying at home as an effortless entrée. Just as any good party is tailored to its guests, we highly encouraging adding a little customization into the mix by topping with some sliced avocado, a bit of shredded cheese, or your favorite of our many fine hot sauce and salsa options.

081840.item_story_marketing:
If the prevalence of dishes like loaded baked potatoes and loaded potato skins indicate one thing, it’s that spuds are some of the most structurally sound starches around. Okay, okay, it’s obvious that people love to load up a potato because potatoes are great at supporting other flavors, not just because of their architectural advantages. But there is something to the fact that a potato’s physical composition is hefty enough to hold onto all sorts of other ingredients without being overtaken by them. And it’s something that’s wonderfully evident in every bite of Trader Joe’s Loaded Mashed Potatoes. 

Neatly packaged and ready-to-serve, this 16-ounce tray contains a hearty portion of creamy, marvelously Mashed Potatoes, which our supplier has lovingly Loaded with shreds of sharp Cheddar cheese, tangy sour cream, sliced scallions, and smoky bits of uncured bacon. All together, it creates a phenomenal flavor profile that mixes the maximalist joy of a fully-loaded baked potato with the smooth consistency of Mashed Potatoes. After only a few minutes in the microwave (or a little longer in the conventional oven), it makes a fantastic side dish for practically any entrée, though we find that it’s especially appropriate for serving alongside traditional holiday fare like roast turkey and prime rib—which is convenient, since it’s only available now through the end of the holiday season. That said, until then, it also makes an easy-yet-elevated addition to a weeknight dinner.

081846.item_story_marketing:
Your guests arrive in ten minutes.Your Mexican-style spread, featuring a host of Trader Joe’s products—Chicken Taquitos, Crispy Potato & Poblano Pepper Tacos, Organic Blue Corn Tortilla Chips, and Guacasalsa—is ready to go. All that’s missing is dessert! You had intended on making churros, but somehow, time slipped away. Now, you need a Plan B; something quick, easy, and delicious that also sticks with the Trader Joe’s/Mexican theme... We’ve got you: Trader Joe’s Traditional Caramel Flan to the rescue!

Our Flan is Traditional, indeed, made with just six ingredients. The custard is cooked using a customary water-bath method to yield that classic firm, yet smooth & creamy texture—and that’s without thickeners or starches. Keep the package (two servings each) in your refrigerator until it’s time to enjoy. To serve, gently run a smooth knife blade around the edge of each foil cup, then invert the Flan onto your chosen serving plate. Dessert, done! If you like, you can garnish with a handful of berries or a dollop of Crème Fraîche.

The custard combines with its translucent, golden-colored, caramel topping to deliver an authentic Flan experience in every silky-sweet bite. Next time, make Trader Joe’s Caramel Flan your Flan A!

081851.item_story_marketing:
Though quite similar in appearance and taste, steelhead trout and Atlantic salmon actually belong to two totally different genera of fish. And while they tend to be used interchangeably at the dinner table, there are some key differences that go beyond the taxonomical: steelhead trout tends to be leaner, less oily, and milder in flavor, making it a popular choice for those who like their fish to be less “fishy.” We find that steelhead’s more overall delicate profile makes it an apt candidate for serving smoked, which is precisely why we’ve brought Trader Joe’s Smoked Steelhead Trout to our refrigerators.

It’s brought to us by a sustainable fish supplier in Norway, who smokes this firm, yet silky and tender Steelhead Trout in facilities within just a few miles of their fisheries. They then slice it into a thicker cut—reminiscent of sashimi—to accentuate its toothsome texture and subtle smoky notes on the palate. It can be used in any situation that calls for smoked salmon, and particularly excels in applications that let its gentler flavors shine, like over a slice of avocado toast, atop a leafy green salad, or, of course, a crisp and chewy bagel with Whipped Cream Cheese and Capers.

081860.item_story_marketing:
If imitation is truly the sincerest form of flattery, then Trader Joe’s Surimi might just be the biggest compliment to crab meat—ever. As one of our most consistent customer requests for years, when we set out to find a surimi to add to our refrigerators, we knew it really had to hit the mark. And after trying many different versions, styles, and variations, this Surimi stood far above the rest. It’s made with tender Alaska pollock that’s been mixed with a touch of sugar and pea starch to give it that characteristic crab flavor and texture, and a bit of tomato lycopene to deliver its signature red hue. It all results in a Surimi that’s lightly sweet, a little briny, and delightfully flaky­­—and ready to be used in all sorts of seafood-y recipes, right out of the package.

Originally invented as a cost-effective alternative to crab, surimi has since taken on a culinary identity all its own, and is especially adored in dishes where its firmer texture and milder flavor makes it preferable to crab, for some palates. Whatever your preference, we find that Trader Joe’s Surimi Imitation Crab Meat is an excellent, conveniently pre-cooked protein choice for anything that calls for seafood. Try it on top of a leafy green salad for an easy work lunch, roughly chop it and mix into chowders and gumbos, or, if you want an easy appetizer dip or seafood salad for sandwiches, simply shred it with a fork, mix it with some mayo, Rice Vinegar, chopped veggies and alliums, and a fun and fiery hot sauce, like our Sriracha.

081863.item_story_marketing:
When you’re looking to improve your sandwich game, we find that one sure-fire way is to get right to the heart of the matter (or, should we say, right to the middle of the sandwich) and plus up your protein. And wouldn’t you know it, the deli section of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s is simply stocked full of amazing options! Take Trader Joe’s Sliced Peppered Uncured Salami, for instance. Made without the use of nitrates or nitrites (apart from those that occur naturally in sea salt and celery poweder), this charming bit of charcuterie starts with wonderfully well-marbled, savory-seasoned Uncured pork Salami, which our supplier has encrusted with a layer of bold and lightly spicy cracked black Pepper, then Sliced to an optimal thickness for a totally tender, toothsome bite. 

On the palate, you get notes of aromatic garlic and rich pork, along with a pleasantly Pepper-y heat—in other words, just the thing to turn a same-old-same-old sandwich into something extraordinary. Speaking of extraordinary, this Salami also serves extraordinarily well as part of a cheese plate or charcuterie spread, is a fantastically full-flavored topper to an antipasto salad, and makes a great ingredient for homemade hors d’oeuvres like olive skewers and caprese crostini.

081869.item_story_marketing:
For anyone who’s ever enjoyed our Creamy Spinach & Artichoke Dip as an appetizer, and mused to themselves “I could make a meal out of this,” we have fantastic news: we did make a meal out of it! In fact, we made a super satisfying, easy-to-prep entrée that combines the comfort-food creaminess of a classic spinach-artichoke dip with the textural excellence of al dente orecchiette pasta. And now, Trader Joe’s 3 Cheese Spinach & Artichoke Pasta is available every day in our freezers, to meet all your weeknight dinner or work lunch needs.

Deeply savory and delightfully hearty, this quick-cooking Pasta dish is smothered with a sauce made with Swiss, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheeses, as well as tender Artichoke chunks and Spinach leaves. After just a few minutes in the microwave or conventional oven, it makes a superb single-serving entrée that pairs particularly well with a leafy green salad or a hunk of crusty bread. Of course, if you want to be especially true to its appetizer-y origins, you could always break out a few tortilla chips for scooping, too.

081932.item_story_marketing:
If you’ve had the pleasure of strolling the famous Tulleries garden in Paris, it’s possible you have also had the pleasure of eating a jambon et buerre sandwich—a fresh baguette, slathered with a thick spread of salted butter and piled high with slices of ham. You can also ask for it with cheese or “salade” (i.e. lettuce); however you take it, it’s a handy way to satisfy your hunger as you saunter through the park.

Trader Joe’s Ham & Cheese Sandwich was inspired by this iconic Parisian nosh, though we’ve slightly adapted it to our taste. It starts with a seven-inch, soft & chewy baguette that’s split lengthwise, almost all the way through. One side is spread with a mildly tangy, dijon-style, stone-ground mustard and topped with slices of gruyere Cheese. On top of that, we’ve piled thinly sliced uncured Ham that delivers salty-sweet, meaty pork flavor. Finally, creamy pats of lightly sea-salted butter are pressed into the top half of the bread, providing an authentic finishing touch.

As-is, this simple Sandwich makes an effortless lunch or snack, whether you choose to enjoy it at work, at school, or strolling in your favorite neighborhood park. And it’s easy to customize, with some fresh Wild Arugula or a handful of mixed greens from our Champs Elysées salad mix. Stroll by our refrigerators and you’ll find Trader Joe’s Ham & Cheese Sandwiches ready to grab-n-go, every day!

081936.item_story_marketing:
Who says moisturizing masks are just for faces? Lips need love, too! Lucky for you, in the tradition of our everyday Vanilla Lip Mask, Trader Joe’s Cinnamon Roll Flavored Lip Mask is here—for a limited time only—to perk up your pout with hydration heavy-hitters like shea butter, coconut oil, and vitamin E. The formula is thick and luxurious, yet still somehow silky and lightweight. In other words, it’ll leave your lips feeling soft and supple, not goopy or sticky like an actual cinnamon roll might.

Not only does TJ’s Cinnamon Roll Flavored Lip Mask feel fantastic, it smells and tastes fantastic, too—just like a sweet, fresh-baked Cinnamon Roll. (You can thank monk fruit extract for bringing the lip-smacking sweetness to the literal and proverbial pot here.) You’ll find it on the shelves with our bath and skin care products, for as long as our limited supply lasts.

081937.item_story_marketing:
Perhaps, in the past, you heard about the exciting new “orange wine” trend and thought, “huh, wine with oranges, that could be delicious,” only to learn later that traditional orange wine gets its hue from limited skin contact with white grapes, rather than any citrus. When we finally encountered Tarongino Frizzante, a light and spritzy Spanish wine that’s genuinely flavored with Valencia oranges, our first thought was, “We were right! It is delicious!” Our second thought was “Let’s get this onto our shelves, pronto!”

Made with a base of sparkling wine and zesty Valencia orange juice fermented together, this innovative, effervescent, low-calorie wine is ebulliently bright, dry,  and refreshing, especially when served well-chilled on a sunny afternoon.It pairs well with everything from potato chips, to shrimp cocktail, to Soufflé Cheesecake. It’s also only available during the summer, so be sure to swing by your neighborhood Trader Joe’s wine section to pick up a bottle sooner, rather than later.

081999.item_story_marketing:
New among our holiday offerings is this showstopping cheese prepared in a “truckle”—a little barrel of cheese (how cute is that?!), perfectly portioned for your party spread. Like our English Cheddar with Champagne [sku 82001], Trader Joe’s Coastal Cheddar with Truffles comes to us from an English supplier in Somerset. Their grass-fed herds of cattle produce a cheese with a firm body but smooth, creamy texture and mature character. This butter-yellow Cheddar has sizable pieces of mushroom and black truffle folded right in. Its flavor and aroma are balanced yet bold, with distinct truffle umami.

For a luxurious touch to your holiday dishes—whether it’s to jazz up a mac & cheese, a gourmet potato gratin, or even gussy up a grilled cheese—this funky Cheddar is the key! Pair it on a charcuterie board with our seasonal fave Step Up to the Bar Snack Mix, which also features a Cheddar-y kick. (And may we suggest a full-bodied red wine to enhance those Truffle notes?) This Coastal Cheddar with Truffles, elegantly sealed in black wax and portioned into 5.3 oz truckles, will be available in the cheese case at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, now through the end of December.

082005.item_story_marketing:
A good blue cheese dressing should be at least a little luxurious. It should elevate a simple salad into feeling like something you’d get at a steakhouse. It should give a buffalo wing an additional bit of cool complexity to complement its vinegary heat. But above all, we contend that a blue cheese dressing should be super blue cheese-y! And that’s precisely why we’re bringing in Trader Joe’s Chunky Blue Cheese Dressing & Dip to our refrigerators. Each batch starts with a base of mayonnaise and sour cream, to which our supplier adds savory and aromatic elements like minced onion, garlic powder, and dill weed, along with big Chunks of soft, satisfyingly funky Blue Cheese to ensure a rich, full flavor and plush, creamy consistency. And in true Trader Joe’s fashion, it’s both a little luxurious (at least!) and a tremendous value.

We recommend spoon-drizzling this Dressing over salads of all sorts, be it a bed of Baby Spinach, a bowlful of our Champs Elysées blend, or a hearty Iceberg Lettuce wedge with crumbled bacon. As a Dip, it adds a certain savory something to chicken wings and Spicy Chicken Nuggets, celery sticks and Carrots, as well as pizza slices and Sweet Potato Fries. And if you’re really looking to live luxuriously, try using it to top your next burger, sandwich, or freshly seared steak.

082007.item_story_marketing:
Ah, for the joyful geometry of pasta. From the lovely line segments of Linguine, the oblique angles of Penne, and happy helices of Fusilli, no other food even approaches the Euclidean euphoria that pasta evokes. Among the plentiful shapes of pasta you’ll find at Trader Joe’s, one of our favorites is also among the newest to join our shelves: Trader Joe’s Organic Cavatappi Pasta. Made for us by an expert supplier in Italy, who uses a classic die to ensure a grippy and toothsome exterior texture, these splendid little spirals are a bit like ridged elbow macaroni, extended to just the right length for maximum sauce retention. 

So named for the Italian word for “corkscrew,” Cavatappi makes a consummate complement to a marinara or alfredo, makes a marvelous base for a baked mac and cheese, and produces a primo pasta salad for picnics and potlucks. And since its shape holds onto sauce from three different angles (its spiraling structure, its ridged exterior, and its hollow interior), it’s acutely capable of carrying those flavors to the palate, while also delivering a delectable al dente texture.

082010.item_story_marketing:
If someone says you can’t have authentic tasting deli meats that aren’t made in Italy, we say, “Baloney!” Then we say: “Trader Joe’s Sliced Mortadella.” We work with a lauded domestic producer of high-quality deli meats to make our Mortadella using a traditional blend of pork, pork fat, and spices. The finely ground pork is formed into large, circular sausages, then thinly sliced, gently folded in half, and finally stacked in our package for easy removal. Each piece displays that classic white lardelli and delivers rich pork flavor, accented with hints of black & white pepper and garlic. With Trader Joe’s Mortadella in hand and your neighborhood TJ’s down the street, there’s no need for travel to Bologna for an authentic tasting panino!

Try a generous spread of Pesto Genovese on lightly toasted TJ’s Ciabatta Demi-Baguette layered with Mortadella and Sliced Provolone. Or how about piling Sliced Mortadella and Wild Arugula between two large pieces of warmed TJ’s Roasted Tomato & Parmesan Focaccia Bread that’s been spread with Burrata and drizzled with Sicilian Selezione Olive Oil. Of course, there’s always the option of gently frying strips of our Mortadella before tossing it with al dente TJ’s pasta!

Now, if someone asks where they can find authentic tasting, high-quality Mortadella priced as a true value, we say: “You’ll find it every day in our refrigerators with our sliced deli meats!”

make our Mortadella using a traditional blend of pork, pork fat, and spices. The finely ground pork is formed 
into large, circular sausages, then thinly sliced, gently folded in half, and finally stacked in our package for easy 
removal. Each piece displays that classic white lardelli and delivers rich pork flavor, accented with hints of black 
& white pepper and garlic. With Trader Joe's Mortadella in hand and your neighborhood TJ's down the street, 
there's no need for travel to Bologna for an authentic tasting panino!

Try a generous spread of Pesto Genovese [sku 15759] on lightly toasted TJ's Ciabatta Demi-Baguette [sku 96399] 
layered with Mortadella and Sliced Provolone [sku 79681]. Or how about piling Sliced Mortadella and Wild 
Arugula [sku 92686] between two large pieces of warmed TJ's Roasted Tomato & Parmesan Focaccia Bread [sku 
64435] that's been spread with Burrata [sku 98671] and drizzled with Sicilian Selezione Olive Oil [sku 78296]. 
Of course, there's always the option of gently frying strips of our Mortadella before tossing it with al dente TJ's 
pasta!

Now, if someone asks where they can find authentic tasting, high-quality Mortadella priced as a true value, we 
say: "You'll find it every day in our refrigerators with our sliced deli meats!"

Sliced Mortadella

082025.item_story_marketing:
Sometimes, we like a sweet, fruit-based snack to focus on a single flavor. Sometimes, we like a sweet, fruit-based snack to feature a particularly delicious pairing of flavors. And in the case of this new candy creation, we’ve opted to...do both! That’s right, Strawberry co-stars with itself in Trader Joe’s Freeze Dried Strawberry Pieces Covered in Strawberry Yogurt Candy Coating! Our supplier Freeze Dries bits of juicy Strawberry until they’re crispy, crunchy, and super concentrated in flavor. They then smother the berries in a smooth and creamy Strawberry Yogurt Candy Coating, so that every bite is teeming with the tart, sweet, and bright sensations of Strawberry in two distinct, yet equally delicious, styles.

Enjoy these Strawberry Yogurt Covered Freeze Dried Strawberry Pieces as you would any fun and fruity candy: we find that they’re especially suited for munching on as a movie snack, alongside a bowl of Movie Theater Popcorn, for instance. Their small stature and strong Strawberry flavor also make them a great candidate for sprinkling over a bowl of ice cream, or using as a decoration for baked treats. And of course, we’d be remiss if we didn’t mention how well they serve as a mini-dessert when packed into a school or work lunch.

082031.item_story_marketing:
What do “the concept of vengeance” and “thin, well-dressed noodles with crisp veggies” have in common? Well, to quote an old Klingon proverb, “revenge is a dish best served cold.” Indeed, much like righteous retribution, Trader Joe’s Korean Style Bibim-Guksu takes on a positively refreshing quality when it’s had time to chill. And in the case of our Bibim-Guksu, enjoying it at a lower temp also lets your palate fully engage with the texture of the slender wheat noodles, the crunch of the cabbage, carrots, and tart kimchi, and the spicy-savory notes of the included gochujang dressing.

Inspired by a long-treasured staple of Korean cuisine, this cold noodle salad can be enjoyed totally on its own or topped with a soft-boiled egg. It’s a light, refreshing, and superlatively easy lunch—simply mix all the noodles and veggies with the dressing and enjoy, right out of the container. And it also makes a superb side for all sorts of savory fare: we particularly enjoy it as an accompaniment to a plate of grilled Bool Kogi,  pan-fried Pork Belly, or air-fried Salmon.

082044.item_story_marketing:
Nothing gets us whipped up into a frenzy like a side dish that combines the best aspects of savory and sweet. So, you can imagine how excited we are to introduce Trader Joe’s Vanilla Bean Whipped Sweet Potatoes to our refrigerators. This hearty, heat-and-eat dish starts with a base of Sweet Potatoes and heavy cream, Whipped to a phenomenally fluffy consistency, which our supplier seasons with sea salt and nutmeg, and sweetens with brown sugar and both Vanilla Bean paste and bits of Vanilla Bean seeds. 

When you take it home, it’s just a matter of minutes in the microwave (or slightly longer in the conventional oven) before it’s ready to serve. Salty, sweet, and with a sumptuous, cloud-like texture, we love the depth of flavor it adds to any meal, be it as part of a holiday grazing board or a more mundane weekday dinner. Just be sure to pick up a package before too late, because it’ll only be around ‘til the end of the year.

082054.item_story_marketing:
Miso-marinated black cod was first popularized in the U.S. during the 1990s amid the New York haute cuisine scene, as a slightly modernized take on a traditional Japanese dish called gindara saikyo yaki. In the decades since, it’s become something of a signifier of high end eating—if a restaurant has a good miso cod on the menu, you can trust you’re in good hands, gastronomically speaking. As fans of fine foodstuffs ourselves, we couldn’t let restaurants have all the fun, so we’ve decided to join in by adding Trader Joe’s Wild Alaskan Black Cod Sablefish with a Miso Marinade to our freezers!

Made with wild caught Alaskan Black Cod (also known as Sablefish) that’s been marinated in a mix of Miso, rice wine, and sugar, our Miso Marinated Black Cod cooks quickly and effortlessly in the oven or air fryer, where the sweet Miso will have a chance to caramelize and crisp up beautifully. It makes a fantastic center of the plate protein option, especially when paired with a leafy green salad, or some steamed veggies and white rice. And considering how our retail compares to most restaurants, it’s also an especially economical option.

Humans across the globe have been preparing donuts according to their cultural traditions for centuries, in all manner of shapes and sizes; with its bite-sized construction, the donut hole is an especially popular iteration. As our product developer was drumming up ideas to fulfill the tradition of bringing in the best pumpkin- inspired products the season has to offer, they thought, “Why not bring in a fall-i-fied version of this famed treat to our bakery shelves, in the form of Trader Joe’s Glazed Pumpkin Pie Spice Donut Holes?” And so, we did!

Like their Glazed Chocolate Donut Hole counterparts, these Pumpkin Donut Holes are dairy-free and gluten-free (thanks to a blend of tapioca starch, rice flour, and corn starch). This unique flour blend, along with pumpkin puree, gives these Donuts a tender, moist, and cakey texture. What really sets them apart are the warming spices—such as allspice, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, and nutmeg—that flavor these bites, delivering a true autumnal punch!

Each pack contains about 20 Donut Holes—more than enough to feed a hungry crowd at your holiday buffet or impress your colleagues at the next morning meeting. Serve them with a hot mug of Autumn Maple Coffee or Spicy Chai Tea Latte Mix for a cozy fall nibble. These seasonal treats will be available on our bakery shelves for a limited time, while supplies last.

082077.item_story_marketing:
Pico de gallo might just be the ideal condiment. Something about that classic combination of diced tomatoes, onions, and jalapeños, along with refreshing lime juice and cilantro srikes such a balance of savory flavors, alluring aromatics, and delicate heat that it verges on the sublime. So, how does one improve on such perfection? One way we’ve found is by introducing another element of flavor that complements and builds on pico de gallo’s considerable strengths—like, say, fresh tropical fruit. It’s a theory we’ve put into practice with Trader Joe’s Mango Pineapple Pico de Gallo Salsa, a delighfully multidimensional addition to our fresh salsa selections. 

With all the same familiar flavors and tender textures present in a standard salsa fresca, plus the sweet, tropical, and juicy notes of chopped Mango and Pineapple, this piquant Pico increasingly expands upon the palate with each bite. While that quality makes it a great choice for serving with your favorite TJ’s tortilla chips, it also makes it spectacularly suited for serving over seafood. In fact, we heartily recommend our Mango Pineapple Pico de Gallo as a topping for everything from fish tacos and air-fried salmon to baked cod, Panko Breaded Tilapia, and grilled shrimp skewers.

082089.item_story_marketing:
The Brits generally refer to American cookies as “Biscuits.” With that in mind, you might say we’ve technically named our new TJ’s treat: Trader Joe’s Mini Dark Chocolate Cookie Cookies. Perhaps that’s what our supplier in Germany covertly calls them?! We do know for sure that our German cookie supplier has called upon their best Biscuit-making skills to craft these scrumptious and cute Cookies for us. And as far as we can tell, they are the first (and only) version of their kind that are Mini!

Postage-sized, wheat-flour rectangles form a crisp Biscuit-base that’s coated on one side with a layer of rich Dark Chocolate. The result is an eminently snackable Cookie that excels as an afternoon nibble and thrills as a lunchbox treat. Their Mini stature means you can sprinkle them atop your ice cream sundae without any need for crumbling. Imagine a cold, creamy bite of Trader Joe’s Super Premium Vanilla accompanied by a gentle Biscuit crunch and Dark Chocolate contrast. Yummy!

Come visit your neighborhood store and when you do, ask for them by name: Trader Joe’s Mini Dark Chocolate Biscuit Cookies. It’s as blissfully redundant as saying you’ll find six-ounce bags of them on our shelves every single day!

082097.item_story_marketing:
Northwest Collective Pinot Noir Sunshine Mountain Vineyard is sourced from a family owned and operated vineyard, where Sunshine Mountain overlooks Oregon's Columbia Valley. This up-and-coming wine region is exposed to 300 days of sunshine annually and benefits from the rich flood sediment material from the flood that created the valley. We’re excited to add this elegant Pinot Noir, which balances out the Burgundian style found in some Oregon wines with the grape development that’s achieved with more sunshine, as the name of the vineyard implies. In the glass, it presents bright red fruits that are characteristic of classic Pinot Noir, like raspberry and slightly tart cherry, along with a touch of earthiness. Vibrant, with a lively palate that carries through on silky tannins, we’re really impressed with the structure and acidity. This is the kind of wine that pairs really well with a variety of dishes, but also can be so pleasant to enjoy on its own. For that to be true, balance is key. This is only achieved if the winemaker is honing the lower tannins of the grapes into the right harmony with the natural acidity, resulting in a silky mouthfeel that has just enough of a bright finish. This versatile Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with a range of dishes, but will shine the most with poultry, salmon, and roasted or sautéed mushrooms. Also, this will be excellent with duck or any game meat with savory stock-based sauces.

Whether customers are indulging in any of these pairings, or simply wanting to enjoy a glass, this new single vineyard wine is an excellent suggestion for Oregon wine lovers looking for a new favorite or an alternative to higher priced brands in the $20 – 30 range. Cheers to an amazing value in a label that will only be seen on our shelves!

082122.item_story_marketing:
You batter believe it’s time for crepes! Crepes have long been a popular street food in France, and with that cultural catalyst, our snackable treats at Trader Joe’s are getting a majuer upgrade.

Allow us to introduce Trader Joe’s Cocoa Hazelnut Crepes, made for us by a French family bakery here in the States. Their expert bakers follow an authentic recipe using simple, wholesome ingredients. If you were to call this confection a simple “roll-up pancake,” it would be doing it a disservice. These Crepes are made with high- quality wheat flour and crafted to deliver precise thinness and texture, then filled with a smooth cocoa hazelnut creme. They’re individually wrapped for maximum freshness and snacking ability.

Enjoy at room temperature or heat for 6-8 seconds in the microwave for a more fresh-bakery vibe! These Crepes are a great out-the-door breakfast treat, handy in a snack pinch, or as a decadent dessert with a sprinkle of powdered sugar, or a scoop of French Vanilla Ice Cream. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Cocoa Hazelnut Crepes on the shelves in our bakery section, every day.

082148.item_story_marketing:
What’s more comforting than a bowl of pasta and meat sauce? How about a bowl of pasta and meat sauce you didn’t have to cook yourself, that microwaves in mere minutes? This is just what you’ll get with Trader Joe’s Spaghetti with Meat & Sauce, the latest and greatest everyday find in our freezers.

Simple yet satisfying, this rib-sticking dish is comfort food at its finest. Our Canadian supplier makes their own Spaghetti in house using a bronze die (which helps the Sauce cling to the al dente noodles). And that Sauce? Hearty and tangy, it’s brimming with tomatoes and the classic combination of beef and pork to create a rich, savory bite. The Sauce’s meaty, pleasantly garlicky notes are further complemented with a bit of sharp Romano cheese to recreate the quintessential pasta parlor experience.

Each tray of Spaghetti with Meat & Sauce easily serves one (with 27 grams of protein to boot!), for about a third of the cost of takeout. Ideal for lunch or dinner al desko, it doesn’t hurt to keep a couple of trays in the freezer—you can serve them alongside a freshly tossed Complete Caesar Salad and Garlic & Cheese Breadsticks when you need a weeknight dinner on the double for a small group.

082197.item_story_marketing:
What do you reach for when you’re hungry and hurried, but your next meal is still hours away? It’s a tough call, to be sure, especially when you consider the sheer magnitude of snacking options available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. We have myriad munchies and mini-meal possibilities in every aisle! If you’re seeking snacks with staying power, don’t overlook our refrigerated case! Seriously, our refrigerators offer some excellent options. Take Trader Joe’s Mini Uncured Pepperoni Sticks, for example—they satisfy salty-snack cravings and provide 13 grams of protein in the process.

We’ve conveniently divided each package of Mini Uncured Pepperoni Sticks into two, individually sealed, one-ounce servings. Peel back the film, and you have a Mini, meaty feast on (and in) your hands—a feast in the form of a snack-sized helping of slim, perfectly chewy Pepperoni Sticks made from savory Uncured pork. (No nitrates or nitrites are added, except those naturally occurring in sea salt and cultured Swiss chard powder). Enjoy a package of Trader Joe’s Mini Uncured Pepperoni Sticks on their own to mightly carry you between meals. Or, to lean into the “antipasto-on-the-go” theme even further, pair them with a pouch of TJ’s Marinated Artichokes and a TJ’s Sharp Cheddar Cheese Snack Pack or two.

082237.item_story_marketing:
It’s true that Trader Joe’s Spicy Spuds are about as exciting as a side dish can get. It’s true that they’re made with creamy-textured potatoes, which are conveniently cut into bite-sized chunks, then seasoned with a complex, capsaicin-rich blend of spices including cayenne pepper, Parmesan cheese, lime juice, and smoked paprika. And it’s equally true that they’re a cinch to cook from frozen, and crisp up wonderfully no matter if they’re sautéed in a skillet, roasted in an oven, or popped into an air fryer. But did you know that they’re also remarkably versatile beyond their uses as a side? Truly, they are!

For example, while our Spicy Spuds will stun when served next to practically any entrée, be it a plate of chilaquiles at breakfast, a pan-fried patty melt at lunch, or a fillet of Miso Marinated Cod at dinner, they’ll also wow when used as an ingredient in a homemade breakfast hash, a hearty burrito, or an easy, cheesy casserole. And if you’re already prepping something with a kick of heat, like a seafood boil, buffalo wings, or chili, these Spicy Spuds’ savory, zesty, and slightly smoky flavor profile will be just the thing to make that meal feel complete.
082237.name: SPICY SPUDS

082245.item_story_marketing:
Cotton candy conjures up good-time memories of a summer carnival or the county fair. It seems almost magical how something so simple (spun sugar with added flavors & colors) could yield such powerful nostalgia. Now, for the first time, we’re offering Trader Joe’s Cotton Candy, which delivers carnival-level nostalgia, but with a recipe that stays true to our commitment to avoid artificial flavors & synthetically-derived colors.

We chose a Sour Cherry profile, unique among our selection of tart candies. Our supplier combines sugar with citric acid (for tartness) and natural flavors to create this fun, puckery flavor. They use a combination of vegetable juice, turmeric, and annatto (from the seeds of the achiote tree) to naturally produce the vibrant pink color. The pink sugar is heated and the resulting liquid is spun—using a modern version of the method created way back in 1897 that debuted at the 1904 World’s Fair—to yield wispy, Cotton-like “floss,” (as they call it across the pond) that melts delightfully on the tongue with a pleasant pucker-inducing Sour Cherry aroma and taste.

Rather than presenting it on a stick, we’ve tucked ours gently into 1.5-ounce tubs so you can gleefully pluck fingers-full at a time and inconspicuously take your Cotton Candy along to the park, to the beach, camping... anywhere you might crave that magical Cotton Candy feeling and flavor.
082245.item_story_qil:
Cotton candy conjures up good-time memories of a summer carnival or the county fair. It seems almost magical 
how something so simple (spun sugar with added flavors & colors) could yield such powerful nostalgia. Now, 
for the first time, we're offering Trader Joe's Cotton Candy, which delivers carnival-level nostalgia, but with a 
recipe that stays true to our commitment to avoid artificial flavors & synthetically-derived colors.

We chose a Sour Cherry profile, unique among our selection of tart candies. Our supplier combines sugar 
with citric acid (for tartness) and natural flavors to create this fun, puckery flavor. They use a combination 
of vegetable juice, turmeric, and annatto (from the seeds of the achiote tree) to naturally produce the vibrant 
pink color. The pink sugar is heated and the resulting liquid is spun-using a modern version of the method 
created way back in 1897 that debuted at the 1904 World's Fair-to yield wispy, Cotton-like "floss," (as they call 
it across the pond) that melts delightfully on the tongue with a pleasant pucker-inducing Sour Cherry aroma 
and taste. 

Rather than presenting it on a stick, we've tucked ours gently into 1.5-ounce tubs so you can gleefully pluck 
fingers-full at a time and inconspicuously take your Cotton Candy along to the park, to the beach, camping... 
anywhere you might crave that magical Cotton Candy feeling and flavor. You'll find Sour Cherry Cotton 
Candy for a limited time, June through August, at your neighborhood Trader Joe's-where you're also likely to 
encounter magic & nostalgia, 365 days a year!

Sour Cherry Cotton Candy

082261.item_story_marketing:
Gözlemes [GUZ-leh-mehs] are a popular handheld Turkish fast-food—picture a quesadilla-meets-stuffed-flatbread, and you’re on the right track. Street vendors in Turkey sell these thin, unleavened-dough wrappers filled with feta and spinach, or loaded with seasoned meat & potatoes. For Trader Joe’s Gözlemes, we decided to focus on the cheese, because—why not?! Our Turkish supplier fills the traditional-recipe dough with three varieties, including: tulum, a crumbly, creamy, and terrifically tangy cheese; kashkaval, sometimes called the “Cheddar of the Balkans,” for its semi-firm texture, yellow color, and buttery flavor; and mild, soft, marvelously meltable mozzarella.

Heat our Gözlemes from frozen on the stovetop in a dry pan over medium-low heat. Once they’re soft & gooey on the inside and nice & crisp on the outside (about five minutes), they’re ready to be enjoyed as an anytime savory snack, or, as they do in Turkey, alongside some sliced cucumbers and tomatoes as part of a hearty breakfast. And like a quesadilla, their size and shape are excellent for dipping—we recommend our very own TJ’s Tzatziki.

082268.item_story_marketing:
O, Canada! Among the many culinary treasures provided by our neighbors to the north, some of our favorites have come in the form of uniquely flavored potato chips, with the ketchup flavored chip chief among them. In fact, we so admire this strangely intuitive, yet still somehow-offbeat-feeling flavor, that we decided to try our own hand at it—incorporating our own textural twist, of course. To that end, Trader Joe’s Ketchup Flavored Lattice Potato Chips combine the flavor of classic tomato Ketchup with the criss-cross texture and satisfying crunch of a Lattice-cut Potato Chip.

A little salty, a little sweet, and with a delighftul, vinegar-y tang in every bite, Trader Joe’s Ketchup Flavored Lattice Potato Chips are a snack that proves why Ketchup and Potatoes have been such an iconic pairing for so long. They’re great for serving at parties, picnics, and barbecues of all kinds, where their Lattice structure will hold up particularly well to dunking into creamy or chunky dips. We’re also quite fond of munching on them alongside a hamburger, sandwich, or hot dog—or really any other dish that would also serve well with a side of ketchup and fries.

082269.item_story_marketing:
Like many traditional dishes from the Korean culinary oeuvre, bugak (a savory treat made with dried seaweed or various veggies coated with glutinous rice, then deep-fried) originated as a form of temple cuisine. Typically served as a kind of banchan, or appetizer, bugak was likely invented by vegeterian Buddhist monks as a way to extend the shelf life of fresh seaweed and vegetables long into the winter months. Centuries later, this tasty snack has become a pillar of Korean cuisine, enjoyed across the world—and it’s a snack you can now add to your TJ’s shopping list, in the form of Trader Joe’s Korean Bugak Sticky Rice and Seaweed Crisps.

They’re made for us by a supplier in the Republic of Korea, who dries discs of combined Seaweed and Sticky Rice for a whopping fifteen hours to ensure a light and well-puffed consistency once cooked. Then, they fry them to a satisfyingly crisp texture, before seasoning them with sesame seeds, sugar, sea salt, onion powder, and kelp powder. It all results in an alluringly umami-rich and crunchy eating experience that still makes a great bit of banchan for a bowl of Organic Silken Tofu soup, a fantastic base for a spicy tuna or salmon hors d’oeuvre, as well as an excellent anytime snack.

Pre-mixed and ready-to-drink, Trader Joe’s Pumpkin Spice Espresso Martini is here for your post-dinner digestif and cocktail party needs, all autumn long!

Each batch of this Pumpkin Spice Espresso Martini is made with a blend of vodka and espresso, and flavored with a suite of pumpkin pie spices including clove, ginger, cinnamon, and nutmeg, plus as a touch of vanilla. Every sip is full-flavored and easy-drinking, striking a deft balance between the boldness of the Espresso and the pleasant zing of the Pumpkin Spice. And, since each 375mL bottle contains roughly four servings, it’s a bit like an instant-cocktail-party-in-a-bottle for you and three friends.

082321.item_story_marketing:
Australian lamb is considered to be among the very best in the world. But why, exactly, does Trader Joe’s Shaved Lamb Shoulder from Down Under get us so head-over-heels? It’s all about how it’s raised. Out on the green, rolling pastures of the Australian countryside, our supplier’s lambs graze on lush grasses, which allows them to attain an ideal fat-to-lean ratio for a light and mild flavor, and marvelous, melt-in-your-mouth texture.  And since our supplier Shaves the Shoulder meat so superlatively thin, it has even more tender texture. It’s the kind of difference that, once you take it home and cook it, you can taste immediately—a level of quality that raises the bar with every bite.

It’s also the kind of difference that’s ideal for plussing up all kinds of everyday entrées, from stir fries and tacos to sandwiches and wraps. It adds an elegant element to ramen, cold noodle salads, and hot pot, and makes a mean Mediterranean cheesesteak when pan-fried and smothered with grilled pepper, onions, and Crumbled Feta on a Sandwich Roll. And for a super easy meal prep, protein, we recommend seasoning it with a bit of cumin and coriander, sautéing until browned, and using it to top everything from rice bowls and salads to pastas and flatbreads.

082328.item_story_marketing:
Like its customer favorite Cab-Syrah and Rosé counterparts, Maison Barboulot Chardonnay-Viognier is made from grapes grown in the Pays d’Oc area within the prolific Languedoc-Roussillon region of southern coast of France. Each varietal is gently pressed, then fermented in concrete tanks, slowly and at low temperature to preserve freshness and enhance the aromas. Finally, the two young wines are skillfully blended together (60% Chardonnay and 40% Viognier), and left unoaked so the wine retains a vibrant, fruit-forward profile and crisp finish.

This Chardonnay-Viognier pours bright and pale-gold in the glass, with intense aromas of peach and ripe pear, plus aromatic hints of white flower blossoms and exotic fruits. To complement this full-bodied wine’s velvety texture and acidity on the finish, we recommend imbibing with sliced Saturn Peaches and Bacon Cheddar Cheese, or a Caprese salad with fresh Mozzarella. Like the other Maison Barboulot wines, this Chardonnay-Viognier is also an exceptional value.
082328.item_story_qil:
Maison Barboulot Chardonnay Viognier 2024 is the harmonious marriage of two noble white 
varietals, creating a wine of remarkable complexity and finesse. The dominant Chardonnay provides a 
structured foundation with bright acidity and subtle minerality, while the Viognier contributes aromatic 
intensity and a luxurious, silky texture. 
On the nose, this wine opens with an enchanting bouquet of white stone fruits-ripe peach and apricot-
complemented by delicate floral notes of honeysuckle and orange blossom. The palate reveals layers of 
citrus zest, particularly lemon and grapefruit, balanced by hints of tropical pineapple and a whisper of 
vanilla from careful oak integration. The mouthfeel is beautifully rounded with a creamy mid-palate that 
transitions to a clean, refreshing finish with lingering notes of white pepper and subtle almond. 
This versatile blend pairs exquisitely with pan-seared scallops, roasted chicken with herbs, or creamy 
pasta dishes featuring seafood. The wine's natural acidity makes it an ideal companion to fresh goat 
cheese, grilled halibut, or a classic French onion tart. For vegetarian options, consider pairing with 
roasted butternut squash risotto or a Mediterranean vegetable gratin. 
Try this new favorite with friends on the patio as the evening breeze carries in the endless summer 
feeling straight to your glass.
082328.name: MAISON BARBOULOT CHARDONNAY VIOGNIER IGP PAYS DOC

Gluten free orzo pasta made from a blend of quinoa and rice flours provides heft and body. And for extra oomph, bright lemon juice and a blend of herbs round out this light, zesty broth.

Serve with rustic breads like our chewy Ciabatta Rolls or our Olive Fougasse—its Kalamata and black olives enhance the zesty and savory flavors of the Lemony Soup. For a satisfying, Mediterranean-inspired meal, pair it with a Classic Greek Salad.

082332.item_story_marketing:
Having recently marked its 100th anniversary as a mainstay of menus all the world over, we thought it only fitting to give the legendary Caesar salad a whole new world to conquer for its centennial celebration: that of the grab-and-go sandwich wrap. Conveniently hand-holdable and enjoyable straight from the fridge, Trader Joe’s Chicken Caesar Wrap showcases everything you love about a Caesar salad —the crisp bite of the lettuce, the creamy garlickyness of the rich dressing, the way you can positively pile it on with Parmesan—in a quick and easy meal, all without the need of a fork. 

Each wrap starts with strips of satisfyingly savory-seasoned Chicken breast, which are packed along with shredded lettuce and Parmesan cheese into a leafy green tortilla (which gets its verdant hues from spinach powder, we should add) and Wrapped tight. Each package also comes with a tub of creamy and full-flavored Caesar dressing to dunk, dip, drizzle or dab to your delight. All in all, it makes an exceptionally easy and flavorful lunch option for all sorts of situations. We particularly love to pack one on a picnic or a day trip, especially when we can pair it with a bag of Trader Joe’s Garlic Butter Irish Potato Chips and a bright, bubbly beverage.

082338.item_story_marketing:
"How do I love thee? Let me count the shreds."  ~with apologies to Elizabeth Barrett Browning

Trader Joe’s Finely Shredded Mexican Style Cheese Blend is our ideal blend for dishes with a Mexican flair, with sharp Cheddar, Monterey Jack, Asadero and Queso Blanco cheeses. It’s a blend that’s unique to Trader Joe’s, and it boasts a unique flavor profile. The Jack, Asadero and Queso Blanco are mild, while the sharp Cheddar adds a bit of a bite.

All of the cheeses are well-known for their meltability, which makes them particularly well-suited to dishes like burritos, enchiladas, quesadillas and tacos. And don’t let the name make you feel like you need to limit yourself to Mexican dishes. This blend is excellent in salads and atop soups, and makes a distinctively flavored grilled cheese sandwich.

082350.item_story_marketing:
In some circles (some circles that smell very good, we might add), our seasonal Scented Candles are considered collectable, cult classics. Our customers simply can’t get enough of these waxy wonders— which is precisely why we’ve brought the beloved fall edition of Trader Joe’s Scented Candle Trio back to our shelves. 

Let the Trio warm up your fall evenings with this year’s scents of crisp Falling Leaves, sweet Vanilla Woods, and cozy Spiced Pear—perhaps the most terrific trifecta of autumnal aromas we’ve ever sniffed. Made with a natural soy wax blend and lead-free cotton wicks, this year’s set is also packaged in attractive yellow, orange, and red glass, making it an exceptional option for home décor or a fall fête host gift. But buyer, be warned: supply of these limited-edition luminaries won’t last long, so if our Scented Candles really light you up, head to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s today!

082351.item_story_marketing:
The Chicken Lettuce Wrap is an icon of restaurant appetizers. It’s handheld, it’s fresh, and it spans an enticing flavor-spectrum in a single bite—crunchy, tender, savory, sweet... And now, you don’t have to go to a restaurant to enjoy this iconic finger food. Just make a stop at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s! 

Like the original, Trader Joe’s Chicken Lettuce Wraps have a pre-cooked filling made with ground Chicken that’s mixed with water chestnuts, shredded carrots, and black sesame seeds—and seasoned with the likes of ginger, garlic, red chili pepper flakes, soy sauce, and sesame oil. This filling comes in a neat little tray that you can easily remove from the larger package to heat in the microwave—just about 30 seconds.

Also included are several large pieces of fresh Greenberg Lettuce, which serve as your Chicken delivery system. Fill a piece of lettuce with a spoonful or two of the warmed Chicken—don’t miss adding a sprig of fresh cilantro, also included! Then top your Wrap with a drizzle of our included, soy & sesame-based sauce and a sprinkle of crispy, fried rice noodles for a crowning crunch. Sound good? That’s a Wrap! ... A Trader Joe’s Chicken Lettuce Wrap—available every day in our refrigerators.

082361.item_story_marketing:
When days are gloomy and gray, keeping cozy and content is of the utmost importance. And as luck would have it, we’ve got just the spirit to keep spirits high this time of year: Trader Joe’s Irish Coffee! Made with authentic, imported Irish whiskey, this pre-mixed and ready-to-drink cocktail is sweet and rich, with every sip full of big, bold, Coffee notes, which are accentuated by a kick of caramel-y, oaky, vanilla-tinged whiskey.

Here's our tip for an extra cozy cocktail experience: pour a few servings’ worth of this Irish Coffee into a sauce pan, then slowly heat on the stove until just steamy, then re-pour into a serving glass, top it with TJ’s Cold Foam Creamer or Whipped Cream, and enjoy. Each 375mL bottle of Trader Joe’s Irish Coffee contains about five servings, and it's available only for a limited time. While it’s stock, it’ll be in our spirits section.
082361.item_story_qil:
TJ's Irish Coffee is a ready-to-drink cocktail that combines Irish Whiskey with coffee extract, sugar 
and water for a convenient pre-mixed take on the classic libation. Meant to be enjoyed warm, this can simply 
be heated up in a small sauce pan until hot, but not scalding. When heated, the Whiskey component will 
become especially prominent with strong aromas that may warm you before even taking a sip, followed by 
roasted coffee aromas combining with vanilla and spice. At 20% ABV, this is a bold Whiskey drink, but the 
balance of delicious coffee flavor and sweetness round out the taste profile, with hints of smooth caramel, 
vanilla, and spice carrying through a lingering finish and inviting you back for more. 
 
 While enjoyable as is, a common way to serve Irish Coffee includes topping with whipped heavy cream 
and easy options for this could be the Whipped Cream can or a Cold Foam Creamer. Whether serving with 
brunch, tailgating or any other festivity that's fitting, natural pairing possibilities could be the Glazed 
Chocolate Donut Holes or Chocolate Croissants. In addition to the classic way of enjoying this warm, it's also 
quite delicious chilled or on ice, with your creamer of choice, if preferred.
082361.name: TJS IRISH COFFEE RTD COCKTAIL

082380.item_story_marketing:
What is it, exactly, about having a little bit of cheese that brightens one’s day? Don’t get us wrong, we’re also tremendous proponents of having a great deal of cheese. But there’s something so charming—so modern, perhaps—about enjoying just a fragment of fromage that makes it one of life’s unexpected little joys. So it’s only appropriate that we celebrate this fact with Trader Joe’s Unexpected Cheddar Cheese Snackers, a convenient collection of eight, ¾-ounce, amuse-bouche-sized, individually-wrapped medallions of our TJ’s-Hall-of-Fame- honored Unexpected Cheddar.

Celebrated for its sharp, nutty, faintly Parmesan-like flavor, Unexpected Cheddar is a natural choice for savoring in this perfectly portioned, on-the-go format. Snackers are ideal for packing into lunches, serving as afternoon snacks, or simply grabbing out of the fridge whenever the ineffable urge for a little bit of cheese strikes. At 80 calories and five grams of protein each, they’re sound and satisfying—which is also how we’d describe their price. You’ll find Unexpected Cheddar Cheese Snackers in our cheese case of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, all year round.

082381.item_story_marketing:
Sometimes, when it comes to naming a new product, it can take a few rounds of brainstorming before we settle on something we like. And sometimes, as with this particular product, the name comes to us right away. Because when the cool and tangy flavors and luxuriously lush textures of cream cheese meet with the herby, aromatic excellence of dill, what else can you call it but Trader Joe’s Dillicious Cream Cheese Spread?

This awesomely herbaceous spread was designed expressly with bagels and lox in mind—we find the notes of Dill are particularly suited to bringing out the best in smoked salmon or Steelhead Trout. That said, it also happens to be great when simply enjoyed with crackers or charcuterie, and a mixed-in spoonful will add all kinds of depth to a pan of soft, scrambled eggs. However you choose to enjoy it, you can count on it being dependably Dillicious.

082409.item_story_marketing:
Taco Tuesdays are terrific, but honestly, just one day each week seems a little limiting for true arbiters of taco taste. At Trader Joe’s, we think of a week like a taco shell: it needs to be filled! That’s why we provide so many ways to get your daily taco fix, including our Mini Beef Tacos —which also happen to be simple, quick, and delicious.

To make Trader Joe’s Mini Beef Tacos, our supplier in Mexico begins with petite tortillas made with yellow and white corn.They fold them in half and tuck in some flavorful ground beef that’s been seasoned using their own in-house seasoning blend, including garlic, onion, cumin, paprika, and oregano. Then the Tacos are pre- fried to an ideal crispness, and finally, frozen. No matter what time of day—or day of the week—they can be heated from frozen in just a matter of minutes. (That’s just 6-8 minutes in the air fryer at 350°F, or 7-9 minutes in a conventional oven at 425°F.)

Once cooked, our Mini Beef Tacos have a firm, crisp-chewy exterior enclosing a tender, beefy filling. This combination delivers savory satisfaction, whether you enjoy them as-is, or with any of our taco-ndiments. Think Taquera Salsa, Organic Chunky Homestyle Guacamole [sku 71498], or White Queso Dip—to name just a few. And here’s the best news: you’ll not only find Trader Joe’s Mini Beef Tacos in our freezers on Tuesdays, they’ll be waiting there for you to pick them up every single day of the week!

082433.item_story_marketing:
When you’re looking to mix in a little more fruit into your daily routine, smoothies are a surefire way to do so with style. And in our estimation, adding a bit of tropical flair to the proceedings is nothing short of superlatively stylish (which should come as no surprise, if you’ve seen our preferred fashion choices.) That’s one of the reasons we’re so excited to offer Trader Joe’s Tropical Smoothie Blend in our freezers. It’s made with a mix of frozen mango, pineapple, and banana, along with cubes of frozen coconut cream, agave syrup, and purées of mango and passionfruit to add some extra body and sweetness. Once blended together, all these elements combine into a vivaciously velvety, delighftully easy-drinking Smoothie that’s tastier than the sum of it’s already-quite-notably-tasty parts.

Here’s another reason we’re excited to carry this Tropical Smoothie Blend: it’s super easy to prep! Simply measure out a cup of the Smoothie Blend, add a 1/2 cup of water or milk—or your favorite non-dairy beverage—and blend to your desired smoothness. If you want to give it a little extra textural oomph (not to mention a bit of protein), you can always add a 1/4 cup of your favorite TJ’s yogurt in, too. Now that’s a stylish Smoothie!

082449.item_story_marketing:
When one sees the green, gently rolling hills of Sonoma County, it’s easy to imagine why vineyards take so well to its idyllic environment and diversity of soils. And when one sips some of the wines produced in Sonoma, like the trio of wines under the Compass Bridge label, it’s easy to see why this region has become so globally renowned. 

Compass Bridge Cabernet Sauvignon, for example, touts flavors of ripe red currant, juicy blackberry, and spicy anise, which combine with espresso aromatics and a toasty, oaky finish to make one seriously satisfying red that pairs particularly well with Ribeye and aged Cheddars.
082449.item_story_qil:
Compass Bridge Cabernet Sauvignon Sonoma County is a new wine we're introducing as an 
alternative to some of the biggest brands, which are priced above this in the $12-17 range. The Compass 
Bridge wines feature an appellation, being from Sonoma County, rather than simply California. These are from 
vineyards controlled by the winery, which has a long history as a key producer in the northern end of Sonoma. 
This new Cabernet Sauvignon from Sonoma County represents the compelling value wines we're known for. 
With a price of $9.99, we think that customers will enjoy the quality and all Crew members should feel 
comfortable recommending these! 

This Cabernet Sauvignon is a true reflection of thoughtful winemaking and the distinctive landscapes 
of Sonoma County. Harvest decisions are guided by the winemaker's careful evaluation of vineyard conditions 
and optimal flavor ripeness. Select lots are chosen for their bold character-offering warm spice, deep, ripe 
fruit, and a plush, jammy richness, with a lushness that lingers long after the last sip. The wine was aged on 
30% New French Oak, imparting subtle notes of warm spices, mocha and caramel, with a smooth, integrated 
structure. This method of oak treatment enhances the complexity and depth of the flavor without 
overpowering the natural fruit characteristics. The balance and structure make this very enjoyable on its own, 
but also will pair well with hearty dishes like rack of lamb, or grilled meats, and of course aged cheddar.
082449.item_title: Compass Bridge Sonoma County Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
082449.name: COMPASS BRIDGE CABERNET SAUVIGNON SONOMA COUNTY

082450.item_story_marketing:
When one sees the green, gently rolling hills of Sonoma County, it’s easy to imagine why vineyards take so well to its idyllic environment and diversity of soils. And when one sips some of the wines produced in Sonoma, like the trio of wines under the Compass Bridge label, it’s easy to see why this region has become so globally renowned. 

Compass Bridge Chardonnay, on the other hand, is medium-bodied and bright, with aromas of pineapple and peach, flavors of lemon zest and baking spice, and a delicate vanilla finish that makes it splendidly suited for serving with grilled seafood and creamy Bries.
082450.item_story_qil:
Compass Bridge Chardonnay Sonoma County is a new wine we're introducing as an alternative to 
some of the biggest brands, which are priced above this in the $11-15 range. The Compass Bridge wines 
feature an appellation, being from Sonoma County, rather than simply California. These are from vineyards 
controlled by the winery, which has a long history as a key producer in the northern end of Sonoma. This new 
Chardonnay from Sonoma County represents the compelling value wines we're known for. With a price of 
$8.99, we think that customers will enjoy the quality and all Crew members should feel comfortable 
recommending these! 

Crafted with care from vine to glass, this Chardonnay begins with harvest at the peak of flavor 
ripeness and balanced acidity. Picked in the cool of the night to preserve its fresh character, the grapes are 
gently pressed upon arrival at the winery. About 35% of the juice is fermented with toasted American and 
French oak, adding depth, subtle spice, and a touch of richness. To soften the wine's natural acidity and create 
a smooth, buttery mouthfeel, 95% of the juice undergoes malolactic fermentation. The result is a beautifully 
balanced wine with layers of elegance, richness, and a lingering finish that invites you back for another sip. 
With a mix of tropical and stone fruit aromas and flavors, along with hints of citrus, vanilla and baking spices, 
this medium bodied Chardonnay is well-rounded and offers both a creamy mid-palate and mouth-watering 
finish. Excellent pairings include roasted or grilled chicken, seafood chowders or a creamy brie. Enjoy chilled.
082450.name: COMPASS BRIDGE CHARDONNAY SONOMA COUNTY

082451.item_story_marketing:
When one sees the green, gently rolling hills of Sonoma County, it’s easy to imagine why vineyards take so well to its idyllic environment and diversity of soils. And when one sips some of the wines produced in Sonoma, like the trio of wines under the Compass Bridge label, it’s easy to see why this region has become so globally renowned. 

Compass Bridge Pinot Noir starts with black cherry aromatics, which lead into tangy cranberry notes and elegant tannins on the palate, with a long, lingering finish that’s all the more accentuated by pairing with lamb, mushroom pasta, or Gruyère.
082451.item_story_qil:
Compass Bridge Pinot Noir Sonoma County is a new wine we're introducing as an alternative to 
some of the biggest brands, which are priced above this in the $12-17 range. The Compass Bridge wines 
feature an appellation, being from Sonoma County, rather than simply California. These are from vineyards 
controlled by the winery, which has a long history as a key producer in the northern end of Sonoma. This new 
Pinot Noir from Sonoma County represents the compelling value wines we're known for. With a price of $9.99, 
we think that customers will enjoy the quality and all Crew members should feel comfortable recommending 
these! 

The grapes for this Pinot Noir are carefully harvested in the cool early morning hours to preserve 
freshness and delicate flavors. Each cluster is picked at peak ripeness, balancing vibrant acidity with rich fruit 
character. At the winery, the grapes are gently crushed and placed into fermenters, where they undergo both 
alcoholic and full malolactic fermentation. This process softens the acidity and enhances its silky texture. A 
portion of the wine is then aged in new French oak barrels, adding layers of spice and structure. Classic cherry 
aromas and flavors lead the way, while subtle nuances reflecting the Sonoma microclimates add complexity 
through light earthy notes, balanced acidity, and an elegant texture. Excellent pairings include portabella 
mushroom parmesan, beef Bourguignon, as well as grilled turkey burgers or salmon. Slightly chilling this 
before serving will enhance both the delicate flavors and the balance of tannins, alcohol and acidity.
082451.item_title: Compass Bridge Sonoma County Pinot Noir 2023
082451.name: COMPASS BRIDGE PINOT NOIR SONOMA COUNTY

082462.item_story_marketing:
As Korean foods continue to grow in popularity, our buyers continue searching for creative ways to bring those characteristically spicy, sweet, and savory flavors—often with a fermented flair—into more TJ’s products. The latest achievement on this culinary fusion adventure is Trader Joe’s Spicy Alfredo Fusilloni Pasta. Our supplier in Italy starts with Fusilloni (giant fusilli) made of durum wheat semolina that’s cooked to an ideal al dente texture. For the fusion part, they’ve crafted a Spicy Alfredo sauce that mixes traditional cream, grated cheese, and butter with gochujang (fermented red chili paste).

The sauce is frozen into little “pucks” and packed right in with the Fusilloni. All you have to do is heat everything together in the microwave or on the stovetop, and you’ll be rewarded with a mouthwatering melding of flavors—rich, ultra-creamy Alfredo with a spicy, fermented kick in every big-spiral bite. While Italian-Korean culinary fusion is quite unique, the fusion of quality products with unbeatable prices is an everyday occurrence at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

082463.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Linguine Nerano is modeled after the original, which was created in the 1950s by a chef in the village of Nerano, on the Amalfi Coast. Durum wheat semolina Linguine is cooked al dente, and prepared in a buttery, cheesy sauce, which includes a smoked, mozzarella-like cheese called Provola. What really raises this dish, beyond being just a simple linguine & cream sauce, is the hallmark addition of summer squash. Coins of vibrant green zucchini (some grilled, some fried) have been included, accented by the sweet and bright flavor of basil. The true delight comes when your fork finds a zucchini or two (there are plenty, so it won’t be hard to do) and twirls them with the long noodles, all dressed in that rich and creamy sauce.

After heating it from frozen on the stovetop or in the microwave, we recommend a garnish of torn fresh basil and a generous sprinkle of Grated Parmigiano Reggiano to top it all off. There’s little doubt in our minds that when you try Trader Joe’s Linguine Nerano, you’ll keep coming back for more—which won’t be hard to do, since we’re bringing the Amalfi Coast right to you! (Or, at least to our freezers, where you’ll find it among our dazzling selection of imported Italian pasta dishes.)

082471.item_story_marketing:
What happens when you multiply mango to the power of passion fruit? Why, you get Trader Joe’s Mango & Passion Fruit Squares, of course! Made for us by a supplier in Thailand, these tremendously tropical treats are formualted by adding sweet & zesty Mango to tart & tangy Passion Fruit, then sweetening the sum with sugar and drying it until it takes on a satisfyingly chewy, fruit-leather-like texture. After that, it’s divided into snack- sized Squares, then individually wrapped for convenient, on-the-go eating.

Since each package contains 17 Mango & Passion Fruit Squares, they present a prime opportunity for packing into school or work lunches throughout the week. And if you find yourself needing the occasional sweet little pick-me-up, they make a constant companion when kept in your bag—Square is individually wrapped, so they’ll stay fresh until the very moment you need them. Factor in the fact that each bite is balanced with a quotient of tart & sweet flavors to tender & toothsome textures and alluringly tropical aromas, and you’ve got a formula for the ideal, anytime fruit snack.

082477.item_story_marketing:
Ah, for the days of the classic pudding cup. For many of us, the mere memory of digging into a pudding cup in the cafeteria or as part of a midday snack on the weekend is enough to send us into a sweet, nostalgic reverie. And here’s the good news: those days are back and better than ever with the introduction of Trader Joe’s Rice Pudding! Made for us by a supplier that specializes in rich and creamy desserts, this is a delightfully refined Rice Pudding, with pleasant notes of vanilla, and every bite punctuated by the soft, toothsome texture of the Rice. And just like the classic pudding cups of yore, it’s a super satisfying sweet treat, ready to revive sweet memories from the past, as well as create new ones for the kids of today.

Great for packing into school lunches, passing out at sports practices, or simply snacking upon when your sweet tooth strikes, Trader Joe’s Rice Pudding comes in a convenient four-pack for easy distribution. And if you really want to take things to the next level, each cup can be accessorized as you see fit with a light sprinkling of Cinnamon, a few plump Raisins, or both.

the cafeteria or as part of a midday snack on the weekend is enough to send us into a sweet, nostalgic reverie. 
And here's the good news: those days are back and better than ever with the introduction of Trader Joe's 
Chocolate Pudding! Made for us by a supplier that specializes in rich and creamy desserts, this is a remarkably 
elegant Chocolate Pudding, with a superlatively smooth and silky texture to match. And just like the classic 
pudding cups of yore, it's a super satisfying sweet treat, ready to revive sweet memories from the past, as well 
as create new ones for the kids of today.

Great for packing into school lunches, passing out at sports practices, or simply snacking upon when your 
sweet tooth strikes, Trader Joe's Chocolate Pudding comes in a convenient four-pack for easy distribution. 
And if you really want to get nostalgic, we recommend mixing in a few of your favorite TJ's gummy candies, 
then crushing up a Joe-Joe [sku 76572] and sprinkling it on top for a quick and easy "worms in dirt" dessert.

Chocolate Pudding
082478.name: CHOCOLATE PUDDING

082479.item_story_marketing:
Australian lamb is considered to be among the very best in the world. But why, exactly, does Trader Joe’s Ground Lamb from Down Under get us so head-over-heels? It’s all about how it’s raised. Out on the green, rolling pastures of the Australian countryside, our supplier’s lambs graze on lush grasses, which allows them to attain an ideal fat-to-lean ratio for a light and mild flavor, and marvelous, melt-in-your-mouth texture. It’s the kind of difference that, once you take it home and cook it, you can taste immediately—a level of quality that raises the bar with every bite.

It’s also the kind of difference that makes it ideal for plussing up all kinds of everyday protein applications. Making some burgers from scratch? Mixing in a bit of Ground Lamb will add a satisfyingly succulent element with ease. Lasagna’s on the menu? Brown up some lamb into your ragu, for a remakably elevated entrée. And that’s before we get into its uses in Mediterranean cuisine: for a quick and easy kofta kebab, mix a package of Ground Lamb with breadcrumbs, chopped parsley, and a few pinches of cumin, cayenne, and cinnamon, then form into cylinder, thread onto some skewers, and grill.

082551.item_story_marketing:
Need a convenient, flavorful meal that’s ready in a flash? Craving meat & veggies with a Tex-Mex twist? Do two kinds of cheese sound better than one? If you answered Yes! to these questions, we recommend Trader Joe’s Beef & Queso Bowl!

It begins with Spanish-style jasmine rice that’s cooked with chicken broth and seasoned with tomato, onion, garlic, and cumin. Next comes ground Beef, sautéed with green chili peppers, jalapeños, and a host of piquant spices. The meat is paired with fajita-style vegetables—a mix of sautéed white onion with red and green bell peppers. This stacked bowl is finally crowned with not one, but two kinds of cheese: shredded white Cheddar and a rich Queso sauce.

You won’t want to wait long to enjoy this Bowl, and you won’t have to. It heats from frozen in the microwave in just 4-5 minutes. Give it a little stir and dig in to experience the delightful contrast of textures—firm rice, tender Beef, and creamy Queso—along with a satisfying mix of bold flavors. Add your favorite TJ’s salsa and some fresh avocado for even more flavor and texture complexity! You can pick up one of these Beef & Queso Bowls today and every day at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. You’ll find it in our freezers alongside a variety of ready-in-a-flash, bowl-based meals.

082562.item_story_marketing: The secret to Trader Joe's Thick & Creamy Strawberry Greek Yogurt is our supplier’s special straining process; the excess whey is carefully removed from the finished Yogurt, resulting in an exceptionally Thick & Creamy texture and a less tangy flavor than our other Greek yogurt offerings. It’s sweetened just so and mixed with a Strawberry fruit base, then pasteurized and cultured, in that order. Like its predecessor, it’s kosher-certified and offers 14 grams of protein in a ¾-cup serving, making it an excellent assist anytime you need to refuel.
082562.item_story_qil:
Food trends come and go, but every so often, an innovation comes along that truly thrills our taste buds. 
Trader Joe's Strained Thick & Creamy Greek Yogurt is one such innovation. Our plain, unsweetened version 
made its TJ's dairy case debut in late 2025, and its instant success inspired a fast foray into fruit territory. Now, 
we're here, in 2026, inviting you to try our sweetly stupendous Strawberry iteration. 

The secret to this Greek Yogurt is our supplier's special straining process; the excess whey is carefully removed 
from the finished Yogurt, resulting in an exceptionally Thick & Creamy texture and a less tangy flavor 
than our other Greek yogurt offerings. It's sweetened just so and mixed with a Strawberry fruit base, then 
pasteurized and cultured, in that order. Like its predecessor, it's kosher-certified and offers 14 grams of protein 
in a ¿-cup serving, making it an excellent assist anytime you need to refuel. We're selling Thick & Creamy 
Strawberry Greek Yogurt in impressively sized 32-ounce tubs in our dairy case, every day, because you'll truly 
want to enjoy it often-topped with Cherry Pistachio Pecan Granola [sku 81000] and fresh fruit... swirled into 
smoothies... mixed with Dark Chocolate Covered Cashews [sku 77512]...

Strained Thick & Creamy

082570.item_story_marketing:
Packing extra protein into your day doesn’t have to be a chore. In fact, at Trader Joe’s, there are many ways to get your macros in that are as flavorful as they are functional, including Trader Joe’s Protein Pancakes. Made with a gluten free recipe that combines cottage cheese, eggwhite, eggs, and oat flour, and flavored with a bit of sugar and vanilla extract, these silver-dollar-style Pancakes come fully-cooked and ready-to-eat, and contain a whopping 20 grams of Protein per four-Pancake package. All it takes is a few seconds of microwaving and a quick application of your favorite toppings, and you’ve got a quick, easy, and totally tasty breakfast that also happens to get you ahead on your daily Protein goals. 

Slightly sweet, with a light note of vanilla and a fluffy, delightfully syrup-soaking texture, we’re particularly partial to accessorizing our Protein Pancakes with a pat of butter and a generous drizzle of Organic Vermont Maple Syrup. They’re great at brunch, before or after a big weekend workout, especially when paired with a plate of eggs and Maple Chicken Breakfast Sausage—talk about protein power! And they’re now available every day at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s—you’ll find them in our refrigerators.

082583.item_story_marketing:
If your skin tends to side-eye overly foamy, squeaky-clean cleansers, Trader Joe’s Marula Oil Cream Cleanser is here to keep the peace. This dermatologist-formulated, ultra gentle, low-lather, cream-based cleanser is designed to calmly and effectively wash away makeup, sunscreen, and daily grime—without leaving skin feeling tight, stripped, or dry. The soothing power here comes from a thoughtful blend of mild, skin-loving ingredients, including 1% colloidal oatmeal to help calm and comfort skin, a mix of amino acids to help support the skin’s natural barrier, and, of course, Marula Oil to moisturize as you cleanse.

Mind you, Marula Oil is the Cleanser’s main character for a reason. Cold-pressed from the fruit of the marula tree, this lightweight Oil has been used in skincare applications for centuries—prized for its high concentration of antioxidants and its ability to hydrate skin without leaving a greasy residue. Cream cleansers with similar credentials can cost upwards of $36, but at our incredible price, Trader Joe’s Marula Oil Cream Cleanser is proof that gentle, effective skincare doesn’t have to come with a luxury price tag. You’ll find it on the shelves with our bath & body care products, every day.

082585.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s new Triple Chip Crispy Cookies have at least three things going for them... One, they are Crisp, which is trending right now, perhaps in nostalgic response to that classic cookie profile that capitalizes on Crisp and snappy. This Crispness is achieved by extra butter in the recipe, which also lends alluring notes of caramel and browned butter.

Two, our Triple Chip Crispy Cookies are on the larger side. They’re not giant, but with their substantial circumference, adults may find a single Cookie to be a satisfying afternoon snack, especially when paired with an ice-cold glass of milk, or mug of freshly brewed coffee. Meanwhile, little children will have their hands literally full! 

Three, they have three different kinds of Chips in them: white chocolate Chips, semi-sweet chocolate Chips, and dark chocolate Chips. If this combination doesn’t make chocolate lovers seriously chipper, we don’t know what will! This Triple-play of winning attributes—Crispy, Larger, and Chip-filled—is sure to win the hearts (and tummies) of TJ’s cookie-lovers.
