082606.item_story_marketing:
Our customers were enchanted by Chili & Lime Flavored Rolled Corn Tortilla Chips. They raved about our Ranch Flavored Rolled Corn Tortilla Chips. So, we wasted no time rolling right into the launch of our new Nacho Cheese Flavored Rolled Corn Tortilla Chips! And for this iteration of what’s quickly become an iconic fixture of our snacks section, we’ve turned to a supplier in Mexico, who specializes in superlatively savory cheesy flavors. You may notice their take on the Rolled Corn Tortilla Chip is slightly more narrow, a touch more tightly rolled than our previous two forays into the form. We found that this structure provides an ideal surface area for accentuating the Nacho Cheese seasoning—which you may also notice emphasizes a rich and mature Cheddar expression, with just a delicately spicy edge. 

Here’s something else we hope you’ll notice about Trader Joe’s Nacho Cheese Flavored Rolled Corn Tortilla Chips: how wonderfully they pair with a sandwich, burger, burrito, or taco! 082641.item_story_marketing:
Haworthia is one of the more popular succulent varieties we offer, largely because of their ease of care—they really only need minimal upkeep, and thrive in indoor environments. We thought it would be loads of fun to house a mix of them in these decorative ceramic vessels, shaped like cats and dogs and painted in floral designs that evoke the beauty of Dia de los Muertos. So, available only for a limited time, Trader Joe’s Bow Wow & Meow Haworthia Gardens are taking up residence in the plants and flowers section of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. They’re ready to be “adopted” by anyone who needs a fun gift for a dog or cat lover, a decorative piece at their work desk, or a lovely, low-maintenance bit of greenery for their kitchen.

Endemic to South Africa, Haworthia are members of the succulent subamily Asphodelaceae, and like fellow subfamily member aloe vera, they have a delightfully spiky appearance. They really only need watering when their soil is dry to the touch—although, do be careful not to overwater your Bow Wow & Meow Haworthia Garden, as the vessel does not have drainage holes. And while they love bright-light environments, make sure not to keep them in direct sunlight, as too much sun exposure will damage them.
082641.item_story_qil:
BOO! Nah, more like Bow Wow & Meow. Just in time for spooky season, meet Trader Joe's Bow Wow and 
Meow-the bone-chillingly cute cat-and-dog duo that proves ghostly can also be downright adorable!  

With their skeleton suits and wild green "hairdos," these playful planters are equal parts Halloween spirit and 
everyday cheer. Whether perched on your desk, brightening up a shelf, or adding some quirky charm to your 
kitchen, Bow Wow and Meow are always ready to bring a grin (and a little greenery) to your day. Their motto? 
"Life's ruff and hiss-terious, but always better with plants!"

The Bow Wow and Meow Tillandsia Planter is meticulously crafted by our designers. This planter will stay 
propped up within the tray on the magnetic strips, sticking to any metal surface once you bring it home. 
Once home, care is a breeze! These plants are low-maintenance and don't require soil, only occasional misting 
needed! You'll find them at your neighborhood Trader Joe's, for a very limited time.

Bow Wow & Meow 
Planter

082644.item_story_marketing:
Though its crust is inspired by the airy, raised crust common in Southern Italy, the flavor profile and elegant appearance of Trader Joe’s Pizza Bianca is inspired by one of our product developer’s favorite pies in all of Los Angeles. (Fun fact: there’s a sauceless, focaccia-based pie in Italy also called pizza bianca—this, however, is not that). The dough that forms the base of this Pizza Bianca is allowed to naturally rise for 24 hours before it’s spread with a creamy Parmesan cheese sauce and topped with mozzarella and sharp Parmesan cheeses, onion, and fragrant rosemary, at which point it’s baked in a wood burning oven. Dreamy, indeed.

From there, about 15 minutes in your oven is all it takes to unleash Pizza Bianca’s allium-y allure and rich, savory cheesiness. (Be warned: guests or roommates will roam into the kitchen to investigate the enticing aroma, so prepare to share!) A juxtaposition of understated sophistication and satisfying, savory finger food, Pizza Bianca would be equally at home served alongside an aperitif at a cocktail party, or as the main course enjoyed while hunkered down on the couch during movie night.  

We aren’t here to argue if Pizza Bianca can truly be called pizza without a classic tomato sauce (that conversation is better left to the bots in the comments section), but we’ll confidently assert that you won’t find a better value on frozen pizza of this quality anywhere but your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

082698.item_story_marketing:
We’re often in “more” mode when creating new Trader Joe’s products, like: Let’s put more buttercream frosting on that cake! Give those spicy chips even more heat! More time in the cave to age that cheese just right! We also acknowledge that sometimes, products call for less. Trader Joe’s Reduced Sodium Italian Dry Uncured Salami is a winning example this.

We’ve worked with our supplier to Reduce the amount of Sodium in this Italian Dry Salami by 49%, measured against the USDA data for dry pork salami. To put an even finer point on it, the amount of Sodium has been Reduced from 630mg to 320mg per seven-slice serving! This is excellent news if love Salami, and also watching your sodium intake. You won’t even miss the extra Sodium when you experience the pleasant chew and taste the meaty pork flavor, with its hints of garlic and mild sweetness.

Enjoy this Salami with Multigrain Crackers and slices of Cave Aged Gruyere. Stack it on a sandwich with your favorite TJ’s mustard. Or, pair it with Sliced Uncured Pepperoni, Grilled Green Olives, and Marinated Fresh Mozzarella to create an appetizing antipasto tray for hungry friends! You’ll find Trader Joe’s sliced Reduced Sodium Italian Dry Salami in our refrigerators, every day. Who could ask for more?!

082719.item_story_marketing:
Made for us by the fine folks at Villa Borghetti, Otto Pinot Grigio is a crisp, ebulliently easy-drinking Italian white wine. Its name, “Otto,” the Italian word for “eight,” is a direct nod to the wine’s modest alcohol content—an intentional attribute our vintner achieves with great care. The grapes are harvested slightly early to capture and maintain lower natural sugar levels, then guided through a cool, temperature-controlled fermentation to ensure the purity of the fruit’s expression and preserve its aromatics. The result is a naturally lower-alcohol wine, no dealcoholization or dilution involved, clocking in at 8.5% ABV. (That’s Otto-point-five percent alcohol by volume, for those following along...)

Most Pinot Grigios typically run somewhere between 11% and 14% ABV, so each glass of Otto has around 30-40% less alcohol, making it a highly sessionable sipper that’s ideal for enjoying over the course of an evening with friends. And considering its refined aromas of ripe pear, wisteria blossoms, and citrus zest, and bright notes of apricot, peach, and white pepper on the palate, it’s also a wine that’s well suited to pairing with seafood, salads, pastas, and cheeses.
082719.item_story_qil:
Otto Low Alcohol Pinot Grigio by Villa Borghetti is elegantly crafted demonstrates that 

exceptional flavor need not be compromised by reduced alcohol content. At just 8.5% ABV, this refreshing 
Italian white wine delivers all the crisp, clean characteristics that make Pinot Grigio a beloved varietal. 
The nose opens with bright aromas of fresh green apple, pear, and citrus zest, complemented by delicate floral 
notes that hint at spring blossoms. On the palate, this wine maintains remarkable balance and structure 
despite its lower alcohol, offering vibrant acidity that carries flavors of stone fruit, particularly white peach 
and apricot, alongside subtle mineral undertones that speak to its Italian heritage. 

 The mouthfeel is light yet satisfying, with a clean, dry finish that leaves a pleasant lingering 
freshness. Notes of lemon verbena and a whisper of white pepper add complexity without overwhelming the 
wine's inherently delicate nature.Perfect for health-conscious wine lovers, or anyone seeking a sophisticated 
option for daytime entertaining, this Villa Borghetti Pinot Grigio pairs beautifully with light seafood dishes, 
fresh salads, soft cheeses, or simply enjoyed on its own as an aperitif. The reduced alcohol content makes it 
an ideal choice for extended social gatherings without sacrificing the authentic Italian wine experience. 
Serve well-chilled at 45-50°F to fully appreciate its crisp, refreshing character and elegant simplicity. This is 
guaranteed to be your new favorite everyday wine.
082719.name: OTTO PINOT GRIGIO LOW ALCOHOL VILLA BORGHETTI

082738.item_story_marketing:
There are all kinds of people in the world, people with different belief systems and different politics, people who love swimming in the ocean and people who are terrified of shark-infested waters, people who are always short of time in the morning and people who... hold on, our argument just broke down. Everyone is short on time in the morning, it seems, and that, friends, is why we’ve introduced Trader Joe’s Brioche Style Pancakes to our Bakery shelves.

Inside every package of Brioche Style Pancakes you’ll find four packs of two sweet, fluffy Pancakes, each approximately three inches in diameter. They’re ready to eat straight from the package, though we think their flavor and texture are even better after a quick stint in the toaster—the interior gets even softer and fluffier, and the exterior develops a bit of a bite. They’re sweet enough that they don’t technically need a sidecar of syrup, but really, the best way to enjoy them is the way that brings you the most enjoyment —right out of the bag on your drive to work, toasted and on a plate with eggs and bacon, or as a snack, any time of day.

You’ll find our Brioche Style Pancakes in the Bakery section, just waiting to save you time and satisfy your palate.

082739.item_story_marketing:
There are plenty of reasons to count oneself as a morning person: the serenity of a sunrise, the awe-inspiring glitter of the morning dew, the convenience of getting an early start to the day… But for our money, one reason stands head and shoulders above all others: Breakfast sandwiches. Perfected over decades of practice by burger joints and coffee shops the world over, the breakfast sandwich is the ultimate incentive for morning person-hood, and Trader Joe’s English Muffin Breakfast Sandwich may just be the epitome of its expression.

Each package comes with two Sandwiches made with tender, crisp-exterior, fluffy-interior English Muffins, layered with a hearty pork sausage patty, scrambled eggs, and melty Cheddar cheese. Once quickly and conveniently prepped in the microwave or air fryer, every bite is savory and full-flavored, with each Sandwich containing 18 grams of protein to set up the rest of your day for success. And here’s the best part: you don’t actually have to be a morning person to eat them, nor need they be strictly served at Breakfast! For a savory Sandwich that can be enjoyed anytime (and happens to be especially delicious in the morning), check out the freezer at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

082746.item_story_marketing:
Have you ever noticed how good the salsa is when you visit a taqueria? That salsa roja is usually handmade from an authentic recipe, presenting a balance of tangy, sweet, roasty, savory, and spicy notes that all work together to make an ideal taco topper. We’ve made Trader Joe’s Salsa Taquera in that same tradition, with the ultimate goal of bringing the taco stand salsa experience right to your table at home!

Our Salsa Taquera (literally, “taco sauce”) begins with a base of diced red tomatoes and blended tomatillos. Of course, we also include essential aromatics, such as onion and garlic purée, plus cilantro, for a hint of bright earthiness. Crucially, some concentrated mango purée boosts the orange color and partners with the sweetness of the tomatoes to balance the tangy tartness of the tomatillos. Finally, there’s the all-important trio of chilis: jalapeños and habañeros for heat, with roasted green chiles to add even more depth of flavor.

Trader Joe’s Salsa Taquera is ideal for dipping your favorite TJ’s chips, like Organic Blue Corn Tortilla Chips, or Organic Corn Chip Dippers. And you’ll want to add a hearty spoonful (or two!) on top of your street-style tacos made with Mini Sonora Style Tortillas, and our Carne Asada Autentica. You can even use Salsa Taquera to marinate your own meat before grilling, or as an ingredient in a homemade salad dressing.

082758.item_story_marketing:
Just as soon as autumn gets into full swing and we start to sense those cool winter breezes on the horizon, our thoughts turn to one thing and one thing only: comfort foods. (All right, fine, one category of things, we suppose). Creamy pastas, steamy casseroles, hearty soups—we simply can’t get enough of them when the weather starts to get a little chilly. And this year, we may have just concocted the comfort food of all comfort foods: Trader Joe’s Lasagna Soup with Turkey. Combining elements from some of our all-time favorite comfort food classics (Cheese! Pasta! Savory-seasoned Turkey!) all into one superlatively savory, rib-sticking Soup, this is a real game-changer for the Trader Joe’s refrigerated section. And it’s available from the late fall to the very end of winter—you know, comfort food season.

Each batch of our Lasagna Soup with Turkey starts with a creamy, savory-seasoned tomato broth, to which our supplier adds al dente mafalda pasta (which are a bit like miniature strips of Lasagna noodles), ground Turkey crumbles, and a bit of Asiago and Romano cheese. After a few minutes in the microwave or on the stovetop, this soup is steamy, aromatic, and totally ready to serve. It makes an easy entrée, especially when paired with some crusty bread or a light green salad (or both!), and really adds some comfy-cozy oomph when served as a side to any wintry, weeknight meal.

082762.item_story_marketing:
Just as Chinese cuisine has jiaozi and Japanese cuisine has gyoza, Korean cuisine has mandu. Estimated to have arrived in the Korean peninsula sometime in the 1500s, mandu come in a variety of shapes (some are circular, some are pyramidal, some look like little coin purses) and are stuffed with all sorts of savory fillings (pork, fish, and napa cabbage are especially common). Brought to us by a Korean supplier, Trader Joe’s Mandu have a flat, almost envelope-like shape, which makes them super easy to prep in a pan, and a satisfyingly spicy Kimchi and glass noodle filling, which makes them even easier to enjoy.

Indeed, after just a few minutes on each side in a hot pan with a bit of oil, these Mandu go from frozen to fantastically crisp, engrossingly aromatic, and ready to serve. They’re a truly convenient weeknight dinner option, especially when combined with rice and our Stir Fry Veggie Blend, and also make an excellent addition to a spread of Korean TJ’s favorites, including our Tteok Bok Ki and Kimbap. And whether they’re an appetizer or the entrée, these Kimchi Mandu take remarkably well to dipping in Yangnyeom or a quick mix of Soy Sauce and Rice Vinegar.

082774.item_story_marketing:
First created in French American bakeries in the 1970s (though which one exactly remains up for debate), the morning bun is experiencing a resurgence in recent days, and Trader Joe’s Morning Buns live up to the hype. Laminated dough (made through an intense process of rolling, layering with butter, folding, and repeating the steps many times) creates the delicate, flaky crust akin to a croissant. In fact, our Morning Buns are made with the very same dough as our Chocolate Croissants and Almond Croissants. The twenty divine layers of dough are then covered with a cinnamon and brown sugar mix that is accented by vibrant orange zest to awaken your sun-up senses. The dough is finally cut, rolled into Buns, frozen, and packaged, leaving just the proofing and baking to you. 

Before you go to bed, place each frozen Morning Bun on a baking tray in the provided paper cup and let rise at room temperature for 7-9 hours. In the Morning, the Buns will have about doubled in size, ready to bake in the oven a 375°F oven for 14-16 minutes. This “muffin” format makes it so easy to take a fresh-baked Bun with you as you rush out the door. On the other hand, you may find yourself unable to resist the flaky, buttery outsides and tender-as-a-pillow insides for even as long as it takes to get to the car—we heartily endorse enjoying as soon as desired!

082778.item_story_marketing:
Luxuriously long-grained and alluringly aromatic (its name comes from the Hindi word for “fragrant,” in fact), basmati rice is one of those staples that we like to have handy at all times. What we don’t always have handy are the tools (or the time!) to cook it from scratch, especially when we want to enjoy it as part of a work lunch or a quick, weeknight dinner. That’s why we offer our quick and convenient Trader Joe’s Organic Basmati Rice in our freezers. Each box contains three pouches of frozen Organic Basmati Rice, which, after just a few minutes in the microwave (or a little longer on the stovetop, if you’d prefer) are ready to be plated with all manner of proteins, accompany all kinds of curry, or soak up all sorts of sauces.

We find that this Rice is especially great for serving with our also-extremely-quick-and-convenient Indian Fare pouches, like Tikka Vegetables or Yellow Tadka Dal, as well as our Middle Eastern Style Kebabs. Since they’re so microwave-friendly, they also provide a shrewd shortcut for batch-prepping work lunches. And when winter rolls around, they also make an easy and time-saving addition to a pot of vegetable or chicken soup.

082779.item_story_marketing:
First invented near the dawn of the 18th century (or so food historians estimate), tempeh is a traditional Indonesian dish made from fermented legumes—most commonly soybeans—formed into a firm, savory cake, in a process that’s not entirely dissimilar to cheesemaking. We love tempeh at Trader Joe’s—we’ve carried an Organic 3 Grain Tempeh for more than fifteen years—but we’ve primarily known it as a vegetarian protein. So, when we learned that tempeh-based chips are super popular in Indonesia, we were intrigued. Then, we were determined. So we reached out to a supplier in Indonesia about making for us a savory, crispy, tempeh chip. And when they came back with what would eventually become Trader Joe’s Sweet Chili Black-Eyed Pea Tempeh Chips, we were overjoyed. 

The first twist in these Chips is that they’re made with Tempeh that’s made from fermented Black-Eyed Peas, as opposed to soybeans. Right off the bat, this gives the Tempeh a mild flavor and slightly starchier texture that takes exceptionally well to frying into a crispy Chip. The second twist is that they’re seasoned with a combo of sugar, Chili powder (which provides quite a kick!), and garlic, which ably complements the inherent umami notes of the Tempeh. It all results in a uniquely delicious Chip that can be enjoyed on its own, with a dip, or as a side for a sandwich, salad, or rice bowl.

082780.item_story_marketing:
Finding the time to prep a snack for yourself can be quite a challenge nowadays, and especially so in the morning. Between getting ready, getting the kids to school, and getting to work, there’s hardly any room for getting a snack ready. That’s why we love easy, on-the-go options like Trader Joe’s “PB & J” Oat Bites. These hearty, gluten-free treats have a dense and toothsome exterior (courtesy of lightly salted Peanut Butter and rolled, whole grain Oats—the first listed ingredient, we should mention) and sweet, fruity interior (courtesy of the strawberry filling inside), making them a super satisfying, sweet and savory snack for grabbing on your way out the door, and enjoying whenever the mood to munch strikes.

We recommend enjoying an Oat Bite on your morning commute, as a supplement to a packed lunch, or as a post-work pick-me-up on your way home. A treat for kids and adults alike, they’re also helpful for handing out on playdates, administering as a movie snack, or serving as a delicious distraction during long car rides. And since each box contains six Bites, they’re great for sharing with a group of friends or family while on vacation, or even just a weekend outing.

082814.item_story_marketing:
If you’re a regular in our coffee & tea aisle, you’re likely familiar with our rotating roster of limited-edition Small Lot Coffees—carefully sourced, single-origin offerings that tend to be available only in small quantities, and only for a short time. Now, thanks to our longstanding relationships with some exceptional growers, we’ve been able to secure a supply of Trader Joe’s Organic Mexico Chiapas Whole Bean Coffee large enough to offer every day. It captures the spirit of our Small Lot releases—high-quality, single-origin craftsmanship—only this time, it’s here to stay.

Coffee cultivation began in Mexico in the late 18th century and found especially strong footing in the southern state of Chiapas by the late 19th century—largely thanks to the region’s mountainous terrain, fertile soils, and high elevations. Organically grown in the Sierra Madre Mountains, the 100% Arabica beans inside each bag of TJ’s Organic Mexico Chiapas Coffee come from a cooperative of nearly 2,000 small, family farmers, who share resources, knowledge, and a commitment to environmental stewardship. This cooperative model supports thoughtful cultivation, community well-being, and—if the Coffee’s silky profile, effortless drinkability, and memorable notes of milk chocolate and stone fruit are any indication—a level of care and expertise that translates from mountain farm to morning cup.

Trader Joe’s Dewy Skin Serum is a real glow-getter... and we’re really, really excited about it. Made for us by an expert skincare supplier, it’s designed to offer soft, lightweight, layered hydration and to leave behind that smooth, lit-from-within, “glass skin” look. It’s dermatologist-formulated with not one, but four forms of hyaluronic acid to help skin attract and retain moisture, plus niacinamide to support the natural skin barrier and brighten uneven tones. Botanicals like sappan bark, rosehip fruit, and watermelon fruit extracts also offer a skin-soothing boost, while a touch of mica lends a luminous—but never sparkly—Dewy finish.

After cleansing (and toning, if that’s something you do—we recommend TJ’s Rose Water Facial Toner), apply a pea-sized amount of Dewy Skin Serum to the face and neck, lightly massaging it into the skin with your fingertips. Follow with an optional application of TJ’s Ultra Hydrating Gel Moisturizer and/or TJ’s Daily Facial Sunscreen, and you’re all set to face the day. (The Serum also layers beautifully under makeup, although its Dewy payoff might even inspire you to forgo additional enhancement!) Finally, before we stop singing this Serum’s praises, can we talk about this packaging?! Its pale purple box and pretty, pearlescent bottle are downright dreamy! It’s an eye-catching addition to any countertop or vanity, offering the look and feel of high-end, name-brand skincare—for a fraction of the price.

082842.item_story_marketing:
Great hair doesn’t happen by accident—it happens when the bonds that give hair its strength and structure are properly supported. To get that support, you need the proper products—like new Trader Joe’s Bonding Shampoo. Powered by plant-based bonding agents, it’s formulated with hydrolyzed keratin and silk to help nourish, hydrate, and ultimately encourage a smoother, shinier, and more resilient mane. Sulfate-free and gentle enough for everyday use, and safe for color-treated hair, it’s designed to strengthen without stripping and contains ingredients like panthenol and aloe to help maintain softness and manageability. Simply wash, rinse, and repeat if necessary, then follow with TJ’s Bonding Conditioner, style as usual (or don’t!), and prepare for compliments...

Professional-level bonding shampoos and conditioners often come with professional-level price tags. We’re talking upwards of $30—each. Not ours. Our Bonding Shampoo is designed for high-performance results at a price that feels almost too good to be true. Except (spoiler alert) it is true; the strongest bond of all is the bond between TJ’s and value. We’re able to focus on what goes into the bottle—not flashy ad campaigns or inflated markups—so you can focus on having your best hair day ever—every day!

082864.item_story_marketing:
We know mornings can be a scramble, and with that comes a culinary conundrum—a real breakfast bind, if you will: Do you risk tardiness to enjoy a truly tasty, made-from-scratch meal? Or, do you let the need for speed sideline your satisfaction? We say, neither—grab one of our brand-new Breakfast Bowls instead! With a Trader Joe’s Breakfast Bowl, time and taste are on your side... 

This savory, best-ever Breakfast Bowl offers a classic combination of fluffy scrambled eggs, tender roasted potatoes, melty Cheddar cheese, crumbled pork sausage and uncured bacon pieces We took our time developing this Bowl, tasting and testing until we got the balance of ingredients juuust right (a delicious errand, indeed). We even opted to add a creamy Cheddar-based cheese sauce to the recipe; it ties the various components together nicely, and prevents them from drying out when you heat the Bowl in the microwave. Speaking of which, since the Bowl comes fully cooked, you can take it from freezer to table in mere minutes—2-3 minutes in the microwave, plus 30 seconds to stand, and perhaps a few more for it to cool to your comfort level. Grab a fork and get ready: this Breakfast will Bowl you over at first bite!

082874.item_story_marketing:
Is there anything more indulgent than eating cookie dough? Admit it. You’ve skipped those twelve minutes in the oven for the immediate reward of rich, gooey-textured, sugary dough—each bite of which is frequently (and gleefully) interrupted by the soft-crunch of chocolate chips. Now... what if we told you that you could enjoy your cookie dough with ice cream, too? With the introduction of Trader Joe’s Cookie Dough Ice Cream Bites, that’s precisely what we are telling you!

Though it certainly took our supplier some ingenuity and skill to bring this Cookie-Ice Cream treat to life, the concept is rather simple: vanilla Ice Cream, wrapped in actual Cookie Dough. The best part about these Bites (aside from the eating experience), is that your only requirement for enjoying them involves reaching into your freezer, opening up the resealable pouch, and pulling out as many Bites as you want. There’s no need to measure ingredients or mix the Dough. And although they’re frozen, there’s no need to watch them thaw, either! Simply sink your teeth into the smooth, chilled, chocolate-chipped exterior to uncover the sweet creamy treat hidden inside.

Four or five Bites make amusing impromptu dessert for drop-in dinner guests—provided you serve immediately (they melt fairly fast). And thanks to their petite size, this whenever-you-walk-by-your-freezer snack lets you, calorically speaking, choose your own adventure! You’ll find 6.6 fluid-ounce bags of twelve Trader Joe’s Cookie Dough Ice Cream Bites in our freezers, every day.

082924.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Chicken Sausage Ravioli is made for us by a supplier who uses extra thin sheets of pasta to create the ideal, toothsome texture when cooked al dente. Each Raviolo is filled with a mix of savory seasoned chicken sausage and a blend of ricotta, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheeses, so that every bite is rich and full-flavored, to complement said satisfying texture. Together, a package takes only 3-4 minutes of cook time in boiling water before it’s ready to be served, and can be accessorized with your favorite pasta sauce, or even just quickly drizzled with EVOO. Add to that its amazing everyday value, and you’ve got proof that these Chicken Sausage Ravioli are a phenomenon in their own right.
082924.item_story_qil:
You may have heard of the biological concept where different species, significantly separated by geography 
and time, all independently and convergently evolve to have a crab-like body. (Hear us out, we promise this 
will eventually relate to ravioli.) It's called "carcinization," and it's an actual, observed phenomenon. If it has 
an equivalent in the culinary world, we'd argue it's the independent invention of stuffed, dumpling-like dishes 
across cultures and cuisines the world over. From Chinese jiaozi to Indian gujias, Polish pierogi to Puerto 
Rican pasteles, and, of course, Italian ravioli, the reason why both these dishes and the crab have proven so 
universally successful can likely be summed up in an age-old adage: if it works, it works. And on every level we 
can think of-taste, value, and convenience-Trader Joe's Chicken Sausage Ravioli simply work.

They're made for us by a supplier who uses extra thin sheets of pasta to create the ideal, toothsome texture when 
cooked al dente. Each Raviolo is filled with a mix of savory seasoned chicken sausage and a blend of ricotta, 
mozzarella, and Parmesan cheeses, so that every bite is rich and full-flavored, to complement said satisfying 
texture. Together, a package takes only 3-4 minutes of cook time in boiling water before it's ready to be served, 
and can be accessorized with your favorite pasta sauce, or even just quickly drizzled with EVOO. Add to that

082978.item_story_marketing:
If you struggle with lactose, you’re emphatically not alone—in fact, it’s estimated that approximately two out of every three people on the planet are at least somewhat lactose intolerant. Luckily, it’s never been easier to enjoy dairy products without having to worry about the effects of lactose, and Trader Joe’s Organic Lactose Free Reduced Fat Milk is just the latest in the field of daring dairy innovations. By simply increasing the amount of the enzyme lactase, which our supplier sources from yeast, they’re able to break lactose down, converting it into the more easily-digestible sugars glucose and galactose. This bit of dairy derring-do results in a rich, cool, and creamy Milk that’s every bit as flavorful and refreshing as standard milk—and also happens to be totally Lactose Free.

It’s not just the taste that’s the same—our Organic Lactose Free Reduced Fat Milk is also every bit as versatile as conventional milk. In addition to serving spectacularly well as a beverage at lunch and dinner, it also makes a great bowl of cereal at breakfast, a magnificent milkshake for dessert, and a capable creamer in your coffee or tea. We also love cooking with it: it’s ideal for Lactose Free baking, and when mixed with flour and lactose-free butter into a roux, makes an excellent ingredient in homemade soups, gravies, and other creamy sauces.

082993.item_story_marketing:
In the world of non-dairy beverage alternatives, before folks went nuts for almond, mad for macadamia, or out of their minds for oat, they were sweet on soy “milk.” Originally a by-product of tofu manufacturing and a staple of East Asian diets for thousands of years, its popularity in North America ebbed and flowed during the 1900s. Given the current popularity of Trader Joe’s Organic Non-Dairy Unsweetened Soy Beverage, it’s safe to say soy is in a flow state once again. With this in mind, we’re going with the flow and introducing a Vanilla variant to satisfy our customers’ collective thirst!

Made with just three ingredients (water, organic soybeans, and organic natural flavor), Trader Joe’s Organic Non-Dairy Unsweetened Vanilla Soy Beverage is mild, creamy, and ready to use in a bowl of cereal, a chai or matcha latte, a smoothie, a dairy-free baking recipe… you get the idea. Its subtle vanilla notes enhance, but never overpower its culinary destination, and it’s packed in a pantry-friendly carton so you can always satisfy a craving for soy. Did we mention it’s free of gluten, dairy, and lactose, it’s kosher-certified, and it’s vegan—and contains nine grams of protein per one-cup serving, to boot?! We’ll raise a glass of Organic Non-Dairy Unsweetened Vanilla Soy Beverage to that. (Don’t forget your favorite Trader Joe’s cookies for dunking.)

083000.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Chicken Breast Bites take grab-n-go to the next level! These Fully Cooked Bites of boneless Chicken Breast are not frozen, so they don’t require any heating at all. They’re unfussily Seasoned with garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then Cooked until tender and tasty—allowing you to enjoy them right out of the package, wherever your day takes you! Our reserved seasoning approach makes way for the flavorful Dipping Sauce—a complementary condiment that blends Honey, Mustard, white wine, and savory spices, including coriander and cumin.

Use the included bamboo skewer utensil to spear each juicy piece, dip it in the sweet-savory-tangy Sauce, and pop it in your mouth. It’ll be a welcome break from your regular sandwich or leftovers lunch routine. Boasting fewer calories per package than a typical energy bar, these Chicken Bites still promise 22 grams of protein to help power your afternoon tasks. If you have a heartier appetite, it’s super easy to pair these Bites with your favorite TJ’s salad, perhaps a Classic Greek, or Chickpea, Kale and Crispy Red Rice Salad. If it’s a hot lunch you want (and you’re not on-the-go), simply heat your TJ’s Chicken Breast Bites on a microwave-safe plate for about 30 seconds. Delicious!

083034.item_story_marketing:
What is Porridge Bread, you ask? Most importantly, it’s delicious. Heck, it may be the best thing since sliced bread. (Okay, it is sliced bread, but stay with us.) Inspired by the traditional morning fare of oat porridge with a drizzle of honey, Trader Joe’s Porridge Bread is made exclusively for us with a sourdough starter and a carefully calibrated combination of wheat flour, chewy rolled oats, and rye flour, balanced with the sweetness of honey and brown sugar.

Consider this the just right loaf for sandwiches and slices-on-the-side. (Stumped as to a pairing partner? Check out the tasty selection of soups in our refrigerators!) It’s a swell snack, toasted and topped with a swoosh of Whipped Feta Spread and a drizzle of your favorite TJ’s honey.

083041.item_story_marketing:
Tinned sardines are the hottest trend among foodies within the human population, so it was only a matter of time before our furry, four-legged friends got in in the fun, too! Made with just a single ingredient, Trader Joe’s Air-Dried Just Sardines come in a resealable bag, rather than a tin—we figured Fido and Fluffy wouldn’t mind, especially considering the increased convenience. They’re ideally sized for giving out one or two at a time, as a training reward, an incentive for good behavior, or a spontaneous, protein-packed little treat for being the best-est, most sweetest little guy or girl in the world—oh, yes they are, yes they are!

Ahem—pardon us. Just imagine—you’re indulging in a sea-cuterie board of TJ’s Sardines, Smoked Trout, or Calamari Pieces in Olive Oil, and you toss an Air-Dried Sardine to your canine and/or feline companion(s) to let them join in on the epicurean enjoyment. Finally! Something we can all agree on.

083089.item_story_marketing:
Believe it or not, Trader Joe’s Organic High Protein Super Firm Tofu has been a favorite in our refrigerators for 12 years and counting. What makes it so super? It starts with sprouted soybeans that have been triple-washed, soaked, and ground; after this mixture is heated, the soy curds are compressed to remove even more liquid than you would when making extra firm tofu—hence its Super Firm status. And while extra firm tofu offers nine grams of protein in a three-ounce serving, this Super Firm Tofu boasts an impressive 14 grams of protein for the same serving size—Super, indeed!

With its pleasantly mild flavor and dense (dare we say meat-like) texture that holds up beautifully when sliced, sautéed, grilled, or fried, this hearty Tofu is a proverbial blank slate for dips, sauces, and dressings of all kinds. Bread thick slices with Panko Breadcrumbs and air-fry for a filling vegan katsu, or sauté some Super Firm Tofu crumbles with Fire Roasted Bell Peppers & Onions and 21 Seasoning Salute for an egg-free, protein-packed breakfast (or breakfast-for-dinner) scramble.

083113.item_story_marketing:
Our freezers have long been a destination for waffle lovers, but until now, there’s been a notable gap: a truly plain waffle that plays well with everything. Trader Joe’s Toaster Waffles step neatly into that space. Made in Belgium (where they know a thing or two about waffles), these Waffles are built for the Toaster first and foremost; while classic Belgian waffles are thick with deep pockets, these are thinner, with shallow pockets. Crafted with whole eggs, wheat flour, and oat flour, they deliver a tender, satisfying bite and a subtle sweetness that works equally well with sweet or savory toppings.

Designed to go straight from freezer to toaster (or oven, or air fryer...), these Waffles crisp up quickly and evenly, emerging golden on the outside and tender on the inside. Keep things classic with butter and syrup, layer on fruit and yogurt, or take a savory turn with mashed avocado and a fried egg. Whether you’re craving breakfast, dessert, or anything in between, they’re a simple, sturdy staple you’ll be happy to have on hand. They’re also an incredible value, especially compared to the leading brand on the market. Not only are TJ’s Toaster Waffles tastier, they offer more protein per serving and feature a far less lengthy ingredients list— which is to say, much of their value lies in what they don’t have. (Like artifical food dyes, for example—we’ll never waffle on that one.) In a Waffle-on-waffle competition, the odds are stacked in our favor.

083116.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Diamond Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Rutherford Napa Valley Lot 11 is an impressive wine with a notable pedigree. It comes to us from Rutherford, in the middle of California’s Napa Valley. Like the Diamond Reserve offerings that have come before it, this 2023 vintage is a best-in-class wine whose price belies its truly excellent quality. The Cabernet Sauvignon grapes used to make this wine come from a highly-sought-after Rutherford vineyard—as part of the deal that allowed us to offer this wine at such a stellar price, we agreed not to reveal the source of these grapes—and the winemaking team is equally renowned. Here, they’ve produced a wine that opens with notes of dark berries, black currant, and deep plum, and leads to flavors ranging from berries and cocoa to woody spices like cedar and clove, with a touch of vanilla on the smooth, lingering finish. This is a wine to enjoy with bold, rich foods like braised meats, creamy Risotto, and hearty roasted vegetables. For cheese pairing, this wine is ideal alongside our English Cheddar with Champagne.
 
This Diamond Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon is available in limited quantities, and as no two vintages of any wine are alike, when this one is gone, it won’t be coming back. If you’re an oenophile, we recommend buying extra bottles for cellaring. This one will only continue to improve with age!
083116.item_story_qil:
TJ's Diamond Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Rutherford Lot 11 embodies the legendary Rutherford 
appellation, where the valley's renowned dust mingles with mountain influence to create wines of remarkable 
depth and structure. While we cannot list the name, a prestigious vineyard sought out by many winemakers was 
the source of the grapes used for this wine. The 2023 vintage showcases the AVA's signature power wrapped in 
elegant sophistication. The wine opens with alluring aromas of blackcurrant, dark cherry, and ripe blackberry, 
layered with notes of cedar, tobacco leaf, and a whisper of dried violet. On the palate, concentrated dark fruit 
flavors of black plum and cassis are revealed with impressive intensity, supported by fine-grained tannins that 
provide both structure and silky texture. Mid-palate richness unfolds with hints of cocoa, espresso, and baking 
spices, while subtle oak integration adds vanilla and toasted notes without overwhelming the fruit. The finish is 
long and persistent, leaving traces of dark chocolate and savory herbs that invite the next sip. 

This robust Cabernet demands equally substantial cuisine. Pair it with grilled ribeye or prime New York 
strip, where the wine's tannins cut through marbled fat beautifully. Braised short ribs or lamb shanks 
complement its earthy undertones, while aged hard cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano or aged cheddar make 
excellent companions. For a vegetarian option, consider portobello mushroom steaks or eggplant parmesan 
with rich tomato sauce. Decant for thirty minutes before serving at 60-65°F to fully appreciate this Rutherford 
masterpiece's complexity and aging potential.

083154.item_story_marketing:
The zesty, aromatic, unmistakable flavor of Ginger makes dozens of dishes delicious, from Thai stir-fries to Indian curries. It’s also unmistakably difficult to prep, stemming from its knobby, irregular shape and tight-fitting skin. Having experienced Ginger’s kitchen challenges firsthand, our Produce team developed Trader Joe’s Organic Peeled Ginger as a boon to fresh-Ginger aficionados everywhere!

Our Organic Ginger is grown in Peru—a tropical climate, not unlike Ginger’s native Southeast Asia. It’s harvested and delivered to the U.S., where our supplier fastidiously peels each bulb, so you don’t have to. Four-ounce portions of whole, Peeled Ginger are then vacuum-sealed, ready for slicing or grating right out of the package. Put it in smoothies, steep it in tea, combine it with garlic to create a flavorful base for all kinds of savory recipes.

And if you’re looking for even more convenience, take note that an unopened and refrigerated package of Trader Joe’s Organic Peeled Ginger will stay fresh up to 45 days (and seven days once opened). Also of timely note: every day, you’ll find those four-ounce re-sealable packages in our refrigerators.

083160.item_story_marketing:
There are times when a singularly focused ice cream flavor is all that will satisfy your sweet tooth, and other times when ice cream merely serves as a carrier of sorts for candy bits and cookie baubles, the combination of which scratches the itch for a sweet sundae craving. If you’ve got a hankering for the latter, we’ve got the “how-to satisfy”: Trader Joe’s All Mixed Up Ice Cream!

Starting with a base of creamy vanilla Ice Cream generously swirled with peanut butter, each pint of All Mixed Up brings the dessert fun in spades—or should we say scoops? It’s chock-full of sweet treats galore: chocolate sandwich creme cookie pieces, candy coated pretzels, mini chocolate peanut butter cups, and a heaping helping of rainbow sprinkles. Each bite is a study in cool, sweet creaminess contrasted with a kaleidoscope of textures, all of it amplified by the savory edge of the peanut butter. Yum. Enjoy it right out of the container, or go for sundae gold with a drizzle of Midnight Moo, sliced Bananas, and Chocolate Whipped Cream. You’ll find pints of All Mixed Up Ice Cream in the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s every day, for a mere fraction of what you’d pay for a similar creation at the ice cream shop!

083163.item_story_marketing:
If you’ll allow us to get on our soapbox for just a minute... We believe a good hand soap really just needs to do two things: clean your hands and leave them smelling nice. Trader Joe’s Clementine Scented Foaming Hand Soap lives up to this soap standard. The Soap includes a coconut-based surfactant (surface active agent), which lowers the tension between molecules, while also bonding to others—effectively working under the surface (well actually, ON the surface!) to really clean dirty hands, even hands that are not visibly dirty. What’s more, it’s made without parabens, sulfates, or dyes!

Pump once or twice into wet hands and you’ll see the liquid transform into a silky Foam. As you rub your hands together, working it into a rich lather, you’ll be greeted by bright citrus tangerina extract and a reviving fragrance reminiscent of juicy Clementine. Rinse your hands thoroughly and that energizing aroma lingers, leaving you with a refreshed, clean feeling. What’s the ‘even more,’ beyond the clean, nice-smelling hands? It’s the serene, sun-soaked Mediterranean vibe the blue & white motif on the bottle brings to your bathroom or kitchen counter. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Clementine Scented Foaming Hand Soap on the shelves with our other household goods, every day.

083168.item_story_marketing:
When the craving strikes for something sweet and sparkly to sip, why not pick something with Prebiotics? (Prebiotics, we should mention, are foods and drinks that contain nutrients for your beneficial gut bacteria, as opposed to probiotics, which introduce actual live bacteria into your system.) Trader Joe’s Cherry Cola Prebiotic Soda, for instance, provides a nice boost to your gut biome in the form of agave inulin, in addition to providing a sweet and tasty pick-me-up to your palate. Made with a recipe that also includes Cherry juice, cane sugar, apple cider vinegar, and stevia, it’s a classically sweet and fizzy Cola drink that can be enjoyed in all kinds of contexts, be it in a packed lunch, a picnic, or as part of a quick and easy cocktail mocktail.

Combining a candy-sweet profile and gut-friendly fiber, and containing just 5g of total sugar per can, Trader Joe’s Cherry Cola Prebiotic Soda is about as practical as a soda pop gets. It’s great right out of the can, serves exceptionally well in a glass, over ice, and makes an ideal accompaniment to a cheeseburger, pizza, or popcorn, especially when sipped on during a movie night at home.

083177.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Steel Cut Oatmeal comes in a box of two individual servings, each with 150 calories and five grams of protein. When frozen, each serving looks a bit like a thick, oatmeal-colored hockey puck. When you’re enjoying a fluffy bowl of steel cut oatmeal three minutes or so after the craving hits, you may feel a bit puckish yourself. This Oatmeal is an unpretentious combination of oats, water, maple syrup, brown sugar, and salt. It has some sweetness, but it’s not too sweet (seven grams of sugar per serving); probably very similar to what you’d make if you started from scratch. Of course, you don’t have to start from scratch, because we took care of that for you. We do things like that. You know, to make your life easier. It’s fun.

083189.item_story_marketing:
Fried Rice is an ancient dish, ostensibly created as a thrifty way to enjoy left-over food. Over the years, it has joyfully evolved to become a celebrated cuisine in its own right, marked by its ability to incorporate a variety of ingredients—meats, vegetables, and even different kinds of rice.

We created Trader Joe’s BBQ Pork Fried Rice in the style of traditional Cha Siu (literally “fork roasted”) Pork, with a marinade that not only imparts sweet & savory flavors, but also leaves behind a characteristically red-hue. (One of the few ways we did deviate from tradition is by our use of beet juice powder for color, instead of the artificial food coloring often found in restaurant recipes.) The barbecued Pork is combined with prepared, long-grain Rice, along with a host of veggies, including green onions, sweet corn, peas, red bell peppers, and carrots—before it’s all quick-frozen, packaged, and sent to our stores.

After just 6 to 7 minutes in your skillet at home, the delicious flavors are awakened, and all of the vibrant colors come to life. Celebrate this Pork Fried Rice, dim-sum style, when you serve it along with a spread of Chicken Shu Mai, Vegetable Dumplings, and Cha Siu Bao.

083191.item_story_marketing:
We certainly won’t be the first to tell you that everything can be improved with a little bit of bacon. And now that Trader Joe’s Uncured Bacon Bits have hit the scene, we definitely won’t be the last. That’s because these Bacon Bits are a genuine game-changer. Each pouch contains rich, smoky, and precisely-as-fatty-as-it-needs- to-be Bacon, fully cooked and crumbled into ready-to-sprinkle Bits. And because the Bacon our supplier uses is Uncured, it contains no added nitrates or nitrites, except those that occur naturally in sea salt and cultured celery powder.

Now, to our first precept: truly, everything can be improved with Trader Joe’s Uncured Bacon Bits. At the breakfast table, they plus up egg scrambles, omelets, hashes, and pancake batter. At lunch, they instantly improve a salad, soup, instant ramen, or leftover pasta. At dinner, there’s nothing better than a baked potato, burrito, casserole, or classic Cheddar Macaroni & Cheese that’s been generously sprinkeld with Bacon Bits. And that’s before we get to dessert: if you’ve never tried a Blondie Bar, Cinnamon Roll, or bowl of French Vanilla Ice Cream topped with Bacon Bits before: now’s the time.

083229.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Chicken Meatballs are made with all natural, minimally processed chicken thigh and breast meat that was raised with no antibiotics ever. The Chicken is ground and mixed with mild Monterey Jack Cheese and a classic Buffalo Style seasoning, then fully cooked. To enjoy, just heat them in an air fryer at 400ºF for four minutes. What do you have in your pockets right now? Keys? Coins? A Trader Joe’s gift card? Right now, in our Pockets we have Uncured Ham and Swiss Cheese! Of course, we’re talking about a new ready-to-heat-and-eat savory pastry in our freezers.

These Pockets are fashioned from croissant dough and filled with Uncured Ham and Swiss Cheese. Transfer them (there are two per box) from freezer to air fryer, oven, or microwave and in a matter of minutes, you’ll have a hot pastry that is buttery and super-flaky on the outside (especially when warmed in an air fryer) and satisfyingly savory and cheesy on the inside. These handy Pockets make a wonderfully hearty breakfast—at home or on the go—and they also work quite well as a brunch option, alongside a spread of your favorite eggs and fruit. Or keep them in your back-pocket (so to speak) as a last-minute lunch on those days when assembling a sandwich feels like too much work.

While you may not be able to actually keep Trader Joe’s Uncured Ham & Swiss Cheese Pockets in your pocket, you can certainly keep a box or two in your freezer at home, ready for whenever you’re craving a savory, café-style pastry.

083233.item_story_marketing:
Ah, tiramisu! That lush last course, luring even the fullest diners with layers of coffee-soaked ladyfingers and rich mascarpone cream. Customers love our traditional Tiramisu. So we thought, why not iterate upon that for a special summer treat? Indeed, Trader Joe’s Lemon Tiramisu has arrived with its lemony allure, promising to be a real pick-me-up for these sun-kissed days.

Our Italian supplier (who also makes our traditional Tiramisu), begins with ladyfinger biscuits, soaked with refreshingly sweet lemon syrup, rather than coffee. The moist, cake-like ladyfingers are then layered with puckery lemon curd, and creamy, lemon-infused mascarpone cheese. No assembly or baking is required to enjoy this sweet, bracing treat—just a little forethought. Remove the frozen Tiramisu (one or both of the individual servings) from its outer packaging and place it in your refrigerator to thaw for about eight hours. After that, you’re ready to dig in! (For a more elegant presentation, remove all packaging, turning the frozen Tiramisu out on a plate before thawing.)

083236.item_story_marketing:
Last holiday season, we introduced a Trio of Italian Pasta Sauce, a tasty, giftable triptych of tomato-based pasta sauces. While all three members of the Trio proved to be hits among our customers, we couldn’t help but be extra intrigued by the sauce that showcased the richness and sweet, juicy profile of Datterino cherry tomatoes from Puglia, Italy. So, when we learned that we could offer a single, larger jar of this special sauce for an equally unbeatable value, we jumped at the chance. 

Trader Joe’s Caro Sugo Datterino Cherry Tomatoes & Roasted Garlic Pasta Sauce is available only in our stores for a limited time. We find that its combo of Puglian Datterinos (or “little dates,” so named for their date-like appearance) and rich Roasted Garlic (along with basil, sea salt, and onions) gives it a bright, bursting flavor profile that synergizes fantastically well with all sorts of pasta shapes. Of course, that’s just where we’d start: you may find your Datterino Sauce destined to be used in a lasagna, on a homemade pizza, or as a full-flavored dipping sauce for some air-fried Breaded Mozzarella Cheese Sticks.

083237.item_story_marketing:
When you really think about it (and goodness knows, we’ve really thought about it), ice cream-filled mochi might be one of the most ingeniously designed desserts of all time. On both a practical level (the way the chewy, sweetened rice dough creates a finger-friendly barrier around the melty ice cream) and an artistic level (the way the mochi and the ice cream provide a delightfully two-toned taste and textural experience), mochi is a marvel. And of course, one of our favorite aspects of its clever construction is the way it invites exploration with all sorts of flavors, from the classic to the cutting-edge. We invite you to consider this by way of enjoying our newest exploration within the mochi medium, Trader Joe’s Salted Caramel Mochi.

Each bite starts with the sweet, tooth-sinking sensations of the outer Mochi layer, which quickly gives way to the rich, full-flavored, and buttery-sweet Salted Caramel ice cream within. It’s a simple treat—brilliantly so, we’d say—and one that can be enjoyed in all kinds of contexts that call for something sweet. We particularly like them as an easy after-dinner dessert, and especially so when served with a cup of hot coffee or cold, creamy milk tea. Just be sure to let them sit outside of the freezer for a few minutes prior to enjoying.
083237.name: MOCHI SALTED CARAMEL

083239.item_story_marketing:
When you first unseal a bag of our latest Os iteration, your olfactory (or should we say, “O-factory) is hit with a tidal wave of Vanilla. Eyes closed, you might imagine you’re catching a whiff of the buttercream frosting on our Chantilly Cream Vanilla Bean Mini Sheet Cake. In one sense, you might as well be, since both contain actual ground Vanilla beans. This should be moderately impressive, given the fact that Vanilla is the world’s second-most expensive spice after saffron, due to the labor-intensive process involved in growing the orchids that supply the Vanilla seeds. 

More to the immediate point... taken as a whole (or should we say, “in a b-O-wl”), we think Trader Joe’s Vanilla Os are more than just ‘moderately’ impressive. Whole grain oat flour is the first ingredient, providing 25 grams of whole grain per every 1 ¼ cup serving. These Os also deliver five essential B vitamins, including: B1 (thiamine), B3 (niacin), B5 (pantothenic acid), B6 (pyridoxine), and B9 (folate). Furthermore, the authentic Vanilla flavor of these Os is buoyed by a fair amount of sugar, carefully calculated to please even the pickiest of kids’ palates; as will their donut-shaped construction that buoys them in your bowl, fits in tiny hands, and helps to maintain a superior crunch.

If you’re a cereal fan, you owe (or should we say, “O”) it to yourself to pick up a box for breakfast tomorrow. (Save the Mini Sheet Cake for dessert.) You’ll find Trader Joe’s Vanilla Os in our cereal section, every day.

083241.item_story_marketing:
Like a collection of greatest hits from the Mediterranean gastronomic canon, Trader Joe’s Greek Style Chicken Salad is packed with tender artichoke hearts, tangy sundried tomatoes, and briny Kalamata olives, all set against a backdrop of savory-seasoned, roasted and pulled white Chicken meat. To finish each batch, our supplier also adds bits of garlic, parsley, and dill, then mixes it all together with mayo and lemon juice for a Chicken Salad that’s zesty, tart, herby, toothsome, hearty, and phenomenally full-flavored, all at once. And as if that weren’t enough, its also ready to enjoy as an entrée, topping, sandwich filling, or snack, right out of the package.

Available in our refrigerators every day, Trader Joe’s Greek Style Chicken Salad makes a lovely lunch option when scooped into lettuce cups, spread onto a Pretzel Bun or croissant, or even simply eaten on its own with a fork. It makes it an especially smart choice to use as a topper for salad greens or a sliced tomato, and as an appetizer, it serves splendidly with crackers, crudités, and bits of Pita or Lavash.

083284.item_story_marketing:
While its name might seem generic, or even redundant (aren’t all salads chopped, in some manner or another?), the chopped salad has a rather specific history, originating in Beverly Hills during the Golden Age of Hollywood. It’s said that its inventor, conscious of the finery worn by the stars that frequented his restaurant, first served a salad where every ingredient had been chopped into bite-sized pieces as a way to minimize mess. In the decades since, the chopped salad has retained a certain sense of elegance, maintaining a presence on trendy bistro menus the world over. For our part, we’re happy to add a bit of convenience to its long legacy via the introduction of Trader Joe’s Chopped Salad Blend to our produce section. 

Made with a mix of finely chopped bits of peppery escarole, earthy endive, crunchy red cabbage, lightly spicy radicchio, and slightly sweet carrot, this expertly balanced Blend works wonderfully as a base for an easy side salad on any given weeknight. Simply toss with your favorite dressing (like our Organic Italian) and toppings (like our Rosemary Croissant Croutons), and you’re all set. And if you want to make a meal out of that salad, just add your favorite protein to the proceedings—we’re particularly fond of featuring Organic Garbanzo Beans and diced Uncured Applewood Smoked Salami.

083288.item_story_marketing:
A breakfast with Trader Joe’s Ground Country Style Pork Sausage is truly a treat for all five senses. As it crisps up the skillet, there’s the sound of its sizzle, along with the aroma of its herby, meaty flavors coming into focus. It’s a sight for sore eyes once plated, especially when paired with some fluffy scrambled eggs and salted Hash Browns. Then, of course, on the palate, it has a hearty, delightfully coarse-Ground texture, as well as a terrifically toothsome taste. It’s the kind of protein that proves breakfast may just be the most important meal of the day, after all.

That said, we find breakfast to be just the beginning for our Country Style Pork Sausage: it’s also an awesome ingredient in lasagnas, casseroles, pasta sauces, and stuffing. It makes a magnificent topping for a homemade pizza, and when mixed with ground beef, adds all sorts of savory flavor and richness to meatballs, burgers, and more. And if we may return to the breakfast table for a bit, they’re also a key component for biscuits and gravy, a Scotch egg, or a fun and filling breakfast burrito.

083292.item_story_marketing:
What can we say? We’re on a roll! After the runaway success of our Chili & Lime Flavored Rolled Corn Tortilla Chips, including their record-breakingly early entry into the Trader Joe’s Product Hall of Fame, we knew that they needed a companion within the snacks section. We asked our supplier to rustle up the best ranch flavor they could muster, and after one bite (and a few more handfuls, for science), our tasting panel was convinced: Trader Joe’s Ranch Flavored Rolled Corn Tortilla Chips are ready to be the next big thing. Giddyup!

Where their Chile Lime cousins are tangy and hot, these Ranch Rolled Tortilla Chips are creamy, herby, and well-rounded. They get their bold, yet markedly mellow flavor via a suite of savory seasonings and spices, including buttermilk, garlic powder, onion powder, and parsley. While we find this profile makes them well suited to solo snacking, we’d be remiss if we didn’t mention how well they pair with a nice dip—our Organic Chunky Homestyle Guacamole is an especially apt complement to their Ranch notes and resounding crunch. Roll on up to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s to wrangle yourself a bag today!

083295.item_story_marketing:
We’ve tasted a lot of granola over the years, and in that time, we’ve established a certain set of expectations. To that end, when we first tried Trader Joe’s Salted Almond Honey Granola, we definitely expected the Salt and the Almonds to work well together, and we certainly expected the Almonds and the Honey to complement one another. What really took us by surprise, though, was how much the Salt and the Honey synergized with each other! And when a granola can surprise you, you know you’ve got something special on your hands.

Indeed, Trader Joe’s Salted Almond Honey Granola is quite special, particularly in the way that its unique, sweet-salty interplay is captured within the context of crunchy Almonds and Granola clusters. It’s an epicurean interaction that adds something elegant to an everyday breakfast bowl with milk (or a non-dairy beverage), and provides a profound pop of flavor when layered into a parfait. With its sweet and semi-savory notes and nutty Almond overtones, it also brings a bit of oomph to an açai bowl, gives texture to a roasted sweet potato, and makes an intriguing alternative to croutons in a spinach salad. Frankly, we enjoy simply snacking on them by the handful—but that likely comes as no surprise.

083311.item_story_marketing:
For many of the dairy-free population, Greek yogurt is one of those hard to replace staples. Whether you enjoy those individual-serving containers, or you buy the big tub for daily breakfasts—thick, creamy, yogurt is tough to beat… And now, you can enjoy the taste of Greek yogurt in Trader Joe’s Organic Greek Style Mixed Berry Cashew Coconut Cultured Yogurt Alternative.

It’s called “Yogurt Alternative” because there is absolutely no dairy in this product, and it’s Greek-style is thanks to its thick, creamy consistency, tart & tangy flavor. Starting with a base made from organic cashews, the mixture is thickened with organic coconut cream and organic cornstarch, then sweetened with organic cane sugar. Our supplier then incorporates organic rice-derived protein, a little organic lemon juice to promote the tang, while actual organic blueberries and raspberries add the mixed berry flavor.

This dairy-free Greek-style yogurt offers a bright and refreshing flavor, 10g of organic rice-derived protein, and billions of live probiotics. After pasteurizing this Greek Style Cashew Coconut Yogurt Alternative, our supplier adds six, live and active probiotics—just like dairy yogurt has—so you can still reap those good- bacteria benefits. Use as a base for a yogurt bowl topped with granola and mixed berries, or enjoy on its own as a snack.

083314.item_story_marketing:
When your schedule’s overstuffed, and making a meal from scratch starts to feel insurmountable, we have the ideal, heat-and-eat entrée to put some pep back in your step: Trader Joe’s Stuffed Poblano Peppers. Each package contains two savory, mildly spicy Poblano Pepper halves, which our supplier has Stuffed with a zesty, flavorful mix of soft brown rice, fresh and tender corn kernels, and hearty white chicken meat. They finish this melange with a creamy, herby cilantro sauce, and top each Pepper with a layer of melty Monterey jack cheese. The result is similar to an open-faced, unbattered version of a classic chile relleno, with a marvelous medley of flavors, textures, and aromatics in every bite. 

Since it only takes a few minutes in the microwave (or a touch longer in the conventional oven) before they’re steamy and ready to enjoy, these Stuffed Poblano Peppers are especially suited to situations when you need something quick and satisfying. They’re just the right size to enjoy on their own as an easy work lunch, and they make a spectacular center of the plate option for an effortless weeknight dinner. And to make more of a complete meal, they accessorize excellently with a side salad, some Spicy Spuds or quickly sautéed Organic Black Beans sprinkled with crumbled Cotija cheese.

083323.item_story_marketing:
Chocolate bark is a confection whose very construction invites experimentation—it’s one of the many reasons we love it so much. Unfettered from the strictures of a bar or bonbon structure, chocolate bark is allowed to be a pure expression of flavor, and, more importantly, flavor combinations, which are all the more enhanced by the irregularity of its shattered, jigsaw-like presentation. Nowhere is this more evident than in our newest foray into the form, Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Bark with Pistachios, Dried Jalapeños, & Sea Salt.

Now, separately, the four elements of Dark Chocolate, Pistachios, Jalapeños, and Sea Salt may make utterly intuitive pairings with one another. But it’s only within the context of this Bark that this curious combination gets to shine together. And so, every bite becomes a symphony of rich, buttery, nutty, grassy, spicy, savory, and sweet, all at once. We recommend savoring this unique Bark-with-a-bite alongside a cup of coffee, a glass of red wine, or an equally unique cheese from our cheese case.

083368.item_story_marketing:
As a company, one of our guiding values is the concept of kaizen, a business practice popularized in Japan in the middle of the 20th century that emphasizes continuous, incremental improvement. It can be something as small as finding an easier way to build an endcap display, or something as big as taking a look at our snacks section and realizing “wait a minute—how long has it been since we offered a BBQ potato chip?!” This latter example took our buyers on a journey that eventually led us to Trader Joe’s BBQ Flavored Potato Chips.

They’re made for us by an esteemed snack supplier, who slices their Potatoes in such a way as to maximize their broad, bountiful surface area and provide a resounding crunch with every bite. They also use a truly bold and full-flavored suite of BBQ sauce-inspired seasonings, which includes a mix of molasses, onion, and garlic, and even a touch of cinnamon and clove. It all results in a profoundly tasty Chip, the kind that pairs wonderfully with hot dogs, burgers, and grilled fare of all sorts; that dunks dependably into creamy dips; and that we’re proud to have representing our BBQ bona fides on the Trader Joe’s snack shelf.

083371.item_story_marketing:
If fruit had personalities, we’d like to think that apples and cherries would be fast friends. They have so much in common, after all! Both come from trees that blossom beautifully in the spring, both are delicious in pastries, pies, and other baked desserts, and both have notable (and well-loved) sour varietals, like Granny Smith and Montmorency. It’s this last bit of potential compatability that inspired Trader Joe’s Organic Sour Apple Cherry Fruit Leather Wraps, the latest addition to our line of fun and flavorful Fruit Leathers. Made with a base of Organic Apple, Cherry, and elderberry juices, which are then dried to a soft, chewy, and satisfying texture, these Wraps represent a harmonious meeting of sweet and Sour that lets the personalites of both featured fruits truly shine.

These tart and tangy Wraps make superb snacks for all sorts of occasions, and we especially like packing them into a school or work lunch as an alternative to candy or cookies. And if you’re looking for a great pick-me-up on a long road trip, plane ride, or even your everyday (seemingly interminable) commute, look no further than these Wraps. Because they’re both so kid-friendly and remarkably reasonable in price, they’re also an easy choice for buying by the handful and distributing out at sports practices and playdates.

083386.item_story_marketing:
Hot Honey is fire right now! At Trader Joe’s, alone, this trending taste has already appeared in fudge, goat cheese, salad dressing, and popcorn. Where do you think Hot Honey will show up next? Spoiler alert: Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Mustard is now available on our shelves, ready to light up your burgers, hot dogs, and other mustard-friendly fare with plenty of lip-smacking flavor.

This kosher condiment contains only familiar ingredients you can pronounce; things like Mustard seeds, white vinegar, salt, sugar, mayonnaise, cayenne pepper powder, and of course, Honey. It’s an ideal balance of spicy-Hot and Honey-sweet, with just the right amount of tangy, pungent Mustard to create your new favorite food accompaniment.

By the way, there’s really no reason to limit your application to hamburgers and hot dogs; a condiment this good demands broad and liberal use! Dip Soft Pretzel Sticks. Make a Chicken drumstick marinade. Drizzle it over grilled Organic Asparagus. Spread on a Pastrami sandwich. Garnish your Pork Tenderloin. You’ll find convenient squeeze bottles of Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Mustard on our grocery shelves. Grab some while it’s hot—which is to say: today, tomorrow, and every day!

083415.item_story_marketing:
New York-style. Japanese soufflé. No-bake. Chicago-style. Ricotta. The concept of cheesecake dates back thousands of years, with cultures the world over putting their spin on this rich dessert. A relative newcomer to the list, Basque cheesecake came to be in the late 1980s, in a small Spanish restaurant. The recipe’s creator eschewed crust and toppings due to limited kitchen space, and baked the cream cheese-based custard mixture in a very hot oven, the end result being a simple dessert with a beautifully burnished crust and jiggly center. Trader Joe’s Basque Style Cheesecakes are a nod to the original, and make it possible to enjoy this iconic Spanish treat in the comfort of your home kitchen.

Made for us in Spain in the Basque Style, these luscious Cheesecakes boast the signature, slightly burned exterior and impossibly creamy interior of the namesake dessert. The only thing standing between you and Cheesecake bliss is a few hours of thawing in the refrigerator! Enjoy as-is for a fuss-free dessert, or alongside a glass of tawny Port or Joseph Händler Riesling. If you can find a slice of this cheesecake on a restaurant menu, it’ll set you back more than a few Euros—but you’ll find packages of two gluten free Basque Style Cheesecakes in the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, for a mere fraction of the price. Bask in the value!

083417.item_story_marketing:
Despite what its name might lead you to believe, Summer Sausage is actually a savory treat suitable for any time of year. It simply gets its seasonal moniker from the fact that, unlike most other sausages, it can be stored at room temperature prior to opening, even during the hotter months of the year. Somewhat paradoxically, this aspect historically made Summer Sausage a traditional gift for the winter holidays within many cultures, as recipients would relish the opportunity to keep them preserved in their pantry until the summer months rolled around. Of course, we don’t carry this Beef Summer Sausage from the folks at Old Wisconsin® for its shelf stable status (although, that is a nice plus!)—we carry it because it’s delicious. 

Slow-smoked over hardwood and seasoned with traditional savory spices, Old Wisconsin® Beef Summer Sausage makes superb (and quick!) snack, either enjoyed solo or paired with your favorite TJ’s crackers and cheese. We truly mean it when we say it’s great any time of year, by the way. Try adding it to an appetizer spread when friends are over for a spring brunch. In the summer, use it to top a pasta salad at a barbecue. It’s an excellent ingredient for a hearty hot dish, and an able alternative to pepperoni on a pizza. It’s also quite at home on an hors d’oeuvres table at a holiday feast.

083495.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Mango Black Tea has been gracing our coffee & tea section for more than nine years, lifetimes in Trader Joe’s years. What is it that makes Mango Black Tea such a stalwart on our shelves? It’s just delicious. But why is it delicious? That’s all about what’s inside each tempting tea bag.

Our Mango Black Tea supplier sources full-flavored black teas from some of the world’s best tea-growing regions – central Africa; Assam, India; and Indonesia. Each of these regions produces teas that convey differ- ent characteristics; bright & invigorating (central Africa), robust & malty (Assam), hearty & medium-bodied (Indonesia). Combined, they create a flavor profile that delivers well-rounded flavors for a lively, bright, and balanced cup. Then, of course, there’s the mango. Here, our supplier has employed natural mango flavor, imparting a hint of the tropics without making the tea overwhelmingly fruity. As we said earlier, it’s just deli- cious. Serve it hot or cold (we recommend steeping it hot before icing for best results) – it’s mango-licious either way!

To prove the point, consider our latest offering, Trader Joe’s Ooey Gooey Cheese Blend. It’s a killer-diller combination of nutty gruyere, mild yellow Cheddar, sharp white Cheddar, and buttery Havarti. Far from namby-pamby, this creamy dreamy combo is the Ooiest and Gooiest we could find, based on our research.

083524.item_story_marketing:
Whether you’re making a quick weeknight dinner, putting together a weekend lunch, or meal-prepping for the week ahead, it’s always a good idea to have some pre-cooked chicken breast on hand. In addition to it being a positive powerhouse of protein, chicken breast is also incredibly good at holding on to all kinds of flavors, making it a potential powerhouse of flavor, too. Both of these aspects are particularly present in Trader Joe’s Grilled Chili Lime Chicken Breast, a longtime favorite of our Midwest stores, and that can now be found in our East Coast stores, too!

Made with a blend of seasonings that includes chili powder, paprika, dried garlic, cumin, as well as a touch of lime juice concentrate, each bite of this pre-cooked, pre-sliced, and ready-to-eat Chicken Breast is bursting with savory and citric notes. It can be enjoyed as a topper for a salad, rice bowl, or pasta, as a filling for a sandwich, burrito, or omelet, and even heated up with sautéed onions and peppers for a super easy fajita meal. And for those watching your macros, here’s another reason to be excited: each serving contains a whopping 24g of protein!

083530.item_story_marketing:
There's something beautiful to us about the dialectical quandry presented by the pretzel. On one end of the pretzel spectrum, you have the big, soft, freshly baked form. On the other, the tiny, crisp and crunchy twist form. While both are undeniably pretzels, they couldn't be more different. Yet in their differences, they somehow embody the ideal of their forms—soft pretzels are superlatively soft, while Trader Joe's Sweet Onion Style Pretzel Twists, for instance, are consummately crisp and crunchy. And in the case of the latter, our supplier has also flavored these totally tasty Twists with an alluringly aromatic and umami-tinged Sweet Onion Style seasoning to accentuate the satisfying snap in their texture even further.

Speaking of ideals, we find that our Sweet Onion Style Pretzel Twists make optimal accessories to sandwiches, burgers, and, of course, a frosty glass of beer, where their Sweet, salty, and allium-rich notes will truly sing. They can be enjoyed entirely on their own, as an anytime treat, and can also be dunked most deliciously into all sorts of savory, creamy dips—our frozen Spinach & Artichoke Dip or Pimento Cheese Dip make a particualrly excellent pairing.

083531.item_story_marketing:
All preparations of onions have their place. Fresh Onions (p. 4) are great sliced on a burger or diced on a taco. Grilled onions are tremendous with a hot dog or sandwich. And pickled onions? Well, if you ask us, pickled onions make a tip-top topping for pretty much anything that could use a little tang, a little texture, and a little pop of umami. Trader Joe’s Pickled Red Onions are marinated in a mix of apple cider vinegar, sugar, garlic, salt, and whole black peppercorns; they deliver a well-balanced profile of sweet, savory, bold, and briny that synergizes well with everything from avocado toast to Carne Asada fries.

Our Pickled Red Onions add a phenomenal finishing touch to a plate of chilaquiles or a lox-laden bagel at breakfast, a bowl of ramen, or a quick Chopped Salad at lunch, and pulled pork or roast chicken at dinner. And when it comes to appetizers and hors d’oeuvres, they’re an essential addition to nachos, mezze platters, and deviled eggs.

083543.item_story_marketing:
A bottle of olive oil might just be the home chef ’s greatest companion. There when you need it to prep a pan, whip up a salad dressing, or finish a freshly seared steak, a good EVOO is practically indispensable nowadays. And that’s why we’re so excited to introduce Trader Joe’s Main Squeeze Extra Virgin Olive Oil to our grocery shelves. Imported from the Mediterranean, it’s a golden, grassy, and pleasantly peppery cold-pressed Olive Oil, ideal for everything from light sautés to dipping bread, and it’s contained within a consummately convenient Squeeze bottle topped with an adjustable spout.

Designed with the utmost of ease in mind, Main Squeeze Extra Virgin Olive Oil drizzles dreamily over roasted veggies and soups, pours with precision when making pestos and other homemade sauces, and swirls stupendously into focaccia dough or over burrata. Of course, it’s also quite at home near your stovetop range, well suited to roasting, pan-frying, grilling, and even poaching. And because we work directly with the supplier to bring this Olive Oil to our shelf, we’ve also made sure that this Main Squeeze won’t squeeze your budget.

083569.item_story_marketing:
We’re of the mind that anytime you’re eating candy, it ought to feel like you’re celebrating. Even if the only thing you’re celebrating is the fact that you get to enjoy some candy! In that spirit, we’re introducing a sweet treat that embodies the very idea of celebration: Trader Joe’s Sour Confetti Chews! Crafted especially for us by a confectioner in Germany, these delightfully sweet, thrillingly Sour, and oh-so-satisfyingly Chewy (texturally, think a cross between taffy and a gummy) candies come in a vivid variety of colors and Confetti-like shapes. Each bag is like its own little party!

Terrifically tart, with a growing sweetness that comes through as you Chew, our supplier uses plant-derived colors like turmeric and spirulina extract, along with fruit and vegetable juices to give these Confetti candies their kaleidoscopic look. Ideal for all sorts of celebrations, big and small, we like to dispense these Chews like their namesake decoration anytime we can: when friends come over for a movie night, when we’re on a long car trip or plane ride, or whenever we’re craving something soft, Sour, and Chewy—in other words, anytime at all.
