083570.item_story_marketing:
It’s always a delight when a dish has a name that perfectly captures its character, and jambalaya is most certainly one of those dishes. Even beyond its inherent musicality (it’s as fun to say as it is to eat), the term jamabalaya is largely thought to be derived from the Provençal word “jambalaia,” meaning “jumble” or “mish-mash,” referring to the mix of ingredients used in its preparation. And wouldn’t you know it, jambalaya is itself a culinary jumble, an ebulliently eclectic mix of West African, Spanish, and French influences—much like the city of New Orleans itself! You can taste each of these influences in every forkful of Trader Joe’s Jambalaya, our easy-to-prep version of this iconic (and aptly-named) Louisiana treat.

Our Jambalaya starts with a base of captivatingly aromatic, savory-seasoned, long-grained white rice, along with diced onion, tomato, green bell pepper, and green onion, and finishes with slices of spicy, smoky, uncured Andouille sausage. It takes only a few minutes on the stovetop or in the microwave to become steamy, satisfying, and ready to serve as an entrée or side dish. We recommend enjoying this Jambalaya alongside a leafy green salad or crisp Haricots Verts, or topped with a similarly NOLA-inspired protein, like barbecued shrimp or blackened Chicken Breast.

083579.item_story_marketing:
The traditional Greek salad is relatively new by ancient historical standards. It was apparently invented in the 1960s when Athenian restauranteurs skirted a tariff on essential salad items by adding non-taxable feta cheese to an already popular plate of cucumber, olives, onion, bell peppers, and tomato. Tourists ate it up. Literally.

Now, tourists of the culinary seas (aka our customers) have been eating up Trader Joe’s Classic Greek Salad since 2005—which may not be ancient, but certainly makes this Salad ‘classic’ by our historical standards! And to this day, it remains a tried & true mix of fresh, Greek-inspired ingredients that harken back to the Athenian original.

The base of romaine, with green & red cabbages, is complemented by wedges of cucumber, diced red bell pepper, julienned red onion, pitted kalamata olives, and—of course—feta cheese. A red-wine vinaigrette—including dehydrated garlic, and dried herbs (oregano, basil & parsley)—comes in a separate packet, ready to toss with this Salad whenever you’re ready to eat it up.
083579.item_story_qil:
Classic Greek Salad 

 
Comprised of fresh ingredients you would likely find in the Mediterranean countryside, 
our Classic Greek Salad is built atop a bed of crisp green lettuce with slices of 
cucumber, red bell pepper, red onions, whole Kalamata olives and crumbled feta. 
Accompanied by a container of tangy Greek vinaigrette that's seasoned with garlic, 
oregano and basil, this salad is a study of vibrant flavor and texture. Made fresh daily, 
each nine ounce salad is $3.49. 

Trader Joe's Company Bulletin02/23/2011 page 37 of 39

083604.item_story_marketing:
Toasted-rice & marshmallow treats have been enjoyed at parties and potlucks ever since the recipe was first developed by a cereal company in 1939. Today, Trader Joe’s Crispy Rice Bars carry on this tradition with our own yummy version of the classic snack—one that is particularly portable.

Our supplier, an expert maker of cookies and cereal bars, puts their treat talents to use by binding together Crispy toasted Rice and marshmallows with tapioca syrup, cane sugar, sunflower oil, and a handful of other naturally derived ingredients. The resulting Bar has that tender, gooey texture, with a familiar, soft and sweet crunch.

Unlike whole trays of these treats that often turn up at gatherings, our Bars are pre-cut and individually wrapped, which makes them ideal for stowing and snacking just about anywhere. 083609.item_story_marketing:
Let the good times roll: the fresh, prepared foods section in select Trader Joe’s stores has a sensational new sushi offering! Trader Joe’s Spicy Salmon Roll is made in a traditional maki style, with hearty, raw, Atlantic Salmon and slices of fresh cucumber. Our supplier rolls the Salmon and cucumber up in a sheet of dried seaweed, as well as rice that’s been seasoned with sugar & vinegar. Just prior to cutting the Roll into easy-to- serve slices, they generously sprinkle it with a Spicy, togarashi-inspired seasoning blend so that every bite has a bit of thrilling heat to go along with its tangy, savory flavors and tender, toothsome textures.

Great as a light, grab-and-go entrée, or filling snack to share with a friend, our Spicy Salmon Roll also makes an excellent inclusion in a TJ’s sushi spread, alongside our similarly maki-inspired California Roll and Vegetable Roll. Additionally, we find that it’s spectacularly suited to serving with our tempura- style Vegetable Birds Nests, and takes well to topping with Sriracha, Nori Komi Furikake, and Spicy Dynamite Sauce.

083610.item_story_marketing:
And now, for a tote that needs no introduction: Trader Joe’s Red and Black Insulated Tote Bag! That’s right, the classic Black and Red Insulated Tote is back in stores after a brief absence, and in a sleeker, slightly more minimalist design: you’ll notice a bigger TJ’s logo, a lack of palm trees, and a modest re-emphasis on black over red. In addition to the aesthetic update, its slightly scaled-down size makes this oh-so-handy Insulated Tote ideal for keeping cool things cool and hot things hot, be it a picnic lunch, concerts-in-the-park dinner, or charcuterie spread for an impromptu patio hang.

We find that these Totes are particularly adept at keeping your frozen and refrigerated goodies from Trader Joe’s at the right temp, especially if used in conjunction with an ice pack—and so much more besides. Need to get hot baked goods, leftovers, or game day appetizers over to a friend’s house? Trust this Insulated Tote to shield them from the elements. And even if temperature isn’t a pressing concern, their 5.3-gallon capacity makes them great for lugging non-edible items about, too, like books, camping supplies, or even a change of clothes and toiletries when taking a day trip.

083622.item_story_marketing:
Baking a fruit pastry can be a bit like matchmaking: you want to make sure that both the fruit and the pastry are compatible with one another, but still individually bring something exciting to the table. To that end,  our summer-seasonal Trader Joe’s Guava Tartelette Cookies are like the ideal couple. They’re crafted for us by a distinguished bakery in France, who matches the crisp, crumbly, Cookie-like elements of the Tartelette crust with the tangy, sweet, and ineffably tropical character of the smooth Guava filling to a most harmonious effect.

Just like a good couple, Trader Joe’s Guava Tartelette Cookies are great at parties! Whether that’s as an addition to a snack table at a watch party for the big game, an easy (and cost-effective) dessert at a dinner party, or an impromptu Cookie party-for-one, whenever the mood strikes. Individually wrapped, and sized at about two-or-three bites (and 65 calories) per Tartelette, they also make a marvelous miniature sweet treat for the end of a work lunch—just enough to provide a pop of much-needed Guava sweetness and Cookie crispness, without feeling overly indulgent. And since this is Trader Joe’s we’re talking about, we’ve also made sure to match them with a truly excellent price—just be sure to grab a box from our cookie section before the summer ends!

083630.item_story_marketing:
Did you know that many green onions out there are actually just immature red, white, or yellow onions? It’s true! If left unharvested, the little white bulb at the end of green onions within the Allium cepa species would eventually grow into the kind of big, standard, papery-skinned onions you see on our produce tables every day. But then, they wouldn’t have the same super tender texture and mild, slightly sweet, delicately piquant flavor that we love in Trader Joe’s Organic Green Onions. We guess it just goes to show that timing really is everything!

Speaking of timing, we’re excited to announce that we now offer these Organic Green Onions on an everyday basis, nationwide! And this is especially great news, because there’s never really a bad time for Green Onions. At the breakfast table, they’re superb when sliced and mixed into biscuit dough, sprinkled into a crepe, or added to any number of egg dishes. At lunch, they elevate even the simplest of salads, sandwiches, or bowls of Squiggly Knife Cut Style Noodles. And at dinner, they add so much to a baked potato, a pan of fried rice, a savory marinade, a seafood fillet, or—lest we forget—some freshly sauced Mandarin Orange Chicken.

083667.item_story_marketing:
As the weather warms up, cooking dinner (read: heating up the kitchen) becomes exponentially less appealing—but you still need to feed your crew. What to do? Pick up some packages of Trader Joe’s Carne Asada Ranchera! Inspired by the flavorful meat offered at taco carts and meat markets across Southern California, our buyer made it his mission to develop exclusive-to-Trader Joe’s marinades for these quick-cooking options in our fresh meat case.

Reformulated just in time for grilling season, our Carne Asada is made using a ranchera cut, also known as sirloin flap—it’s a thin, flavorful cut prized for its rich marbling and takes extremely well to the citrus juice-based marinade.

Impossibly easy to prep (just open and cook in a pan, on the grill, or on a plancha, if you’ve got one handy), the finished meat shines in a street taco setting, and makes for a palate-popping addition to a bed of salad greens, burrito bowl, or quesadilla. Grab a package from your neighborhood Trader Joe’s and try it for yourself!
083667.item_story_qil:
During a recent review of our fresh meat offerings, our buyer saw an opportunity to improve upon the quality 
of our marinated offerings. Inspired by the flavorful meat found at taco carts and meat markets across Southern 
California, he made it his mission to develop delicious, exclusive-to-Trader Joe's marinades and pair them with 
high quality cuts of meat, and thus, Trader Joe's Carne Asada Ranchera was born!

Our Carne Asada is made using a Ranchera cut, also known as sirloin flap-it's a thin, flavorful cut prized for 
its rich marbling and takes extremely well to marinade. We've done that prep work for you, bathing the meat in a 
bright, citrus-forward marinade boasting red and guajillo chile peppers, a suite of savory seasonings (including 
garlic, onion, and oregano), and a splash of vinegar for a pleasant, tangy note. The only thing standing between 
you and a mouthwatering Carne Asada plate is a few minutes of medium-high heat cooking on a grill or stovetop. 
(We'll take this opportunity to drop a PSA for Corn & Wheat Tortillas [sku 81246] as a preferred pairing partner). 
Other satisfying serving contexts include salads, burrito bowls, quesadillas, scrambled eggs, tacos¿

083669.item_story_marketing:
Blazing back to our shelves after an extended absence, Trader Joe’s Spicy Cheese Crunchies have officially returned—and we couldn’t be more fired up. In case you didn’t have the chance to try them the first time around, now’s a great time to get in on the fiery hot fun. They’re made with a base of crunchy, craggy corn, flavored with a savory mix of seasonings that includes Cheddar Cheese powder, garlic powder, and chili pepper, while their signature red-hot hue is achieved thanks to a blend of paprika, vegetable juice, and turmeric. What better way could there be to bring the heat to your next potluck, tailgate, or picnic?

We enjoy munching on these gluten free Crunchies by the bowlful while watching a movie, lazing on a weekend afternoon, or sipping on something nice and chilled to balance out the burn. They make a great, Spicy little side for a hot dog, hamburger, or taco, and when crumbled up fine, they make an able ingredient for breaded chicken tenders, elote, or phenomenally full-flavored macaroni and cheese. We’ve even known a few folks who are partial to sprinkling crushed Spicy Cheese Crunchies over ice cream. Join us in welcoming Trader Joe’s Spicy Cheese Crunchies back by grabbing a bag today!

083748.item_story_marketing:
Looking to step up your baking game this summer? Because we have a marvelous Mix with a sweet, slightly savory, and captivatingly crunchy twist available just for the season! Trader Joe’s Strawberry & Corn Flake Muffin & Loaf Cake Mix is made with bits of sweetened, dried Strawberry throughout, and also includes a packet of crispy, lightly salty Corn Flakes and eye-catching red sanding sugar in every box. Simply prep the Mix per the package instructions (you’ll need a few common baking ingredients: eggs, milk, and oil), and pour the dazzlingly pink batter in a paper-cup-lined Muffin pan or lightly greased Loaf pan. Mix the Corn Flakes with the sugar and a bit of melted butter, sprinkle them over the batter, and you’re ready to bake!

Easy to make, and even easier to enjoy with a group of loved ones, we find that the resulting Strawberry & Corn Flake Muffins or Loaf Cake from this Mix are especially great for bringing along to potlucks, pool parties, barbecues—all sorts of summer-y occasions, really. Since one box makes 12 Muffins or one 8”x4” Loaf Cake, it’s also ideal for surprising your co-workers, friends, or neighbors with something special and sweet, all without needing to spend too much.

083749.item_story_marketing:
Believe it or not, we previously offered a paneer cheese—once back in the early 90s, and again in the mid- aughts. Neither option caught on, but for the past 15 years, we’ve offered Palak Paneer and Paneer Tikka Masala in our freezers, much to our customers’ delight. Because we never say “Never,” and given the increasing number of requests, our cheese buyer made it her mission to develop a new, palate-pleasing Paneer Indian Style Cheese—and boy, does it deliver!

Made for us in Wisconsin, this pasteurized cow’s milk cheese is produced by curdling the milk with acetic and lactic acids, resulting in a firm and crumbly fresh cheese with a subtle tang. Its decidedly mild flavor makes it an excellent choice for curries and soups, as it allows the spices and aromatics to be the star of the show, while its ability to hold its shape comes in handy when grilling, frying, or baking. Marinate it in yogurt and herbs, then grill for a few minutes, and you’ll have an easy—and tasty—vegetarian protein on your hands. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Paneer Indian Style Cheese in our cheese case, every day.

083750.item_story_marketing:
We all know that vitamin C is an essential nutrient in our everyday diets. But did you know that vitamin C has a lot to offer our skin, too? It’s true! In fact, vitamin C has become an increasingly popular ingredient in the skincare world for its refreshing properties. Of course, as is often the case with highly popular skincare solutions, that’s also resulted in some perilously high price tags—we’ve even seen a few single-ounce bottles of vitamin C-based serum out there for more than $150(!). That’s precisely why we decided to bring Trader Joe’s Vitamin C Serum to our shelves. Formulated for us by dermatologists, this Serum includes 15% L-ascorbic acid (AKA Vitamin C), 1% tocopherols (AKA vitamin E), and 0.5% ferulic acid (a compound that helps keep the combo of Vitamin C and E stable), and each one fluid-ounce bottle is $9.99! 

We recommend using our Vitamin C Serum as a follow-up to your morning facial cleanser and toner routine: just apply four or five drops (using the conveniently included pipette) to your finger tips, then gently massage  into the skin of your face, neck, and chest (anywhere that might be exposed to the sun) and finish with your daily moisturizer and sunscreen. Throughout the day, Vitamin C helps skin look smooth and radiant, while vitamin E helps keep it feeling soft and hydrated. C-riously! You’ll find Trader Joe’s Vitamin C Serum among our skincare products, every day.

083756.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Soft Pretzel Stick is shaped kind of like a short baguette. Despite its lack of a twist, it’s unmistakably pretzel-y; with pillowy insides, and that classic, dark- brown exterior, first innovated by 16th century monks who used a pure form of lye to boost the Maillard reaction. Fancy as this may sound, Trader Joe’s Soft Pretzel Stick is really just a yummy, yeasty bun that can be enjoyed in several tasty ways.

Heat up some White Queso Dip, then tear off pieces of the Stick to dunk and enjoy. You could also slice it in half lengthwise, toast it, then spread with Cultured Salted Butter. Or perhaps you’re in the mood for a sandwich, in which case we recommend a healthy spread of Organic Yellow Mustard and several slices of Uncured Pastrami. Of course, you could always just open up the package and take a bite!
083756.item_story_qil:
Our tasting panel was recently reflecting on the success (and the deliciousness) of the soft Pretzel Bread Stick 
[sku 95820] we've been selling in just a couple regions of the country. With its tender, brown crust, and distinctly 
malty flavor, the consensus was: this needs to be available to all our customers, everywhere! The bakery category 
worked their magic and Trader Joe's Soft Pretzel Stick was born.

Very similar to the original, regional version, this three-ounce Pretzel Stick is shaped kind of like a short 
baguette. Despite its lack of a twist, it's unmistakably pretzel-y; with pillowy insides, and that classic, dark-
brown exterior, first innovated by 16th century monks who used a pure form of lye to boost the Maillard 
reaction. Fancy as this may sound, Trader Joe's Soft Pretzel Stick is really just a yummy, yeasty bun that can 
be enjoyed in several tasty ways. 

Heat up some White Queso Dip [sku 79820], then tear off pieces of the Stick to dunk and enjoy. You could also 
slice it in half lengthwise, toast it, then spread with Cultured Salted Butter [sku 53720]. Or perhaps you're in the 
mood for a sandwich, in which case we recommend a healthy spread of Organic Yellow Mustard [sku 50237] 
and several slices of Uncured Pastrami [sku 86861]. Of course, you could always just open up the package and 
take a bite! If any of this sounds good, we're happy to announce that you can now find our Soft Pretzel Stick 
at every Trader Joe's, every day!

Soft Pretzel Stick

083758.item_story_marketing:
Ever heard of a Baby Iceberg? Well, it’s a thing. Only you won’t find it in the Arctic—you’ll find it at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. Full disclosure: we’re not talking about a mini-sized, partially submerged block of ice. We’re talking about Baby Iceberg Lettuce, a.k.a. Trader Joe’s Ice Cube Lettuce, a.k.a. the cutest little Lettuce heads you ever did see! They’re cultivated for us in California and Arizona, using a unique seed variety bred to produce purposely petite Iceberg Lettuce. Like chips off the ol’ ice block—or Cubes off the ol’ ’berg, as it were—these shrunken heads possess the same firm crunchiness and mild (although slightly sweeter) flavor as their big-headed cousins. Their wee size isn’t just for show, though—it also helps reduce waste. (Have you ever had to toss the wilted remains of an extra-large lettuce head, simply because you couldn’t eat it all fast enough? Every bit counts, Baby!)

Cut each little Lettuce head in half to make classic-yet-compact wedge salads, or to create snack-sized cups you can fill with TJ’s tuna. Or use it in the myriad ways you’d use larger-leaf lettuce—tossed salads and turkey sandwiches are just the tip(s) of the Iceberg!

083762.item_story_marketing:
The sight of a well-assembled Charcuterie tray shouts, “Party time!” Sliced cheeses, savory meats, and crunchy crackers invite hungry friends to feast. So, what does one do when craving Charcuterie and all alone? We say, get your solo party started with Trader Joe’s Charcuterie Party of One!

Charcuterie Party of One is the ideal size for a single serving when you’re craving savory. The partitioned tray includes thick, round slices of Uncured Milano Salami (a style made from a finer grind of pork), with garlicky flavor, and visible pieces of coarsely ground black pepper. An adjacent compartment holds square slices of soft and mild Mozzarella Cheese. To contrast with these tender Cheese and meat cuts, a third compartment houses rectangular, rustic-cut, Crackers. These present a pleasant hint of Sesame, plus a truly capital crunch that positions them as pleasing partners for the slices of Salami and Cheese.

And lest we forget to mention, this Party of One is portable! Stick the tray in your lunchbox for an easy and satisfying mid-day meal or snack. Of course, it’s also customizable, with an endless number of add-ons, such as Just a Handful of Pitted Salted Manzanilla Olives, Soft & Juicy Dried Mandarins, Organic Green Seedless Grapes, and Mesquite Smoked Seasoned Almonds. Whenever you’re flying solo, you’ll find Trader Joe’s Charcuterie Party of One in our refrigerators, every day!

083764.item_story_marketing:
With its rectangular shape, deep, crispy-edged crust, and golden underside, Detroit-style pizza has been wowing pizza fans and converting thin crust devotees since 1946. Believe it or not, the original Detroit-style pie was said to have been baked in steel pans originally used for auto parts! While Trader Joe’s Detroit Style Uncured Pepperoni Pizza is decidedly not assembled in auto part pans, it is packaged in a rectangular, oven-friendly pan that’s sprinkled with cheese prior to pizza assembly. This crucial step delivers the golden, crispy-on-the-underside and pillowy-on-the-inside crust that’s characteristic of a Detroit Style pie.

Our Detroit Style Pizza is every bit as delightful as the original, boasting a bright, garlicky tomato sauce, plenty of Uncured Pepperoni, and Parmesan, Romano, and mozzarella cheeses spread generously from edge to edge. Keep one in your freezer, and you can enjoy piping hot, fresh-from-the-oven Detroit Style Pizza for a mere fraction of the cost of takeout—not to mention the delivery time! To create the complete pizza parlor experience at home, don’t forget to add a bag of Chopped Salad Blend and a bottle of Grifone Primitivo to your Trader Joe’s shopping list.
083764.name: DETROIT PEPPERONI PIZZA

083835.item_story_marketing: Made with 100% Chardonnay grapes, notes of stone fruit and candied citrus deftly complement the minerality of this delicate bubbly. Opaline Brut never met a cheese board it didn’t like, and its pleasant acidity cuts through buttery foods with ease (fried chicken or Movie Theater Popcorn, anyone?). It’s bottled in an elegant, jewel-cut bottle, which lends a bit of joie de vivre to the table each time a bottle is popped, no matter the occasion.
083835.item_story_qil:
Opaline Brut, crafted from 100% Chardonnay grapes sourced from France's vineyards, embodies 
elegance and refinement in every bubble. Like the Sparkling Rosé from Opaline, the unique bottle reflects the 
vibrant taste profile of the wine within. This luminous sparkling wine showcases the purity and finesse that 
Chardonnay brings to sparklers, offering sophistication at an approachable price point. Technically also a 
Blanc de Blancs, maintaining the Brut style could involve blend adjustments and being able to offer consistent 
quality and value to customers is a priority. 

The wine displays a pale gold color with persistent, delicate bubbles that form an elegant mousse. The 
nose opens with fresh aromas of citrus, white peach, and citrus blossom, accompanied by subtle notes of 
brioche, almond, and a whisper of honeysuckle. On the palate, Opaline Brut is crisp and refreshing, with bright 
acidity that brings vibrancy to flavors of lemon zest, pear, and white cherry. The fine, creamy bubbles create a 
luxurious texture, while hints of toasted bread and mineral notes add depth and complexity. Nice length and 
lovely balance contribute to the well-rounded taste profile, finishing clean and invigorating with lingering 
citrus notes. Offering versatility, serve as an aperitif with oysters, shrimp cocktail, or smoked salmon canapés, 
but also pairs beautifully with fried calamari, tempura vegetables. For cheese, try fresh chèvre, triple-cream 
Brie, or aged Comté. It also complements lighter fare such as Caesar salad, sushi rolls, or quiche Lorraine.
083835.name: OPALINE BRUT

083847.item_story_marketing:
When it comes to lunch, one shouldn’t have to sacrifice great flavor, convenience, or quality for the sake of speed. Thankfully, the refrigerators at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s offer plenty of options to support top-tier sandwich construction, like Trader Joe’s Rotisserie Seasoned Chicken Breast.

This Rotisserie Seasoned Chicken has no added nitrates or nitrites—in fact, each slice only contains the nitrates and nitrites that naturally occur in sea salt. You could call that being ingredient-conscious—we like to think of it as an acute appreciation of inner beauty. Lightly seasoned rotisserie-style with vinegar, sea salt, celery powder, sugar, honey, rosemary extract & dried garlic, and sliced to an easy-to-stack, medium-to-thin thickness, our Sliced Chicken Breast is an ideal inclusion for your next homemade sandwich. The way we like to do it? Pile slices high on your choice of bread with Sliced Swiss, cooked Applewood Smoked Bacon, lettuce, and tomato for a classic chicken club. And for an easy midnight snack or post-workout protein boost, simply roll a slice up with your favorite cheese, and enjoy.
083847.name: SLICED CHICKEN BREAST ROTISSERIE SEASONED

083858.item_story_marketing:
Ever since we introduced our Brioche Style Liège Waffles in 2024, customers have embraced these snackable Belgian treats as a decidedly delicious reason to enjoy waffles well beyond breakfast. And because practically anything can be improved with the addition of chocolate, we’ve further elevated this waffle-eating experience with new Trader Joe’s Chocolate Chip Brioche Style Liège Waffles. Laden with rich chocolate chips that complement their buttery base and golden edges, they’re just as charming and sweetly satisfying as ever: smaller than classic breakfast waffles, roundish in shape, irresistibly tender within, and topped with coarse pearl sugar for a bit of textural intrigue.

Made exclusively for us in Belgium, these Chocolate Chip Liège Waffles are wonderful right out of the package; what’s more, they’re individually wrapped for easy, on-the-go enjoyment (think morning commute, lunchbox treat, etc.). If you have more time at your disposal, gently warm them in the oven or toaster oven* to amplify their crisp exterior and melt the Chocolate Chips slightly (a scoop of Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream wouldn’t be out of place here, come to think of it). You’ll find these wonderful Waffles on the bakery shelves at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, every day.

083882.item_story_marketing:
When we say we listen to our customers, it’s not just lip service—we truly mean it. Your feedback guides us in our quest to provide the best quality products at incredible prices in our stores, every day. With this in mind, we’re positively tickled to announce the arrival to our shelves of the number one requested item on our customers’ fresh meat wish list: Boneless Chuck Roast is now available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s! The key to highlighting the savory flavor and fall-apart texture of this USDA Choice Premium Angus Beef Boneless Chuck Roast is slow roasting or braising, making it a must-have for cozy season grocery lists.

Impressively sized and budget-friendly to boot, Chuck Roast is ideal for feeding large groups or meal-prepping for a busy week ahead. Combine the Roast with Mirepoix, potatoes, garlic, rosemary, and a splash of Charles Shaw Cab in a slow cooker or pressure cooker for a no-fail pot roast dinner. Previously the co-star in our summer-seasonal two-hander Italian Pistachio & Fior di Latte Gelato, Trader Joe’s Italian Pistachio Gelato Style Frozen Dessert is making its breakout turn as a solo act! And now, it’s available on an everyday basis at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s freezer section!

Sweet, creamy, and with a delicately savory edge, our Italian Pistachio Gelato Style Frozen Dessert has a lovely, velvety texture that sets it apart from other styles of ice cream. It serves spectacularly well in a cup or a Sugar Cone, plain or topped with crumbled-up cookie bits. While it’s certainly flavorful enough to be enjoyed simply by the scoop, it’s also well suited to more complex presentations: we’re rather fond of prepping it affogato style by pouring a shot of Shade Grown Espresso over it, for instance. And for a truly unforgettable treat, try sandwiching it between two Brioche Style Liège Waffles.

083967.item_story_marketing:
First created sometime in the 1920s in either Australia or New Zealand (its exact origins remain disputed between the two nations to this day), pavlova is one of those desserts that seems like elegance made manifest. Named in honor of the Russian ballerina Anna Pavlova—a figure of considerable elegance herself—pavlova starts with a base of crisp-on-the-outside, dreamily-soft-and-light-on-the-inside meringue, which is then typically topped with a combination of fresh fruit and whipped cream, giving the eating experience a uniquely pleasing contrast of textures. Of course, as one might expect with any elegant dessert, it can be a challenging, time-consuming proposition to make at home—but we still think everyone ought to get a chance to try it. Which is why we’re bringing Trader Joe’s Meringue Dessert Shells to our cookie section for the summer! 

Inspired by the almost-otherworldly elegance of a pavlova, these shelf-stable Meringue Shells are made with a traditional recipe that includes egg whites, sugar, and vanilla extract, and crafted into a convenient, cup-like structure. Right out of the package, they’re ready to be filled with fresh fruit and whipped cream for a minature pavola, or anything else you can imagine that might taste great inside some Meringue. (We’re rather excited about the possibilities of a Meringue Shell filled with Lemon Curd or some Cookie Butter whipped into some cream cheese, ourselves.) And since each package contains two Shells, each sized for a single serving, they’re also an economical choice for creating easy-yet-exquisite desserts for a dinner party.

083970.item_story_marketing:
When it comes to physical fitness, everyone could use a little help! Trader Joe’s is doing our part by offering a curated selection of nutritional supplements to support your health and fitness goals. North Star Labs Creatine Hydrochloride is one example that’s aimed at maximizing the effectiveness of our workouts.

Creatine is a natural compound produced in the body and also found in high-protein foods, like red meat and fish. It doesn’t directly build muscle, but it may support muscle strength and muscle recovery*, allowing you to workout longer with more intensity, and with a quicker recovery afterwards. What’s particularly special about these North Star capsules is that the Creatine is bound with Hydrochloride, a combination that may encourage faster absorption in the body.

One to two of these Creatine capsules taken per day (with food and plenty of water) may provide the extra energy you need to train harder and to potentially see better results. Now it’s just up to you to get to the gym! But first, get to Trader Joe’s, where every day you’ll find North Star Labs Creatine capsules on our nutritional supplement shelves.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA.

083984.item_story_marketing:
Some mornings—and some bagels—call for a classic schmear. Others call for something just a little sweeter. Enter Trader Joe’s Whipped Strawberry Flavored Cream Cheese Spread—a light, airy take on our customer’s favorite cream cheese that brings a burst of strawberry flavor to every swipe. Made with pasteurized milk and cream, plus strawberries, sweetened dried strawberries, and natural strawberry flavor (you didn’t need further proof of our present strawberry preoccupation, but we just served it to you), this Whipped Cream Cheese is sweet, smooth, and effortlessly easy to spread atop anything your heart desires.

Of course, bagels are a natural match, but don’t stop there. Spread it on toast, Graham Cracker Squares, and Strawberry Liège Waffles. Serve it as a dip for fresh berries or cookies. Swirl it into frosting for a strawberry-kissed finish to cakes and cupcakes. However you use it, this softly Whipped Strawberry Cream Cheese brings the Strawberry brightness along with it.

083985.item_story_marketing:
How best to describe Trader Joe’s Parmesan Tapenade? On a purely technical level, it’s made from thick shreds of umami-rich Parmesan cheese, which have been combined with a medley of diced garlic, jalapeños, and Manzanilla olives, then seasoned with herbs like cilantro, oregano, and thyme, and marinated in a blend of olive oil, sunflower oil, and red wine vinegar. On a practical level, it’s a catch-all condiment, dip, and spread that adds briny, spicy, savory zing to all sorts of dishes. And on a more conceptual level, it’s precisely the kind of irresistibly unique, everyday treasure that you can only discover at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

Try a spoonful of Parmesan Tapenade on a sandwich. Try a spoonful of Parmesan Tapenade on a piece of avocado toast. Try a spoonful of Parmesan Tapenade…by itself! It pays to be daring with something as rich and full-flavored as this. We dare, for instance, to dip it with artichokes, endives, or chunks of crusty bread. We’ll also use it to top pastas, salads, and steaks, and spread it over a burger bun, or pita. And for an easy, cheesy side dish, spoon over a sheet pan of potatoes, just before roasting.

084007.item_story_marketing:
Our Refresh Citrus Body Wash was a beloved customer favorite since we first introduced it, thanks to its bright scent, invigorating cleanse, and amazing value. Over time, its formula fell out of favor with our customers, and we saw an opportunity to make some drastic improvements. We partnered with a trusted beauty supplier to give this shower staple a thoughtful refresh—if you’ll pardon the pun—and our new Refreshing Citrus Body Wash retains the essence of the original, with an elevated ingredient lineup designed to be gentle on skin.

In this new formula, you’ll find a trio of highly sought after skincare ingredients—niacinamide, sodium hyaluronate, and squalane—that help support the skin’s moisture barrier, leaving it feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated long after you’ve showered. Notes of orange, grapefruit, tangerine, and lemon bring a burst of sunny citrus to every lather, while ingredients like vitamin C, chamomile, ginseng, ginger, and vitamin B5 nourish and revitalize the skin. Similar body wash offerings found elsewhere sell for a much higher prices—our incredible everyday price on this body wash might be the most refreshing part of this deal!

084039.item_story_marketing:
In all the hubbub of weekly meal planning, it’s easy to get so focused on what entrées you’ll serve that you lose sight of the sides. And that’s a real shame! A good side makes or breaks a meal, in our experience. So, we’ve decided to do something about it: the next time you find yourself scrambling for a side dish (or even just the next time you’d like to try some savory, aromatic spuds) we recommend reaching for Trader Joe’s Garlic Parsley Potato Kit!

Each Kit contains a pound of pre-washed and ready-to-cook gold Potatoes, along with a packet of flavorful seasonings that includes dried Parsley, Garlic, onion, and sea salt. Simply mix the contents of the seasoning packet with the Potatoes, then cook, per packaging instructions, in the oven, microwave, or air fryer. (We recommend the microwave method—it leaves the Potatoes super tender and only takes about six minutes before they’re ready to eat!) Wondering what entrée to pair these Potatoes with? That’s the best part: they go well with everything! Try them alongside a plate of Tenderloin Steak Tips, teriyaki-glazed chicken breast, spaghetti Bolognese, salmon with Chimichurri Sauce... we could quite literally go on all day.

084084.item_story_marketing:
Chewy Thai coconut cakes are among the most popular street foods in Thailand. If you’ve been fortunate enough to visit Thailand and try one (or several) of these flower-shaped, bite-sized cakes for yourself, you can certainly understand why. And even if your travels haven’t taken you to Thailand, you’re in luck, because Trader Joe’s Chewy Thai Coconut Cakes are bringing this delicacy straight to your freezer!

Following an authentic recipe, Trader Joe’s Chewy Thai Coconut Cakes are made for us in Thailand from a straightforward batter of coconut milk, sugar, tapioca starch, water, wheat flour, baking powder, and salt. We added in purple sweet potato and ube to give them their rich, purple coloring and signature flavor. When heated in the air fryer or toaster oven, these Cakes develop a nice, crisp exterior while remaining soft and chewy on the interior. What you end up with is an elegant, lightly sweet, and bouncy dessert that is a great addition to a grazing table or a handy finger food for vegan snacking.

Trader Joe’s Red Velvet Cupcakes are great cupcakes. We found a supplier who makes some of the moistest, tastiest cupcakes we’ve ever tried, did some cupcake collaborating (a tasty gig), and now, we’re rolling out the red carpet for Red Velvet.

Each soft, cocoa-kissed Cupcake is made with buttermilk for tenderness and topped with a generous swirl of tangy cream cheese frosting, offering that classic red velvet profile: subtly chocolatey, lightly tangy, and velvety smooth. They also offer that classic red velvet color —only here, the deep, crimson hue comes from from vegetable juice, annatto, and turmeric, not artificial dyes. Whether you’re celebrating something special or simply satisfying the sudden need for a sweet treat (relatable), Trader Joe’s Red Velvet Cupcakes rise to the occasion.

084108.item_story_marketing:
A quick pop quiz for you: What, exactly, makes Trader Joe’s Creamy Dreamy Whipped Ricotta Cheese so Creamy and so Dreamy? Could it be the rich, full-flavored, whole milk with which the Ricotta is made? Could it be its light, airy, cloud-like consistency? Could it be the ease with which it spreads over toast, or the delight you’ll experience when you dip into it with a carrot or crostini? The answer, of course, is a resounding, triumphant “all of the above”—for extra credit, though, we’d certainly accept that our unbeatable price has a pleasantly Dreamy quality to it, too.

Available every day in our refrigerator cases, Trader Joe’s Creamy Dreamy Whipped Ricotta Cheese has myriad uses in the kitchen. Starting at the breakfast table, it’s super convenient for making quick Ricotta toasts, and spreads wonderfully on a bagel or English muffin. In an hors d’oeuvres spread, it serves spectacularly well as a dip with crudités, crackers, or anything crisp and crunchy—and especially so when stirred with fresh herbs, a drizzle of honey, or a sprinkling of savory seasonings. And when it comes to desserts, it makes a first- rate filling for pastries, a beautiful base for a frosting, and even works wonders when simply used to top a bit of sliced fresh fruit.

084160.item_story_marketing:
As a French invention, crepes generally stick to the haute cuisine rule that sweet & savory flavors should remain separate. For instance, think of the classic (savory) La Complete crepe, which involves shredded Gruyere, a slice of ham, and an egg; or the traditional (sweet) Chocolat crepe, with chocolate-hazelnut spread and sliced bananas. We were curious, what happens if you break with culinary tradition and put savory and sweet together in a single crepe? Trader Joe’s PB&J Filled Crepes help answer this question—and they do so deliciously!

These ultra-thin pancakes are made using a wheat-flour batter that is itself a nice balance of savory & sweet, including salt and sugar in the recipe. Once cooked, they’re spread with a thin layer of both savory peanut butter spread (made with dry roasted peanuts), and sweet strawberry filling (made with—you guessed it—strawberries), then rolled to make a treat that is delightfully easy to enjoy. It turns out, the flavor combination of savory-nutty and sweet-fruity in a single Crepe is magnifique! Add the fact that these individually wrapped Crepes can be stored anywhere (no refrigeration required), and we believe they’ll become a regular part of your handy-snack rotation. And if you have access to a microwave, these Crepes are also wonderful when gently warmed for six to eight seconds.

084191.item_story_marketing:
For many of the dairy-free population, Greek yogurt is one of those hard to replace staples. Whether you enjoy those individual-serving containers, or you buy the big tub for daily breakfasts—thick, creamy, yogurt is tough to beat… And now, you can enjoy the taste of Greek yogurt in Trader Joe’s Organic Greek Style Strawberry Vanilla Cashew Coconut Cultured Yogurt Alternative.

It’s called “Yogurt Alternative” because there is absolutely no dairy in this product, and it’s Greek-style is thanks to its thick, creamy consistency, tart & tangy flavor. Starting with a base made from organic cashews, the mixture is thickened with organic coconut cream and organic cornstarch, then sweetened with organic cane sugar. Our supplier then incorporates organic rice-derived protein, a little organic lemon juice to promote the tang, and organic strawberries & organic vanilla extract for flavor.

This dairy-free Greek-style yogurt offers the sweetness of strawberry and the rich flavors of vanilla, 10g of organic rice-derived protein, and billions of live probiotics. After pasteurizing this Greek Style Cashew Coconut Yogurt Alternative, our supplier adds six, live and active probiotics—just like dairy yogurt has—so you can still reap those good-bacteria benefits. Use as a base for a yogurt bowl topped with granola and mixed berries, or enjoy on its own as a snack.

Not only is this cheese expertly sourced with our eye for the highest quality, but it’s also mixed with an enticing Italian-style seasoning blend. Our supplier starts with a bold, nutty Parmesan and finely grates it into a coarse powder, then mixes in a savory blend of dried herbs and spices, including basil, parsley, black pepper, and garlic. 

For your part, it’s just one delicious step to well-cheesed (and well-Seasoned) pasta, and that’s generously sprinkling Grated Seasoned Parmesan Cheese atop your bowl of Italian Spaghetti or Organic Italian Artisan Gigli. Don’t sleep on cheesing non-pasta foods, too, such as Organic Hearty Minestrone Soup, Cacio e Pepe Gnocchi, Organic Popping Corn, Trader Potato Tots... the list goes on!

084221.item_story_marketing:
Chicken is a protein that lends itself well to all sorts of preparations, from the basic to the baroque. And while we certainly enjoy an intricate and involved coq au vin or cordon bleu every now and again, there’s honestly something equally as satisfying about a simple rotisserie chicken, lightly seasoned and slowly rotated on a spit. Which got us thinking: what can we do to make access to this simple pleasure even simpler? The solution came to us in the form of Trader Joe’s Seasoned and Shredded Rotisserie Chicken. Each package contains a pound of savory-Seasoned, Rotisserie-cooked Chicken breast, which comes pre-Shredded and ready to enjoy in any number of applications.

For those who engage in weekly meal prep, this Shredded Rotisserie Chicken is an easy answer to the question, “what’s my protein going to be?” For those who like to vary up their meals, they’re a tasty way to finish a salad, fill a sandwich, or build a burrito. And since it’s Seasoned with an all-around savory blend of spices including garlic, onion, and chicken broth, it’s flavor profile is versatile enough to act as a quick and convenient ingredient for everything from omelets to enchiladas to appetizer dips, and everything in between.

Each piece is made with a square of sweet, satisfyingly spearmint-y chewing gum stacked atop a cool, remarkably refreshing Velamints™ classic spearmint. Is it gum? Is it a mint? It’s both! And it’s sugar free, to boot. Your dentist would surely approve. Pop a piece of Velamints™ Spearmint Gum whenever you need fresher breath or a minty pick-me-up. It comes in a slim, durable tin (with a fun, sliding enclosure system), so you can carry it in your purse (or on your person) at all times. We like to keep a tin in the console or glove compartment of a car, for instance, in case we ever find ourselves in a breath-freshening emergency. If you feel like sharing, circulate a tin around your dinner party after serving up a veggie platter replete with TJ’s Roasted Garlic Hummus and TJ’s Garlic Spread-Dip—your guests will take the hint.

084285.item_story_marketing:
On taking a bite of Trader Joe’s Taco Seasoned Beef Stick, we want your first thoughts to be about its tender texure, its hearty meatiness, its savory, smoky, and delicately spicy flavors. We want you to think of memories of road trips, camping weekends, and even taco nights of yesteryear. And to help ensure that’s what’s on your mind, our supplier has worked hard to keep its recipe as simple and straightforward as possible: just organic, grass fed Beef; a whole suite of Taco-evoking Seasonings, including cumin, cilantro, oregano, garlic, and chipotle pepper; plus encapsulated citric acid to keep it fresh on the shelf; and a Beef collagen casing to keep it all contained—and add a satisfying snap to its bite, too!

Of course, you can also think about the fact that among that list of ingredients you won’t find anything containing sugar or gluten, but you will find 10 grams of protein in every single-Stick serving. We find, for our part, that these Taco Seasoned Beef Sticks make an unbeatable snack after a workout, before a workday, or as an in-between-meal, anytime pick-me-up. As such, we recommend stashing a couple in a cool, dry place at home and work: when a snacking emergency arises, you won’t have to give it a second thought.

084293.item_story_marketing:
At Trader Joe’s, we dedicate a relatively small space to what is referred to in the grocery biz as the HABA section. HABA stands for Health And Beauty Aids, a rather old-fashioned term that doesn’t really cover the breadth of the bath, beauty, skincare, haircare, and body care products you’ll find there, even in a small section like ours. What’s different about this part of Trader Joe’s is the level of selectivity–we’re very picky about what we allow on our shelves, and we select products with great care. For food and drinks we have a tasting panel that tastes every product before it’s granted a space in our stores. For HABA products, we have a similar group of panelists, and they use every product before it earns its way onto our shelves.

Trader Joe’s Cypress and Bergamot Scented Whole Body Deodorant Spray is among the newest member of this select group of products. This is an aluminum-free Deodorant you can use all over your body, to keep you smelling fresh whether you’re leaving the house to go to work in the morning or leaving the gym after a tough workout in the evening. Its scent is a little woodsy and a little citrusy—it’s mild, clean, and quite pleasant. We like to keep this on hand in a gym bag or backpack, and because it comes in a three ounce spray bottle, it’s great for travel—even in a carry on bag! You can find this versatile Spray in our HABA section.

084327.item_story_marketing:
The original Pasta Primavera (literally “springtime”) hit the restaurant scene in the late 1970s, making a splash with its colorful assortment of fresh vegetables. Accordingly, ours has plenty of long, thin, Zucchini pieces; ribbons of red Bell Peppers; and bite-sized Broccoli florets. These veggies are paired with an Egg Pasta shape called Strozzapreti (literally “priest choker”—evidently named for the overindulging clergymen who originally shoveled this delicious pasta into their mouths with a bit too much gusto). The Pasta is delicious—thin, elongated scrolls, like unsealed tubes that are excellent at trapping and delivering the creamy, butter-cheese sauce. 

The fully cooked pasta and veggies in Trader Joe’s Pasta Primavera only require a quick heat-up in a skillet on the stovetop, or in the microwave. Serve it hot, perhaps with some additional grated cheese, like Parmigiano Reggiano. You may be tempted otherwise, but we advise a slow and mindful dining pace to fully enjoy all the charms of this vibrant and flavorful Pasta! You’ll find it every day in our freezers, along with our broad assortment of authentic Italian dishes.

87813] are beloved by customers, not only for their deliciousness, but also for their ease of preparation. Always

084336.item_story_marketing:
One of our favorite things about gelato, aside from its superlatively soft and creamy texture, is how well its various flavors tend to play off one another. Is there anything better than going to a gelato shop and picking out two complementary flavors to enjoy in the same cup? Well, how about a whole tub containing two complementary flavors? Because that’s exactly what you’ll find in Trader Joe’s Italian Mascarpone & Mixed Berries Gelato Style Frozen Dessert, available in our freezers from August through September. Brought to us by a celebrated gelato supplier in Italy, each tub is filled with a 50/50 ratio of rich and velvety Mascarpone and bright and juicy Mixed Berry, so you can mix, match, and enjoy in any combination you like.

An essential ingredient in tiramisu, and often employed in cheesecakes, the flavors of Mascarpone are well served by the soft and super smooth texture of this Gelato Dessert. They also provide a creamy and mildly milky complement to the ebullient, “frutti di bosco” style flavors of the Mixed Berry half of the tub. We recommend trying them separately, then together, to truly appreciate their full expression. We also emphatically recommend trying a scoop sandwiched between two cookies or a Brioche Bun, or simply by the bowlful, topped with fresh fruit or an Amarena Cherry.

084349.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Granola Butter begins like any good granola, with a base of rolled oats—specifically, gluten free rolled oats. The oats are blended smooth with a mix of ingredients including olive oil, brown sugar, coconut oil, maple syrup and vanilla extract, and the result is a little graham cracker-like, with hints of vanilla. It’s creamy, with just a bit of texture, and it’s wonderfully spreadable. And it's Gluten Free, Kosher (pareve) and Vegan.

We think Trader Joe’s Granola Butter is bound to be the next spreadable hit (Cookie Butter, anyone?), and recommend it on a sandwich or piece of toast, mixing it into yogurt or a smoothie, or even enjoying it straight from the jar with your favorite spoon.

084416.item_story_marketing:
There’s a lot more to Buffalo sauce than just heat. In fact, a truly great Buffalo sauce is a careful balancing act between its spicy, acidic, salty, and creamy elements, with the last of these typically being achieved via the inclusion of butter. We’ve found, however, that an equal—if not greater—effect can be realized with avocado oil. It’s a theory we’ve put to the test, and is ready to taste in Trader Joe’s Buffalo Sauce with Avocado Oil. Tangy, rich, and indeed, delightfully spicy, this is a Buffalo Sauce with a remarkably round and buttery (despite containing no dairy ingredients), palate-coating consistency that’s ideal for any number of appetizer-y or entrée-based applications.

Whether it’s chicken wings or breaded cauliflower, pizza or patty melts, mac and cheese or even a bowl of Hot Honey Popcorn, our Buffalo Sauce with Avocado Oil enhances all sorts of dishes with aplomb. We recommend it drizzled over scrambled eggs, sandwiches, and French fries, mixed into savory dips and homemade meatloaf, or used to flavor casseroles, grilled seafood, or twice-baked potatoes.

084427.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe's Chicken Florentine Lasagna is a decidedly different take on this classico Italiano! We begin with a traditional base of durum wheat semolina lasagna noodles, cooked al dente. They're joined by hearty ground chicken, a creamy white sauce, Parmesan and Romano cheeses, and an array of seasonings, including garlic, sea salt, black pepper, and nutmeg. From here, things take a fabulously Florentine turn—that is to say, we add spinach, rounding out the flavors and incorporating a pop of color into the otherwise monochromatic mélange. It's rich, it's delicious, and all you need to do is heat it in your microwave or conventional oven to enjoy the taste of from-scratch Lasagna at your dinner table.

That's why we offer a Family-Style Meat Lasagna [sku 95112] in our freezers, every day. But that's just one take

styles, every day...

084436.item_story_marketing:
Our Trader Joe’s every day potato chip line-up now contains all the quintessential flavors—especially since we’ve added Trader Joe’s Sea Salt & Vinegar Potato Chips into the mix. This hold-out flavor was a long-time coming and a consistent request of customers. Now, it’s finally arrived to satisfy our customers’ expectations!

Knowing demand would be strong, we had to find a supplier who could both handle our volume, and also deliver the very best Salt & Vinegar Chip to satisfy our customers’ expectations. We found that supplier in Canada. Their secret (not-so-secret) formula involves kettle-cooking thinly sliced potatoes in small batches using Avocado Oil, which produces an amazing crunch that serves as an ideal base for the all-important seasoning. Our seasoning involves the optimal ratio of vinegar powder to sea salt, yielding an irresistible interplay between bold, tangy flavor and lip-smacking brininess. In short: it’s goooood!

Whether you’ll dunk Trader Joe’s Sea Salt & Vinegar Chips in Ranch Cottage Cheese Dip, tuck them into a sandwich, or munch them directly from the bag, we’re certain you’ll agree these Chips were well worth the wait!

084441.item_story_marketing:
“Ska vi fika?” is what Swedish people say when it’s time for a snack. Fika (a slang term derived from mixing up the syllables for kaffi - i.e. “coffee”) is essentially a highly social coffee break that not only encourages people to slow down and take a mindful moment, but also to enjoy some delicious traditional pastries—like a Swedish Princess Cake. Being lovers of coffee and pastries (not to mention a good time with friends), we decided a Swedish Princess Cake would make a fine offering in our freezers!

Trader Joe’s Swedish Princess Cake is made for us by experts in Sweden. It’s a traditional domed confection that features two layers of airy sponge cake sandwiching a thin layer of tart-sweet raspberry jam and rich pastry cream. On top of this is a lusciously thick dome (we mean thick!) of whipped cream, with the entire Cake draped in stunning, pastel-green marzipan that’s accented with thin white stripes. There’s really nothing quite like this combination, either in look or in taste!

Serve it to friends at tea-time. They’ll be astonished by the presentation. Make it the center of a child’s birthday. It’s sure to make them feel extra special. Or... simply take a slice for yourself, whenever you need to have a mindful moment. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Swedish Princess Raspberry Cake in our freezers for a limited time, September through the end of the year.

084466.item_story_marketing:
As the weather warms up, cooking dinner (read: heating up the kitchen) becomes exponentially less appealing—but you still need to feed your crew. What to do? Pick up some packages of Trader Joe’s Carne Asada Ranchera! Inspired by the flavorful meat offered at taco carts and meat markets across Southern California, our buyer made it his mission to develop exclusive-to-Trader Joe’s marinades for these quick-cooking options in our fresh meat case.

Reformulated just in time for grilling season, our Pollo Asado—previously made with chicken breast—is now made with ultra-juicy chicken thighs, the ideal foil to its zesty, citrus-infused marinade.

Impossibly easy to prep (just open and cook in a pan, on the grill, or on a plancha, if you’ve got one handy), the finished meat shines in a street taco setting, and makes for a palate-popping addition to a bed of salad greens, burrito bowl, or quesadilla. Grab a package from your neighborhood Trader Joe’s and try it for yourself!

On a warm day or busy evening, cooking (read: heating up the kitchen) becomes exponentially less appealing— but you still need to feed your crew. What to do? 084486.item_story_marketing:
You know what are great? Orange & cream flavored desserts. Ice creams, popsicles, frosty blended beverages, and... well, we suppose that’s about it, as far as orange & cream flavored treats go. Now, we could simply be content with the limitations of the current orange & cream landscape, but that wouldn’t be very Trader Joe’s-y of us, would it? No, instead we’ve dared to dream big, to push the boundaries of what an orange & cream flavored sweet treat can be. And with one taste of Trader Joe’s Orange & Cream Flavored Cookies, you’ll see we were right to do so.

They’re made for us by an esteemed cookie supplier, who starts with a sweet, buttery, and lightly salty base dough, then mixes in delicately tangy yogurt chips and Orange & Cream flavored bits of sugar, and bakes them until they’re crisp, crumbly, and wonderfully delicious. On their own, they provide all the same sweet, rich, and citrus-y splendor of a classic frozen Orange & Cream treat, and all the same satisfyingly buttery crunch of a Cookie at the same time. And as a complementary confection, they make an excellent companion to a bowl of French Vanilla Ice Cream—especially if they happen to be crumbled atop the ice cream. This is why we do what we do, folks.

084504.item_story_marketing:
Over the years, we’ve introduced a veritable rainbow of our handy (and handsome!) Insulated Bags, in a splendid spectrum of red, orange, yellow, green, teal blue, purple, and lavender. And now, just for the summer, we’re welcoming this lovely, electrifyingly Lime Green Insulated Bag into the lineup, too.

Of course, these Bags are much more than just an aesthetic accessory. Dimensionally, they’re a foot-and-a-half wide and a little more than a foot deep, with the capacity for about eight gallons of groceries. The padded insides and zippered lid of this reusable shopping Bag will help keep cold any frozen pizzas, ice creams, cheeses, dips, chilled produce, and more, as you traverse from our refrigerators to yours.

And like our other colored Insulated Bags, this one has extra sturdy, reinforced straps that are long enough to sling over your shoulder for easy carrying. There’s even a convenient internal pocket for your keys and money while you’re shopping—or to hold extra supplies when you use Trader Joe’s Lime Green Insulated Bag to tote desserts and picnic salads over to a pool party or late-summer potluck at the park. You’ll find them with our other reusable bags, August through October.

084540.item_story_marketing:
The baked goods in our freezers are not only practical for busy, would-be bakers, but they’re also decidedly delicious. You get all the pastry pleasure with no dough rolling—and sometimes no baking at all! Trader Joe's Raspberry Filled Donuts are a great example of this, ready to enjoy after just two hours thawing in the refrigerator. 

Borrowing features from German Berliners, French beignets, and good-old American donut holes—our Raspberry Filled Donuts have a few unique traits of their own, setting them apart in the universe of fried pastries. Made for us in Belgium, each one is round and soft with a striking pink hue that is naturally derived from red beet powder. When you take a pillowy bite, you’ll first discover the airy crumb, then the dollop of deep-red-hued filling (colored with fruit & vegetable juices) and flavored with raspberries & raspberry purée. 

The burst of sweet-tart fruitiness in the midst of tender fried dough makes these Donuts ideal partners for a cup of morning coffee, a spot of afternoon tea, or a scoop of after-dinner ice cream (yay, frozen desserts!).

Joe's Raspberry Filled Donuts have a few unique traits of their own, setting them apart in the universe of fried 
pastries. Made for us in Belgium, each one is round and soft with a striking pink hue that is naturally derived 
from red beet powder. When you take a pillowy bite, you'll first discover the airy crumb, then the dollop of 
deep-red-hued filling (colored with fruit & vegetable juices) and flavored with raspberries & raspberry purée. 

The burst of sweet-tart fruitiness in the midst of tender fried dough makes these Donuts ideal partners for a 
cup of morning coffee, a spot of afternoon tea, or a scoop of after-dinner ice cream (yay, frozen desserts!). You'll 
find Raspberry Filled Donuts in our freezers from July through September.

084544.item_story_marketing:
A couple of years ago, when we realized that we had an assortment of delicious guacamole offerings and a variety of sensational salsa options, but no queso, we got right on the case and introduced Trader Joe’s White Queso Dip. Today, customers love its creamy dippable character and flavorful, yet mild, profile. Now, for those who love our Queso, yet crave more heat, we’re introducing our Spicy Queso Dip! 

This Dip begins with the exact same tasty white Cheddar base as our White Queso. (In fact, white Cheddar is again the very first ingredient.) Chunks of jalapeños aren’t far behind, followed by chipotle pepper purée. Both add a healthy amount of heat, and the blended chipotles naturally provide the Dip’s distinctively orange hue.

A handful of other seasonings, such as dried red chili, smoked paprika, cayenne, and garlic & onion powders all collaborate to make this Queso just right for kicking up your next dipping session—whether you’re dunking TJ’s Organic Blue Corn Tortilla Chips, Organic Corn Chip Dippers, a Soft Pretzel Stick, or some other TJ’s favorite that’s looking for a Spicy, cheesy partner.

084582.item_story_marketing:
Summer is approaching, and it feels like just the right time to introduce Trader Joe’s Lemon Pepper Seasoning to our spice shelves. This is a straightforward blend of black pepper, lemon peel, sea salt, citric acid, garlic, onion, and lemon oil. It’s definitely Lemon Pepper forward, with just enough other elements added to heighten the flavors and really make them pop. 

Like the summer season itself, this shake-able seasoning blend is bright and sunshiny, a veritable breath of fresh air to liven up all kinds of cooking. With outdoor cooking top of mind, we’re thinking of how much more exciting a grilled chicken breast or turkey burger will be with a few dashes of Lemon Pepper Seasoning shaken on while it cooks. And because this will be a spice section staple, when summer has faded, these flavors will still be available for bold, bright takes on your favorite dishes. Try it with roasted vegetables, as a rub for all kinds of meats and seafood—it’s especially good with shrimp —and as an easy way to elevate a humble bowl of popcorn.
084582.item_story_qil:
Lemon has an inherent ability to brighten everything it touches, no matter the time of year. It adds a sharp acid 
that wakes up flavors in grilled meats during summer, rich pastas in fall, hearty casseroles in winter, or fresh 
salads chopped up for spring. A straightforward blend of black pepper, lemon peel, sea salt, citric acid, garlic, 
onion, and lemon oil, Trader Joe's Lemon Pepper Seasoning delivers that bright, lemony flavor in a tiny-yet-
mighty jar.  It's definitely Lemon Pepper forward, while the allium-y elements further heighten the citric flavor.

This shake-able seasoning blend is bright and sunshiny, a veritable breath of fresh air to liven up all kinds of

with roasted vegetables, as a rub for all kinds of meats and seafood-it's especially good with shrimp-and as

084589.item_story_marketing:
You may have seen a Flauta and wondered, “what makes this any different from a taquito?” Well, it’s true they both start with the same foundation of a flavorful, tender filling (typically made up of shredded meat) rolled tightly in a tortilla, then deep-fried until golden and crispy—the main difference is taquitos use corn tortillas and are much smaller in size. That’s why we’re so excited to offer Trader Joe’s Chicken Flautas in stores; they’re made traditionally with a larger flour tortilla for a more substantial, chewy bite, then filled with a mix of expertly seasoned dark meat chicken, diced green chile peppers, and Monterey jack cheese. Our supplier then lightly fries the Flautas, flash-freezes them, and sends them on their way to us, where they wait patiently in our freezers. 

Their larger size makes our Chicken Flautas a satisfying main dish on their own. We like to dress ‘em up with generous toppings of crema, salsa, guacamole, shredded lettuce, and a squeeze of lime. All you need to do is air fry at 375°F for 10 to 12 minutes, and you have crispy Flautas ready for enjoyment. Three or four Flautas make for an easy weeknight dinner, or just eat one or two for a hearty snack to hold you over until the next meal rolls around—pun not intended (but hopefully appreciated).

084678.item_story_marketing:
Few desserts evoke nostalgia like a hot fudge sundae; one spoonful can bring us back to simpler times, when our only concern on a summer night was getting home before the street lights turned on. Our Trader Joe’s Hot Fudge Sundae In A Handful! Confectionery Coated Almonds deliver all those classic ice cream parlor flavors in a single bite: creamy vanilla ice cream, the cocolately warmth of hot fudge, and the bright sweetness of a cherry on top, all wrapped around a perfectly toasted, buttery almond.

Our supplier starts with dry-roasted California Almonds, then expertly coats each one with either a vanilla ice cream confection with fudge flavors, or a sweet-tart cherry glaze. To ensure a sundae experience, you’ll find more ice cream with fudge flavored almonds per bag, with each cherry flavored almond acting as the cherry on top. Hot Fudge Sundae In A Handful can be enjoyed straight from the bag and are excellent when you want something a little sweet, a little salty, and completely delicious—all without the threat of melting before you can finish them. They also make an eye-catching garnish on baked goods and sweet treats—use to adorn homemade cupcakes, dress up a Mini Sheet Cake, or crush up a handful and sprinkle them on top of a scoop of French Vanilla Ice Cream and finish with a drizzle of Organic Midnight Moo and a Pitted Amarena Cherry for a bit of sundae-ception.

084739.item_story_marketing:
Your guests arrive in ten minutes. Your Mexican-style spread, featuring a host of Trader Joe’s products—Chicken Taquitos, Crispy Potato & Poblano Pepper Tacos, Organic Blue Corn Tortilla Chips, and Guacasalsa—is ready to go. All that’s missing is dessert! You had intended to make churros, but somehow, time slipped away. Now, you need a Plan B; something quick, easy, and delicious that also sticks with the Trader Joe’s/Mexican theme, with a dash of fall flair... We’ve got you: Trader Joe’s Pumpkin Flan to the rescue!

Our Flan begins with a traditional custard base, blended with Pumpkin purée and seasoned like Pumpkin pie. The Pumpkin-infused custard is cooked using a traditional water-bath method to yield that classic firm, yet smooth and creamy texture—and that’s without thickeners or starches. To serve, gently run a smooth knife blade around the edge of each foil cup, then invert the Flan onto your chosen serving plate. Dessert, done! In classic flan style, the golden-hued caramel sauce at the bottom is now on top of the pumpkin-y custard, and every spoonful delivers a silky-sweet, creamy-smooth, super-satisfying bite. Next time you need dessert, make Trader Joe’s Pumpkin Flan your Flan A! You’ll find it in our refrigerators, only during the fall.
084739.name: HOL FLAN PUMPKIN

084740.item_story_marketing:
While we’re on the subject of pumpkins (which is to say, pretty much any given moment you catch us between August and November), we’d like to take the time to reiterate a point near to our hearts: when it comes to pumpkin spice, we often like the pumpkin as front and center as the spice. Don’t get us wrong—we dearly love cinnamon, nutmeg, and clove in their own right, but when we want something pumpkin-y, we want something pump-kin-y. Something like Trader Joe’s Pumpkin & Spice Caramel Sauce (notice the Pumpkin & Spice, there).

Each batch is made with rich, buttery, super sweet Caramel, familiar fall-evoking Spices (see above), and, crucially, enough puréed Pumpkin to impart the mild and nutty taste of Pumpkin itself. It’s a luxuriously thick dessert Sauce, ideal for drizzling over our Apple Pie À La Mode Ice Cream, Pumpkin Yogurt, Salted Almond Honey Granola—truly anything you wish to give a kick of Caramel, Pumpkin, & Spice. This is one of those items where your only limit is your imagination, though we’d happily suggest using it for coffee drinks, Pumpkin Sourdough French toast, or for dunking apple slices.

084760.item_story_marketing:
Especially around this time of year, a good torte has so much to offer. At brunch, it pairs impeccably well with a hot coffee or cold brew. On a brisk evening, it’s wonderful when warmed and topped with ice cream. (And, depending on how your family dinners tend to go, at a big holiday feast, it can act simultaneously as a dessert and peace offering.) 

Trader Joe’s Plum Torte comes to us from a longtime supplier in Canada, who just so happens to be an expert in the art and science of fruit-forward pastries. Here, they start with halved, slightly tart, quite juicy Plums (the first ingredient!), arrayed within a layer of batter. The Torte is baked until just done, then frozen in this state of perfection. Once you get it home, some time in your oven is all it takes to achieve the alluring aromas, slightly crispy edges, and tender, fruity Plum Torte of your dreams.

084763.item_story_marketing:
What do you get when a Trader Joe’s buyer crosses croissant-inspired dough with an apple Danish filling? Well, our buyer received a resounding “Yay!” vote at the Trader Joe’s Tasting Panel, which means you, dear customer, get Trader Joe’s Mini Apple Danish Pastries! 

Made for us in France, these petite, two-bite Pastries are elegantly formed with an all-butter dough base adorned with elegant cutouts on top, which allow the sweet, golden, Apple purée and caramel filling to prettily peek through. Each buttery, flaky bite of Pastry is complemented by the floral sweetness of the fruit and rich warmth of the caramel, creating an eating experience akin to what you might find in an upscale pastry shop—but instead, you found it in the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s! What’s more, the only thing standing between you and pure Pastry bliss is a quick stint in the oven—there’s no proofing required, just let them mellow on the counter while your oven preheats. C’est magnifique!

084769.item_story_marketing:
As our celebrated Sweet Picanté Peppers with Creamy Cheese Filling have shown during their tenure on our grocery shelf, something magical happens on the palate when you combine sweet, peppery, tart, and creamy flavors all at once. And now, their fiery cousins, Trader Joe’s Spicy & Sweet Picanté Peppers with a Spicy Creamy Cheese Filling, have arrived to show that a whole different kind of magic can occur when you add some Spice into the mix! On their own, Picanté Peppers don’t provide all that much heat, so our supplier in Greece (the same stuffed-pepper specialist behind our original Sweet Picanté Peppers) has upped the ante by mixing these Peppers’ Creamy Cheese Filling with a Spicy and savory blend of seasonings, including chili powder, chili flakes, and chili extract, along with onion, garlic, and paprika. 

It all results in some seriously full-flavored and pleasantly poppable little Peppers, which fulfill a surprising variety of culinary roles. As an hors d’oeuvre, for instance, they add plenty of zest to a party’s snack table. As a topping, they provide a piquant punch to a sandwich, pizza, or salad. And enjoyed simply on their own as a standalone snack, you’re free to savor the full breadth of their well-balanced flavors—and in particular, appreciate how well their Spicy notes complement, rather than overpower, their other elements.

084771.item_story_marketing:
Bark has become something of a fixture at Trader Joe’s. For nearly a quarter of a century, we’ve offered Peppermint Bark during the holidays, and over time, we’ve introduced a number of dark chocolate-based bark products. What exactly is a bark, when talking about candy? Generally speaking, it’s a slab of chocolate, studded with complementary flavors and textures, and broken into pieces for easy, handheld enjoyment.

New to our shelves this fall, Trader Joe’s Pumpkin Pie Spice Bark delivers on all your expectations—and then some. It begins with a canvas of white chocolate, to which we’ve added pumpkin pie spices, as well as broken-up bits of pretzels and gingersnap cookies. The top is drizzled with dark chocolate, and sprinkled with a bitof sea salt, which not only adds a lovely salty balance, but also amplifies all the other flavors. Sweet-but-not-too-sweet, just the right amount of salty, and a harmonious blend of creamy and crunchy—in other words, delicious!

084775.item_story_marketing:
Roughly similar to a crumble, cobbler, or pan dowdy, apple crisp is an elegantly simple dessert consisting of sweetened and spiced apples, covered with a crunchy streusel topping and baked until golden brown. Now, if there’s anything we love more than elegant simplicity, it’s taking a simple idea and exploring it in a captivatingly complex way—which is precisely what our supplier, a chocolatier in Ireland, has done with Trader Joe’s Apple Crisp Inspired Milk Chocolate Caramels.

Available only for the fall, these Caramels express the same satisfyingly sweet, cinnamon-y, and crunchy profile as a homemade Apple Crisp, by way of a Chocolate confection. Each bite starts with the smooth and teeth-sinking sensations of the Milk Chocolate exterior, which is immediately followed by super sweet, Apple-and-cinnamon-flavored Caramel (complete with teeny little bits of Apple throughout!) and finished with a streusel-evoking crunch from the Crisp bottom layer of Chocolate filling.
084775.name: HOL CARAMELS APPLE CRISP

084778.item_story_marketing:
By its very nature, vinaigrette starts as a tart, tangy, altogether acidic proposition—anything based primarily on vinegar will be. So, when setting out to create a vinaigrette, balance is paramount. And what better way to balance out some tart tanginess than some approachable, apple-y sweetness? That’s what’s on offer with our latest seasonal salad dressing, Trader Joe’s Apple Vinaigrette Dressing. Our supplier uses a mix of Apple juice concentrate and honey, along with bright and bracing vinegar to create a lush and fruity Vinaigrette that’s expertly balanced, measuredly mellow, and ideal for all sorts of seasonal dishes.

Beyond its use in salads—which we certainly won’t overlook; it’s particularly delicious with spinach, arugula, and Butter Lettuce—our Apple Vinaigrette also makes an excellent marinade or finishing sauce for grilled chicken, air-fried Sockeye Salmon Fillets, and pan-seared pork chops. It provides a nice piquant note to a sandwich or wrap, and elevates a simple bowl of Steamed Lentils to a truly sensational side dish.

084780.item_story_marketing:
As ovens across the land begin to heat, ready for baking season to begin, the grocery shelves at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s are packed with plenty of ingredients for baking from scratch, as well as mixes ready to unbox and move into the oven with very little effort. You might want a Pumpkin Bread Mix or a Brownie Mix. Or you might want the newest addition to our lineup, Trader Joe’s Maple Butterscotch Blondie Baking Mix.

To make our Maple Butterscotch Blondie Mix, you need only add an egg and a stick of melted butter. Mix it up, pour it into a pan, then bake. Easy! After the alchemy of the oven is complete, an entirely new level of magic happens, courtesy of the included packet of Butterscotch syrup. You can drizzle it on top in any manner you desire—we’ve included pictorial instructions on the box for creating the feathered pattern on the package. When complete, these Blondies deliver on the expected buttery, sweet, and salty flavors, as well as the slightly crisp exterior (especially the edges!) and chewy interior. (Pro-tip: we like these baked on the lighter side, which results in a chewier texture.)

Like autumn itself, Maple Butterscotch Blondie Mix will only be around for a short time, so stock up while it’s on our shelves.
084780.item_story_qil:
Fall's arrival signals the start of a slightly less official, but almost as important season in our stores-that's right 
folks, we're talking about baking season! Your neighborhood Trader Joe's offers a curated collection of baking 
mixes and mix-ins ready to help warm up your kitchen and make your fall baking dreams a reality, such as 
Trader Joe's Maple Butterscotch Blondie Baking Mix.

With a deeply sweet and rich maple butterscotch syrup and a tender, chewy blondie base, this Baking Mix 
combines the complex warmth of butterscotch, the seasonal flavor of maple, and a scrumptious bakery favorite. 
Combine the Mix with a large egg, unsalted butter, and a little elbow grease, and evenly spread the soft dough 
in a baking pan. To create a feathered butterscotch pattern, cut one corner of the included butterscotch syrup 
and create 7-8 parallel lines of butterscotch over dough, with ~1 inch of space between lines, then, pull a knife 
gently through the surface of the dough in alternating directions. After a short stint in the oven, you'll have 
a gooey, chewy dessert bar teeming with the warm notes of maple and the robust undertones of caramel-a 
confection that looks and tastes like it's straight out of an upscale bakery! It's sure to please morning or night, 
with coffee or tea, or topped with a dollop of Salted Maple Ice Cream [sku 74637] to really indulge in the flavors 
of the season. 

Maple Butterscotch 
Blondie Baking Mix
