084787.item_story_marketing:
The season of holiday gatherings is upon us, and if there’s one thing we know for sure, it’s that your guests are going to show up hungry. That’s where the charcuterie board comes in—its goal, tempering hungry hordes of humans until dinner is served. Some of us simply don’t have willpower or crafty capacity to create salami roses or cheese swans. That’s where Trader Joe’s Calabrese & Mozzarella Swirls come in to save to day! Aside from its obviously charming “swirl” design, this spiral shaped antipasto boasts some additional charms. For example, the Mozzarella cheese here is fresh and creamy, and rolled in spicy, uncured Calabrese salami for a rich, flavorful bite.

These Swirls make a striking and tasty addition to any charcuterie board—pair them with Garlic & Jalapeño Olives, Cornichons, and slices of toasted Organic French Baguette for a show stopping spread your friends will boast about. Whether you’re entertaining a crowd, or simply craving a quick cheese and charcuterie, our Calabrese & Mozzarella Swirls deliver a quintessentially handy (and hand-held), no-cracker-required nibble that is sure to please.

084820.item_story_marketing:
Now, you might be thinking, “21 Grains & Seeds? How is that possible? Are there even enough reasonable Grains and Seeds to put into a single loaf?” The answer is an unequivocal “yes!” Organic Grains include whole wheat, flax, millet, oats, quinoa, barley, rye, spelt, triticale, amaranth, corn, khorasan, buckwheat, purple corn, brown rice, and sorghum. Organic Seeds include sunflower, pumpkin, sesame (black and white), and poppy. Twenty-one!

Like the icosikaihenagon (21-sided polygon), Trader Joe’s Organic Thin Sliced 21 Grains & Seeds Bread is multi-faceted. 084821.item_story_marketing:
Fall’s arrival brings with it shorter days and colder nights, bountiful harvests and spooky frights—the most terrifying of which is without doubt, the eternal question, “What’s for dinner?!” If reading the preceding sentence made you shudder, take heart, dear customer—Trader Joe’s Apple Cabbage Slaw is here!

This Complete Salad Kit starts with a blend of shredded cruciferous veggies—namely, green and red cabbage, brussels sprouts and radicchio. Toasty pecans, crunchy apples, and tart currants add sweet, nutty intrigue, and the included lemon Dijon vinaigrette adds brightness to the pleasantly bitter Slaw. The Complete Salad’s well- rounded flavors make it an ideal foil for a simply prepared protein (seared salmon or roasted Pork Tenderloin, perhaps?), while the array of hearty textures provides a satisfying base for a grain salad with quinoa or 10-Minute Farro. From September through January, grab an Apple Cabbage Slaw Complete Salad Kit from the refrigerators at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, and consider dinner decided!

084822.item_story_marketing:
We all know how important it is to get your leafy greens in—that’s just a given, at this point. What we’d like to add to the conversation, if we may, is the importance of getting your leafy reds in, too. And not strictly as a matter of nutrition, either! As Trader Joe’s Organic Red & Green Leaf Salad Mix ably demonstrates, a blend of vividly verdant (organic baby spinach, frisée, and beet Greens) and radiantly ruddy (organic Red arugula) Leaf vegetables also bring a delightfully two-toned aesthetic to the table, as well as a balanced Mix of elegant flavors and light, tender textures.

And since this Organic Red & Green Leaf Salad Mix comes pre-washed and ready-to-use, it’s a cinch to put together a side or entrée salad in any and all contexts, from a big holiday feast to a last-minute weeknight dinner. Simply toss the contents of a bag with your favorite TJ’s salad dressing (we find something tangy and tart like our tried-and-true Balsamic Vinaigrette is an excellent complement to the Salad’s sweet, earthy, and delicately peppery notes), along with something crunchy, something fruity, and something cheesy, and you’re on your way. Now through the end of the year, you’ll find this Mix among our refrigerated produce.

084825.item_story_marketing:
Over time, we’ve figured out a few things when it comes to sandwiches. Like, the bread really matters—some bread just doesn’t hold up well, and other bread is simply too darn thick, and distracts from the good stuff inside. Our Chicken & Cheddar Sandwich on Cranberry Bread is a great example of great bread holding everything together and really allowing what’s inside to shine. With Trader Joe’s Homestyle Chicken Salad Croissant Sandwich, the Croissant in which our star ingredients are stuffed might be the ideal sandwich carrier, and we are here for every bite.

Trader Joe’s Homestyle Chicken Salad Croissant Sandwich features Homestyle Chicken Salad, stuffed inside a buttery Croissant. This is a classic American chicken salad, with celery and carrots and green onions, dressed with mayo, and enhanced with a suite of savory seasonings. The addition of crunchy Green Leaf Lettuce brings some textural complexity, and the Croissant maintains its airy insides and flaky outside. The Sandwich’s convenient grab-and-go, ready-to-eat package makes it an excellent option for work, travel, or a picnic. And it’s easy to elevate with Provolone Cheese or sliced tomato and onion. Pack one in a Mini Insulated Tote Bag with a handful of Chips, and a beverage and you have the makings of the perfect lunch!

These Meatballs are made with all natural, minimally processed chicken thigh and breast meat from birds raised without antibiotics. These Meatballs make a great savory snack or appetizer—just simmer these them in a sauce of your choice, or serve alongside a tangy dip, and you have a quick and flavorful appetizer for cocktail and holiday parties alike. 084853.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Chicken Burgers are made from All Natural Chicken raised with no antibiotics ever and no added hormones. It’s ground and seasoned with garlic, onion, oregano, basil, parsley, salt and pepper. Then it’s portioned, flattened, and cooked just right to maintain all the tender juiciness of the high-quality Chicken.

At home, these fully-cooked patties conveniently heat through in just minutes—in a skillet, microwave, or air fryer. They’re so simple to enjoy, we think that the most difficult thing about Trader Joe’s Chicken Burgers is just deciding what other TJ’s products to pair with them! To that delicious end, you’ll find these Burgers—plus a wide variety of buns, cheeses, produce, and condiments—all at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, every day!
084853.item_story_qil:
1930s Americans thought that the "ham" in hamburger referred to the meat in the patty, so they shortened it to 
"burger." (In fact, the original seasoned ground beef patty came from 19th century Hamburg, Germany-and 
there were no pigs involved.) One happy side-effect of this misunderstanding was how subsequent ground-
meat aficionados (like Trader Joe's) felt free to think outside of the bun, so-to-speak, leading to a whole host 
of non-beef "burgers," including Turkey Burgers [sku 96937], Shrimp Burgers [sku 57733], and even Vegetable 
Masala Burgers [sku 88865], to name just a few. What next? Given the popularity of our Chicken Meatballs [sku 
74578], we decided it was high time to add a Chicken Burger to our extensive list of meat-patty products.

084859.item_story_marketing:
The name Tazmin Breeze ostensibly refers to the air current flowing over the Tasman Sea between Australia and New Zealand, eventually kissing the plentiful vineyards of Sauvignon Blanc in the region of Marlborough. Cool nights and long daylight hours (and, no doubt, the ocean breeze) team up to preserve acidity and aromatic intensity. Stainless steel fermentation—and the deliberate choice to avoid oak—also help to preserve the clean, fruit-driven style that is so refreshingly evident in this wine. Indeed, the finished juice boasts aromas of bracing lime zest and grapefruit, with hints of passion fruit. Bright citrus, tropical fruit, and notes of fresh herbs on the palate ease their way to a clean, crisp finish.

All these traits prove to be amiable partners to Marinated Mozzarella delivered on crusty baguette slices, or a scoop of Surimi-based seafood salad poised on a bed of our Chopped Salad Blend. Of course, a chilled glass also graciously complements the rich character of homemade mac-n-cheese made with TJ’s Organic Gigli Pasta. Indeed, enjoying this wine is a breeze, especially because you can find 750mL bottles of Tazmin Breeze Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc in our wine section, every day!

084921.item_story_marketing:
Take your tastebuds on a proverbial tropical getaway with a box of Trader Joe’s Pineapple Coconut Bars! These yellow Bars are sweet, tart, and oh-so-refreshing. Rich Coconut cream is complemented by the tangy verve of Pineapple juice, the mixture is sweetened with cane sugar to enhance the tropical notes of the fruit, and a bit of turmeric delivers a pop of color. This is a supremely satisfying frozen treat, equally enjoyed by adults and kids alike.

Reminiscent of a soft-serve flavor popular at theme parks, but in an easy-to-enjoy, perfectly portioned, bar-on- a-stick format, these Bars are a no-brainer dessert option for BBQs, backyard hangs, pool parties, and picnics. They also happen to be vegan and gluten free, making it easy for more of your guests to partake in the frozen Pineapple Coconut fun. Best of all, it won’t cost you a theme park ticket (or a sunburn for that matter) to enjoy.

084965.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Harvest Kale Caesar Salad may share a name with a few Roman emperors, but in its construction, it actually reminds us of a different icon of Mediterranean antiquity: the Ship of Theseus. Inspired by the mythological hero’s watercraft, which was totally rebuilt, part by part, throughout his escape from Crete, the philosopher Plutarch asked: at what point is the Ship of Theseus no longer the original ship? To that end, at what point does our fall-seasonal Harvest Kale Caesar, which remixes on the familiar Caesar formula by adding hearty Kale, a blend of Harvest veggies, and crunchy, candied pumpkin seeds, remain a Caesar?

While the original Ship of Theseus is meant to be an open-ended thought experiment, we have a much more conclusive answer for our conundrum: Trader Joe’s Harvest Kale Caesar Salad is very much a Caesar, and a supremely satisfying one at that! The additions of jammy tomatoes, roasted sweet potatoes, and pepitas to the traditional shaved Parmesan, crouton-y breadcrumbs, and creamy Caesar dressing simply bring a twist to a beloved classic. And while we’re on the subject of satisfying conclusions, we should note that at our retail for each 11-ounce Salad, it makes an expertly elevated grab-and-go meal. Be sure to swing by our refrigerators to pick one up, while supplies last!

084977.item_story_marketing:
Table Red Blend is an ode to Santa Barbara County’s cool maritime corridors and sun-drenched inland valleys that conspire to produce wines of striking complexity, and this Rhône-inspired blend is no exception. Drawing from the county’s diverse appellations, including grapes sourced predominantly from the Santa Ynez Valley, this wine captures a season of ideal temperature swings that preserved bright acidity while allowing phenolic ripeness to develop fully for supple texture and an enjoyable finish. Deep garnet in the glass with a violet rim, this wine opens with an expressive nose of blackberry compote, plum and cherry, layered with Grenache’s lifted red fruit, like wild strawberry and pomegranate. Mourvèdre contributes an earthy, savory backbone of leather and garrigue that adds gravitas and depth.

On the palate, the wine is full-bodied yet structured, with velvety tannins and a mid-palate richness shaped by twelve months in American oak, of which 50% was neutral for a balanced influence. Vanilla, toasted cedar, and subtle notes from the oak weave seamlessly into the fruit without overpowering it. The finish is long and warming, with lingering notes of espresso, dark chocolate, and a touch of spice.

This blend begs for the table, as the name indicates, but is equally fitting for BBQs –outdoor tables work too! Serve alongside braised short ribs, lamb shoulder with rosemary and olives, or a wood-fired leg of lamb. It excels with smoky preparations — barbecued brisket, grilled merguez sausages, or a charcuterie spread of aged Manchego and soppressata. For a vegetarian pairing, try roasted eggplant with harissa and herbed couscous. Gather ‘round and enjoy…in this 1L bottle, there’s more to share of this amazing value!

084990.item_story_marketing:
Now here’s a dessert that cuts right to the chase. Inspired by the superlatively full-flavored experience of serving a slice of apple pie with a generous scoop of ice cream, Trader Joe’s Apple Pie À La Mode Ice Cream delivers those sensations all within the confines of a single pint. Our supplier starts with a rich and velvety vanilla Ice Cream as the base, adds in chunks of cooked, sweetened Apple and bits of crumbly Pie crust, then finishes it with a cinnamon-and-nutmeg spiced Apple swirl for good measure.

Available now through the end of the holiday season, Trader Joe’s Apple Pie À La Mode Ice Cream combines the best of both its constituent parts in every bite: from the crumbly Pie crust pieces and tender Apples, to the aromatic allure of the cinnamon-y spice and heady vanilla. It serves excellently on its own, and—dare we say it? Of course, we dare!—also takes a marvelously maximalist turn atop a warm slice of Plum Torte, or a Teeny Tiny Apple Pie itself as a doubly-À La Mode masterpiece.

084994.item_story_marketing:
For a relatively small piece of fruit, passion fruit sure packs a big, flavorful punch. This tropical wonder has recently been making waves on our shelves—much to our customers’ delight—appearing in the form of Tartelettes, Sorbet, Granola, Yogurt, and even dried Fruit Squares. You can imagine our buyer’s delight, then, when she found an ice cream bar supplier who could transform the fruit’s tart, tangy essence into what are now Trader Joe’s Passion Fruit Ice Cream Mini Bars!

Juxtaposing bright, mouth-puckering Passion Fruit juice with cool, velvety Ice Cream, these gluten free Mini Bars will take your taste buds on a tropical vacation. Their Mini size makes them ideal for an afternoon cool-down or post-dinner treat, capable of satisfying a sweet craving without making you feel overly full. What’s more, our passion for value means you can get a box of six Passion Fruit Ice Cream Mini Bars from the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s for less than the cost of a single bar from the ice cream truck!

084997.item_story_marketing:
Pak choi (or commonly called “bok choy”) is an ancient leafy green, with its earliest seeds dating back 6,000 years ago in China. While we might be a couple dozen centuries late to the party, we’re excited to introduce Trader Joe’s Baby Pak Choi. This multi-colored, tender baby green is high in vitamin C, vitamin K, vitamin A, and folate—making it a particularly nutritious addition to your diet. And while it’s similar to spinach, we find it to be crispier, with a slightly better shelf life, Unlike regular bok choy, Baby Pak Choi really stands out in taste—it’s mild and slightly sweet in flavor—and cooks up quickly!

Baby Pak Choi is delicious raw or cooked—it’s an excellent salad base, and is perfect for sautéing and stir-fries with a mix of your favorite vegetables or proteins. What’s more, ours is pre-washed, so it’s ready-to-eat straight from the bag. Just open, pour, add your own accoutrements as desired, and enjoy! The options are almost endless, but you might start with stir-frying with scallions, garlic, and ginger with a dash of salt, sugar, Reduced Sodium Soy Sauce and Toasted Sesame Oil. Easy & delicious!

085000.item_story_marketing:
For reasons we can't entirely understand, it seems to be a common conception that pasta salad should be exclusively associated with summer. Sure, we get the “cold pasta in hot weather” connotation, but really, pasta salad is a delicious addition to any meal, no matter the weather. As we contemplated the complexities of cold noodles, our imaginations drifted to fall, and we imagined mafalda pasta topped with apples, sweetened dried cranberries, pumpkin seeds, celery, mandarin oranges, feta, and arugula. Then we set to work bringing our dreams to life, and added a tangy white balsamic dressing, because really, if you're going to dream... dream big!

Trader Joe's Mandarin Crunch Pasta Salad partners slightly al dente, ribbon-like mafalda pasta with crunchy, chewy, sweet, savory, and salty components to create an only-at-Trader Joe's side Salad that can become a full meal in moments with a few ounces of your favorite protein. Whether it's lunch or dinner, and whether you're dining solo or with a friend, Mandarin Crunch Pasta Salad brings Pasta Salad to your table, and value to your grocery budget.

085005.item_story_marketing:
Depending on where you are in the country, fall often means gloomier weather, or at the very least, heralds gloomier weather to come. That’s no reason to feel gloomy yourself, however. In fact, we actively look forward to cloudy skies and gray mornings, because those are the ideal conditions for slowly sipping a little caffeinated beverage. And with our tea and coffee concentrates, including the new Trader Joe’s London Fog Tea Concentrate, it’s never been easier or more convenient to mix-up a little pick-me-up. Which means even more time for slow sipping and savoring the gloom around you.

Made with a blend of brisk, earthy Assam and citrus-blossom-y bergamot black teas, and flavored with a touch of vanilla, this rich and robust Concentrate was designed with an iconic London Fog Tea latte in mind. It’s Concentrated to a 2:1 strength, meaning it should be mixed with two parts milk or non-dairy beverage for every one part of Concentrate. And since it’s available all year-round, we should mention that it makes an excellent hot or iced London Fog latte...

085007.item_story_marketing:
Honey mustard is one of the greats in the condiment hall-of-fame, rightfully celebrated for its balance of sweet, fragrant honey and zesty mustard flavors. And this seasoning blend is no stranger to the snack world; you’ll often find pretzels, crackers, and even potato chips coated with this medley of flavors. Now, we’re Trader Joe’s—so, we couldn’t simply iterate on a classic, we had to innovate. With the love our customers consistently show for our evolving selection of well-seasoned popcorn top of mind, we got to work on a snack we hadn’t seen elsewhere, and Trader Joe’s Honey Mustard Popcorn was born—a crunchy, piquant, I-think-I-need-another-handful snack made for sweet and savory lovers alike.

Each bite contains the perfect seasoning-to-popcorn ratio for maximum enjoyment. This rich and bold blend sticks in all those ideal crevasses so that every bite is loaded with sweet Honey and tangy Mustard goodness. We could have stopped there, but we decided to pop these kernels in 100% Avocado Oil for a nice crunch and airy pop. Take a bag to the movies. Take it to the park. Take it to your couch. We find that more often than not, you’ll magically find your hand making its way to reach for a handful before you even notice. It’s just that good.

085020.item_story_marketing:
An underrated aspect of cheese is its capability to act as a canvas for all sorts of eye-catching and mouthwatering flavor combos. It’s an aspect ably explored by the suppliers of our new, limited-supply Trader Joe’s Pink Peppercorn Fontina. A renowned group of cheesemakers based in the dairylands of Wisconsin crafts mini wheels of mild, nutty, creamy Fontina, then generously dusts their surface area with cracked Pink Peppercorns, and also freeze-dried strawberry powder for a pop of color. The result is a regal, rosy feast for the eyes, and a pleasantly piquant, almost spicy note on the palate.

Ideal for presenting on charcuterie platters, shaving over salads, or melting over burger patties, our uniquely delicious Pink Peppercorn Fontina pairs remarkably well with dried fruit, sparkling wine, and our similarly-seasonal Autumn Harvest Sweet & Salty Snack Mix. Around this time of year, we also find it makes a formidable foundation for a fondue, and eats dreamily when drizzled with honey.

085040.item_story_marketing:
In the north of Colombia, a collective of indigenous coffee growers known as Anei (from the Arhuaco word for “good” or “delicious”) have gained global recognition for their organic growing methods, sustainable practices, and, of course, fantastically full-flavored coffees. In addition to Anei’s environmental efforts at the agricultural level, the beans they supply are freighted to the roasters via sailboat, where they’re roasted using hydro-electric power. Each bag of Trader Joe’s Organic Fair Trade Colombia Anei Coffee is adorned with sailboat imagery—as tribute to both the farmers’ earth-friendly approach to growing, and the sense of adventure that imbues every sip.

Originally introduced as part of our small lot coffee series, we’re excited to announce that Colombia Anei Coffee is now available every day! With its rich notes of dark chocolate and ripe, red fruit, it’s a silky and smooth-drinking Coffee that’s an able accompaniment to breakfasts of all kinds. It brings out the sweetness of a pastry just as easily as it complements a plate of spicy chilaquiles.

085041.item_story_marketing:
Truly: what’s more delightful than a donut in the morning? What’s better than a sweet and cakey pastry enjoyed on the way to school, or lazily dunked into a cup of coffee to start your day? These may sound like rhetorical questions, but trust us, we’ve been hard at work finding a decidedly non-rhetorical answer. And now, we’re ready to introduce said answer to you in the form of Trader Joe’s Cinnamon Powdered Sugar Mini Donuts! Though Mini in stature, they strictly improve upon the morning Donut experience in a big way—by turning it into an “anytime you feel like it” Donut experience!

Each Mini Donut is sized for about one to two bites and generously coated in a sweet, Cinnamon-spiced Powdered Sugar, which makes an excellent complement to its dense and crumbly texture. Individually, they’re ideally proportioned for a quick and easy, anytime sweet treat. And when enjoyed in a serving of two or three, they’re an awesome after-dinner dessert, or, indeed, a marvelous little morning indulgence—especially when paired with a nice cup of coffee or cocoa.

085054.item_story_marketing:
It’s the time of year when colorful leaves fall from the trees—and also the time when our customers fall for seasonal treats, such as Trader Joe’s Autumn Leaf Sugar Cookies! The snack-attraction is irresistible with these charming Cookies, starting with their whimsical Leaf shapes, made using cookie molds uniquely designed just for Trader Joe’s. In other words, you won’t find any Leaf-shaped Cookies like these anywhere else in the world! Adding to their Autumn-ticity these Leaf Cookies come in shades of gold and red, with colors created using vegetable juice and beta-carotene.

Of course, looks alone are not enough when lasting attraction is concerned... The flavor of these Sugar Cookies definitely follows through with a rich, buttery bite (the recipe includes butter), complemented by a sprinkling of coarse Rock Sugar on top for extra sweet crunch. Whether you offer a pile of these Leaves in a bowl at your fall get-together, or snack on them, straight out of the box, we think you’ll fall for them all Autumn long!

085056.item_story_marketing:
One could argue, without hyperbole, that Stags Leap District is the most important wine-growing region in the United States. Located in the heart of Napa Valley, this four-square-mile patch of land is where the wine from the storied 1976 Judgment of Paris was made, signaling California’s viticultural debut on the global stage. And in the half-century since, the dozen-or-so vineyards that call Stags Leap District their home have continued to produce some of the very best wines in the world. So, when we tell you that we are as excited as we’ve ever been to bring this Trader Joe’s Platinum Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon from Stags Leap onto our shelves, that’s entirely without hyperbole.

Characteristically elegant and jammy, yet artfully restrained, and with an impeccable tannic structure, this is the kind of Cabernet you savor, preferably with an herb-crusted rack of lamb, a well-marbled steak, or a nicely aged cheese. Speaking of aging, it’s also the kind of Cab you could cellar for a year or two, to give its already-refined edges an even smoother temperament. Indeed, it’s a truly remarkable wine, and what might be most remarkable about it is its price: for as long as we can keep it stocked in our wine section.
085056.item_story_qil:
TJs Platinum Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Stags Leap is crafted in the celebrated tradition with 
premium grapes sourced from a historical vineyard within the Stags Leap District of Napa Valley. This 
Cabernet Sauvignon captures the district's signature balance of power, polish, and graceful restraint, reflecting 
a total of 18 months aging in French Oak. 

In the glass, it opens with a deep garnet core and a ruby rim, immediately suggesting concentration 
and age-worthy structure. The nose is layered and expressive, offering ripe raspberry, black cherry, cassis, and 
red currant, followed by lifted accents of violet, dried rose petal, and warm baking spice. Subtle oak notes of 
cedar, cocoa, vanilla bean, and toasted espresso add depth without overpowering the fruit. On the palate, the 
wine is full-bodied, yet refined, delivering plush flavors of dark plum, black currant, raspberry, and bittersweet 
chocolate. Fine-grained tannins frame the mid-palate with a velvety texture, while balanced acidity keeps the 
wine vibrant and composed. The finish is long, smooth, and dry, lingering with notes of cassis and cocoa 
powder. 

This gem of a wine is ideal with richly flavored dishes that echo its depth and structure. Pair it with 
grilled ribeye, herb-crusted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, prime rib with rosemary jus, or a pepper-crusted 
filet. It also complements roasted portobello mushrooms, truffle risotto, aged cheddar, Gouda, and blue cheese. 
For a memorable pairing, serve with slow-braised beef over creamy Parmesan polenta or dark chocolate 
flourless cake with blackberry coulis.
085056.item_title: Plat Rsv Cabernet Sauvignon Stags Leap District Napa Valley 2023
085056.name: TJS PLATINUM RESERVE STAGS LEAP CABERNET SAUV

085059.item_story_marketing:
Hot coffee, tea, and Spiced Apple Cider aren’t the only drinks that bring beverage warmth during the blustery season. One might also find Whiskey to be an amiable, cool-weather friend—and wouldn’t you know it, our new, Trader Joe’s Spiced Apple Flavored Tennessee Whiskey fits the autumn bill to a capital T!

Speaking of bills, the mash bill for this Whiskey is more than 51% corn, which qualifies it as Tennessee Whiskey, as does its indubitable origin in the “Volunteer State.” But that’s not all. As is also required for all spirits labeled as “Tennessee Whiskey,” this one has been steeped through thick layers of sugar maple charcoal prior to aging. The so-called “Lincoln County Process” strips the spirit of any harsh impurities and leaves behind an impeccably smooth profile. Pair that silky sip with natural Apple flavor as we’ve done, and you’ve got one delicious and decidedly drinkable Tennessee Whiskey. It’s quaffable ‘neat’ or on-the-rocks, and we also recommend it in mixed drinks to add an Apple twist and fall flair to your Old-Fashioned cocktail or Hot Toddy! You’ll find it for a limited time among our other spirits, including our everyday, “all season,” Tennessee Whiskey.
085059.item_story_qil:
TJs Spiced Apple Tennessee Whiskey is a cozy, fruit-forward pour made for crisp evenings, holiday 
gatherings, and easy after-dinner sipping. The aroma opens with strong scents of baked apples fresh from the 
oven, layered with sweet cinnamon, subtle vanilla, and a gentle hint of toasted oak. On the palate, it delivers 
the familiar character of Tennessee whisky beneath a bright apple profile: tart yet sweet apple cider, brown 
sugar, warm baking spice, and a soft ribbon of vanilla. The whiskey's toasted-oak backbone keeps the 
sweetness balanced, adding depth, structure, and a satisfying warmth that lingers through the finish. 
Enjoy it neat to appreciate its baked-apple richness, over ice for a smoother, slower release of spice. We also 
recommend using this in mixed drinks to add an apple twist, especially in an Old-Fashioned for an autumn-
inspired version of the classic cocktail. It also shines in hot drinks, especially warmed with apple cider, a 
cinnamon stick, and an orange peel garnish. 

Serve alongside smoked pork ribs, glazed ham, barbecue chicken, or sharp cheddar to echo the 
whiskey's caramel, oak, and spice. For sweeter pairings, match it with apple pie, cinnamon rolls, bread 
pudding, gingerbread, or roasted pears with vanilla ice cream. Compact, flavorful, and inviting, this 375ml 
bottle is an ideal seasonal treat or thoughtful gift.
085059.name: HOL TJS SPICED APPLE TENNESSEE WHISKEY

085089.item_story_marketing:
There are few desserts more iconic than cherry pie. Sweet-tart cherries swimming in glossy syrup, tucked within a buttery, flaky crust has been a staple of family gatherings, summer celebrations, and holiday tables for generations. Now, we could simply be content with the limitations inherent in a cherry pie, but that wouldn’t be very Trader Joe’s of us, would it? No. Instead we’ve dared to dream big, to push the boundaries of what a cherry pie flavored sweet treat can be. And with one taste of Trader Joe’s Cherry Pie Flavored Cookies, you’ll be ever so glad we did!

They’re made for us by an esteemed cookie supplier, who starts with a sweet, buttery, and lightly salty dough, then mixes in delicately sweet white chocolate chips, Cherry Pie flavored crunchy bits and dried Bing Cherries, and bakes them until they’re crisp, crumbly, and delicious. The end result is the rich, sweet-tart experience of enjoying a slice of Cherry Pie, delivered in the satisfyingly buttery crunch of a Cookie. Delightful paired with an afternoon cup of coffee or tea, they’re also bound to delight when packed into lunchboxes, shared at picnics, or arranged on a dessert platter for gatherings. And as a complementary confection, they make an excellent companion to a scoop of French Vanilla Ice Cream—especially if they happen to be crumbled atop the ice cream. This is why we do what we do, folks.
085089.name: COOKIES CHERRY PIE

085099.item_story_marketing:
Olive oil tortas (“tortas de aceite”, as they’re known in Spain) are decidedly not a new idea—they’re mentioned in a few Spanish novels from around 400 years ago, including Don Quixote. But when our tasting panel tried Ines Rosales Cinnamon Tortas for the first time, it certainly felt like something new and exciting. If you’ve ever toasted a flour tortilla, spread it with butter, and sprinkled it with some cinnamon sugar, they’re a little like a perfected, elevated, gourmet version of that. And they ought to feel perfected: Ines Rosales, the company behind these celebrated Cinnamon Tortas, has been in business for over a century, honing their skills to the point where their Tortas have become a staple of specialty shops all over the globe.

Because they’re so desired, and because they’re imported from Spain, that’s often meant that these specialty shops have charged specialty prices on them. We, however, worked out a deal directly the folks at Ines Rosales to bring in their sweet and crispy Cinnamon Tortas for a limited time at an unbeatable retail. So, if you’ve never tried a sweet and cinnamon-y olive oil torta before, now’s the ideal time! Aside from serving as a standalone snack (which they do with aplomb), we recommend trying them topped with a scoop of your favorite ice cream, and drizzled with a bit of Fleur de Sel Caramel—the crunch of the Torta makes an especially excellent complement to French Vanilla. And as we get closer to autumn, a broken-off bit of Cinnamon Torta will serve as a great garnish to a cup of coffee, tea, or hot cocoa.

085142.item_story_marketing:
This Halloween, we’re putting down roots in the spookiest way possible. Trader Joe’s Brainiac Water Root Planter is a ghostly white, wide-eyed ceramic skull that pulls double duty as a planter and propagation station. Inside each skull is a glass vase filled with a propagated plant suspended in water, teeming with fresh root systems. Just refresh the water weekly and watch as the tangled roots creep into view through its glassy eye sockets—like watching a skull grow a brain!

Brainiac Water Root Planter comes in an assortment of foliage varieties, ready to be set out as Halloween decoration, or what the truly macabre refer to as “home décor.” Place in a sunny corner, set one on your desk, or gift one to the plant-obsessed ghoul in your life. 085211.item_story_marketing:
When the craving strikes for something sweet and sparkly to sip, why not pick something with Prebiotics? (Prebiotics, we should mention, are foods and drinks that contain nutrients for your beneficial gut bacteria, as opposed to probiotics, which introduce actual live bacteria into your system.) Joining the ranks of our popular Prebiotic Soda line (including our everyday Cherry Cola and Strawberry Vanilla flavors) for a limited time, Trader Joe’s Apple Prebiotic Soda contains fiber in the form of agave inulin, and provides a sweet and tasty pick-me-up for your palate, to boot. Made with a recipe that also includes Apple juice, cane sugar, apple cider vinegar, and stevia, it’s a sweet, fizzy, and refreshing Apple Soda that we find is especially suited to enjoying during the autumn, whether it’s in a packed lunch on a leafy hike, enjoyed from a cooler during a fall camping trip, or as part of a quick and easy, cinammon-spiced cocktail or mocktail.

Combining a and fun and fruity profile and gut-friendly fiber, and containing just 4g of total sugar per can, Trader Joe’s Apple Prebiotic Soda is about as practical as a soda pop gets. It’s great right out of the can, serves exceptionally well in a glass, over ice, and makes an ideal accompaniment to a cheeseburger, Buffalo wings, or popcorn, especially when sipped on during a cozy movie night at home.

085223.item_story_marketing:
All too often, “vanilla” is considered the default flavor—the boring, mundane choice at the ice cream parlor. In reality, vanilla is rapturously rich and utterly unique. Sweet, warm, and enchantingly floral, there’s a reason that vanilla is such a ubiquitous inclusion in baked goods and sweet treats—it’s simply very good at making sweet treats taste better! That’s why we’re proud to offer Trader Joe’s Double Fold Bourbon Vanilla Extract in a refreshed, pantry-friendly bottle, for all your baking needs.

This Extract is made with the Bourbon Vanilla Beans, a variety that’s exclusively grown east of Africa on a designated group of islands. (The name’s borrowed from the French royal family who ruled these islands at one time; which is to say, this Vanilla contains no whiskey!) Each bottle does contain a few of those famous Vanilla Bean Seeds, intensely concentrating this pleasantly potent Extract so that it delivers twice the Vanilla flavor as a standard extract. With Double Fold, you can literally use half the amount of regular vanilla called for in a recipe to efficiently elevate the flavor of your breads, cakes, cookies, frosting, waffles, whipped cream... the list is endless!

Needless to say, Trader Joe’s Double Fold Bourbon Vanilla Extract with Vanilla Bean Seeds is an apt addition to any pantry. It may even inspire you to double your oven output as you rediscover the joy of baking with high-quality Vanilla. You’ll find it in our grocery aisle through December, or while supplies last.

085325.item_story_marketing:
Parmesan cheese that has been blessing bowls of pasta and charcuterie boards alike for centuries. We offer multiple takes on this perennially useful cheese, but today we’re talking about our conveniently pre-Shredded Parmesan Cheese variety. Made to mix in, garnish, and embellish dishes-a-plenty to bring that world famous and well-loved piquancy home with you! 

Like most cheeses, Parmesan starts its life as a cultured milk mixture that is heated to create a hard, granular cheese. However unlike many other cheeses, Parmesan typically includes added salt as a preservative and is aged for at least a few months. We age Trader Joe’s Shredded Parmesan Cheese for a minimum of ten months to enhance that sharp and strong savory flavor and create the characteristic dry, gritty texture that Parmesan is known for. We especially recommend sprinkling it over pizza and pasta, where its inherent umami notes will synergize spectacularly with rich and tangy tomato sauce.

085369.item_story_marketing:
Thrills & chills, frights & delights—Halloween sure likes to keep us on the edge of our seat! While most Halloween decorations like to scare and startle, take a note from Trader Joe’s Bare Bones Succulent Garden and enjoy a moment of zen this season. This collection of captivating succulents is nestled in a miniature ceramic clawfoot bathtub with a skeleton bathing amongst the foliage, reminding us that spooky season and cozy season are one in the same.

This Succulent Garden is great for outdoor garden decor and indoor plant displays alike! Just place in bright, indirect sunlight and water once the soil is completely dry to maintain it’s good health. Unlike a real bathtub, this ceramic vessel does not contain drainage holes, so be mindful not to overwater—succulents thrive with minimal care!

085461.item_story_marketing:
New to our shelves for summer 2026, Sauvigio represents a best-of-both-worlds blend, viticulturally speaking. Each bottle contains a 50/50 mix of crisp, flinty, citrus zest-y Sauvignon Blanc and lush, easy-drinking, peach blossom-y Pinot Grigio, each sourced from select vineyards across California. As delicious as that may sound in writing, tasting it is an entirely singular experience. Every sip manages to express the best aspects of each varietal: the distinct stone fruit aromatics and effortlessly light body of the Pinot Grigio supports the bright mineral notes and delicate tropicality of the Sauv Blanc, and vice versa, in a subtle, satisfying synthesis on the palate.

Best served well-chilled, Sauvigio is well-suited to enjoying on its own, as a crisp, refreshing quaff during a late summer evening. That said, it also pairs marvelously with grilled seafood or summer squash, a chicken Caesar salad, or a toast topped with Creamy Dreamy Whipped Ricotta at brunch. Now through the end of the summer.
085461.item_story_qil:
Sauvigio Sauvignon Blanc- Pinot Grigio Blend is what happens when two of summer's most beloved 
white wines join forces. Sauvignon Blanc + Pinot Grigio = SAUVIGIO! - a 50/50 blend of Sauvignon Blanc and 
Pinot Grigio sourced from select California vineyards, and quite possibly the most refreshing thing you'll pour 
all season. The bright and refreshing elixir opens with an inviting bouquet that bridges both varietals 
beautifully, with bright citrus zest and a whisper of tropical fruit from the Sauvignon Blanc mingling with the 
delicate peach blossom and stone fruit aromatics from the Pinot Grigio. On the palate, the two find a satisfying 
harmony. The Pinot Grigio's effortlessly light body provides an approachable foundation, while the Sauvignon 
Blanc asserts itself with crisp, flinty mineral notes, tropical flavors and a clean, bright finish. Every sip 
manages to express the best aspects of each varietal, in a subtle, satisfying synthesis on the palate. 

This wine is equally at home when enjoyed on its own, as it is when paired with a meal. Serve it well-
chilled as a languid late-summer sipper on the porch, or bring it to the table alongside grilled seafood, summer 
squash, or a classic chicken Caesar salad. For brunch, try it with a crostino topped with whipped ricotta, the 
wine's bright acidity makes it a natural match. Crisp, layered, and endlessly drinkable, Sauvigio is a best-of-
both-worlds white blend that will be your new summer favorite.
085461.name: SAUVIGIO SAUVIGNON BLANC PINOT GRIGIO

085539.item_story_marketing: A barbell is a long metal bar used for lifting various weights that are attached to its ends. A Barebell, on the other hand, is a short (relatively speaking) protein bar used to fuel said weight-lifting sessions… or simply for lifting to your mouth when you need something yummy to give yourself a boost! The Barebells brand of protein bars was launched in Sweden in 2016. For the past ten years, the company has been doing the ‘heavy lifting’ when it comes to developing high-protein snack bars that really deliver on the flavor. None of their bars include added sugar, and each bar packs an impressive 20g of protein. Plus, they are touted as some of the best-tasting bars you can buy. Barebells Brownie Batter Protein Bar is the latest in the lineup—and we’re pumped to welcome it aboard. It boasts a phenomenally fudgy chocolate interior, and a rich, chocolatey exterior coating, studded with crunchy little cocoa nibs for extra texture. Each bite is sweet, soft, and satisfying, like if a super soft-baked Brownie just happened to provide a nice boost of protein... Prepare for (a) lift-off!
085539.name: BAREBELLS BROWNIE BATTER

086161.item_story_marketing: The combination of whole oat flour and wheat flour gives Trader Joe's Strawberry Yogurt O’s a wonderful crunch. Some O’s are enrobed in a yummy yogurt coating—some of them are not. This was very intentional, as our tasting panel painstakingly formulated the best balance between coated and not (with some additional, creamy, yogurt chunks thrown in) for just the right amount of tangy-sweet yogurt flavor. And then there are freeze-dried strawberries, which impart authentic strawberry flavor; especially as your milk or non-dairy beverage re-hydrates them right there in your cereal bowl! Our Strawberry Yogurt O’s are low in sodium, an excellent source of vitamin C and Iron, and they’re made without artificial flavors or preservatives.
086161.item_story_qil:
Trader Joe's Strawberry Yogurt O's are made with whole grains and pack a great crunch.  Heck, even without 
anything other than that, this would be a terrific cereal. What really makes Strawberry Yogurt O's stand out 
from the crowd is the addition of fruit and yogurt to the mix. Unlike some other cereals, ours are liberally 
coated with delicious yogurt - in a deliberately selective fashion, of course.  Some of the crispy O's are coated 
with yogurt; some are not. Some of the crunchy freeze-dried strawberries are coated with yogurt; some are 
not. Being fussy with the yogurt coating allows us to create cereal that's wonderfully crunchy and bursting 
vibrant flavors without being too sweet. It's a winner with milk for breakfast, and can be addictive as a snack 
right out of the box - trust us, we speak from experience. 

We're selling each 12-ounce box of Trader Joe's Strawberry Yogurt O's for $2.99 every day.

086450.item_story_marketing:
Ever wonder how Greek yogurt is crafted? Do we culture the milk by reading each batch of yogurt epic Hellenic poetry? It couldn’t hurt, however Trader Joe’s Nonfat Plain Greek Yogurt uses a traditional Greek yogurt process to yield a deliciously creamy nonfat Greek yogurt.

Each batch of Trader Joe’s Nonfat Plain Greek Yogurt has its beginnings with grade A pasteurized skim milk sourced from cows not treated with rBSt. From there, the milk is heated, cooled to a desirable fermentation temperature (approximately 110° F), and topped off with the addition of bacterial cultures. While this bacteria grows and produces lactic acid, we prepare for the final step that takes this regular yogurt mixture to the Parthenon of pleasant texture and taste. This final, multi-straining step is what separates this Greek God of a yogurt from the mere mortals of regular yogurt. The thorough straining of the liquid whey is what gives this Greek yogurt a concentrated, powerful flavor and dense, velvety texture. So much of the liquid is strained that it can typically take around four cups of raw milk to yield one cup of Greek yogurt. This leaves a concentrated, protein-rich yogurt low in sodium and sugar, making for a nutritious snack any time of day!

086483.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Fully Cooked Uncured Bacon is one the handiest products to keep in your fridge. Sometimes you want bacon, but you don’t really want to cook bacon, with the time that can entail. If a package of Fully Cooked Uncured Bacon is there waiting for you, you can have your bacon and eat it, too. Far from the “bacon” bits of old, this is apple wood smoked bacon that’s fully cooked, packaged and refrigerated, so it’s ready to heat (very quickly) and eat. As if bacon really needed to be more appealing… yet this really does make it more appealing! Just think of the possibilities… BLT’s, bacon cheeseburgers, bacon & eggs, crumbled bacon on your salad or baked potato, and of course, pizza… all without the mess that comes from cooking the bacon. Genius!

Each 3.25 ounce package of Fully Cooked Uncured Bacon contains 15 cooked slices of bacon – the equivalent of about 12 ounces of uncooked bacon. And ours is a thicker cut than most, which results in rich, full flavor in every slice.

086861.item_story_marketing:
When you’re craving pastrami, you can go to a Brooklyn deli... or, you can just go to the deli case at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. There, you’ll find our revamped and better-than-ever Sliced Uncured Pastrami! Coming to us from a new supplier, this oh-so-stackable sandwich staple is made with no nitrates or nitrites added (except those that occur naturally in sea salt and cultured celery powder), and has an even heartier, beefier, and more tender presence on the palate.

Trader Joe’s Sliced Uncured Pastrami is lightly marbled, expertly thin-sliced, and has that characteristic, peppered edge for maximum flavor when you stack it on toasted TJ’s sourdough with some melty Swiss, or Provolone. Stack it with TJ’s Sauerkraut with Pickled Persian Cucumbers and some Dijon Mustard. Or chop some up and mix with TJ’s Roasted Potatoes with Peppers & Onions for a quick & delicious breakfast hash!

087175.item_story_marketing:
Cotswold is a variation on classic Double Gloucester cheese that has been imbued with chopped onions and chives for added flavor. It begins its life as a pasteurized whole milk cheese that originates in Gloucestershire County, England. It’s a golden yellow, semi-hard cheese that is similar to cheddar, but not quite as hard. The “double” variety is aged longer than “Single Gloucester” which lends to a firmer cheese with a stronger, more savory flavor.

The flavors of our Cotswold Double Gloucester are creamy, buttery, sweet and mild, yet full-flavoured like a cheddar cheese. With the added onions and chives, each bite has an extra-savory zing guaranteed to satisfy. Double Gloucester is a common pub cheese in England, making an iteration such as our Cotswold Double Gloucester a wonderful pairing with any beer or a bold Zinfandel, Shiraz, or Chardonnay. So remember to stop by the wine and beer section after picking up a block of cheese from our cheese cooler.

087777.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Pretzel Slims take the same salty, crunchy, hard mini-pretzels you love as a bar snack, and flattens them into a chip-like “Slim” shape. Each one-two-bite- sized Pretzel Slim is thin, crispy, and studded with coarse crystal of salt, just like a classic pretzel. Unlike your everyday pretzel, however, their increased surface area allows them to be used as a vehicle for a wide variety of dips, cheeses, spreads — even salsas, if you so choose — meaning these Pretzel Slims aren’t just delicious, they’re postively practical.

Made from just four simple ingredients (wheat flour, sugar, salt, and barley malt syrup), we reccomend dunking your Pretzel Slims into Pub Cheese (with or without Jalapeños), Organic Buffalo Style Hummus, or even a jar of Aioli Garlic Mustard Sauce. Dip averse? They’re still quite delicious on their own, especially when paired with a cold beer, or beverage of your choice.

087785.item_story_marketing:
Fresh fruit has a long, storied history of being a common breakfast delight around the world. Something has to give a sugary kick to those tired bones and sleepy muscles so that you’re feeling alert and strong for the day ahead! While we sell plenty of whole fresh fruits and by all means, enjoy them in the morning, too, but how about you join the jubilant “jam”boree and try out a dollop of Trader Joe’s Fresh Strawberry Preserves with your next breakfast.

Sometimes you need that extra oomph getting out of bed, and if we have any suggestions, it would surely be this: imagine the breakfast you could throw together in minutes before heading to work or school. A hot breakfast full of eggs and turkey bacon for your protein and fat, toasted sourdough for your fiber, and to turn that toast into a treat, a generous spread of our Fresh Strawberry Preserves for your simple sugar needs. Each jar is made for us using freshly picked strawberries combined with a little bit of sugar, lemon juice concentrate, and a hint of pectin to jelly up this jam (and as always, no artificial flavors or coloring)! May sound like a simple recipe, but we know it’ll always be enough to get you dancing around the kitchen within minutes of leaving your warm bed.

088544.item_story_marketing:
Making a cheese board for guests who have a low tolerance for cheese from cow’s milk? Looking for that tangy flavor that can only be described as “goaty”? Well, Trader Joe’s Chevre Fine Herbs Goat Cheese has the perfect little log of creamy, fresh goodness for you! And with the added herb blend throughout the log, its an elevated version of our Chevre Goat Cheese without you even needing to lift a finger! 

Chevre, French for goat cheese, is made in similar fashion to many cheeses made from cow’s milk. The finished product, though, delivers a whole new world of flavors, texture, and nutrition profile that works wonders for people who prefer to stay away from traditional cheeses or anyone looking to add a slice of adventure to their cheese spreads. Trader Joe’s Chevre Fine Herbs Goat Cheese has a uniquely herbaceous, tangy taste that separates it from just a traditional log of goat cheese and especially from cow’s milk cheeses. This lovely Chevre is fresh, soft, and unaged - lower in fat, calcium, but higher in vitamin A than cheese from cow’s milk. And with a lower lactose content, makes it more tolerable for many children and elderly people who may have a tougher time processing lactose.

088617.item_story_marketing: Alfredo sauce dates back to Italy in the 1920’s, when Alfredo di Lello perfectly merged heavy cream, butter and garlic to create an international sensation. We searched far and wide for an Alfredo sauce that could live up to this reputation and found one with just the right blend of these classic ingredients – Trader Joe’s Alfredo Pasta Sauce. This zesty, creamy Alfredo Sauce is perfect with long-cut pasta like TJ’s Italian Linguine or TJ’s Papardelle, but you can also go with TJ’s Italian Penne Rigate or TJ’s Italian Farfalle. Serve it flanked with TJ’s Just Chicken [sku 43020], TJ’s Medium Cooked Shrimp [sku 01206], and topped with TJ’s Shaved Parmigiano Reggiano. Not in the mood for pasta? TJ’s Alfredo is also as delicious as a sauce for stand-alone seafood or chicken. This full-flavored Alfredo is perfectly delicious as a traditional sauce, but we’re never shy to add some mushrooms, broccoli, or whatever you may be in the mood for. That’s the great thing about it, you can add this or that, or not add anything at all but pasta or chicken, either way your dish will turn out delish!

088649.item_story_marketing:
“There are two types of people who eat truffles: those who think truffles are good because they are dear, and those who know they are dear because they are good.” Jean-Louis Vaudoyer

Oh, truffles. For thousands of years, you’ve inspired such passion, from ancient Mesopotamia to modern America. You’ve also inspired Trader Joe’s Italian Truffle Cheese, which is definitely dear because it is good. Our Italian Truffle Cheese is made with black truffles from central Italy’s Umbria region. Made from pasteurized cow’s milk, it’s a young cheese, aged for 15 days. Its mild flavor makes it the ideal canvas for the concentrated truffle oil and black truffle pieces that are blended liberally throughout the cheese. The truffles’ earthy, woody, musky aroma shines, and on the palate, it delivers with aplomb. The semi-soft nature makes this an excellent melting cheese – it’s delicious melted over roasted meats, makes delightful omelets, and adds dynamic dimension to pasta or potato dishes. It also makes a bold statement on a cheese board.

090061.item_story_marketing:
This Charles Shaw Pinot Grigio offers a refreshing and light-bodied experience typical of the varietal. On the nose, it presents delicate aromas of pear, citrus blossom, and green apple. The palate follows through with crisp flavors of lemon zest, white peach, and a hint of almond, balanced by a lively acidity that carries through to a clean finish with subtle mineral notes.

The grapes for this wine are sourced from vineyards in California, where the warm climate and alluvial soils contribute to the wine's fruity character and approachable style. The region's long, sun-drenched growing season allows the Pinot Grigio grapes to develop fully, resulting in a wine that captures the essence of California's generous terroir while maintaining the varietal's characteristic freshness.

This versatile Pinot Grigio pairs excellently with a wide range of light dishes. It's an ideal companion for fresh seafood, particularly grilled white fish or a zesty shrimp scampi. The wine's bright acidity complements salads with vinaigrette dressings and pairs wonderfully with mild, creamy cheeses like fresh mozzarella or goat cheese. For a classic pairing, try it with a margherita pizza or a plate of herb-roasted chicken with lemon.
090061.name: CHARLES SHAW PINOT GRIGIO BOTT

090083.item_story_marketing:
True Marcona Almonds are grown only on the Mediterranean coast of Spain. They’re shorter and flatter than California almonds, with a distinctive flavor and a light, crunchy texture. We’ve taken that flavor profile a step up by adding whole dried rosemary to the mix. The nuts are roasted in expeller pressed sunflower oil, dusted with sea salt and sprinkled with whole rosemary. They’re a real treat. You can use them in recipes (just the thought of Green Beans Rosemary Marcona Amandine makes us smile), present them as an hors d’oeuvre or eat them right out of the bag. They’re excellent with a glass of crisp white wine – perhaps a Sauvignon Blanc or Côtes du Rhône. We’ve found them to be quite difficult to resist; you may want to err on the side of caution and have several bags on hand in case of emergencies. And napkins. You’ll need napkins. Trust us on this one.

Marcona Almonds tend to be expensive, but at Trader Joe’s, we have them at a great price.

090460.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s BBQ Chicken Pizza might just be the ideal marriage of Italian and American culinary customs. Each one starts with a hand-stretched, wood-fired-oven-baked pizza crust sourced straight from Italy, which our American supplier tops with a tangy, smoky BBQ sauce, shredded whole milk Mozzarella and smoked Gouda cheeses, fire-roasted onions, cilantro, and, of course, char-grilled Chicken breast. Together, the undeniably Italian influence on the chewy, savory crust, comingling with the eminently American flavors of the hearty Chicken and rich BBQ sauce, constitute a classic feat of fusion cuisine. Each 13-ounce BBQ Chicken Pizza takes only 10 minutes in a 450°F oven to go from frozen to ready-to-eat. You’ll find them in our freezerias, all year round.
090460.item_story_qil:
Pizza may have its origins in Italy, but Trader Joe's BBQ Chicken Pizza is as American as baseball and apple 
pie. While we've never been afraid of upending traditions, for this particular pie we decided not to stray too far 
from the source. So, taking inspiration from its Romanesque relations, this premier pizza starts with a hand-
stretched crust, baked in a wood-fired oven, made by one of our longtime Italian pizza suppliers. There's just 
something about that Italian crust... 

This ideal crust is delivered to our American supplier, because let's face it, we Americans know barbecue like 
the Italians know pizza crust. Once stateside, the crust is topped with a sweet-smoky BBQ sauce, whole milk 
Mozzarella, smoked Gouda, fire roasted onions, cilantro, and of course, char-grilled chicken breast. It's a classic 
American pizza as only Trader Joe's can deliver it. And, with the addition of a classic green salad, it's a classic 
American dinner you can deliver to your dinner table in 10 minutes or less.

We're selling each 13 ounce BBQ Chicken Pizza for $4.99, every day.
090460.name: BBQ CHICKEN PIZZA

090570.item_story_marketing:
Tri-Tip is a premium, signature cut of beef widely adored across the West Coast. In the Eastern U.S., however, it’s historically been called a “bottom sirloin,” a “Newport steak,” or not called anything at all, and instead ground and blended with other cuts. Here at Trader Joe’s, we’ve offered Santa Maria Boneless Tri-Tip Roast in our West Coast stores since 2007. Customers have loved this local specialty so much, we decided it was time to make Trader Joe’s Santa Maria Inspired Boneless Beef Tri-Tip Roast available in every Trader Joe’s, nationwide.

Our Santa Maria Boneless Tri-Tip Roast combines tender and juicy beef with a marinade that would be right at home on Santa Maria, CA’s open-fire grills, with garlic, black pepper, chili pepper, cumin, and marjoram. As soon as you toss this Tri-Tip on the grill or in your oven, you’ll be swept up in the aromas of Santa Maria barbecue. Cook it to medium-rare or just barely medium, then slice it against the grain and serve alongside roasted veggies, or in a superbly satisfying sandwich.
090570.item_story_qil:
While the origins of the name "tri-tip" are hotly contested, one thing is agreed on by all: this premium, signature 
cut of beef is widely adored across the West Coast. Sometimes called a "Santa Maria steak" due to its frequent 
use in Santa Maria style barbecue, we loved this local specialty so much, we wanted to share it with as many of 
you as possible. Hence, Trader Joe's Santa Maria Boneless Tri-Tip Roast.
 
Our Santa Maria Boneless Tri-Tip Roast combines tender and juicy beef with a marinade that would be at 
home on the traditional iron grills of Santa Maria, CA. This Boneless Roast is packaged in a marinade of 
garlic, black pepper, chili pepper, cumin, marjoram, and more, so you can be sure it's had time to really soak 
up those powerful, western flavors. As soon as you toss this Tri-Tip on the grill or in the oven, you'll be swept 
up in the scents of Santa Maria barbecue. Regardless of where you live, we'll save you a trip to the West Coast 
in exchange for a trip to your neighborhood Trader Joe's. Just make sure you get enough Tri-Tip for everyone...
plus a little extra for that steak sandwich you know you'll be craving tomorrow! 

Santa Maria Boneless Tri-Tip Roast

090588.item_story_marketing:
Just because Trader Joe’s European Style Organic Plain Yogurt made with Whole Milk is “European style” doesn’t mean that it should be foreign to your refrigerator! It’s simply one of the many different methods of crafting a unique style of yogurt that is less firm and contains more active cultures by volume than “regular” yogurts. Take these probiotic positives in stride and use it as a versatile culinary ingredient for dressing up vegetables, taming a hot dish with a yogurt dressing, thickening soups, or simply topped with your favorite fruit in a smoothie!

Trader Joe’s European Style Organic Plain Yogurt made with Whole Milk is made in small batches, using milk from family farm raised cows in Northern California. It's organically produced, and minimally processed.

090642.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Mediterranean Style Hummus needs no introduction. A traditional spread. A neighborhood grocer. Your shopping cart. A classic combination, not unlike a bountiful blend of garbanzo beans, tahini, lemon juice, and garlic.

Mediterranean Style Hummus is super smooth and creamy, a bit more “whipped” than many of our other hummus choices. The texture of hummus tends to be different depending on where in the world it originates, so it makes sense for us to offer some of that variety in our stores. We’ve also taken the liberty of topping Trader Joe’s Mediterranean Style Hummus with crunchy pine nuts, and a bright blend of herbs and spices, red bell pepper, and olive oil which creates a distinctive flavor and texture profile we think you’ll really enjoy. Of course, it’s also mighty delicious – then again, this isn’t a difference at all, because we think all of our hummus options (hummi?) are delicious.

090748.item_story_marketing:
"How do I love thee? Let me count the shreds" ~with apologies to Elizabeth Barrett Browning

Trader Joe’s Finely Shredded Lite Mexican Blend is our ideal blend for dishes in need of a little Mexican flair, with reduced fat Cheddar, Monterey Jack, Asadero and Queso Quesadilla cheeses. It’s a blend that’s unique to Trader Joe’s, and because of this boasts a flavor profile just as unique as our brand. The Jack, Asadero and Queso Quesadilla are mild, while the Cheddar adds a bit of a bite with every mouthful.

All of the cheeses are well-known for their meltability, which makes them a particularly potent pairing to dishes like burritos, enchiladas, quesadillas and tacos. And don’t let the name make you feel like you need to limit yourself to Mexican dishes. This blend is excellent in plenty of salads, atop any of our boxed soups, and makes a distinctively flavored grilled cheese sandwich.

090761.item_story_marketing: A sure sign that summer has arrived, Trader Joe’s Corn on the Cob is a celebration of the season. You’ll find our Corn with their husks to help keep each ear from drying out and stay fresh. The kernels taste buttery and sweet and can be prepared a variety of ways. Throw them on the grill, with or without their husks, until tender and infused with smoke. They are delicious boiled, roasted, microwaved, or even raw—and can be eaten on or off the cob. Peak season Corn is a treat to eat all by itself, but it’s an absolute stunner when generously seasoned with and slathered with butter or mayo. There may be no better way to enjoy the summer than with Corn on the Cob.
090761.name: CORN ON THE COB EACH

090809.item_story_marketing:
Here’s a quick dinner idea we think will really excite you! Trader Joe’s Korean Style Beef Short Ribs. It’s a simple entrée, really – lean beef short ribs marinated in a Korean style sweet and savory soy-based marinade. In the marinade, soy sauce and garlic account for the Ribs savory flavors, then brown sugar is added to make it deliciously sweet. The combination is simple, yet phenomenal.

The genius is really in the preparation, and that’s where you come in. In about 15 minutes (if you count the time it takes to thaw the meat), these simple Short Ribs cook to utter perfection – just pop them on a grill – or grill pan on the stovetop – at medium-high heat, cook for a couple of minutes on each side and, you’re done. See? Genius! Before devouring, the Beef should be cooked thoroughly, at 160 degrees Fahrenheit or higher measured by a food thermometer.

090859.item_story_marketing:
Chicken broth is one of the handiest tools in a cook’s toolkit. It adds an ineffable depth of flavor to soups, casseroles, and rice dishes; it deglazes a pan most deliciously; it’s an indispensable ingredient in all manner of sauces and gravies—and it even makes a pretty satisfying drink in and of itself, especially when you feel a cold coming on. But like any tool, it’s only as useful as it is easily accessible. That’s what makes Trader Joe’s Chicken Broth Concentrate such an excellent addition to any culinary toolkit. Each package contains 12 shelf-stable packets of Concentrate that, when dissolved in a cup of hot water, creates a rich and aromatic Chicken Broth that’s ready to be used, right then and there, for whatever application you may need.

Convenient, easy-to-prep, and delightfully full-flavored, our Chicken Broth Concentrate is great for keeping in your pantry for whenever culinary inspiration strikes. Since it has such a savory, umami-forward profile, it’s also great for using as a seasoning, especially when crafting homemade curries, mashed potatoes, chili, or pot roast. And because it requires no refrigeration (though it should be stored somewhere cool and dry), it’s also quite portable, meaning you can take a packet on the go whenever necessary—like if you happen to need something restorative to sip on while traveling under the weather.

090874.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Apple Blossoms® have been a Customer favorite in our frozen foods section for nearly 20 years. And it’s no wonder why—they’re unbelievably delicious. Plus, they’re lovely to look at.

Picture a single-serving apple pie, only instead of resting in a regular pie crust shell, the apple filling is enveloped by six, carefully folded pie crust “petals” and sprinkled with cinnamon streusel, making the pie look just like (you guessed it!) a Blossom. Or picture a palm-sized, pastry coin purses filled with sweetened & spiced Northern Spy apples instead of gold (arguably even better than gold). If you’ve got a baking sheet, an oven, and 20 minutes to spare, then you’ve got a warm, dreamy dessert in your very near future...
090874.item_story_qil:
The ancient Greeks believed that if a man tossed an apple to a woman, he was proposing marriage. If she caught 
it, she accepted. In these modern times, we've updated primitive traditions. Today, you can toss a box of Trader 
Joe's Apple Blossoms®.

Apple Blossoms® are individual pastries filled with sweet, cooked apples and topped with a tasty bit of 
cinnamon crumble. They're like little apple pies, with the crust folded over to look like a blossom. They're made 
in the Niagara Fruit Belt of Canada with a variety of apples called Northern Spy, which have the firm texture of 
a Granny Smith, and the sweetness of a Macintosh. If you've been thinking about popping the question to that 
special someone, you might try tossing a box of Blossoms - they'll cost you a lot less than a ring, and they taste 
better, too! It's a great way to determine whether or not your "special someone" has taste as great as yours. We're 
selling each eight-ounce box of two, fully-baked Apple Blossoms® for $2.29*. You'll find them in our freezers.

090879.item_story_marketing:
After a long, tireless search, we’re excited to announce: the refrigerated cases at Trader Joe’s are back on a Roll! A Trader Joe’s Spring Roll with Shrimp, to be exact! When the supplier that made the previous iteration of this fresh customer favorite could no longer meet demand, we resolved then and there to find an even better version. All it took was one taste of these savory, refreshing, and texturally tantalizing Spring Rolls, and we knew that we had it. Welcome back!

Inspired by traditional Vietnamese gỏi cuốn, our new supplier crafts each Spring Roll by wrapping firm, perfectly cooked shrimp and fresh mung bean noodles along with a mix of lettuce, carrots, red cabbage, and mint leaves in delicate, slightly chewy rice paper. Each bite is filled with a mix of complex and complementary flavors and textures, creating an uncommonly captivating eating experience—and even more so when enjoyed with the lightly spicy, umami-tinged notes of its included cashew sauce. It makes an easy lunch entrée or light snack all on its own, and serves spectacularly well as a side with your favorite noodle soup or rice bowl.

090987.item_story_marketing: Nothing subliminal about it; these ice cream sandwiches more than live up to their name. Trader Joe’s Sublime Ice Cream Sandwiches came to fruition some years back, when we had an ice cream epiphany and realized we could do better—way better—than most of the ice cream sandwiches we found in freezers around the country. Not to insinuate that it was easy. Not at all. It took months and months of tasting and re-tasting by our panel. (Yes, it’s a messy job, but someone had to do it!) When the chocolate chip cookies finally reached the proper crunchy-chewy ratio (which changed, by the way, depending on how long they’d been frozen), we moved on to the ice cream; it had to be truly transcendent. After a few go-rounds, we landed on the ideal balance of cookie and ice cream. Then, of course, we had to make them even better, so we rolled the sides in mini, semi-sweet chocolate chips. In case you were curious, this is the kind of task we can always be counted on to undertake with vigilance.

091030.item_story_marketing:
While leeks might not be the most widely discussed veggies around, they’re highly valued by cooks who know. In the same family of alliums that includes onions, garlic, and chives, they have a mild flavor, like a bigger, gentler, oblate scallion. At this time of year, leeks lend loveliness to fall soups and stews. You can substitute them for regular onions in casseroles, or pair them with sautéed mushrooms and roasted Potatoes. 

If you’re seeking a novel side, why not feature Trader Joe’s Trimmed Leeks at the center of their own dish? Simply brown them in a pan with a little olive oil, then braise them in a shallow pan with some chicken stock and white wine (and a pat of salted butter for good measure). You’ll be quite pleased, and so will your dinner guests!

There’s a time and place for that—like pickle chips on a burger. No, we’re talking about those long, thin slices (picture Trader Joe’s Organic Kosher Sandwich Pickles) that rest on the edge of the plate, eager to complement the soft bread and meat with their salty crunch. That Pickle presence also says: “This Sandwich was no accident. It was put together with forethought and care—right down to the pickle slice on the plate.”

We’ll devour zingy Organic Kosher Sandwich Pickles anytime, anywhere—sandwich or no sandwich! Crack open a jar, and we come a-callin’. All pickle-posturing aside, though, these briny delights really are perfectly engineered for sandwiches—they’re thin, they’re flat, and they’re cut length-wise for superior coverage. We jar them in a classic Kosher brine that includes organic vinegar, salt, dehydrated organic garlic, and natural pickle flavors.

While you can surely find ground beef with different lean/fat ratios (we also sell 90/10 and 85/15), experts claim that 20% is just the right amount of fat for a moist, juicy burger. The fat renders (or melts down) as the burger cooks on your hot grill or in your skillet, ensuring you don’t end up with a dry puck of a patty!

Our Ground Beef is sourced from a number of countries renowned for their excellent beef production, including Australia, New Zealand, and the United States—and it’s processed and inspected in the U.S. to ensure only the best quality.

091087.item_story_marketing:
Like their carb cousins the brioche and Danish pastry, croissants belong to a family of baked goods collectively referred to as viennoiseries, baked goods made with yeast-leavened, laminated dough that’s enriched with eggs, butter, or milk. They first arrived in France by way of Austria in the late 1800’s, and are now ubiquitous in French bakery culture, their glossy, flaky crust and tender crumb a mainstay of breakfast and snacktime. While flavor variations run the gamut from sweet to savory, the pain au chocolat, or chocolate croissant, is the preferred variation of many a pastry connoisseur—this is just one of the many reasons why Trader Joe’s Chocolate Croissants have become a mainstay of our frozen cases.

Made with creamy butter and filled with rich, semisweet Belgian chocolate, Trader Joe’s Chocolate Croissants bring high-end bakery quality to your home kitchen with minimal effort. Remove them from the package and let them proof overnight (just as a French bakery would); in the morning you’ll find the Croissants have nearly tripled in size! Brush with an egg wash, then bake 20-25 minutes until the Croissants are a deep golden brown. Let them rest for 10 minutes (distract yourself by brewing a pot of coffee), and then prepare to delight in the gooey melted Chocolate and warm, flaky Croissant dough. Yummmmm.

Each 12-ounce box contains four ready-to-proof-and-bake Chocolate Croissants, so you can bake a bunch for brunch, or savor them one by one as a weekday breakfast or snack.

091113.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Sweet Chili Sauce is our authentic take on the sweet-hot blend of chilies and garlic used in kitchens across Thailand. Our supplier adds whole red chilies and Thai garlic to a sweet & sour-like concoction, creating a versatile sauce that can be used as a condiment, dip, stir-fry sauce, or appetizer component. We like it on burgers and Korean Style Short Ribs, or brushed on chicken before grilling. It’s a natural for dipping things like gyoza, egg rolls or spring rolls. You may also try grilling peaches or nectarines and dipping them in Sweet Chili Sauce. It’s also surprisingly delicious served over softened cream cheese and served with crackers – a quick, super-easy hors d’oeuvre that will leave your guests begging for the “recipe.”

Instead, we mixed freshly brewed green tea with a splash of actual fruit flavors, resulting in a well-balanced beverage brimming with natural phytonutrients. So, sit back, relax and enjoy the flavorful fusion of sweet blueberries and tart pomegranates in this delightfully and refreshing tea. In whatever season, TJ’s Blueberry Pomegranate Tea can be served hot in a mug just like any other tea, or chilled over ice for a refreshing beverage. Remember the Tea is unsweetened, so enjoy as is, add a bit of honey to your cup o’ tea, or a little Organic Cane Sugar to your iced tea.

091624.item_story_marketing:
Cape Gooseberries (aka “Golden Berries”) are the very definition of superfruit. Their size and shape make one think first of cherry tomatoes. Their orange-golden color suggests some relation to persimmons or citrus. And then there are the dried green leaves that enclose each Gooseberry, like a tomatillo—or a superhero’s cape, fittingly enough. So what exactly is a Cape Gooseberry?!

Ours are grown in South America, from whence Gooseberries are native, and where they’ve been grown since the days of the Incan empire. Slice into one and you’ll find moist seeds suspended like the inside a tomato or tomatillo—though more plentiful. (Incidentally, these Berries arrive in our stores with the tomatillo-like leaves removed.) Take a taste and you’ll discover they’re juicy and quite tart, reminiscent of sour candy, but still including hints of sweet, tropical-fruit flavor. 

Nutritionally, Cape Gooseberries have an impressive amount of antioxidants, along with plenty of fiber, vitamin C, and other important vitamins and minerals. With their earned “superfood” status, Gooseberries make an obvious choice for adding to smoothies. Their tart character makes them ideal for simmering with sugar to create pie filling or jams. Of course, you can also enjoy them raw, right out of the package, or sliced and tossed in a salad!
091624.name: R-CAPE GOOSEBERRIES 6 OZ

091708.item_story_marketing:
Our Uncured Turkey Bacon is made with turkey thighs that come from birds raised in a clean environment, without antibiotics. Chopped Turkey thigh meat is seasoned with naturally purified sea salt (not kiln dried), raw sugar, and a few spices before it’s hand-trimmed and placed into metal pans to create a bacon slab shape. Next the Turkey is slow smoked over applewood and other hardwoods for several hours. Then it’s sliced and packaged and, voilà! Bacon. And just like pork bacon, you can cook it in a skillet, in the oven, or in the microwave.

Unlike pork bacon, our Uncured Turkey Bacon is 94% fat free! Each lean slice (one serving) contains just 30 calories and 1.5g of fat, which is about a quarter of the fat found in a typical slice of pork bacon. And you still get 6g of protein per slice!
091708.name: BACON TURKEY

091749.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Ridge Cut Potato Chips with Sea Salt are thick slices of Arizona and Minnesota grown potatoes, cooked in small batches in expeller pressed sunflower oil, then lightly salted. They’re simple chips, with three simple ingredients, and they’re simply delicious. On their own, dipped in virtually any dip, or even crushed and used as a breading for chicken (trust us here: yum!), these Chips are the real deal.

One of the benefits of the Trader Joe’s label versus a national brand label is we’re able to negotiate better pricing when we package products in our label. That holds true here. Have you shopped for chips elsewhere? They’re crazy expensive! But ours aren’t.
091749.item_story_qil:
There was a time, in the not-so-distant past (yet sometimes it feels like a lifetime ago), that we sold quite a 
number of potato chips in bags bearing national brand names. Whatever were we thinking? In fact, at one stage, 
we offered two entirely different rippled, ridge cut potato chips with the same flavor profile. Why would we 
do such a thing? Well, we remedied that situation by doing what we do-we held a blind tasting to determine 
which was best, and the winner got a packaging facelift. Actually, the winner got a packaging face transplant-it 
won its way into the world of Trader Joe's private label, and has been winning fans ever since. 

Trader Joe's Ridge Cut Potato Chips with Sea Salt were the winners then, and they remain winners today. 
They're thick slices of Arizona and Minnesota grown potatoes, cooked in small batches in expeller pressed 
sunflower oil, then lightly salted. They're simple chips, with three simple ingredients, and they're simply 
delicious. On their own, dipped in virtually any dip, or even crushed and used as a breading for chicken (trust 
us here: yum!), these Chips are the real deal. 

One of the benefits of the Trader Joe's label versus a national brand label is we're able to negotiate better pricing 
when we package products in our label. That holds true here. Have you shopped for chips elsewhere? They're 
crazy expensive! But ours aren't. We're selling Trader Joe's Ridge Cut Potato Chips with Sea Salt in a 16-ounce 
bag for $2.99, every day. That's a value that's a chip off the old Joe.
