And if you can contain that carbonation in a conveniently conveyable can? That’s the dream. That’s why we’ve made the move to put Trader Joe’s Lime Sparkling Water in an eight-pack of aluminum cans. Sparkling water fans, rejoice!

Whether you enjoy it chilled, straight out of the can, in glass over ice, or even used as a mixer for stronger juices, like our 100% Organic Pomegranate Juice, it’s never been easier to tote, store, or serve our Lime Sparkling Water. Enjoy a can at home, on the go, or packed along with your work lunch. Enjoy its refreshing, oh-so-citrusy hint of lime.

What do you get when you infuse delicate white tea with a splash of tart pomegranate juice and an abundance of invigorating bubbles? You get Trader Joe’s Sparkling White Tea with Pomegranate Juice Beverage, that’s what!

Pleasantly pomegranate-y, ultra-fizzy, and subtly sweet, this bold beverage sips like a sparkling summer afternoon. Even on the dreariest of days, it’ll add swagger to your step and leave you feeling positively peppy. You’ll also be pleased to know that we haven’t added any sugar or sweeteners to this sparkling sensation — it’s just a 10-calorie can of brewed white tea, pomegranate juice, and CO2, plus some citric acid & ascorbic acids to acidify and maintain color.

Enjoy it chilled, over ice or straight from the can. Add it to a cocktail or mocktail, garnished with a sprig of mint or fresh pomegranate seeds. Make it the base of a punchy, pink pomegranate float. Let your imagination sparkle!

174345.item_story_marketing:
Made fom a time-tested recipe with ingredients that include water, sugar, ginger juice, lime and lemon juices from concentrate, and ginger extract, our Ginger Beer has a refreshing, gingery bite, and mild carbonation. The addition of lemon and lime juices adds a zesty, citrus zing, and also helps establish the right acidic balance. After canning, our Brewed Ginger Beer is pasteurized, which gives it shelf stability.

We think our Ginger Beer makes the perfect refresher, all by itself—chilled, or over ice. That said, there’s no denying it enhances the character of spirits. Enjoy a Bermudan classic, the Dark & Stormy, made with dark rum and Ginger Beer. Or, imbibe a customized Mule cocktail: in a copper mug (if you’ve got it), mix our Brewed Ginger Beer with lime juice and your favorite vodka, tequila, whiskey, or gin.
174345.item_story_qil:
Ginger is a real winner with our customers; one need look no further than the fervent fanbase for our holiday-
seasonal Triple Ginger Brew [sku 51857] for proof. For the past few years, we proudly carried a Brewed Ginger 
Beer [sku 54205] to ensure that this perennially popular potable is available year-round. Taking a cue from 
another of our ginger-y holiday favorites, the Sparkling Cranberry & Ginger Beverage [sku 69074], we felt like 
our Ginger Beer could use a bit of a packaging upgrade. Made for us by the same supplier using the same recipe 
as our bottled version, please allow us to (re-)introduce Trader Joe's Brewed Ginger Beer, now in a convenient 
4-pack of 12 fluid-ounce cans!

Just like its bottled predecessor, this non-alcoholic beverage is made from ingredients that include: water, 
sugar, ginger juice, lime and lemon juices from concentrate, and ginger extract. It has a refreshing, gingery bite, 
and mild carbonation. The addition of lemon and lime juices adds a zesty, citrus zing, and also helps establish 
the right acidic balance. After canning, our Brewed Ginger Beer is pasteurized, which gives it shelf stability. 

We think our Ginger Beer makes the perfect refresher, all by itself-chilled, or over ice. But, there's also no 
denying it enhances the character of spirits. Enjoy a Bermudan classic, the Dark & Stormy, made with dark 
rum and Ginger Beer. Or, imbibe a customized Mule cocktail: in a copper mug (if you've got it), mix our 
Brewed Ginger Beer with lime juice and your favorite vodka, tequila, whiskey, or gin.

175189.item_story_marketing:
Like all of the products we sell, Trader Joe’s takes beers very seriously. This is well illustrated in Josephsbrau Bavarian Style Hefeweizen. Though it’s made for us through a partnership with one of the foremost crafter breweries of the West Coast, it’s brewed with imported malt and hops under the strictest interpretation of the Reinheitsgebot, a strict set of laws from 16th century Bavaria that determined that beers could only contain barley, hops, and water. Of course, the Reinheitsgebot has been updated since the 16th century to make way for other beer styles, including Hefeweizen, which necessarily includes wheat in its recipe.

Josephsbrau Hefeweizen is fermented with a special wheat beer yeast strain from Bavaria (hefeweizen literally means: “wheat yeast”). This unique yeast produces an array of flavors typical of an authentic Hefeweizen including: citrus, clove, banana, and even hints of bubble gum. This beer’s unfiltered golden color, combined with its lightly hopped, lightly malted character, makes it wonderfully refreshing to sip by itself. It also pairs extremely well with a grilled Uncured Bavarian Bratwurst or our Sweet Italian Chicken Sausage.

175918.item_story_marketing:
When we first introduced Trader Joe’s Rainbow’s End Trail Mix to our shelves back in 2000, it truly set the bar for how sublimely simple a trail mix could be. With just a minimalist mix of peanuts, almonds, raisins, and candy-coated milk chocolate gems, every bite contains a remarkable medley of flavors and textures, which is why it’s remained a solid gold hit with our customers for nearly 25 years. So how does one celebrate such a bar-setting snack? How about by recontextualizing it into a new setting: a highly snackable Bar? 

Proudly made with the same constituent components as the Trail Mix that inspired it,  Trader Joe’s Rainbow’s End Trail Mix Bars are held together with a bit of tapioca syrup and a rich coating of dipped dark chocolate on the base. Like its predecessor, each Bar offers a nice mix of crunchiness from the roasted peanuts and almonds, a bit of tenderness from the plump raisins, and some fun, flavorful sweetness from the candy-coated milk chocolate, all of which is captivatingly complemented by the dark chocolate layer. We find it’s ideal for enjoying before work or school, during a hike or long car ride, or after a run or gym day.

177620.item_story_marketing: Like our other sparkling waters, Trader Joe’s Black Cherry Vanilla Sparkling Water is completely unsweetened, yet thanks to an infusion of natural Black Cherry and Vanilla flavors, it still manages to offer a timeless, cherry cream soda-esque sipping experience. At zero calories per can, it’s a great way to add some light, flavorful fizz to cocktails and mocktails, too. Pour a can over ice, add a splash to your favorite juice beverage and garnish it with an orange slice, or be adventurous and try it in an ice cream float!
177620.item_story_qil:
Flavored Sparkling Waters have truly popped off in recent years. It's not hard to see why-with their subtle, 
fruity flavors that don't overpower the palate, they're just the thing to add some sparkle to the act of everyday 
hydration. At Trader Joe's, when we choose to venture into the business of fizziness, we do so with great care...
and that's how you know our new Black Cherry Vanilla Sparkling Water is something special.

Like our other sparkling waters, Trader Joe's Black Cherry Vanilla Sparkling Water is unsweetened, yet 
thanks to an infusion of natural Black Cherry and Vanilla flavors, it still manages to offer a timeless, cherry 
cream soda-esque sipping experience. At zero calories per can, it's a great way to add some light, flavorful fizz 
to cocktails and mocktails, too. Pour a can over ice, add a splash of To The Power of Seven Red Organic Juice

find at Trader Joe's.

177916.item_story_marketing:
The juice box is so much more than just a source of hydration—it’s a legend of the lunchbox, an icon among recess-ready refreshments. Which makes it all the more important that the contents inside it be of the highest quality possible. That’s why we’re proud to carry eight-packs of Trader Joe’s Organic Apple Juice Beverage on our shelves. Made with a base of Organic Apple Juice concentrate, and sweetened only with Organic natural fruit Juices, each serving is sweet, snappy, and happily Apple-y, while containing only ten total grams of sugar.

These Organic Apple Juice Beverage boxes aren’t just great for packing in school lunches, they’re expressly designed for that purpose, and taste great whether they’re sipped chilled or at room temp. That said, they’re also a savvy choice for enjoying with an afternoon snack, bringing along for long car rides and neighborhood walks, or sharing during picnics and sports practices. And have we mentioned that they’re also an excellent source of vitamin C?

177935.item_story_marketing:
When the weather warms, a nice, spritzy cocktail is nothing short of heavenly. When you’re winding down after a long, hot day, or kicking up your feet on a warm porch or patio, a bubbly little beverage hits like nothing else. That’s why we’re so excited to bring Aperito Spritz to our shelves. Crafted for us with a base of lightly bubbly wine that’s been spruced up with natural orange and aromatic herbal flavors, every sip of this Spritz is fruity and slightly sweet, with a beautifully bitter and bracing edge.

Bright and refreshing, with just enough herbaceous astringency to slyly stimulate the senses, our Aperito Spritz makes a capable companion to pool-side lounging, afternoons outside, or any other summery scenario you can imagine. Best served well chilled (and accessorized with a wedge of orange, if you’d like), we find it pairs particularly well with charcuterie and tart, creamy chevres, like our very own Goat Cheese.
177935.item_story_qil:
We love a Spritz and when we found the opportunity to add this convenient 3pk of 200ml bottles, it was too 
good to pass up. As a wine-based cocktail with natural flavors added to replicate the traditional liqueur (most 
common being Aperol), we're also able to offer this in all stores that sell wine, so the more the merrier!  
 
While some people may consider the spritz a summer drink, traditionally they're enjoyed throughout the year 
and we see this as a great ready-to-drink option to keep on hand. Crafted with a blend of fine ingredients, 
Aperito Spritz offers a tantalizing fusion of flavors that effortlessly captivate the senses. Designed to be the 
perfect companion for relaxing after a long day or enhancing vibrant gatherings, this delightful drink 
embodies sophistication and indulgence. Aperito is a light and refreshing drink with a mingling of wonderful 
aromatics and flavors of bittersweet orange and herbal notes. This Spritz is ready to serve, upon chilling, and 
can be enjoyed straight away. For the perfect experience, we recommend enjoying this chilled on the rocks 
and garnished with a slice of orange. As noted above, don't forget to stop by the cheese & salami section 
next and then you're ready to recreate an Italian Aperitivo moment as if you are in Venice! 


	Aperito Spritz
177935.name: APERITO SPRITZ

178890.item_story_marketing:
While making cocktails at home is certainly fun, nothing quite beats having a skilled bartender make one for you. Which presents us with the exact kind of problem we love to solve: how can you enjoy an expertly crafted mixed drink at home, without being an expert mixologist yourself? How can you have your margarita, and drink it too—so to speak? Wouldn’t you know it, we have just thing: Trader Joe’s Everything But the Bartender Classic Lime Margarita.

Made with real tequila, agave syrup, and lime juice, this pre-mixed, totally ready-to-drink Lime Margarita has all the sweetness, citrus, and spirit you’d expect from a margarita at a treasured, local cantina. It really does have everything—except the bartender, of course. Excellent when served chilled, right out of the can, or in a salt-rimmed glass with ice, each 200mL can is perfectly portioned for a single serving, making every four-pack a party-in-waiting for you and three friends. And since each four-pack sells for a price that beats many a happy hour special for a single cocktail, this might just be the most affordable Margarita you’ll ever encounter.

180300.item_story_marketing:
When you’re in the mood for a light, sweet, and sassy little cocktail, there’s really only one thing better than a cosmopolitan: a cosmopolitan that you both didn’t have to leave the house for, and that you didn’t need to mix yourself. In other words, Trader Joe’s Everything but the Bartender Cosmopolitan. These convenient, oh-so-sippable single-serve cans of Cosmo come pre-mixed from a classic barroom recipe of vodka, lime juice, and cranberry juice, with a little splash of blood orange juice added in for good measure.

Whether you’ve got friends over to watch a movie or game, you’re taking some much-needed me-time during the weekend, or you’re simply relaxing after a long day at work, our Everything but the Bartender Cosmo will help you do so in sweet, citric style. And since we work directly with the producer to ensure each four-pack costs less than what you’d pay at most happy hours for a single Cosmopolitan, these Cosmos are both easy on your wallet and your cocktail-shaking arm.

180832.item_story_marketing:
Depending on one’s relationship to coffee, one might not immediately associate the full flavors and aromatics of espresso with the idea of summer refreshment. But that’s the beauty of an espresso tonic. By combining the bolder elements of espresso with the tangy, tart, and bubbly sensations of tonic water, you end up with something uniquely refreshing: a fantastically balanced beverage that’s only further enhanced via the addition of something sweet and citrus-y, like orange juice. Sound intriguing? Give it a try for yourself with Trader Joe’s Sparkling Orange Flavored Espresso Tonic Beverage, a sublime little sipper that’s only available during the summer at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. 

Best enjoyed chilled or over ice, Trader Joe’s Sparkling Orange Flavored Espresso Tonic Beverage is especially suited for serving as part of a summer weekend breakfast for brunch, preferably with some flaky pastry, a savory slice of avocado toast, or a cheesy omelet. And since each package comes with four 8-45 fl. oz cans, it’s great for grabbing when you’ve got folks coming over for a summer morning hangout. And while we’re on the topic of Espresso Tonic, we’d be remiss if we didn’t recommend accessorizing this Beverage with a lemon slice, orange twist, and a fresh sprig of rosemary or mint.

181308.item_story_marketing:
When you think about it, Spindrift® Sparkling Water and Trader Joe’s go together like... like…well, like a really great beverage and a really great grocery store. It makes sense for us to carry this stuff—it doesn’t contain artificial flavors (sound familiar?), artificial sweeteners (what about now?), or added sugars. In fact, the company itself began as one man’s effort to kick his own diet soda habit by crafting simple, Sparkling alternatives in his kitchen. (It’s also worth noting that “spindrift” is a term for the whitewash of a breaking wave, and, as traders on the culinary seas, we’re pretty into the whole nautical thing.)

The latest Sparkling Water to join our stores’ Spindrift® squad is Island Punch, a tropical-tasting blend of guava purée, passion fruit juice, and orange juice, singing together in harmony with ultra-fizzy carbonated water and a touch of citric acid—nothing else. Enjoy Spindrift® Island Punch Sparkling Water chilled, straight from the can, or add it to a fruity cocktail or mocktail (mini tropical umbrella advised, but not mandatory). You can even make this everyday sparkler the base of a bright and cheery ice cream soda. Options abound!

At zero calories per can, it’s a great way to add some light, flavorful fizz to mocktails and cocktails, too. Or, if your sweet tooth is singing to you, try submerging a TJ’s Tangerine Cream Bar in an ice-cold glass of the stuff! 182282.item_story_marketing:
Whether you’re hosting a Friendsgiving Fête or Thanksgiving Day buffet, or simply looking to relax with a post-work beverage on a random Wednesday, Trader Joe’s Everything But The Bartender Gin & Tonic is here to answer the call. This bubbly and refreshing, ready-to-drink Gin & Tonic combines herbal gin, bright lime juice, water, sugar, natural flavors, and carbonation. It’s further embellished by butterfly pea flower to achieve a striking purplish hue for an utterly satisfying cocktail bar experience in your glass—all without the Bartender, of course. 

Enjoy over ice, with a lime wedge or lemon wheel, or simply sip chilled, straight from the can, as you put the finishing touches on the T-day fixins’. Thanksgiving menu aside, this G&T is a swell companion to smoked fish, fresh berries, and strong, savory cheeses (Totally Cheeseball Unexpected Cheddar Spread, anyone?)
182282.item_story_qil:
TJ's EBTB Gin & Tonic once again brings the taste of a quality bartender made cocktail right into your hands. 
This classic cocktail adds an exciting twist to our growing Everything But The Bartender lineup by lowering 
the sweetness level and kicking up the aroma. This Gin & Tonic has strong scents of citrus and juniper with 
soft herbal undertones, making you feel like you just watched the tonic hit the gin filled glass right in front of 
you. Once poured over ice, you will discover it is further embellished by butterfly pea flower leaving you with 
a beautiful light purple color. 
 
Made with real gin, lime juice concentrate, and water this bubbly Gin & Tonic is ready to rock your taste buds. 
This is the perfect way to warm up as weather gets cold but fear not - this Everything But The Bartender is 
here to stay and is the perfect Gin & Tonic for any time of year. Enjoy alongside smoked fish, strong savory 
cheeses, or a nice charcuterie board. This 4pk comes in right at $9.99, giving you four drinks for less than the 
cost of one cocktail at a bar. Whether you are sharing with friends over a game or kicking your feet up to relax 
after work, you'll be happy you didn't need to miss a play or make a cocktail after a long hard day to enjoy this 
refreshing bartender-less drink. Enjoy chilled over ice with a lime wedge, or simply enjoy chilled right out of 
the can.
182282.item_title: Everything but the Bartender Gin & Tonic
182282.name: TJS EVERYTHING BUT THE BARTENDER GIN & TONIC 4PK

183366.item_story_marketing:
The juices of passion fruit, orange, and guava all synergize with one another so nicely, you’d think each of these three fruits originated with the others in mind. In reality, passion fruit is native to central South America, oranges come from southeast Asia, and guavas likely first came about in Mexico. And while it may have taken until the 1970s in Hawaii for passion fruit-orange-guava juice to first become popularized, perhaps that’s all the more evidence that this tropical trio was simply meant to be—even if it took a few millennia of human intervention to get them together. In honor of this triumphant triumvirate, we offer Trader Joe’s Passion Fruit, Orange, & Guava 100% Juice Blend.

Made for us by a supplier in Vietnam, each sip of this Juice Blend is impeccably balanced between the sharp tang of the Passion Fruit, the citric sweetness of the Orange, and the velvety texture and floral roundness of the Guava. It’s great for serving chilled or over ice, it makes a beautiful base for a cocktail or mocktail, and it pairs particularly well with grilled seafood, pizza, or spicy fare, like our Spicy Cheese Crunchies.

185062.item_story_marketing:
We have nothing against bartenders, but it’s hard to pass up the convenience of a ready-to-drink, single-serving, craft cocktail. This was the broader inspiration for Everything But the Bartender, our incredibly popular line of open-and-enjoy cocktails. For the latest addition, we set our sights on the coveted cantina classic, the Paloma, with ingredients that include tequila, agave syrup, and red grapefruit juice & lime juice concentrates. Each tequila-forward sip (it’s 15% alcohol by volume) hits with bracing citrus notes, balanced with just enough sweetness and a hint of salt. To serve, just pour over ice—lime wedge and TJ’s Chili Lime Seasoning Blend- rimmed glass optional, but recommended! For Palomas on-the-go (picnic, beach, patio party, etc.), simply chill and sip straight from the can.

Whether you’re relaxing poolside with friends, hosting a cookout with neighbors, or seeking an easy evening cocktail after a hard-day’s work, Trader Joe’s Everything But the Bartender Paloma will be there for you. You’ll find four-packs of 6.76-ounce cans in our stores where spirits are sold.

194705.item_story_marketing:
Neither pine nor apple, the curiously named pineapple is native to the regions of South America that now make up Brazil and Paraguay. The Spanish were the first to ponder its piny-ness, calling it “piña” (pine cone), as well as “ananá,” a nod to the indigenous Tupi word “nanas,” which means “excellent fruit.” The Spanish are also said to have brought the fruit to the Philippines, which is now the world’s largest pineapple growing region—and also happens to be where Trader Joe’s 100% Pineapple Juice is made.

Trader Joe’s 100% Pineapple Juice isn’t just made with 100% Pineapple Juice (as in, that’s the only ingredient included), it’s also made with 100% of the pineapple (minus the foliage, of course)! Our supplier in the Philippines takes whole pineapples and puts them through a juicer, so not a single bit is lost—and not a single drop of concentrate is used, either. Fruit to juicer to can to Trader Joe’s—that’s a pretty succinct summation of how this Juice gets to you. Sweet and tropical with bright, balanced acidity, we recommend you chill it down and drink it straight, add it to your favorite cocktails and mocktails, or mix into a homemade marinade.
